title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
At Global IT Hub, we are more than a technology organization. We are a community of innovators, problem-solvers, and digital pioneers dedicated to accelerating Atlas Copco Group’s business potential through world-class technology solutions. Join us to shape the future of digital transformation, work on global challenges, and create impact for businesses and customers worldwide.

CLASSICAL MACHINE LEARNING | JOB DESCRIPTION

Role purpose Lead the design, validation, deployment and lifecycle ownership of production-grade classical machine learning solutions that convert business problems into measurable outcomes. The role combines deep algorithmic expertise, disciplined CRISP-DM execution, MLOps practices and senior technical leadership.

Role at a glance

Team

AI Team, Global IT Hub

Primary Stakeholders

Business product owners, IT, data engineering, analytics and domain teams

Experience

5+ years in data science / machine learning, including 3+ years owning production ML solutions

Education

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering or a related quantitative field

Key responsibilities

  • Partner with stakeholders to frame ambiguous business needs as well-defined machine learning problems, including decision context, baselines, constraints, risks and measurable success criteria.
  • Lead end-to-end delivery using CRISP-DM: business understanding, data understanding, data preparation, modeling, evaluation and deployment, with iteration and traceability across phases.
  • Design, train and compare classical supervised and unsupervised learning models; select the simplest approach that meets performance, interpretability, latency, scalability and cost requirements.
  • Own feature engineering, data leakage prevention, sampling strategy, cross-validation, hyperparameter optimization, threshold selection, calibration and robust error analysis.
  • Build reliable evaluation frameworks using fit-for-purpose metrics, statistical tests, confidence intervals, business-cost functions and champion-challenger comparisons.
  • Take models from experimentation to production with engineering teams, covering packaging, APIs or batch scoring, versioning, CI/CD, monitoring, retraining and rollback.
  • Own post-production performance, including drift detection, data-quality controls, incident analysis, model refresh decisions and communication of model limitations.
  • Apply explainability and responsible AI practices through model cards, reproducibility, bias and fairness checks, audit trails, privacy-aware design and human oversight.
  • Set technical standards, conduct design and code reviews, mentor data scientists, create reusable components and influence the classical ML roadmap.
  • Communicate recommendations, uncertainty, assumptions and trade-offs clearly to technical teams, business leaders and governance forums.

Mandatory Technical Skills

  • Advanced Python and SQL, with strong hands-on use of NumPy, Pandas, scikit-learn, SciPy and statsmodels; ability to write modular, tested and maintainable code.
  • Deep knowledge of regression and classification: linear and logistic regression, regularization, decision trees, Random Forest, Extra Trees, XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost, support vector machines, k-nearest neighbors, Naive Bayes and appropriate ensemble methods.
  • Strong understanding of unsupervised learning: k-means and hierarchical clustering, DBSCAN, PCA and other dimensionality-reduction methods, anomaly or outlier detection and segmentation evaluation.
  • Practical knowledge of forecasting and statistical modeling, including ARIMA/SARIMA, exponential smoothing, trend and seasonality, lag features, back-testing and prediction intervals.
  • Expertise in feature selection and engineering, missing-value treatment, categorical encoding, class imbalance, resampling, pipeline design and prevention of target leakage.
  • Rigorous evaluation skills across ROC-AUC, PR-AUC, precision, recall, F1, log loss, RMSE, MAE, MAPE/WAPE, lift, gain, calibration and business-impact metrics, selected according to the use case.
  • Hands-on optimization using grid, random or Bayesian search, with sound cross-validation design for grouped, temporal and imbalanced datasets.
  • Practical MLOps experience with experiment tracking, model registry, source control, automated testing, Docker, CI/CD, deployment and model or data monitoring.
  • Working knowledge of explainability techniques such as feature importance, permutation importance, partial dependence and SHAP, including their limitations.
  • Experience handling large structured datasets and collaborating on scalable data pipelines in a cloud or distributed environment.

Senior-level capabilities

  • Independently owns technical direction and delivery for complex ML use cases from discovery through production adoption.
  • Challenges weak problem formulations and prevents unnecessary use of ML when rules, analytics or simpler statistical methods are more suitable.
  • Makes defensible trade-offs among accuracy, interpretability, maintainability, latency and cost.
  • Reviews experimental design and model evidence before approving production release.
  • Mentors team members and raises standards for coding, documentation, reproducibility and stakeholder communication.

Good-to-have experience

  • Domain exposure in manufacturing, industrial operations, supply chain, service, pricing, finance, sales or customer analytics.
  • Optimization, causal inference, survival analysis, uplift modeling, recommendation systems, geospatial analytics or graph-based techniques.
  • Azure Machine Learning, Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, MLflow, Spark and enterprise data sources such as SAP.
  • Experience integrating classical ML models into applications, APIs, decision-support workflows or Power BI solutions.
  • Awareness of deep learning and generative AI, with the judgment to benchmark them against classical ML rather than defaulting to higher-complexity approaches.

Core algorithm and method coverage

Candidates are expected to demonstrate depth in several categories and sound model-selection judgment across the full landscape. This is not a requirement to have used every library or algorithm in production.

Capability area

Expected knowledge

Supervised learning

Regression, classification, tree ensembles, boosting, SVM, nearest-neighbor and probabilistic baselines.

Unsupervised learning

Clustering, dimensionality reduction, anomaly detection and segmentation validation.

Time-dependent modeling

Forecasting, temporal validation, lag and rolling features, seasonality and uncertainty.

Data and features

EDA, data-quality assessment, transformations, encoding, imbalance handling and leakage control.

Evaluation

Metric selection, baselines, validation design, statistical significance, calibration and business value.

Production lifecycle

Reproducibility, versioning, deployment, observability, drift, retraining and retirement.

Governance

Explainability, documentation, bias and fairness assessment, privacy, approvals and auditability.

What you can expect from us

  • Meaningful global business problems and access to cross-functional expertise.
  • Freedom to choose fit-for-purpose methods and challenge unnecessary complexity.
  • A collaborative environment focused on engineering quality, responsible AI and measurable value.
  • Opportunities to mentor, build reusable capabilities and shape the enterprise AI practice.

At Global IT Hub, we believe exceptional talent drives exceptional transformation. As a strategic partner for next-generation digital transformation, we empower our people to innovate boldly, collaborate globally, and turn ideas into solutions that create lasting business value. Join a team where learning never stops, innovation is part of our DNA, and your contribution helps shape the future of a global industry leader.

Role Evolution – Next 3–4 Years

  • Evolve from predictive modelling toward decision intelligence, combining prediction, causal analysis, simulation and optimization.
  • Build hybrid AI solutions integrating classical ML with Generative AI, foundation models and AI agents.
  • Establish systematic benchmarking across classical ML, deep learning and emerging AI models to select the best approach based on performance, explainability, scalability and cost.
  • Drive automation of the end-to-end ML lifecycle, including feature engineering, experimentation, deployment, monitoring, drift detection, retraining and model retirement.
  • Develop advanced model evaluation frameworks covering technical performance, business impact, robustness, explainability, fairness and operational reliability.
  • Advance model observability and continuous learning, proactively managing data drift, concept drift and model degradation.
  • Strengthen Responsible AI and model governance, including lineage, reproducibility, explainability, bias assessment, human oversight and auditability.
  • Develop reusable ML frameworks, components and engineering standards to accelerate enterprise-wide AI development.

title: Events Intern - Summer 2027
description:
Events Intern - Summer 2027
General Description
The Events Intern is a paid intern position at the Detroit Zoological Society. The Events Intern will work in the Events department and will assist the Event Managers, Supervisors, and Coordinator. Qualified and motivated candidates will have the opportunity to learn about all aspects of public and private events. The candidate will rotate between the Private Events team and the Public Events team.
This internship will focus on hands-on experience and will be responsible for assisting the Events department in event planning and event execution. This will include developing event ideas, working with local vendors, customers and staff, creating event documentation and executing event timelines. The Events Intern will also have the opportunity to serve as the point of contact on designated event days.
This job description is by no means all-inclusive and may be subject to change during a performance period due to the needs of the Detroit Zoological Society and its leadership. This document will be reviewed on a continual basis and will be modified as needed.
Principal Duties and Responsibilities
  • Assist in developing event concepts and themes.
  • Assist with coordination and execution of event logistics (e.g. banquet event orders, talent, vendors, etc.)
  • Assist with event timeline details including timing for promotional materials, date logos need to be received from sponsors, date promotional materials will be displayed, dates event talent/activities need to be confirmed, etc.
  • Assist with set up and tear down of events.
  • Meet customers at the start of their event and serve as point of contact for any needs that may arise.
  • Participate in DZS activities, meetings and events as required.
  • All other responsibilities and tasks as assigned by the Event Managers.
Qualifications
Education and Experience
  • Must be a college student enrolled in a relevant degree program.
Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
  • Interest in actively learning about event planning and development.
  • Ability to multitask and use creativity to develop new event concepts.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook.
  • Outgoing and friendly personality who enjoys working with people.
  • Work with accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work well as a team member or independently.
Working Conditions
Regular work schedule may include occasional evenings, weekends, early-mornings and holidays. The work environment is generally comfortable; some work is conducted indoors however the position does require work outdoors with exposure to seasonal weather conditions. This internship will run from May-August of 2027.
Physical Requirements
This position requires sitting, standing, walking, bending and stooping for extended periods, the ability to lift and move up to 40 pounds and the use of standard office equipment and the computer.
The individual must have the ability to perform the essential functions of the job satisfactorily with or without accommodations. Reasonable accommodations will be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the role.
Just as we value and celebrate biodiversity, the DZS celebrates the diversity of our human community. We are committed to ensuring that our programs and facilities are fully accessible to create a welcoming and inclusive workplace for all.

title: Senior Software Engineer (React Native)
description:
Epassi’s purpose is to boost everyday well-being.

We are a leading provider of employee benefit solutions in Europe. We were established in Finland in 2007, and in 2008 we were the first company to launch a mobile-payable employee benefit payment solution in Europe. Since then, we have consistently grown, diversifying our products and introducing our services into new markets. Epassi has been awarded by the Financial Times as one of the fastest-growing companies in Europe on multiple occasions.

Are you interested in joining of Europe's fastest growing companies? Do you want to impact the wellbeing of millions of employees?

If yes, then keep reading and join us to make an impact in a fast-paced and dynamic environment where you’ll play a key role in boosting everyday wellbeing, at home, at work. Everywhere!

Epassi’s purpose is to boost everyday well-being. We are a leading provider of employee benefit solutions across Europe. We were established in Finland in 2007, and in 2008 we were the first company to launch a mobile-payable employee benefit payment solution in Europe. Since then, we have consistently grown, diversifying our products and introducing our services into new markets.

Epassi has been awarded by the Financial Times as one of the fastest-growing companies in Europe on multiple occasions.

We are strengthening our mobile engineering team to build and scale a unified consumer app platform, starting in Germany and growing across the EU. This role exists to establish a solid, scalable React Native foundation built for long-term growth.

This role sits within the Engineering function and is part of a cross-functional product team of 8 engineers, one product owner, one designer, and one QA.

The Role

You will take ownership of the Epassi consumer mobile application - designing, building, and evolving it with quality, scalability, and long-term maintainability at the centre. You are the engineer who ensures our React Native app can grow as fast as our ambitions demand. You will contribute to architectural decisions and shape how we build, operate, and continuously improve mobile solutions across the Epassi group.

Success Criteria

  • The mobile app is stable, well-structured, and shipping reliably on a weekly delivery cadence within the first 90 days
  • Architectural patterns are in place that support long-term scalability and modularisation
  • Technical debt is actively identified and reduced, not just managed
  • You are a trusted, effective collaborator across Product, Design, Backend, QA, and DevOps

Key Responsibilities

Mobile Engineering (primary focus)

  • Build and maintain high-quality mobile features using React Native, TypeScript, and Expo
  • Write clean, testable, and maintainable code and hold peers to the same standard through code review
  • Integrate REST and/or GraphQL APIs in close collaboration with Backend Engineers
  • Monitor app behaviour, analyse issues, and support incident resolution
  • Write and maintain end-to-end tests (e.g. using Maestro or equivalent tooling) to ensure consistent quality

Architecture and Technical Ownership

  • Shape and refine the mobile app architecture with scalability and modularisation as guiding principles
  • Lead and contribute to architectural discussions and document decisions clearly
  • Proactively identify and reduce technical debt
  • Support build, release, and deployment processes for iOS and Android, including ownership of Google Play Console and App Store Connect processes

Release and Delivery

  • Own the full app release management cycle end-to-end, from build pipelines through to publishing on Google Play Console and App Store Connect
  • Manage source code using Git or equivalent source code management tools, maintaining clean branching and release practices
  • Work within a weekly delivery cadence: plan on Monday, demo to leadership on Friday
  • Participate in agile ceremonies (planning, refinements, reviews, retrospectives) while keeping meeting load lean so the team can focus on delivery

Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Product Owners and Designers to refine requirements and deliver user value
  • Collaborate with Backend, QA, and DevOps to support smooth operation under a "you build it, you run it" mindset
  • Leverage AI-native development tools and workflows (such as Copilot, Cursor, and Claude) to accelerate delivery and improve code quality - and set the standard for AI-assisted engineering practices across the team

You'll Be a Great Fit If You Have

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience with React Native (non-negotiable for this level)
  • A track record of delivering mobile applications or major features end-to-end
  • Solid experience with app release management, including Google Play Console, App Store Connect, or equivalent deployment tooling
  • Experience contributing to or shaping scalable mobile architectures in long-lived products
  • Worked effectively in cross-functional teams alongside Product, Design, and Backend
  • Comfortable working in a high-pace, high-change environment where the team ships weekly
  • Java experience is a bonus - useful given the team's cross-functional setup and occasional need for backend support

Your Key Attributes

  • Takes ownership of quality and reliability, not just the ticket
  • Communicates clearly and collaboratively across disciplines - engineers, designers, and product people alike
  • Comfortable operating in a high-pace environment where things move and change quickly
  • Proactive about raising and addressing technical debt rather than working around it
  • Embraces AI-native tooling as a genuine accelerant, not an afterthought
  • Languages: Fluent English required. German is a bonus.

Tools: React Native, TypeScript, Expo, Git, Google Play Console, App Store Connect, E2E testing tools (e.g. Maestro), AI development tools (Copilot, Cursor, Claude)

Why You Should Join Us

  • Be part of an ambitious growth journey and join a global community of driven, bold, entrepreneurial, yet humble Epassians in a company that is constantly evolving.
  • Work with a clear purpose — boosting everyday wellbeing — and create a meaningful, positive impact on both individuals and society.
  • Thrive in an open and inclusive culture with low hierarchy, where relationships are built on respect, camaraderie, and shared successes and challenges.
  • Come as you are — we’ll bring out the best in you and support your personal and professional growth.
  • Join a fast-growing tech company with a strong financial foundation, offering opportunities to grow and make an impact together with us.
  • Benefit from an inspiring and supportive work environment where employee wellbeing is a true priority.
  • Contribute to solidifying our position as the number one player in Europe’s employee benefit market and help shape the next wave of success.

title: Data Products Lead
description:
Data Products Lead

Dealpath is looking for a Data Products Lead to join our growing team and bring our powerful SaaS platform to institutional investment management firms.

This is a revenue role. You will own data products from the first query to the first paying customer and beyond, working directly with our CFO and our business development leaders. You will define what we sell, build it, put it in front of customers, and measure whether they come back and pay.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will:

  • Turn reporting into a product. Replace static reports with self-serve, permissioned analytics. Design how it is packaged and instrument usage so we know who logs in, who comes back and who converts.
  • Build and launch benchmark data products. Create market benchmarks from anonymized, aggregated data. Own the methodology, refresh SLAs and the quality bar a paying data customer will hold us to.
  • Own the data product layer. Design governed, multi-tenant models in Snowflake and dbt and the semantic layer in Omni: metric definitions, tests, freshness and correctness alerting, tenant isolation and entitlements.
  • Deliver data where clients work. Package data for delivery outside a dashboard: APIs, data feeds, warehouse shares and MCP tools. Build in the entitlements, usage metering and SLAs a paying data customer expects.
  • Normalize messy market data. Data arrives from many sources in different shapes. Resolve it into consistent entities customers can compare, and catch data gaps before a customer does.
  • Validate demand and pricing with the commercial team. Run design partnerships, time-boxed trials and willingness-to-pay tests. Bring the evidence that decides what we build, how we package it and what we charge.
  • Be the analytics partner to the business development team. Own the recurring analysis they rely on, including partner reporting, pilot success criteria and revenue attribution, so they can spend their time with customers.
  • Make it last. Write the metric definitions, document the usage rules for each product and leave work that others can maintain and extend.

How we think about AI for this role

We expect you to build with AI every day. You will use AI tools to write and test code, prototype products and document your work, and you will judge when AI output is accurate enough to put in front of a customer. You will also design data so AI agents, ours and our clients', can query it reliably.

What success looks like in your first year

We're excited that you have:

  • Commercial instinct. You can sit with a customer, work out what they would pay for, and turn it into a product, a metric and a price test.
  • Clear writing and speaking. You can explain a methodology to a broker, a product spec to an engineer and a result to a board member.
  • A bias to ship. You thrive in 0 to 1 work at a growth-stage company and ship in weeks, not quarters.

Qualifications

  • 8+ years in analytics, data science or analytics engineering, including at least one customer-facing data product you shipped to production and supported.

  • Delivered data to customers through APIs, data feeds or warehouse sharing (for example Snowflake Secure Data Sharing), with entitlements and usage tracking, not only through dashboards.
  • Owned a company's metric layer end to end: modeling, lineage, governance, tests and adoption by executives.
  • Statistical judgment: cohort and retention analysis, segmentation, experiment design, forecasting, and knowing when a number is noise.
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, statistics, economics or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Nice to haves

  • Commercial real estate, proptech, marketplace or two-sided network data.
  • Embedded analytics or data sold as its own product.
  • Data privacy and aggregation design: de-identification, minimum cell sizes, entitlements.
  • Built agentic workflows, MCP servers or retrieval on top of structured data.

The Perks & Culture

  • Medical, dental, & vision insurance coverage options
  • Flexible Spending Account
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Hybrid Work Policy, 3 days in office (Tues/Wed/Thur).
  • 401(k)
  • Company sponsored commuter benefits
  • Flexible time off policy
  • Catered lunches and snacks
  • Monthly wellness reimbursement
  • The estimated base pay range for California candidates is $190,000 - $215,000.
  • Your compensation will be based upon several factors including your experience, qualifications, education, location, and the skills assessed in Dealpath's interview process. Your actual compensation will be confirmed in writing at the time of offer.
  • Dealpath's compensation ranges are determined by current market data, so compensation data posted on our job posts may change as new market data becomes available.

About Dealpath

Dealpath is the world's largest and most trusted AI-powered operating system for real estate investing. To date, the platform has powered more than $10 trillion in transactions, partnering with hundreds of firms, including leading global institutions such as Blackstone, Nuveen, LaSalle, CBRE IM, MetLife, Newmark, Oxford Properties, New York Life, UBS, Manulife, DWS, and Principal.

By bringing together the only private exchange for institutional real estate listings, investment data, and intelligent execution workflows into a single platform, Dealpath enables firms to capture more opportunities, make faster decisions, execute efficiently, and deliver superior returns.

Our company is led by an experienced team and backed by a combination of top tier venture capital firms and strategic industry partners including: Blackstone, Nasdaq, 8VC, JLL Spark, WTI, GreenSoil Investments, LeFrak, Milstein, Bechtel, and Morgan Stanley Expansion Capital.

We value your voice! If you get excited about solving real business challenges and working closely with other smart folks in a winning culture, we'd love to meet you!

Equal Opportunity and Interview Process Notices

At Dealpath, we hire for talent, curiosity, and drive, not background or identity. We're committed to building a team that reflects the full range of perspectives and experiences, and we welcome applicants regardless of race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

If you need an accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please reach out to us at recruiting@dealpath.com. We're happy to help.

title: IT Security Specialist III
description:
About the Opportunity

The IT Security Specialist III will serve as the security lead for a cloud platform supporting a safety-of-life weather-warning system, integrating security practices across the software development lifecycle and cloud environments in a remote work environment. The platform runs on AWS with Kubernetes (EKS), uses a fully GitOps deployment model, and is defined entirely as infrastructure as code. It operates as a FISMA-Moderate environment and is maturing toward a multi-account federal landing zone. This role sits at the intersection of platform engineering, security, and compliance. The IT Security Specialist III will bring expertise in cloud security, DevSecOps, vulnerability management, compliance, and security automation as a senior member of a small, high-trust team that manages infrastructure through code and pipelines rather than manual processes.

Success in this role looks like secure, scalable, and compliant solutions that support rapid software delivery in a cloud-native environment.

What You Will Do in This Role

The IT Security Specialist III leads the design, automation, and oversight of security controls across cloud infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines.

Responsibilities include:

  • Integrate security controls and automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and software development processes.
  • Design and implement security architectures for AWS and/or Azure cloud environments.
  • Embed security guardrails into infrastructure-as-code and GitOps workflows, including policy-as-code, secrets management, and Kubernetes cluster hardening.
  • Conduct vulnerability assessments, security reviews, and remediation activities.
  • Develop and maintain security automation, monitoring, and compliance solutions.
  • Support compliance with federal security requirements, including NIST, FISMA, FedRAMP, and Zero Trust initiatives.
  • Support Authority to Operate (ATO) and continuous monitoring activities, including maintaining System Security Plans (SSPs), control evidence, and Plans of Action and Milestones (POA&Ms).
  • Collaborate with development, infrastructure, and operations teams to implement DevSecOps best practices.
  • Monitor security events, investigate findings, and support incident response activities.
  • Develop security documentation, policies, procedures, and technical guidance.
  • Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

What You Will Bring

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of cybersecurity, DevSecOps, or cloud security experience.
  • Experience securing AWS and/or Azure cloud environments.
  • Experience with CI/CD tools such as Git, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms.
  • Experience with container security and Kubernetes environments.
  • Knowledge of security frameworks, including NIST RMF, NIST 800-53, FISMA, and FedRAMP.
  • Experience with vulnerability management and security scanning tools.
  • Strong understanding of Identity and Access Management (IAM), Zero Trust, and secure coding practices.

Preferred Qualifications

  • One or more of the following certifications: CISSP, CCSP, AWS Certified Security – Specialty, Microsoft Azure Security Engineer Associate (AZ-500), Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist (CKS), or CompTIA Security+.

Work authorization/security clearance requirements

  • Ability to obtain a security clearance.

Work Environment

  • This work is normally completed in a remote environment.

Physical Demands

  • Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
  • Must be able to access and navigate each department at the organization's and client facilities.

Travel Required

  • No

Proficiency Requirement

  • The employee is expected to demonstrate proficiency in all essential job functions, tools, and processes related to this position within the first 90 days of employment. This includes acquiring a thorough understanding of job-specific responsibilities, systems, and workflows as outlined during onboarding and training. Failure to meet this requirement may result in additional training, reassessment, or other actions as deemed necessary by management.

About BioTissue & our Culture

At BioTissue, we transform the gift of life by sharing miracles. We are a diverse community, where talent and teamwork are core to who we are. Position Summary

As part of the BioTissue Surgical sales team, the OR Business Leader (OBL) will be responsible for leading business initiatives that drive regional sales within our Ocular Surgical product portfolio (specifically Amniograft and Amnioguard) engaging directly with ophthalmologists, across cornea, glaucoma, oculoplastics, retina and other subspecialties. The OBL will work closely with regional sales leadership and their respective sales representatives as well as with the marketing and enterprise sales teams to develop, execute and monitor sales plans. They will be a subject matter expert in BioTissue’s Surgical/OR products and mechanisms of action, with the goal of breaking into and developing new key surgical/OR customers and accounts. The OBL will have a solid track record of sales success including several years of above average sales performance, preferably with a related product line.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Drives Growth and Executes National Sales at the Regional Level

  • Leads key product sales campaigns within assigned region. Grow business in existing accounts as well as developing high utilization, training, case coverage and clear/consistent messaging for new and existing accounts.
  • Acts as OR Product/New Account Onboarding Specialist (Clinical application and technology). For instance: training surgeons, supporting OR cases, presenting to physicians/departments, etc
  • National expert on OR/Surgical Procedures – takes lead on field training, MD development, including running educational labs, supporting journal clubs and communication and implementation of commercial strategy and messaging.
  • Partners with the Marketing Group to craft field level initiatives that result in near term business growth.
  • Partners with the Surgical sales team and regional leadership to targets key accounts/fellowship programs and other KOL’s to launch/maximize GPO and IDN contracts.


Leads Regional Sales Planning, Execution, and Monitoring

  • Participates in regional and national sales meetings
  • Partners with Regional Sales Leadership to develop sales strategy for overall region and for key accounts within region
  • Develops metrics with AVP of Sales to monitor region sales performance to goals
  • Partners at field level to cultivate new accounts while growing business at existing accounts
  • Manages deployment of key resources at regional level to drive business performance
  • Creates monthly reports analyzing regional business performance

Develops Key Account Business Plan

  • Drives growth in sales of the Ocular Surgical products at key accounts within assigned region.
  • Develops written strategic business plan for developing key account business
  • Develops key relationships in targeted facilities and key accounts
  • Fosters the development of key opinion leaders within region; Partner with Director of Professional Education to create strong corporate relationship
  • Develops Key Account Business Plan


Drives Achievement of Regional & National Sales Goals

  • Facilitates key customer meetings to drive existing or new business
  • Provides expertise in clinical settings and at convention/sales meetings to promote sales and further BioTissue’s reputation in the marketplace.
  • Provides expertise for national and regional surgeon education and product sales training of company representatives.
  • Provides updates to the Product Manager and Sales Leadership regarding competition, product use, clinical updates, reimbursement and other important business metrics.
  • Conducts regular field sales visits with region sales reps to gain sales execution and professional development of the team.
  • Conducts product presentations or instruction to small and large groups to promote adoption and increased utilization at the customer level (inclusive of performing in-services for key healthcare staff)
  • Provides field support in areas of product reimbursement & product complaint handling


Skills & Abilities

Essential Duty Definition:

Position Expertise/Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree required

Type and Number of Years of Experience

  • Preferred 5-7 years of successful OR sales experience, 3+ years of outside medical sales experience, preferably with regenerative product line.
  • Previous record of above quota sales performance
  • Previous record of success at the institutional setting
  • Skilled at coaching / developing sales colleagues
  • Demonstrated analytical, written, and verbal skills
  • Demonstrated confidence to communicate with surgeons and hospital personnel
  • Demonstrated competence of anatomy and physiology as it pertains to the Biotissue’s product lines
  • Must possess a valid driver’s license

Physical Requirements

  • Must be able to lift and carry 50lbs

Travel Requirements

  • Travel is required by automobile, train, bus, and airplane within the Region
  • Travel may extend outside assigned territory when product assistance is required
  • Travel responsibilities extend to corporate office, professional conventions and conferences, and any other determined by director


Compensation:

The posted salary range reflects base compensation only and represents the company’s good-faith estimate of the base pay for this position at the time of posting. Actual base salary will depend on factors such as skills, experience, qualifications, location, and business needs.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible to participate in a variable commission plan. Commission earnings are based on individual and/or company performance under the terms of the applicable commission plan.

Education

Experience

One year experience as Special Studies Technologist I with PHH, Inc., OR Required

A minimum of two years of experience in performing technical work which must have included as primary responsibility of radiographic examinations and two or more of the following: mammography, magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), computerized tomography (CT), and special procedures (including angiography).

Possession of valid California CRT license, Fluoroscopy Certification
Current BLS
ARRT required
Specialized training in Interventional Radiography, CT or MRI
Registration in CT, MRI, or Vascular Intervention preferred
Venipuncture certification within six months of hire/transfer

Hospital established policies quality assurance program, safety, environmental and infection control policies and procedures.

The more common radiology equipment and instruments used in a hospital setting, basis radiography and at least two of the following: Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI), Computerized Tomography, mammography, special procedures (Angiography) procedures.

Anatomy and Physiology.

Processing and evaluating quality images.

Ability to:

Operate equipment used in Radiology and two of the following: MRI, CT Scan, Mammography and Angiography.

Understand, interpret, and apply rules, regulations, standards, and procedures.

Keep abreast of developments in the field of expertise.

Communicate effectively, both orally and in writing.

Prepare necessary reports and records.

Establish and maintain effective working relationships with the public, physicians and fellow employees.

OVERVIEW: The Irrigation Technician at Boca West Country Club is responsible for the installation, maintenance, and repair of the golf courses' irrigation systems across four luxurious courses. This experienced professional ensures optimal water distribution, promotes healthy turf, and supports the aesthetic and operational excellence of the golf courses through expert irrigation management.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Irrigation System Maintenance & Repair

  • Conduct routine inspections, troubleshooting, and repairs of irrigation systems, including valves, heads, controllers, and pumps.
  • Diagnose and resolve issues promptly to minimize water waste and maximize system efficiency.
  • Perform seasonal start-up and shut-down procedures for irrigation systems.

Installation & Upgrades

  • Assist in the installation of new irrigation components, upgrades, and system expansions.
  • Support system design modifications to improve coverage, efficiency, and water conservation.

Monitoring & System Management

  • Use computerized controllers and weather data to optimize watering schedules.
  • Regularly calibrate and test system components to ensure proper operation.
  • Record maintenance activities and system modifications accurately.

Water Management & Conservation

  • Monitor water usage and identify opportunities for conservation.
  • Support compliance with water usage regulations and club policies.

Tools, Equipment & Inventory Management

  • Track parts and supplies, and assist in inventory control.
  • Report equipment issues or supply shortages to supervisors.

Safety & Compliance

  • Handle chemicals, tools, and equipment safely and responsibly.
  • Promote environmentally sustainable irrigation practices.

Team Collaboration

  • Work closely with the maintenance team, grounds staff, and supervisors.
  • Assist with training or mentoring junior irrigation staff.
  • Communicate effectively about maintenance needs and project progress.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Proven experience in irrigation system installation, repair, and maintenance.
  • Strong knowledge of irrigation controls, valves, piping, and pumps.
  • Ability to troubleshoot electrical and hydraulic issues.
  • Familiarity with computerized irrigation controllers and weather-based irrigation systems.
  • Valid driver’s license; certifications such as TCEQ, NCID, or equivalent are a plus.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

Preferred Attributes

  • Excellent organizational and communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

title: Supervisor, Gearbox Assembly
description:
HORSBURGH & SCOTT
Job Description – Gearbox Assembly Supervisor
Job Title: Gearbox Assembly Supervisor
Department: Manufacturing Operations – Gearbox Assembly & Repair
POSITION SUMMARY
Horsburgh & Scott is seeking an experienced, hands-on Gearbox Assembly Supervisor to lead daily operations within our industrial gearbox assembly, disassembly, inspection, and repair department.
This position is responsible for supervising assembly technicians and mechanics, coordinating production activities, maintaining quality standards, and ensuring customer orders are completed safely, efficiently, and on schedule.
The ideal candidate will have a strong mechanical background in industrial gearboxes, power transmission equipment, and heavy industrial machinery, combined with proven leadership experience in a manufacturing or repair environment.
The Gearbox Assembly Supervisor must be comfortable working directly on the shop floor, providing technical guidance, resolving mechanical challenges, and holding employees accountable for productivity, quality, safety, and performance.
ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES
1. Production Leadership & Daily Operations
  • Supervise daily gearbox assembly, disassembly, inspection, troubleshooting, and repair operations.
  • Coordinate daily work assignments based on customer priorities, production schedules, manpower availability, and delivery requirements.
  • Establish clear daily production goals and communicate expectations to employees.
  • Monitor job progress and proactively address issues that could impact production timelines.
  • Ensure technicians are working efficiently and effectively while maintaining quality standards.
  • Work closely with Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, and Planning to resolve production challenges.
  • Coordinate overtime and rotating weekend coverage to meet customer commitments.
  • Maintain a strong shop-floor presence and provide hands-on assistance when necessary.
2. Gearbox Assembly & Technical Oversight
  • Oversee the disassembly, inspection, rebuilding, and assembly of industrial gearboxes and related power transmission equipment.
  • Provide technical guidance regarding bearings, seals, shafts, gears, housings, and other mechanical components.
  • Ensure proper assembly procedures, tolerances, fits, and mechanical specifications are followed.
  • Verify critical measurements, clearances, bearing settings, gear contact patterns, backlash, and alignment.
  • Assist employees in troubleshooting complex mechanical problems.
  • Ensure proper use of precision measuring instruments, lifting equipment, hydraulic tools, and assembly equipment.
  • Review engineering drawings, assembly instructions, technical specifications, and work orders.
  • Coordinate testing, inspections, and final quality verification before equipment is released.
  • Identify opportunities to improve assembly processes, tooling, and repair methods.
3. Employee Supervision & Development
  • Provide direct supervision, coaching, and technical support to gearbox assembly technicians and mechanics.
  • Establish and communicate clear performance expectations.
  • Monitor employee attendance, productivity, work quality, and adherence to company policies.
  • Conduct employee performance evaluations and provide ongoing feedback.
  • Identify employee training needs and coordinate technical development.
  • Support onboarding and hands-on training of new employees.
  • Develop employee versatility through cross-training and skills development.
  • Address performance and behavioral concerns promptly and professionally in coordination with Human Resources.
  • Promote teamwork, accountability, professionalism, and a positive working environment.
4. Productivity, Efficiency & Continuous Improvement
  • Monitor labor hours against estimated job hours and production targets.
  • Identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, and opportunities to reduce assembly and repair cycle times.
  • Improve productivity through effective manpower planning and workflow management.
  • Minimize rework, downtime, and unnecessary labor costs.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives focused on safety, quality, productivity, and customer satisfaction.
  • Work with Operations and Engineering to develop standardized assembly procedures.
  • Ensure accurate reporting of labor hours, job progress, and production activity.
  • Drive accountability for meeting established production and delivery goals.
5. Quality Control & Customer Commitments
  • Ensure all gearbox assemblies and repairs meet engineering specifications, customer requirements, and company quality standards.
  • Verify that inspection and assembly documentation is accurate and complete.
  • Ensure all critical measurements and assembly requirements are properly documented.
  • Address quality concerns immediately and coordinate corrective actions.
  • Support root-cause investigations involving assembly failures, rework, or customer complaints.
  • Maintain a strong focus on first-time quality and reducing warranty-related issues.
  • Coordinate with Operations leadership to ensure customer delivery commitments are achieved.
6. Safety & Workplace Organization
  • Enforce all company safety policies and OSHA requirements.
  • Ensure proper use of personal protective equipment and safe lifting and rigging practices.
  • Conduct routine safety observations and address unsafe conditions immediately.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and efficient assembly department.
  • Promote 5S workplace organization and continuous safety improvement.
  • Ensure tools, equipment, and work areas are maintained in safe operating condition.
  • Participate in safety meetings, incident investigations, and corrective action initiatives.
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in industrial gearbox assembly, mechanical repair, heavy equipment maintenance, or a related manufacturing environment.
  • Previous supervisory, team lead, or demonstrated leadership experience.
  • Strong mechanical knowledge of industrial gearboxes, gear drives, bearings, shafts, seals, and power transmission equipment.
  • Ability to read and interpret mechanical drawings, blueprints, and technical specifications.
  • Experience using precision measuring equipment and mechanical assembly tools.
  • Demonstrated ability to supervise employees and coordinate multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Strong understanding of production scheduling, labor utilization, and manufacturing efficiency.
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex mechanical and assembly issues.
  • Strong communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced manufacturing environment with changing customer priorities.
  • Willingness and availability to work rotating weekends and additional hours based on operational requirements.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
  • 7–10 years of experience in industrial gearbox assembly, rebuilding, or heavy mechanical repair.
  • Experience supervising gearbox mechanics or industrial assembly technicians.
  • Experience with large industrial gear reducers, custom gearboxes, and heavy-duty power transmission systems.
  • Familiarity with gearbox inspection, failure analysis, and root-cause investigations.
  • Experience working in a job-shop or engineered-to-order manufacturing environment.
  • Knowledge of ERP systems, production reporting, and labor tracking.
  • Experience implementing Lean Manufacturing, 5S, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Technical degree, apprenticeship, or equivalent hands-on mechanical experience preferred.
WORK SCHEDULE & AVAILABILITY
Regular Schedule: Monday through Friday, 6:00 AM – 2:30 PM.
Rotating Weekend Requirements:
Due to the nature of our industrial gearbox repair and manufacturing operations, this position requires flexibility to support customer demands and production commitments.
  • Rotating weekend assignments will be scheduled based on operational needs.
  • Weekend coverage may be required to support critical customer projects, emergency repairs, and production deadlines.
  • Additional hours may be necessary to ensure completion of customer orders and maintain production schedules.
  • The supervisor is expected to coordinate staffing and provide leadership coverage during assigned weekend operations.
PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS & WORK ENVIRONMENT
  • Ability to work in an industrial manufacturing and mechanical assembly environment.
  • Ability to stand, walk, bend, reach, and move throughout the manufacturing facility for extended periods.
  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds with or without reasonable accommodation; mechanical lifting equipment is available for heavier components.
  • Exposure to manufacturing equipment, industrial machinery, noise, and typical shop-floor conditions.
  • Required use of appropriate personal protective equipment.
  • Ability to safely work around heavy industrial equipment and lifting operations.
IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE
The successful Gearbox Assembly Supervisor will be a hands-on manufacturing leader who understands industrial gearbox assembly and repair operations.
We are seeking an individual who:
  • Leads by example and maintains a strong presence on the shop floor.
  • Understands the importance of customer deadlines and production commitments.
  • Can balance technical problem-solving with employee supervision.
  • Holds employees accountable while providing coaching and development.
  • Takes ownership of departmental productivity, quality, and performance.
  • Communicates effectively with employees, management, and supporting departments.
  • Thrives in a custom manufacturing and repair environment where priorities can change quickly.
WHY JOIN HORSBURGH & SCOTT?
Horsburgh & Scott has a 140-year history of providing engineered gearing solutions, industrial gearboxes, and power transmission products to customers across a wide range of industries.
We offer the opportunity to work with complex industrial equipment, lead an experienced team of mechanical professionals, and play a critical role in delivering high-quality products and repair services to our customers.
Equal Employment Opportunity
Horsburgh & Scott is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees without regard to legally protected characteristics.

description:

Job Description

The Lead Youth Development Specialist is responsible for ensuring youth development principles are being incorporated into programs and activities. They also serve as a backup to the Unit Director and assist with the facilitation of all programs.

The Youth Development Youth Professional is part of a team-oriented Club staff dedicated to serving our youth and creating an optimal Club Experience. This position will plan, supervise, and implement various high-yield activities and targeted programs with a focus on health and life skills.

This position is responsible for ensuring youth development principles are incorporated into all programs and activities; providing guidance and discipline to ensure a safe and positive environment for youth; ensuring the incorporation of age-appropriate and gender-specific programs and activities; ensuring that culturally diverse programs are implemented; assisting, as needed, in the planning, implementation, and delivery of activities and programs for youth ages 6 to 18.

KEY ROLES (Essential Job Responsibilities):

Prepare Youth for Success

This position’s primary responsibilities are:

  • Assist with planning and implementing a variety of youth programs for members of all ages
  • Recruiting and retaining youth for all programs
  • Working with other staff in the club to help implement these programs throughout the school year
  • Arrange and invite career professionals to engage with youth about career paths
  • Serves as a backup to the Unit Director when necessary

This position helps members to make appropriate choices about their education, career, and social, physical, and emotional needs. The position also assesses youth's developmental needs, interests, and characteristics to develop targeted programs that result in an outcome-driven club experience.

  1. Ensure that all club members experience the STEM programming as outlined in the 21st Century Community Learning Centers narrative. Participate in specialized STEM training with BGCNF's community partner, STEM2Hub. In addition, the STEM YDP will interface with the school science teachers to ensure the afterschool STEM programs align and complement the school programming.
  1. Ensure programs, services, and activities prepare youth for success, promoting the safety of members, quality of programs, and appearance of the Club at all times. Provide guidance and role modeling to members.
  1. Contribute to the planning and implementation of the strategic plan by:
  • Planning and organizing a range of program services and activities for members, such as field trips, program-specific activities, guest speakers, field trips, etc.
  • Initiating new programs with the approval of the Program Director/Unit Director.
  • Promoting and stimulating program participation.
  1. Ensure quality improvement by monitoring and evaluating program achievement against target goals, recommending modifications that respond to member needs and interests, and participating in weekly Club staff meetings.
  1. Participate in local, state, regional, and national Boys & Girls Clubs Career Development programs and competitions.

Health and Safety

  1. Ensure a healthy and safe environment, supervising members in the program area.
  2. Maintain the cleanliness of the program area.
  3. Maintain an inventory of program equipment and supplies in good order. Recommend requisitions as necessary.

Program Administration

  1. Prepare weekly reports for the Program Director/Unit Director regarding activities, special programs, upcoming events, attendance, and other reports as required.
  2. Maintains a daily written schedule. Ensures that programs begin and end on time.

ADDITIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES

  1. May participate in additional special programs and/or events.

title: Senior Creative Designer
description:
In a world where old school soft drinks, unnecessary food waste and outdated business practices are a thing of the past, DASH is leading the healthy hydration revolution. We infuse our super tasty waters with real wonky fruit. That's the bent, crushed, misshapen fruit that supermarkets say no to. No sugar, no sweeteners, no worries.

DASH launched in 2017 and has quickly become the market leading brand in a category that has grown over 60% YoY in the UK. DASH has an industry-leading DTC platform, and in 2026 we will sell over 56 million cans in 20+ international markets with notable retailers including: Sainsbury's, Tesco, Waitrose, Ocado and M&S.

We are incredibly proud to say that we are a Certified B Corporation. We always intend to use our business as a force for good, and now it's official.

Job role:

We're looking for a Senior Creative Designer to join our Brand + Creative team, reporting into our Design Lead. This is a hands-on role for a highly creative, passionate designer who is as comfortable setting creative vision and leading on concepts as they are opening Illustrator and designing themselves.

You'll work across every DASH touchpoint, with a focus on marketing campaigns, driving brand buzz and retail-led partnerships, bringing big, strategically grounded ideas to life in a way that balances creative ambition with commercial reality. Tapped into culture and always looking beyond our category, you'll bring fresh thinking from the worlds of lifestyle, fashion, design and food and drink to keep DASH distinctive and impossible to ignore.

Key responsibilities:

  • Partner with brand leadership and the Design Lead to turn brand vision and business objectives into compelling creative concepts, owning the idea from brief to final design and shaping how it's brought to life
  • Bring strategic thinking to every brief, grounding ideas in consumer insight and brand strategy, and help shape DASH's longer-term creative direction
  • Craft high-quality work across key brand touchpoints, from marketing comms to packaging, POS, retailer partnerships and in-store
  • Drive brand buzz through standout creative for launches, campaigns, cultural moments and retail-led partnerships, working closely with commercial colleagues on ideas that get people talking and drive sales in store
  • Build visually led pitch decks and confidently present ideas to internal teams, retailers and partners, while staying open to feedback
  • Act as guardian of the DASH brand identity across in-house and agency-led projects, whether producing campaigns fully in house or guiding external agencies
  • Manage multiple projects to timelines, budgets and retailer requirements

Requirements

  • Significant experience in a senior designer or creative role, with a strong track record across creative concepting and graphic design
  • Proven experience creating integrated marketing comms, campaigns and retail pitches or in-store creative. Experience with brand partnerships or retail-led activations is a big plus
  • Experience within FMCG, beauty, fashion or lifestyle, ideally with brands that operate in a fast-paced retail environment
  • A standout portfolio that shows big-picture conceptual thinking, a clear creative rationale behind every idea and exceptional design craft
  • Expert in Adobe Creative Suite; Figma experience ideal
  • Experience in packaging design, setting up print-ready files and working closely with printers and packaging suppliers independently is a bonus

About you:

At DASH, we're looking for people who take ownership and follow things through, even when it gets challenging. You're someone who cuts through complexity, focuses on what matters and turns ideas into action. You're proactive, thoughtful in your approach and not afraid to share your perspective openly and honestly. You use AI as a natural part of how you work not because you've been told to, but because you're always looking for smarter faster ways to get to better outcomes. You don't need to be an expert, but you're curious, you experiment, and you're not precious about how things have always been done

  • Free tasty breakfast in the office
  • Regular social events with the team
  • Dynamic and supportive working environment
  • As much DASH as you can drink!

DASH Water is committed to employing a diverse workforce and providing a supportive environment for employees from all backgrounds. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability or age. title: Grafik Produktowy/Senior Product Graphic Designer (k/m/x)
description:
Szukamy doświadczonego grafika, który łączy kreatywność i wyczucie estetyki z praktyczną znajomością projektowania produktów i przygotowania ich do produkcji.

Na tym stanowisku będziesz mieć realny wpływ na wygląd naszych kolekcji – od projektowania nadruków, wzorów i grafik produktowych, przez opakowania, metki i etykiety, aż po finalne przygotowanie materiałów do druku. Zależy nam na osobie, która potrafi samodzielnie prowadzić projekty, dostrzega trendy i przekłada je na spójne rozwiązania odpowiadające charakterowi marki Moraj.

Jeśli masz doświadczenie w projektowaniu dla branży fashion, dbasz o detale i chcesz współtworzyć produkty, które trafiają do klientów – zapraszamy do naszego zespołu w Żorach.

Twój zakres obowiązków

  • Projektowanie opakowań i materiałów produktowych: kompleksowe tworzenie projektów opakowań, wykrojników, metek, hangtagów, etykiet, instrukcji oraz materiałów POS.

  • Tworzenie nadruków i wzornictwa: projektowanie grafik, printów oraz wzorów umieszczanych bezpośrednio na produktach i ich akcesoriach.

  • Przygotowanie do druku: profesjonalne przygotowywanie plików produkcyjnych oraz nadzór nad poprawnością odwzorowania kolorów i detali.

  • Co-branding i rozwój marki: tworzenie spójnej identyfikacji wizualnej linii produktowych zgodnej z trendami rynkowymi i identyfikacją marki.

  • Mentoring i wsparcie zespołu: dzielenie się wiedzą z zespołem oraz dbanie o wysoki standard estetyczny i techniczny powstających projektów.

Nasze wymagania

  • Wykształcenie: Preferowane wykształcenie wyższe lub średnie związane z grafiką komputerową, projektowaniem, sztuką wizualną, modą lub pokrewnymi dziedzinami.

  • Doświadczenie zawodowe: Minimum 3 lata doświadczenia w pracy na stanowisku Graphic Designer w branży odzieżowej lub podobnej. Doświadczenie w pracy z markami odzieżowymi lub projektowaniu elementów związanych z modą, takich jak nadruki na tkaninach, wzory, etykiety, grafiki do katalogów, ikonografiki.

  • Znajomość programów graficznych: Biegłość w obsłudze programów Adobe (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Adobe XD), Affinity Designer lub podobnych narzędzi do projektowania graficznego.

  • Rysunek i ilustracja: Umiejętność tworzenia i modyfikowania rysunków, ilustracji, szablonów nadruków, wzorów tekstylnych. Umiejętność odręcznego rysowania oraz malowania

  • Znajomość technologii druku: Zrozumienie różnych metod druku (np. sitodruk, sublimacja, nadruk cyfrowy) oraz ich zastosowań w odzieży.

  • Zmysł artystyczny: Kreatywność i umiejętność tworzenia projektów graficznych, które wpisują się w aktualne trendy mody oraz stylistykę marki.

  • Znajomość trendów w modzie oraz grafice: Bieżąca znajomość światowych trendów w branży odzieżowej oraz umiejętność ich interpretacji w kontekście graficznym.

  • Praca z kolorami: Doskonałe wyczucie palety barw, umiejętność tworzenia harmonijnych kompozycji kolorystycznych.

  • Projektowanie wzorów odzieżowych: Umiejętność projektowania grafik, które będą aplikowane na tkaninach, odzieży sportowej, streetwearowej, casualowej itp.

  • Cechy osobiste: wysokie poczucie estetyki, dbałość o detale, samodzielność w działaniu i umiejętność pracy pod presją czasu.

To oferujemy

  • Stabilne zatrudnienie – umowa o pracę.

  • Prywatną opiekę medyczną Medicover – zdrowie masz u nas pod ręką.

  • Kartę Medicover Sport – żeby zadbać o siebie po pracy.

  • Elastyczny start dnia – bez stresu, że się spóźnisz.

  • Wpływ na to, co tworzymy – Twoje pomysły naprawdę mają znaczenie.

  • Nowoczesne środowisko pracy – technologia, procesy i zgrany zespół.

  • Wszystkie potrzebne narzędzia – laptop, telefon i realne wsparcie.

Poznaj Moraj – wygodnie być sobą!

Jesteśmy polską marką fashion z ponad 30-letnim doświadczeniem. Tworzymy odzież i akcesoria, które łączą wygodę, funkcjonalność i styl. Nasze produkty trafiają do klientów, którzy cenią komfort i możliwość wyrażania siebie.

Za marką Moraj stoi zespół ludzi o różnych kompetencjach, doświadczeniach i pomysłach. Wspólnie rozwijamy nasze kolekcje, dbamy o jakość produktów i szukamy nowych inspiracji. Wierzymy, że dobre projekty powstają tam, gdzie kreatywność idzie w parze ze współpracą, odpowiedzialnością i zaufaniem.

W codziennej pracy kierujemy się pięcioma wartościami:

  • Szacunek – dbamy o dobre relacje i wzajemne traktowanie.

  • Współpraca – wiemy, że najlepsze efekty osiągamy razem.

  • Zaangażowanie – cenimy inicjatywę i odpowiedzialność za swoją pracę.

  • Rozwój – wspieramy zdobywanie wiedzy i nowych umiejętności.

  • Zaufanie – dajemy przestrzeń do samodzielności i realizacji pomysłów.

Nasze hasło „Wygodnie być sobą” to nie tylko idea, która przyświeca naszym produktom. To również podejście do ludzi i współpracy, które chcemy budować każdego dnia.

title: Salesperson - Hazleton Hyundai
description:
Timbrook Automotive is seeking motivated, customer-focused individuals to join our sales team as an Automotive Salesperson. This position requires strong communication skills, professionalism, attention to detail, and a commitment to providing an exceptional customer experience.

title: Principal Java Engineer - Distributed Systems, Serverless - Elasticsearch
description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What Is The Role:

We are on the lookout for a Principal Software Engineer to join our Elasticsearch - Distributed Systems team and focus on how Elasticsearch provides scale, performance, and resilience, especially in the context of our Serverless offering. You will be tackling deep distributed systems challenges in how nodes in an Elasticsearch cluster communicate, and how data are indexed, allocated, and managed across nodes.

What You Will Be Doing:

  • Leveraging your deep distributed systems expertise to design, build, and operate core pieces of our next-generation Serverless Elasticsearch offering, directly impacting the experience of customers worldwide.
  • Improving Elasticsearch’s components that support concurrent and consistent indexing across multiple machines.
  • Maintaining our cluster coordination system to keep performance high even though nodes come and go from the cluster and data moves around, while maintaining the safety and liveness properties of the system as a whole.
  • Pushing the limits on the number of shards, nodes, and petabytes that Elasticsearch can handle today.
  • Looking into all kinds of issues, including performance or concurrency issues, and proposing solutions.
  • Supporting our support engineers with the harder problems.
  • Owning operational investigations end-to-end, until performance or stability issues are successfully resolved.

What You Bring:

title: Financieel Adviseur Zorgfinanciering | Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport
description:
Omschrijving

Wij zijn voor het Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport (VWS) op zoek naar een ervaren Financieel Adviseur Zorgfinanciering. De opdracht wordt uitgevoerd binnen de directie Informatiebeleid/CIO (DICIO), waar wordt gewerkt aan digitale innovatie, gegevensuitwisseling, AI, cybersecurity en gezondheidsdata in de zorg.

Binnen deze opdracht speel je een belangrijke rol in de voorbereiding van de nieuwe Gezondheidsdata Autoriteit (GDA). Deze nieuwe organisatie brengt verschillende taken en financieringsstromen samen die momenteel bij meerdere organisaties zijn belegd. Je analyseert complexe financieringsvraagstukken, brengt risico’s en afhankelijkheden in kaart en adviseert over een toekomstbestendige financiële inrichting van de organisatie. Daarnaast ben je verantwoordelijk voor het financieel beheer van het programma GDA.

Dit is een interessante opdracht voor een senior financieel adviseur met ervaring binnen de overheid, zorgfinanciering, bekostigingsmodellen en organisatieveranderingen.

Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

  • Je brengt bestaande financieringsstromen in kaart, inclusief budgetten, wettelijke grondslagen, verantwoordingslijnen en verdeelsleutels.

  • Je analyseert financiële risico’s, overlap en knelpunten die ontstaan bij de inrichting van de nieuwe organisatie.

  • Je adviseert programmamanagement en opdrachtgever over de financiële inrichting, begrotingsstructuur en bekostiging van de GDA.

  • Je werkt financiële scenario’s en doorrekeningen uit en vertaalt deze naar heldere bestuurlijke adviezen.

  • Je stemt af met ministeries, financiers, uitvoeringsorganisaties en andere betrokken partijen over financiële afspraken en budgetoverdrachten.

  • Je adviseert over financiële sturing, rechtmatigheid en de planning- & controlcyclus.

  • Je beheert en monitort de financiën van het programma GDA.

Wat vragen wij?

Eisen:

  • Je beschikt over wo werk- en denkniveau, aantoonbaar door een afgeronde opleiding zoals bedrijfseconomie, gezondheidseconomie of bestuurskunde, of minimaal 8 jaar relevante werkervaring op wo-niveau.

  • Je hebt minimaal 8 jaar ervaring als financieel adviseur, controller of beleidsadviseur financiën.

  • Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring binnen het overheidsdomein, bijvoorbeeld bij het Rijk, een uitvoeringsorganisatie, ZBO, gemeente of zorgkantoor.

Aanvullende wensen:

  • Je hebt ervaring met transities, decentralisaties of het herinrichten van bekostigingsmodellen.

  • Je hebt kennis van financieringsstromen en bekostigingsmodellen binnen het zorglandschap en landelijke gezondheidsdata-infrastructuren.

title: Private GP & Health Screening Doctor Opportunities | London | Work-life balance & structured days
description:
Opportunity

An outstanding opportunity has arisen to join one of the UK’s leading private healthcare services as a GP / Advanced Health Screening Doctor. Positions are available across London and at the Glasgow city site. We are seeking a motivated and clinically excellent GP who wants to focus on prevention, continuity of care and high-quality health assessment, rather than high-volume reactive medicine.

This is a clinically rewarding and professionally refreshing post. You will see pre-booked, privately insured corporate patients, with the time to get to know them and deliver thorough, proactive care. You will also have rapid access to advanced diagnostics and specialist networks through a wider hospital group.

There are no weekends, no evening clinics, no walk-ins and no home visits. Days are structured with fixed start and end times, on 3, 4 or 5 day contracts. A comprehensive orientation programme means previous health screening experience is desirable but not essential.

This post offers a genuine chance to build a sustainable, well-supported career in private general practice within a leading UK provider.

Key Responsibilities

Health Screening

  • Deliver comprehensive health screening assessments for pre-booked, privately insured corporate patients.
  • Lead consultations that focus on prevention, early identification of risk and personalised health advice.
  • Interpret screening results and communicate findings clearly, with appropriate follow-up and onward referral where required.
  • Use rapid access to advanced diagnostics and specialist networks through the wider hospital group to ensure timely, joined-up care.

General Practice & Continuity of Care

  • Provide high-quality general practice consultations with time to build lasting relationships with your patients.
  • Perform cervical screening, vaccinations, venepuncture and ECGs as part of everyday practice.
  • Manage patients’ ongoing health needs, offering continuity of care in a calm, unhurried setting.
  • Work to a structured day of two 4-hour sessions, each with protected admin time.

Training, Development & Team Working

  • Complete the 12-week orientation programme, including the dedicated GP Academy, shadowing and full health screening training.
  • Work with your named GP mentor during onboarding and ongoing development.
  • Contribute to a collegiate clinical team and maintain high standards of governance, documentation and patient safety.
  • Make use of study leave to support your continued professional development.

Essential Criteria to Apply

Qualifications & Registration

  • Full registration with the General Medical Council (GMC) with a licence to practise.
  • Inclusion on the GMC GP Register.
  • A minimum of one year of post-qualification GP experience.

Clinical Experience & Skills

  • Confident performing cervical screening, vaccinations, venepuncture and ECGs.
  • Excellent communication skills and a patient-centred approach, with a genuine interest in prevention and continuity of care.
  • Previous health screening experience is desirable but not essential, as full training is provided.

What’s on Offer for You?

  • Permanent salaried position on a 3, 4 or 5 day contract: up to £104,000 per annum (£10,400 per clinical session).
  • Additional Health Screening Allowance of £8,000 to £12,000 per annum, subject to screening activity and service requirements.
  • Work-life balance: no weekends, no evening clinics, no walk-ins and no home visits.
  • Structured days with fixed start and end times: two 4-hour sessions a day, with a 1-hour lunch and 30 minutes of protected admin time in each session.
  • Pre-booked appointments with engaged, privately insured corporate patients, with time for continuity of care.
  • Rapid access to advanced diagnostics and specialist networks through a wider hospital group.
  • A 12-week orientation programme including a dedicated GP Academy, a named GP mentor, shadowing and full health screening training.
  • Paid indemnity.
  • Private medical insurance for you and your family, dental cover, pension, critical illness cover and life assurance.
  • Up to 5 days’ paid study leave on top of annual leave
  • Skilled worker visa sponsorship is applicable

Location in detail

Working in London means being part of one of the world’s great medical hubs, with a diverse patient population, excellent transport links and everything the capital has to offer on your doorstep. Our London locations are well connected and easy to reach, so you can choose a site that suits your commute and lifestyle.

About Pulse Healthcare Doctors

Pulse Healthcare Doctors is a leading medical recruitment partner, supporting NHS Trusts and Private healthcare organisations across the UK. We work closely with hospitals to connect talented doctors with outstanding permanent and fixed-term career opportunities.

To discuss this opportunity in confidence or to submit your application, please contact Stuart on the email address: stuart.sutherland@pulsejobs.com

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
At Zensai, we're looking for a experienced Product Manager to help shape the next chapter of our Human Success Platform, bringing learning, performance management, and employee engagement together inside Microsoft 365.

We're rethinking existing workflows, exploring what agentic AI makes possible, and improving how our products help organizations and their people succeed. There's plenty to figure out, and we're looking for people who enjoy tackling complex problems and turning ideas into something useful.

You'll own a product area end to end, working closely with Design, Engineering, and the wider business. You'll also help us evolve how we build products, with more emphasis on discovery, evidence, and outcomes rather than simply shipping features.

What you’ll be doing

  • Own your product area, end to end. Set direction, identify opportunities, drive discovery and delivery, and take responsibility for what happens after launch. You're accountable for outcomes, as well as output.

  • Understand the people and the practices behind the product. Our buyers and users aren't always the same people. You'll work to understand their Jobs-To-Be-Done, the outcomes they chase, their different needs, spot patterns in research and data, and make sense of problems that rarely have straightforward answers.

  • Make smart product and business decisions. Balance customer needs, technical realities, and commercial opportunities. Work with Product Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success on positioning, pricing & packaging, launches, adoption, and the decisions that make a product successful in the market.

  • Turn thinking into action. Work closely with Design and Engineering to explore solutions, test assumptions, make trade-offs, and get things shipped. You know when more discovery is needed and when it's time to make a decision and move forward.

  • Help us rethink what's possible. Explore how AI can improve our products and the way our teams work. Bring ideas from your own experience, challenge existing approaches, and help us build better product practices without adding unnecessary process.

What you’ll bring

  • Strong experience in B2B SaaS product management. You've owned complex product areas independently, from strategy and discovery through delivery, launch, and adoption.

  • Sharp analytical and conceptual thinking. You can break down complex problems, recognize patterns, and make sound decisions with incomplete information. You use research, data, and meaningful product metrics to guide decisions and measure results.

  • Strong judgment and a practical mindset. You know when to explore further, when to make a decision, and how to turn complex thinking into action. You're comfortable making trade-offs and working closely with Engineering to get things done.

  • Commercial understanding. You know how SaaS businesses work, understand the difference between buyers and users, and can connect product decisions to customer value, retention, and growth.

  • Experience putting AI to work. You've used AI in practical ways to improve how you work and are interested in how it can fundamentally change products and customer experiences. Experience building AI-powered features is a plus, but not essential.

  • Ability to connect technology with human needs. You can understand complex organizational challenges, think beyond individual features, and translate insights about how people and businesses work into meaningful product opportunities.

Process

Apply in just a few minutes, no cover letter required. We review applications weekly and keep you updated throughout the process. Learn more about how we hire at Zensai here!

At Zensai, performance, learning, and motivation go hand in hand. In this video, our Chief Human Success Officer, Nina Carøe, shares how we connect human ambition with real business impact

The benefits!

Full Flexibility: Work where and when you do your best (as long as it is within the UK…🇬🇧) Morning person or night owl? You decide.

Pension: 5% from you, 5% from us. Simple, matched, and building your future.

Learning: 10% of your working time dedicated to development. Built in, not squeezed in.

Sick Pay: From day one! you’ll get full pay for up to 4 weeks.

Time Off: 25 days of holiday — growing each year you’re with us, up to 30 days.

Health & Dental: BUPA medical insurance plus Level 3 dental cover — check-ups and peace of mind included.

Headspace Family Plan: Mindfulness and sleep tools for you and your household, free with Headspace.

About Zensai

Zensai is a global team of around 200 people across Europe, the US, and ANZ. We believe people should have the opportunity to keep learning, feel connected to their workplace, and do their best work. That’s why we created the Human Success Platform. Built into Microsoft 365 and powered by AI, it helps companies turn learning, engagement, and performance into a natural part of everyday work.
