Job Description

Classification Title: Director of Benefits and Compensation

FLSA Status: Exempt

Unit: Administrative

GENERAL STATEMENT OF JOB


Reporting to the Executive Director of Human Resources, this position provides strategic leadership in the development, administration, coordination, and evaluation of the College's Human Resources functions that support the entire employee life cycle, from recruitment through retirement. The role collaboratively provides direction and oversight for the College's employee benefits, compensation, training and professional development functions.

SPECIFIC DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Essential Functions:

  1. Assists the Executive Director in providing strategic and operational leadership for the Office of Human Resources and serves as the Executive Director's designee in their absence, ensuring continuity of all HR functions and services.
  1. Spearheads strategic and operational leadership for benefits, talent acquisition, compensation, employee development, and performance management. In the absence of the Executive Director, directs onboarding, HRIS, and HR data reporting functions, assuming leadership responsibility for these areas.
  1. Provides direct supervision, leadership, coaching, performance management, and professional development for assigned full-time and part-time Human Resources staff.
  1. Oversees the administration of all processes associated with the employee life cycle, directly or through subordinate supervisors, ensuring efficient, consistent, and compliant delivery of HR services.
  1. Directs the administration of the College's employee benefits programs, including ADA accommodations and FMLA leave administration, and collaborates with internal stakeholders, third-party administrators, and vendors to ensure the effective delivery of health, prescription, dental, retirement, and other employee benefit programs.
  1. Oversees the College's compensation function, including classification and compensation administration, salary actions, market analyses, and compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and collective bargaining agreements.
  1. Provides leadership for the College's employee training and professional development initiatives by overseeing the planning, coordination, implementation, and evaluation of learning and development programs.
  1. Supervises the College's Certifying Officer with the New Jersey Division of Pensions and Benefits, ensuring timely and accurate benefit enrollments, pension transactions, and required state reporting.
  1. Finalizes benefits-related actions reflected in Human Resources Board resolutions and coordinates with Payroll, the President's Office, and other departments to ensure accurate and timely processing.
  1. Collaborates with the Director of Labor Relations and other College leaders to ensure compliance with applicable federal and state employment laws, regulations, policies, collective bargaining agreements, and HR best practices.
  1. Performs other duties as assigned.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • Seven (7) years of progressively responsible professional Human Resources experience in higher education, government, or another complex public-sector environment, including experience working for or supporting a public agency
  • Direct experience leading a team responsible for employee benefits administration, including retirement plans, medical and dental benefits, short- and long-term disability benefits, and leaves of absence
  • Direct experience leading a team responsible for employee compensation administration, including job analysis, salary and hourly rate benchmarking, classification surveys, and reclassifications
  • Functional expertise in at least one additional Human Resources discipline, such as labor/employee relations, training and development, talent acquisition, or related areas
  • Experience working in a unionized environment and applying federal and state employment laws and regulations to human resources administration


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Master's degree from an accredited institution
  • Seven (7) years of progressively responsible Human Resources leadership experience in higher education, government, or another complex public-sector environment; community college experience
  • Experience working with the New Jersey Division of Pensions and Benefits, including supervision of pension administration, and serving in a senior HR leadership capacity with responsibility for department operations in the absence of the chief human resources officer
  • Experience with HRIS systems, HR analytics, and data reporting; active CEBS, SHRM-SCP, SHRM-CP, SPHR, or PHR certification

SCHEDULE: Monday – Friday 8:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m.

title: G1026-Equipment Technician - OT
description:
JOB INFORMATION:

Job Title:   Equipment Technician - OT
Department(s): 6002 - Ocean Terminal Start Up; 6022 - Fleet Maintenance - OT;
Location(s):  Ocean Terminal
FLSA Status:  Non-Exempt

JOB OVERVIEW:

Under the supervision of the Equipment Maintenance Foreman, the Equipment Technician inspects, services, and repairs electrical, electronic, mechanical, structural, and hydraulic systems for ship to shore cranes (STS), rail mounted gantry cranes (RMG), rubber-tired gantry cranes (RTG), shuttle trucks, and associated equipment.

Upholds the values of the GPA to promote Safety, Integrity, Respect, Community, Creativity and Opportunity. Promotes a safe work environment by participating in safety initiatives and reporting unsafe conditions and behaviors.

JOB DUTIES:
  • Perform emergency response to operations requests for immediate repair of disabled equipment. Identifies problem and implements necessary corrective action to repair cranes or associated equipment. Operate cranes/heavy equipment as necessary for repairs.
  • Inspect, repair, and perform preventive maintenance on electrical, electronic, mechanical, structural, and hydraulic systems. To include: DC and AC circuits, motors, drive systems, generators, alternators, programmable logic controllers, limit switches, lights, resistor banks, wiring and alarm systems, fiber-optic cables, load cell systems, hydraulic systems, gear reducers, fans, bearings, clutches, wheels, brakes, drums, wire ropes, and diesel engines.
  • Reads and understands electrical, electronic, mechanical, and hydraulic drawings and schematics, makes necessary changes to schematics and wiring diagrams to reflect as-built or as-modified conditions.
  • Performs set-up, parameter download, and calibration of AC drive systems per original equipment manufacturer’s recommendations.
  • Inspects, troubleshoots, and repairs electrical, electronic, mechanical, and hydraulic systems on the cranes.
  • Perform millwright tasks, such as leveling, aligning, and installing machinery, aligning electric motors and installing couplings. Repair/rebuild mechanical drive systems such as gear boxes, brakes, air, hydraulic and electrical systems.
  • Replace wire ropes.
  • Troubleshoot, repair or rebuild diesel engines.
  • Install conduit and wiring as necessary for installation of equipment modifications or for new equipment installations.
  • Perform miscellaneous burning, welding, and other assigned tasks.
  • Assists Crane Operations personnel when necessary.
  • Plans, selects, and orders materials, tools, and equipment necessary for jobs.
  • Willing and able to repair equipment to eliminate the cause of downtime and its recurrence. Consult with supervisor and set-up preventive maintenance procedures. Report any equipment which requires repair or maintenance to the immediate supervisor.
  • Assist in the training of other employees on the finer points of electrical and mechanical theories and practices requiring the highest skill and knowledge.
  • Maintains a safe, clean, and environmentally acceptable working environment.
  • Performs other duties as assigned
  • Complies with all policies and standards
JOB REQUIREMENTS:

Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities
  • Ability to work well with other employees necessary.
  • Thorough understanding of, and familiar with necessary techniques to troubleshoot, mechanical, hydraulic, pneumatic, electrical, and electronic systems.
  • Thorough understanding of and ability to read electrical, mechanical, and hydraulic diagrams required.
  • Thorough knowledge of industrial diagrams and their symbols and meanings necessary.
  • Ability to use a systematic troubleshooting technique that will quickly isolate and find troubles in cables, wiring, relays, regulators, power supplies, AC drive systems, and brake systems as necessary.
  • Proficient in the use of hand tools, welding equipment, forklifts, and electrical diagnostic tools.
  • Vision requirements: Visual acuity of 20/40 with or without corrective lenses for each eye, minimum depth perception of 6/9, and minimum peripheral vision of 70 degrees for each eye.
  • The ability to interact and communicate effectively and professionally with the GPA staff on all levels of administration including immediate supervisor, management and co-workers required.
  • This position requires that the individual is able to lift up to 50 lbs., and maneuver large parts. Must climb and work at high elevations up to 330 ft.
Experience
  • Experience in industrial maintenance. Required
  • Experience on container cranes Preferred
  • Strong electrical and mechanical aptitude Required
  • Extensive knowledge of solid-state troubleshooting techniques Preferred
Education
  • Required High School Diploma Or equivalent
  • Preferred Certified vocational technical school training, or extensive industrial experience in electrical or mechanical systems
  • Preferred Electrical/electronic technology associate or engineering degree
Licenses & Certifications
  • TWIC - Transportation Worker Identification Credential Required
  • Driver's License - Valid state driver's license Required

Note: This job description is not necessarily an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, job requirements, or working conditions associated with the job. Management reserves the right to revise the job or to require the performance of different or additional tasks. The employee must be able to perform the essential functions of the job, with or without reasonable accommodation, an without direct threat to the health or safety of others.

title: Senior Delivery Manager
description:
Requirements

About Scrumconnect Consulting
Scrumconnect Consulting is a multi-award-winning digital consultancy, recognised for delivering impactful and innovative technology solutions across UK government departments. Our work has positively influenced the lives of over 40 million UK citizens.
We are passionate about user-centred design, agile delivery, and building digital services that make a real difference. Our teams work at the forefront of innovation, helping organisations transform and deliver high-quality, scalable solutions that truly matter.

We are looking for a Senior Delivery Manager to set up and embed effective ways of working across two teams, one using Kanban and the other using Scrum sprints. You will coach the teams, manage stakeholders and keep high-profile work moving at pace.

What you will do

  • Establish the right ways of working for each team, including agile events with clear goals.

  • Support two teams: one working in Kanban and the other in sprints.

  • Set up and configure Jira to support each team.

  • Develop and document working processes with the teams, iterating as needed.

  • Coach teams to embed agile ways of working.

  • Facilitate the creation of team artefacts such as definitions of ready and done, and sizing approaches.

  • Support teams through change, including people management, coaching and support.

  • Manage stakeholder relationships and ensure high-profile work is delivered at pace.

What you will bring

  • Proven experience as a Senior Delivery Manager, leading more than one team at a time.

  • Hands-on experience with both Kanban and Scrum.

title: Senior Java Engineer - Distributed Systems, Serverless - Elasticsearch
description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What Is The Role:

We are on the lookout for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Elasticsearch - Distributed Systems team and focus on how Elasticsearch provides scale, performance, and resilience, especially in the context of our Serverless offering. You will be tackling deep distributed systems challenges in how nodes in an Elasticsearch cluster communicate, and how data are indexed, allocated, and managed across nodes.

What You Will Be Doing:

  • Leveraging your distributed systems expertise to build, and operate core pieces of our next-generation Serverless Elasticsearch offering, directly impacting the experience of customers worldwide.
  • Improving Elasticsearch’s components that support concurrent and consistent indexing across multiple machines.
  • Maintaining our cluster coordination system to keep performance high even though nodes come and go from the cluster and data moves around, while maintaining the safety and liveness properties of the system as a whole.
  • Pushing the limits on the number of shards, nodes, and petabytes that Elasticsearch can handle today.
  • Looking into all kinds of issues, including performance or concurrency issues, and proposing solutions.
  • Supporting our support engineers with the harder problems.
  • Owning operational investigations end-to-end, until performance or stability issues are successfully resolved.

What You Bring:

  • You have a deep background in distributed systems and consensus algorithms.
  • You have strong skills in core Java and are conversant in the standard library of data structures and concurrency constructs, as well as newer language features.
  • You have a deep technical proficiency in algorithms.
  • You have shown your ability to understand and work on complex, highly distributed systems, rather than making use of off-the-shelf services.
  • You demonstrate the ability to build and debug features with a broad impact, running on multiple machines.
  • You are able to own projects from beginning to end. This covers both technical design and working with others to develop needed components.
  • You have a proven track record of using AI to accelerate development, debug complex systems, and optimize code, while still owning the final outcomes.
  • You possess the ability to collaborate across functions and teams and seamlessly transition between different projects, codebases, or teams based on business priorities.
  • You can work autonomously, drive decisions and results in a distributed team by leveraging asynchronous, direct, and transparent communication.

Bonus Points:

  • Data stores
  • Search, analytics, Lucene
  • Strong knowledge of the JDK
  • Asynchronous event-driven network frameworks such as Netty.

title: Endpoint Security Engineer, Technology
description:
Endpoint Security Engineer, Technology

A Career with Point72's Technology Team

As Point72 reimagines the future of investing, our Technology team is constantly evolving our firm’s IT infrastructure and engineering capabilities, positioning us at the forefront of a rapidly evolving technology landscape. We’re a team of experts who experiment and work to discover new ways to harness open-source solutions, modern cloud architectures, and sophisticated Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions, while embracing enterprise agile methodologies. Our commitment to building and innovating in the AI space provides the framework intended to drive smarter decision making and enhance how we build and operate our platforms and applications.

As a member of Point72’s Technology team, we encourage and support your professional development from day one—helping you advance your technical skills, contribute innovative ideas, and satisfy your own intellectual curiosity—all while delivering real business impact for our multi-billion-dollar global business.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

You will own endpoint protective controls across workstations, servers, virtual desktops, mobile devices, and browsers, helping keep our firm’s endpoint security posture measurable and resilient. Specifically, you will:

  • Administer endpoint detection and response platforms across the endpoint estate, including sensor deployment, prevention policies, host grouping, exclusions, custom indicators of attack, and response actions
  • Maintain sensor coverage across Windows, macOS, Linux, and virtual desktop environments by reconciling telemetry against asset inventory and closing coverage gaps
  • Manage endpoint protection and Windows security controls, including antivirus policy, attack surface reduction, tamper protection, vulnerability management, and coexistence settings
  • Govern the enterprise browser as an endpoint control surface, including policy enforcement, extension governance, data protection controls, and isolation for higher-risk destinations
  • Implement hardening baselines aligned to CIS Benchmarks through endpoint management platforms, with control-level evaluation, remediation, and compliance evidence
  • Engineer application control, device control, and host firewall policies from audit mode through measured enforcement across diverse endpoint populations
  • Detect and remediate configuration drift by verifying sensor status, policy assignment, baseline compliance, and other control-state telemetry
  • Manage endpoint security exceptions with documented justification, accountable ownership, expiry dates, and ongoing review to minimize persistent risk
  • Lead sensor and platform lifecycle management, including release evaluation, staged rollout planning, production deployment, and rollback readiness
  • Partner with security operations, infrastructure, and desktop engineering teams to tune detections, improve response actions, and deliver sprint commitments through verified control state

WHAT'S REQUIRED

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in endpoint security engineering within a production enterprise environment
  • Deep experience administering endpoint detection and response platforms, such as CrowdStrike Falcon, including sensor deployment across Windows, macOS, and Linux, prevention policy design, host groups, exclusions, response actions, and workflow automation
  • Experience using security platform APIs, such as the CrowdStrike API, for endpoint security automation, reporting, and control-state validation
  • Experience administering endpoint protection platforms, such as Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, through endpoint management security baselines and policies, including antivirus, attack surface reduction, tamper protection, and vulnerability management
  • Experience operating a native endpoint protection platform alongside a third-party endpoint detection and response platform, including coexistence and passive mode configuration
  • Working knowledge of endpoint security portals, such as Microsoft Defender, including advanced hunting with KQL for investigation, validation, and reporting
  • Experience deploying and operating enterprise browser security controls, including policy design, extension governance, download and upload controls, and browser-layer data protection
  • Experience with endpoint management tools, such as Microsoft Intune, Jamf, and Group Policy, as well as CIS Benchmarks, application control, device control, and audit-to-enforcement rollout of endpoint policies
  • Experience supporting virtual desktop or thin client environments, scripting in PowerShell, Python, or Bash, and delivering sprint backlog items through verified completion
  • Commitment to the highest ethical standards

WE TAKE CARE OF OUR PEOPLE

We invest in our people, their careers, their health, and their well-being. When you work here, we provide:

  • Fully-paid health care benefits
  • Generous parental and family leave policies
  • Volunteer opportunities
  • Support for employee-led affinity groups representing women, people of color and the LGBT+ community
  • Mental and physical wellness programs
  • Tuition assistance
  • A 401(k) savings program with an employer match and more

ABOUT POINT72

Point72 is a leading global alternative investment firm led by Steven A. Cohen. Building on more than 30 years of investing experience, Point72 seeks to deliver superior returns for its investors through fundamental and systematic investing strategies across asset classes and geographies. We aim to attract and retain the industry's brightest talent by cultivating an investor-led culture and committing to our people's long-term growth. For more information, visit .

The annual base salary range for this role is $170,000-$250,000 (USD) , which does not include discretionary bonus compensation or our comprehensive benefits package. Actual compensation offered to the successful candidate may vary from posted hiring range based upon geographic location, work experience, education, and/or skill level, among other things.

title: Advocate Supervisor
description:
Advocate Supervisor
Full-time, non-exempt
$36-42,000 annually
Monroe, LA
Reports to Program Coordinator
Revised June 2026
Application Window: November 9-20
Interviews will begin the week of November 23.

The Center for Children & Families is seeking an Advocate Supervisor to join CASA of Northeast Louisiana. The Advocate Supervisor provides professional staff support to CASA for up to 25 volunteers ensuring that children involved with the CASA program receive sound advocacy and early permanency planning. The Advocate Supervisor is responsible for volunteer supervision and coordination of cases. This position also requires that the individual be capable of working as a member of a goal-oriented strength-based team. The Advocate Supervisor is hired by and reports to the CASA Program Coordinator.

Minimum Job Requirements
  • Bachelor’s degree in a social service-related field or equivalent combination of education and experience
  • Familiarity with the CASA program, the work of CASA programs, and the child advocacy system
  • Excellent communication skills (oral and written), including collaboration, conflict-resolution, negotiation, and persuasion
  • Ability to work cooperatively with different types of personalities; maintain confidential information and organizational skills; prioritize multiple tasks and remain flexible in a dynamic work environment
  • Working knowledge and understanding of computer systems and the ability to enter data efficiently and accurately
  • An ability to accomplish multiple tasks efficiently, while also prioritizing those tasks
  • Ability to work with and thrive in a variable work schedule environment, including flexibility to work outside of Monday – Friday (8:30-4:30)
  • Must have a valid drivers license and reliable transportation.
  • Must be able to pass a series of background checks and provide references as a condition of employment
  • Commitment to CFCF’s and CASA’s fundamental goals and mission
Duties & Responsibilities
  • Case Management
    • Maintain knowledge of each child on the caseload
    • Accurately document all activities performed in your capacity as an Advocate Supervisor, ensuring data integrity for reporting needs.
      • Document case activity on each case.
      • File up-to-date documents received by court and collaterals in electronic case files.
    • Complete monthly performance indicators based on volunteer reports.
    • Develop and retain relationships with volunteer, foster families, DCFS workers, court personnel and all parties related to the case
    • Attend all court hearings and track court dates
      • Provide written and verbal testimony to the court
      • Collaborate with volunteers regarding written CASA court reports.
      • See that all parties involved receive a copy of CASA’s court report.
      • Monitor judicial docket; manage case assignments and court week
  • Volunteer Supervision
    • Work with volunteers in order to achieve a safe and permanent home for children
    • Maintain awareness and sensitivity to service populations cultural and socio-economic characteristics and integrate this into supervision of volunteers and child advocacy
    • Communicate the role of the CASA Program and CASA volunteer
    • Attend and assist with trainings and orienting new volunteers as needed
      • Must complete Training of Facilitator in order to train volunteers
      • Be familiar with all CASA training materials
    • Assist in preparing volunteers for court testimony if necessary
    • Provide support to volunteers regarding their case including problem solving, resource information and guidance related to the child welfare system.
      • Consult with volunteers a minimum of twice a month for volunteer supervision
      • Insure face to face communication with volunteers at least once a quarter
      • Attend home visits and pertinent social service meetings with volunteers
      • Reinforcement of confidentiality policy with every volunteer
      • Create action plans with volunteers regarding new case assignments
      • Assist volunteers in gathering information, specialized services and resources pertaining to the case
    • Evaluate volunteer job performance yearly via National CASA evaluation process
    • Ensures volunteers are in compliance with annual in-service hours as well as other CASA of NELA policies
  • Collaboration, Supervision, and Administration
    • Work collaboratively with all program staff to accomplish the goals and mission of the program
    • Communicate regularly with the Program Coordinator regarding updates and changes in volunteer and case progress
    • Participate in monthly supervision
    • Participate in employee evaluations as directed by the Program Coordinator
    • Maintain accurate daily time records and ensure timely submission of timesheets in compliance with agency policies and payroll deadlines
    • Adhere to the programs policies on dress, professional conduct and demeanor
    • Attend all necessary staff training/meetings
    • Attend conferences, seminars, and meetings for continuing education as requested by the Program Director
    • Participate in monthly peer file reviews
    • Demonstrate acceptable level of commitment to the core values and mission statement of CASA of Northeast Louisiana and The Center for Children and Families
*Disclaimer: This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities,
duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may
change, or new ones may be assigned at any time with or without notice.

Working Environment
The physical demands and work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of the job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee regularly works in a business office setting. Tasks require a variety of physical activities, not generally involving muscular strain, such as walking, standing, stooping, sitting, reaching, and light lifting. Regular and consistent in-person interaction and continuous talking, hearing, and seeing are required in the normal course of performing the job. Common eye, hand, and finger dexterity are required to perform some essential functions. Mental application utilizes memory for details, verbal instructions, emotional stability, critical thinking, and creative problem-solving. Regular automobile and airline travel may be required in the normal course of job performance.

We take affirmative action to ensure equal opportunity for all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other legally protected characteristics.

title: Cloud Solutions Architect
description:
About us

Appnovation is the AI Product Company. Headquartered in Vancouver, Canada, with teams around the world, Appnovation builds AI products, delivers enterprise AI and digital solutions, and co-invests with clients to bring new AI products to market.

Open source has been the foundation of Appnovation's work since 2007, and it remains the foundation underneath every AI product the company builds today. Appnovation teams work with organizations in highly regulated industries, including global leaders such as Pfizer, Google and AstraZeneca, to help them adopt AI they can govern and own.

ENGLISH WILL FOLLOW

La technologie est au cœur de toutes les offres d'Appnovation, du conseil à l'innovation numérique, en passant par la création de produits et services digitaux. Le département technologie se concentre sur la livraison de solutions logicielles qui permettent des expériences riches pour les utilisateurs, des applications mobiles et web à l'analytique avancée et l'apprentissage automatique, en passant par les plateformes de gestion de contenu et d'engagement.

Nos capacités technologiques reposent sur une expertise approfondie du cycle de vie du développement logiciel, une créativité constante, une passion pour le métier et une collaboration étroite avec les autres disciplines — des ingrédients essentiels à la réussite des expériences numériques et des partenariats clients.

En tant qu'architecte de solutions cloud, vous rejoindrez une équipe dynamique et expérimentée et réfléchirez à la mise à l'échelle de notre plateforme, d'un petit pilote à une échelle enterprise. Vous concevrez l'architecture pour des dizaines de milliers d'utilisateurs sur AWS, définirez les stratégies de mise en cache, multi-région et de fédération pour maintenir la plateforme rapide et résiliente à travers les géographies, et vous assurerez que l'architecture répond aux besoins de sécurité et de contrôle d'accès pour les contenus sensibles.

RESPONSABILITÉS PRINCIPALES

  • Concevoir l'architecture de la plateforme à l'échelle enterprise (dizaines de milliers d'utilisateurs) sur AWS.
  • Évaluer la scalabilité du backend Postgres/Supabase et concevoir des niveaux de mise en cache, une architecture multi-région et une fédération globale selon les besoins.
  • Prendre en charge la stratégie de tests de charge et les objectifs de réactivité à travers les géographies.
  • S'assurer que l'architecture répond aux besoins de sécurité et de contrôle d'accès pour les contenus sensibles.
  • Produire des diagrammes d'architecture, des registres de décisions et des standards techniques.
  • Guider et mentorer les ingénieurs sur les meilleures pratiques et les patterns cloud.
  • Définir les exigences non fonctionnelles (disponibilité, résilience, coût, observabilité).
  • Collaborer avec les équipes sécurité et conformité pour répondre aux contrôles enterprise.
  • Soutenir les décisions de développement interne ou d'achat et les évaluations technologiques.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Baccalauréat en informatique ou dans un domaine connexe, 8 ans et plus en ingénierie dont 3 ans et plus en architecture.
  • Expérience senior en architecture cloud sur AWS, certification recommandée (ex. : Solutions Architect Professional).
  • Expérience en conception de systèmes distribués haute performance, faible latence et multi-région.
  • Stratégies de mise en cache, fédération de données et tests de performance et de charge.
  • Architecture de sécurité, incluant le contrôle d'accès basé sur les rôles et les attributs (RBAC/ABAC).
  • Infrastructure-as-code (Terraform/CloudFormation) et conteneurisation (Docker/Kubernetes).
  • Solide maîtrise des réseaux, IAM, optimisation des coûts et outils d'observabilité.
  • Capacité à travailler dans un cycle de vie d'ingénierie enterprise établi et à être opérationnel rapidement.
  • Excellentes compétences en communication avec les parties prenantes et en leadership technique.

QUI VOUS ÊTES

  • Vous pensez à comment automatiser et opérer à grande échelle, pas seulement à résoudre le problème immédiat.
  • Vous comprenez la pensée lean.
  • Vous établissez des standards élevés en matière de qualité de code, de performance et de sécurité, et recherchez l'amélioration continue.
  • Vous avez de solides compétences analytiques, en résolution de problèmes et en prise de décision.
  • Vous adoptez une approche centrée sur le client avec un vrai sens du service.
  • Vous développez des relations positives avec les parties prenantes internes et externes, tout en gérant plusieurs initiatives aux priorités parfois concurrentes.
  • Vous faites preuve d'initiative, de passion et de fortes compétences en communication et en collaboration dans un environnement transversal.
  • Vous êtes réactif et vous épanouissez dans un environnement rapide, diversifié et en constante évolution.
  • Vous recherchez activement de nouveaux défis et apprenez rapidement de nouveaux concepts, modèles d'affaires et technologies.
  • Vous avez une expérience préalable en consultation.
  • Une expérience et des connections dans l'industrie des sciences de la vie sont un atout.

Technology is foundational to all of Appnovation’s offerings, from consulting to digital innovation, to digital product and service creation. The technology department is focused on delivering software solutions that enable rich consumer experiences, from mobile and web applications to advanced analytics and machine learning, to content and engagement management service enablement platforms.

Inherent throughout our tech capabilities is deep expertise in the Software Development Life Cycle, a drive for creativity, a passion for the craft, and collaboration with other disciplines - all foundational ingredients in successful digital experiences and client partnerships.

As a Cloud Solutions Architect, you will join a highly motivated and experienced team and think through scaling our platform from a small pilot to enterprise scale. You will architect for tens of thousands of users on AWS, design the caching, multi-region and federation strategies that keep the platform fast and resilient across geographies, and ensure the architecture meets the security and access-control needs of sensitive content. We are looking for people who can bring a strong, consulting and solution-focused mindset and contribute to architectural decisions, best practices and get things done.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Architect the platform for enterprise scale (tens of thousands of users) on AWS.
  • Evaluate scalability of the Postgres/Supabase backend; design caching tiers, multi-region, and global federation as needed.
  • Own the load-testing strategy and responsiveness targets across geographies.
  • Ensure the architecture meets security and access-control needs for sensitive content.
  • Produce architecture diagrams, decision records, and technical standards.
  • Guide and mentor engineers on cloud best practices and patterns.
  • Define non-functional requirements (availability, resilience, cost, observability).
  • Partner with security and compliance to meet enterprise controls.
  • Support build-vs-buy decisions and technology evaluations.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or a related field; 8+ years in engineering, with 3+ years in architecture.
  • Senior cloud architecture experience on AWS; certification (e.g., Solutions Architect Professional) preferred.
  • Experience designing high-scale, low-latency, multi-region distributed systems.
  • Caching strategies, data federation, and performance/load testing.
  • Security architecture, including role- and attribute-based access control (RBAC/ABAC).
  • Infrastructure-as-code (Terraform/CloudFormation) and containerization (Docker/Kubernetes).
  • Strong grasp of networking, IAM, cost optimization, and observability tooling.
  • Ability to work within an established enterprise engineering lifecycle and hit the ground running.
  • Excellent stakeholder communication and technical leadership skills.

WHO YOU ARE

  • You think about how to scale, automate and operate, not just how to build a solution to an immediate problem
  • You understand lean thinking
  • You set high standards for code quality, performance/scalability and security and seek continuous improvement
  • You have solid analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills
  • You have a customer-first mindset and a devotion to customer service
  • You engage and build positive internal and external client relationships, while managing multiple initiatives, often with competing priorities
  • You have strong self-initiative, passion, interpersonal, oral and written communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work, influence and make an impact in a cross-functional environment with all levels of the organization
  • You are responsive and thrive in a fast-paced, diverse, high-performance environment with rapidly changing business needs
  • You actively seek out things outside your comfort zone with the ability to rapidly learn and take advantage of new concepts, business models, and technologies
  • You have prior experience in consulting
  • Prior experience and connections in the Life Sciences industry is preferred
Thank you for your interest in a career with Appnovation Technologies! Please note that only those selected for an interview will be contacted.
At Appnovation, we recognize that diverse teams are the strongest teams. Diversity, Equity & Inclusion is not only something that we embrace - we celebrate it! We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and we encourage applicants from all backgrounds, lived experiences and industries to apply. Come join us at Appnovation, and learn more about how we stay true to our company values as we build better lives through better digital.

title: Research Associate / PostDoc (m/f/x)
description:
As part of the German government's artificial intelligence (AI) strategy, the successful Saxon competence center ScaDS.AI Dresden/Leipzig (Center for Scalable Data Analytics and Artificial Intelligence) is being expanded into a leading German AI competence center for Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (AI). For TUD Dresden University of Technology, diversity is an essential feature and a quality criterion of an excellent university. Accordingly, we welcome all applicants who would like to commit themselves, their achievements and productivity to the success of the whole institution.

At the **Center for Interdisciplinary Digital Sciences (CIDS),** the **Department for Scalable Data Analytics and Artificial Intelligence (ScaDS.AI Dresden)** offers, subject to the availability of resources, two project positions funded by the BMFTR as

# Research Associate / PostDoc (m/f/x)

(subject to personal qualification, employees are remunerated according to salary group E 13 TV-L)

starting **as soon as possible**. The positions are fixed-term until March 31, 2029. The individual contract duration will be determined according to the candidate’s qualifications and the intended academic qualification goal. An extension may be possible subject to the availability of resources. The period of employment is governed by § 2 (2) Fixed Term Research Contracts Act (Wissenschaftszeitvertragsgesetz - WissZeitVG). A shorter contract term is possible by arrangement.

Within the project Neuro-Symbolic AI with Logic-Memory Decomposition (Neuro-SAIL), a new class of architectures for verifiable neuro-symbolic AI is being researched using Logic-Memory Decomposition. Rule-based decisions are made by logic components, while memory modules are only used when information is incomplete or ambiguous. If no reliable decision is possible, escalation to humans occurs. The aim is to make rule-based decisions more transparent and efficient, to limit the use of neural models to necessary cases, and to reduce rule violations and unsubstantiated statements.

Professional assignment: Chair of Scalable Software Architectures for Data Analytics (Prof. Dr. Michael Färber)

## Research areas:

Natural Language Processing, Large Language Models, Knowledge Graphs, and related fields (e.g., Graph Machine Learning)

## Tasks:

  • scientific research and development activities in at least one of the above-mentioned research areas
  • participation in national and international research projects, possibly in collaboration with industry

title: Apparatus Technician
description:
Summary

The Apparatus Technician is responsible for performing inspection, testing, maintenance, troubleshooting, and commissioning of electrical power distribution equipment in industrial and commercial environments. This position supports the Power & Reliability team in maintaining the safety, performance, and reliability of electrical systems. Working under the direction of senior technicians, lead technicians, and project leadership, the Apparatus Technician performs electrical testing, evaluates equipment conditions, identifies deficiencies, and completes required documentation while adhering to TIG safety standards, customer requirements, and applicable industry regulations.

Qualification Requirements

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Minimum Qualifications

  • High school diploma or GED required.
  • Technical degree, electrical apprenticeship, military electrical training, or equivalent technical education preferred.
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in electrical apparatus testing, maintenance, troubleshooting, or a related electrical field preferred.
  • Experience working with low- and medium-voltage electrical distribution equipment.
  • Basic understanding of electrical testing procedures and diagnostic equipment.
  • Ability to read and interpret electrical drawings, one-line diagrams, schematics, and equipment manuals.
  • Familiarity with NFPA 70E, NETA standards, and electrical safety practices preferred.
  • Valid driver's license and ability to meet company driving requirements when applicable.
  • Ability to travel and work overtime, nights, weekends, and scheduled outages as required.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Knowledge of electrical power distribution systems, equipment, and maintenance practices.
  • Familiarity with transformers, switchgear, circuit breakers, motor control centers, switches, and related electrical apparatus.
  • Understanding of electrical testing methods, including insulation resistance, contact resistance, transformer turns ratio, and other applicable diagnostic testing.
  • Ability to operate electrical test instruments and specialized diagnostic equipment with appropriate training.
  • Ability to identify equipment deficiencies and assist with troubleshooting electrical and mechanical problems.
  • Ability to interpret electrical test results and compare findings with manufacturer specifications and applicable standards.
  • Working knowledge of electrical safety procedures, lockout/tagout, and appropriate PPE requirements.
  • Familiarity with applicable ANSI, IEEE, NETA, and manufacturer testing standards.
  • Strong mechanical aptitude, attention to detail, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to follow technical instructions, testing procedures, and established work practices.
  • Effective communication and teamwork skills.
  • Ability to accurately complete test reports, inspection forms, and field documentation.

Essential Functions

  • Perform inspection, testing, preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, and commissioning of electrical power distribution apparatus.
  • Test and maintain low- and medium-voltage switchgear, circuit breakers, transformers, motor control centers, switches, and related equipment.
  • Perform electrical testing, including insulation resistance, contact resistance, transformer turns ratio, and other applicable diagnostic procedures.
  • Conduct visual and mechanical inspections to identify equipment damage, deterioration, or abnormal operating conditions.
  • Assist with troubleshooting equipment failures and identifying corrective actions.
  • Read and interpret electrical drawings, one-line diagrams, schematics, and manufacturer documentation.
  • Operate and maintain electrical testing equipment, tools, and diagnostic instruments.
  • Verify that testing equipment is in proper working condition and within required calibration periods.
  • Record test results, document equipment deficiencies, and prepare accurate field service reports.
  • Assist senior and lead technicians with equipment startup, commissioning, energization, and return-to-service activities.
  • Participate in pre-job planning, job safety analyses, and daily safety meetings.
  • Follow TIG safety policies, NFPA 70E requirements, customer procedures, and applicable industry standards.
  • Coordinate with lead technicians, project leadership, and other field personnel to complete assigned work safely and efficiently.
  • Maintain tools, equipment, vehicles, and assigned work areas in a safe and orderly condition.
  • Support scheduled outages, shutdowns, emergency repairs, and other field assignments as required.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Physical Demands

  • Ability to regularly stand, walk, sit, bend, stoop, kneel, crouch, reach, and move throughout active industrial facilities.
  • Ability to walk and work on uneven terrain, gravel, concrete, elevated platforms, and other industrial surfaces.
  • Ability to climb stairs and ladders as required to access electrical equipment and work areas.
  • Ability to work at various elevations and in confined or restricted areas when properly trained and authorized.
  • Ability to wear required PPE, including electrical and arc-rated protective equipment, for extended periods.
  • Ability to visually inspect electrical equipment, wiring, test instruments, drawings, and test results.
  • Ability to safely handle and operate electrical testing equipment, hand tools, and related equipment.
  • Ability to frequently lift, carry, push, or pull tools and equipment weighing up to 50 pounds.
  • Ability to communicate effectively in environments with moderate to elevated noise levels.

Work Environment

This position primarily works in industrial facilities, power generation plants, substations, manufacturing facilities, petrochemical plants, and other customer locations. Work is performed indoors and outdoors and may involve exposure to electrical hazards, energized equipment, elevated noise levels, moving machinery, chemicals, dust, fumes, and varying weather conditions.

The position requires strict adherence to electrical safety procedures, established testing practices, and appropriate PPE requirements. Travel and work outside normal business hours may be required, including nights, weekends, holidays, scheduled outages, shutdowns, and emergency assignments.

title: Senior Java Engineer - Distributed Systems, Serverless - Elasticsearch
description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What Is The Role:

We are on the lookout for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Elasticsearch - Distributed Systems team and focus on how Elasticsearch provides scale, performance, and resilience, especially in the context of our Serverless offering. You will be tackling deep distributed systems challenges in how nodes in an Elasticsearch cluster communicate, and how data are indexed, allocated, and managed across nodes.

What You Will Be Doing:

  • Leveraging your distributed systems expertise to build, and operate core pieces of our next-generation Serverless Elasticsearch offering, directly impacting the experience of customers worldwide.
  • Improving Elasticsearch’s components that support concurrent and consistent indexing across multiple machines.
  • Maintaining our cluster coordination system to keep performance high even though nodes come and go from the cluster and data moves around, while maintaining the safety and liveness properties of the system as a whole.
  • Pushing the limits on the number of shards, nodes, and petabytes that Elasticsearch can handle today.
  • Looking into all kinds of issues, including performance or concurrency issues, and proposing solutions.
  • Supporting our support engineers with the harder problems.
  • Owning operational investigations end-to-end, until performance or stability issues are successfully resolved.

What You Bring:

  • You have a deep background in distributed systems and consensus algorithms.
  • You have strong skills in core Java and are conversant in the standard library of data structures and concurrency constructs, as well as newer language features.
  • You have a deep technical proficiency in algorithms.
  • You have shown your ability to understand and work on complex, highly distributed systems, rather than making use of off-the-shelf services.
  • You demonstrate the ability to build and debug features with a broad impact, running on multiple machines.
  • You are able to own projects from beginning to end. This covers both technical design and working with others to develop needed components.
  • You have a proven track record of using AI to accelerate development, debug complex systems, and optimize code, while still owning the final outcomes.
  • You possess the ability to collaborate across functions and teams and seamlessly transition between different projects, codebases, or teams based on business priorities.
  • You can work autonomously, drive decisions and results in a distributed team by leveraging asynchronous, direct, and transparent communication.

Bonus Points:

  • Data stores
  • Search, analytics, Lucene
  • Strong knowledge of the JDK
  • Asynchronous event-driven network frameworks such as Netty.

Compensation for this role is in the form of base salary. This role does not have a variable compensation component.

At Elastic, our compensation philosophy aims to provide fair, competitive and transparent remuneration. Salary ranges are established based on a combination of external market benchmarks, internal pay equity considerations, and the responsibilities and complexity associated with each role. This approach helps ensure consistency across comparable roles while remaining competitive within the relevant labour markets.

The final compensation offered within the applicable range will be determined based on several objective factors, including relevant professional experience, level of skills and expertise, alignment with the role requirements, and the overall scope and complexity of the position.

The typical starting salary range for this role is:
€55.800—€88.300 EUR

Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People

As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.

We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.

  • Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary
  • Health coverage for you and your family in many locations

  • Generous number of vacation days each year
  • Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service
  • Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love
  • Embracing parenthood with minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave

Different people approach problems differently. We need that. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law, ordinance or regulation.

title: [쿠팡풀필먼트서비스] 급여담당자 (5년이상)
description:
회사 소개

Coupang Fulfillment Services(이하 CFS)는 쿠팡의 물류를 총괄하는 쿠팡의 계열사입니다. CFS는 물류센터(Fulfillment Center, 이하 FC) 운영을 책임지고 있으며, 업무효율성과 전문성 제고를 통해 글로벌 이커머스 기업으로 성장하기 위한 혁신을 이끌어 가고 있습니다.

Fulfillment Center(이하 FC)는 쿠팡의 물류센터를 말하는 것으로 상품의 입고, 적재, 포장, 출고를 담당하는 곳입니다. FC는 단순한 물류 창고가 아닌, 첨단 기술이 집약된 하나의 Automation Factory로서, 제조업 생산 공장과 같이 각각의 업무를 전문화하고, 입고부터 출고까지 데이터를 기반으로 시공간을 효율적으로 관리하여 낭비를 최소화 하는 등 최적의 물류 시스템을 구현해 나가고 있습니다.

업무 내용

  • 상용직 및 일용직 급여(Payroll) End-to-End 프로세스 운영
  • 월별 급여 산출 및 검증, 지급 업무 수행
  • 근태, 수당, 공제, 퇴직금 등 급여 데이터 관리 및 정산
  • 급여 관련 세무 신고 및 법정 보고 업무 지원
  • 급여 시스템 운영 및 데이터 정확성 검증
  • 대규모 일용직 급여 운영 프로세스 개선 및 효율화
  • 내부 통제 및 Payroll Compliance 관리 지원

자격요건

  • Payroll 업무 경력 최소 5년 이상을 보유하신 분
  • Payroll A to Z 프로세스 전반에 대한 실무 경험을 보유하신 분
  • 상용직 및 일용직 급여 운영 경험을 보유하신 분
  • 급여 정산, 원천세 신고 및 4대보험 관련 업무 경험을 보유하신 분
  • 대량의 급여 데이터 검증 및 처리 역량을 보유하신 분
  • 다양한 이해관계자와 원활한 커뮤니케이션 및 협업이 가능하신 분

우대사항

  • 대규모 조직 또는 대규모 인력 운영 환경에서 Payroll 업무를 수행해보신 분
  • 일용직 급여 운영 경험을 보유하신 분
  • 물류, 제조, 유통, 서비스 산업에서 Payroll 업무를 경험해보신 분
  • Payroll 프로세스 개선 또는 자동화 프로젝트를 수행해보신 분
  • Excel 및 HRIS 활용 역량을 보유하신 분
  • 빠르게 변화하는 환경에서 우선순위를 관리하며 업무를 수행해보신 분

전형 절차 및 안내 사항

  • 전형절차
    • 서류전형 - 직무 적합성 인터뷰 - 핵심 역량 인터뷰 – 최종 합격
    • 전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.
    • 전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.
  • 참고사항
    • 본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
    • 지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.
    • 취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.
    • 직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.
    • 채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.
    • 고용형태는 정규직으로 수습기간 12 주를 포함합니다. 단, 업무상 필요한 경우에는 상기 수습기간을 적용하지 않거나 단축 또는 연장할 수 있습니다.

개인정보 처리방침

  • 쿠팡 그룹은 입사지원자 개인정보 처리방침(아래 링크)에 따라 귀하의 개인정보를 수집하여 처리합니다.

서류 반환 정책

  1. 본 고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』 제11조제6항에 따른 것 입니다.
  2. 당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.
  3. 위2항 본문에 따라 채용 서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용 서류 반환 청구서 [채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제 3 호 서식]를 작성하여 이메일 (recruitingops@coupangfs.com) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14 일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다.
  4. 당사는 위2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.
  5. 단, 위 1항 내지 4항의 내용은 대한민국의 노동 관계 법령이 적용되는 경우에만 적용됩니다. 그 이외의 경우에는 적용되지 않습니다.

title: Case Manager - Transitions
description:
The Transitions Case Manager provides comprehensive case management services to individuals impacted by substance use disorder who are participating in the Transitions Program and returning to the workforce. Reporting to the Transitions Case Management Coordinator, this role is responsible for assessing eligibility, developing individualized employment and training plans, coordinating supportive services, and guiding participants toward sustainable employment. The Transitions Case Manager works collaboratively with recovery agencies, behavioral health providers, employers, training providers, and community partners to support long-term recovery, workforce reintegration, and program success.

Program Delivery

Estimated Effort: 50%

  • Screen and assess applicants for WIOA eligibility in accordance with federal, state, and local guidelines; gather and verify all required documentation to ensure compliance.

  • Assist participants with completion of intake and enrollment requirements, including Eligibility Applications, OMJ Backpack setup, WorkKeys testing, TABE testing, Future Plans assessments, and other career-related evaluations.

  • Enter and maintain accurate client data in the ARIES case management system, including documentation of services, barriers, Individual Employment Plans (IEPs), progress monitoring, performance measures, monthly case notes, and follow-up surveys.

  • Evaluate applicants to determine appropriateness for services, ensuring resources are targeted effectively and aligned with program goals and eligibility standards.

  • Provide ongoing case management services, including regular client reviews, follow-ups, attendance monitoring, and issue resolution to support successful completion of service plans.

  • Identify client needs and provide referrals to supportive services and community resources, including CAC programs, social service agencies, recovery agencies, behavioral health providers, and other partners addressing barriers such as housing, childcare, transportation, healthcare, and recovery support.

  • Facilitate placement into post-secondary training and/or unsubsidized employment by maintaining proactive communication with training providers, employers, and clients.

  • Assist clients with resume development, cover letter preparation, interview practice, and job readiness activities; provide retention services to support employment stability.

  • Coordinate work experience placements under supervision of the Coordinator, including employer recruitment, participant matching, monitoring performance, and maintaining employer relationships.

  • Contribute to the development and delivery of life skills and educational workshops designed to support recovery, employability, and long-term self-sufficiency.

  • Work toward achieving WIOA performance outcomes, including placement at exit, employment retention in the 2nd and 4th quarters post-exit, credential attainment, median wage gains, and measurable skill increases.

  • Support achievement of Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) aligned with the agency’s strategic plan.

  • Maintain strict confidentiality and protect Personally Identifiable Information (PII) in compliance with agency policies and state and federal regulations.

Case File Management

Estimated Effort: 30%

  • Maintain complete, accurate, and compliant case files in accordance with State and Federal WIOA regulations, including eligibility documentation, service records, training accounts, purchase orders, and invoices.

  • Perform data validation to ensure consistency between case files and the ARIES case management system.

  • Ensure timely and thorough case note documentation, with at least monthly updates detailing client activities, services provided, progress toward goals, and outcomes.

  • Adhere to all CAC, ODJFS, and Workforce Development Area #1 policies and procedures related to documentation standards, confidentiality, and file management.

  • Maintain accurate and compliant files for Special Grant programs (e.g., Car Repair Program), ensuring audit readiness at all times.

Outreach Delivery

Estimated Effort: 10%

  • Participate in outreach and recruitment activities to increase awareness of OhioMeansJobs Pike County and Transitions Program services.

  • Attend community events, OMJ Van events, and outreach initiatives to connect with potential clients, employers, recovery agencies, and community partners.

  • Communicate with employers, social service agencies, recovery agencies, and behavioral health providers to align workforce opportunities with client needs.

  • Provide backup support in the OMJ Center as needed, including greeting clients, assisting with intake paperwork, referring clients to services, and supporting job search activities.

  • Attend meetings, conferences, and trainings related to workforce development, recovery services, and case management and communicate relevant information to stakeholders.

  • Distribute program information through flyers, presentations, and direct outreach efforts.

Service and Other Responsibilities

Estimated Effort: 10%

  • Adhere to all agency safety policies and procedures.

  • Serve on CAC committees and collaborate to promote service coordination and continuous improvement.

  • Perform additional duties as assigned by the Supervisor to support program and organizational goals.

Minimum Requirements

Education:

  • Chemical Dependency Counselor Assistant (CDCA) certification with an active Ohio license OR

  • Associate degree in Social Work, Human Services, Specialized Studies with a Case Management concentration, or a related field, with the ability to obtain CDCA certification within six (6) months of hire.

Licenses, Certifications, and Accreditations:

  • Valid Ohio driver’s license

  • Ability to be insured under agency insurance

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with diverse populations in varied settings

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, with strong Excel skills for data analysis and reporting

  • Knowledge of client case management, workforce development, and recovery-oriented services

  • Experience using client tracking or case management systems

Working Conditions

This position operates in a well-lighted office environment and requires occasional local and regional travel (up to 40%). Evening and weekend work may be required. The role is fast-paced and involves managing multiple priorities, detailed documentation, and coordination with recovery and workforce partners, with low-to-moderate levels of stress.

title: [쿠팡] 가품 모니터링 오퍼레이션 매니저
description:
회사 소개

쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.

쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.

쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.

직무 소개

쿠팡에서 발생된 IP(지식재산권) 침해 상품에 한 위험 요소를 관리합니다. 판매될 또는 판매중인 상품 및 셀러 정보를 기반으로 지식재산권 침해 상품이 적발되면 모니터링 이후에 판매 여부를 결정합니다.
또한 고객 및 내부 신고건을 신속하게 대응하여 지식재산권 침해 상품에 대한 고객의 안좋은 경험을 빠르게 차단합니다. 아이템 마켓 정책에 따라 지식재산권 침해 상품을 반복적으로 등록하는 셀러에게 패널티를 부과하거나 제재할 수 있는 프로세스를 마련합니다.

업무 내용

  • 여러 조직에서 검출된 지식재산권 침해 상품과 셀러 모니터링
  • IP 위반 이슈로 인입된 고객 및 내부 신고건 리뷰
  • 권리자 및 대외기관으로부터 인입되는 IP 침해 상품에 대한 검토 및 조치
  • IP 침해 상품을 등록하는 셀러에 대한 정책 마련하여 이슈 재발 방지

자격 요건

  • 관련 분야 경력 3년 이상이신 분
  • 이커머스(e-commerce), 온라인 플랫폼 또는 유사 온라인 업계 경험이 있으신 분
  • 적극적으로 의견을 개진하고 팀과 활발하게 소통하는 커뮤니케이션 스타일을 보유하신 분
  • 데이터 기반으로 업무 성과를 분석하고 보고할 수 있으신 분

우대 사항

  • 소규모 팀(10명 내외) 운영 또는 인력 관리 경험이 있으신 분
  • 가품 모니터링, 지식재산권 침해 대응 등 관련 업무 경험이 있으신 분
  • 영어 커뮤니케이션이 가능하신 분 (필수 아님)
  • 데이터 기반으로 업무 성과를 분석하고 보고할 수 있으신 분

전형 절차 및 안내 사항

  • 전형절차
    • 서류전형 - 직무 적합성 인터뷰 - 핵심 역량 인터뷰 – 최종 합격
    • 전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.
    • 전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.
  • 참고사항
    • 본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.

    • 취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.

title: YDP - HEALTH & WELLNESS (MILLER FREEDOM)
description:
YOUTH DEVELOPMENT PROFESSIONAL - HEALTH & WELLNESS (MILLER FREEDOM)

This position is designed to develop young people’s capacity to engage in positive behaviors to nurture their well-being, set personal goals and grow into self-sufficient adults.

The Health & Wellness Youth Development Professional is part of a team-oriented Club staff dedicated to serving our youth and creating an optimal Club Experience. This position will plan, supervise and implement a variety of high-yield activities and targeted programs within a health and life skills focus.

This position is responsible for: ensuring youth development principles are incorporated into programs and activities; providing guidance and discipline to ensure a safe and positive environment for youth; ensuring the incorporation of character development, age appropriate and gender-specific programs and activities; ensuring that cultural diversity educational programs are implemented; assisting, as needed, in the planning, implementation, and delivery of educational activities and programs for youth ages 6 to 18.

KEY ROLES (Essential Job Responsibilities):

Prepare Youth for Success

This position primary responsibilities are:

  • Planning and implementing a variety of health and life skills programs for members of all ages, including Cybersafety, Date SMART, Passport to Manhood, Be a Star, UPS Road Code, SMART Girls, SMART Moves, Street SMART & Triple Play: Healthy Habits
  • Recruiting and retaining youth for the health and life skills programs
  • Working with other staff in the club to help implement these programs throughout the school year
  • Tracking and reporting student data for grant purposes

This position helps members to make appropriate choices about their education, career, social, physical and emotional needs as it relates to health and their future goals. The position also assesses the developmental needs, interests and characteristics of youth to develop targeted programs that result in an outcome-driven club experience.

  1. Ensure programs, services and activities prepare youth for success, promoting safety of members, quality in programs and appearance of Club at all times. Provide guidance and role modeling to members.
  2. Contribute to the planning and implementation of the strategic plan by:
  • Planning and organizing a range of program services and activities for members, such as field trips, program specific activities, guest speakers, field trips, etc.
  • Initiating new programs with the approval of the Program Director/Unit Director.
  • Promoting and stimulating program participation.
  1. Ensure quality improvement by monitoring and evaluating program achievement against target goals, recommending modifications that respond to member needs and interests and participating in weekly Club staff meetings.
  1. Participate in local, state, regional, and national Boys & Girls Clubs programs and competitions.

Health and Safety

  1. Ensure a healthy and safe environment, supervising members in program area.
  2. Maintain the cleanliness of program area.
  3. Maintain an inventory of program equipment and supplies in good order. Recommend requisitions as necessary.

Program Administration

  1. Prepare weekly reports for the Program Director/Unit Director regarding activities, special programs, upcoming events, attendance, and other reports as required.
  2. Maintains a daily written schedule. Ensures that programs begin and end on time.

ADDITIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES

  1. May participate in additional special programs and/or events.
  2. Evenings/weekend work may be involved.
  3. May be required to drive Club van.
    • (Requires valid driver’s license & three-year clean driving record)
  4. Other duties as assigned.

RELATIONSHIPS:

Internal: Maintains close, daily contact with club staff and volunteers, club members, and supervisor to receive/provide information, discuss issues, explain guidelines/instructions; instruct; and advise/counsel.

Requirements

Education

High School diploma or GED

Ability to pass DCF Level II background screening and drug test

Experience

  • Knowledge of youth development
  • Ability to motivate youth and manage behavior issues
  • Ability to work with the public
  • Ability to plan and implement quality programs specific to Health & Wellness
  • Ability to organize and supervise members in a safe environment

WORK ENVIRONMENT:

This position generally works M – F, between the hours of 2PM – 7PM, but may require longer hours outside of this schedule and occasional weekends when necessary. Work is conducted indoors and outdoors.

PHYSICAL AND MENTAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Ability to sit, stand and walk for long periods of time; bending and squatting on occasion
  • Ability to lift to 20 lbs. on occasion
  • Ability to hear at a normal conversational level
  • Ability to maintain high energy level when necessary
  • High degree of emotional intelligence

The Boys and Girls Clubs of NE Florida is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer and Drug Free Workplace. To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential job duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform essential job functions.

This position requires a Level 2 background screening through the Care Provider Background Screening Clearinghouse as mandated by Florida Statute 435.12. For more information, please visit the Clearinghouse Applicant Education and Awareness website: https://info.flclearinghouse.com/

title: Full stack Developer
description:
About The Company

IT Talent Solutions connects skilled technology professionals with opportunities to make a meaningful contribution. For this role, you will support an international organisation working across a range of web applications and digital services. The environment offers exposure to varied technical challenges and the opportunity to collaborate with people across different functions. The organisation values thoughtful problem-solving, dependable delivery, and solutions that are maintainable and responsive to user needs.

About The Role

As a Full Stack Developer, you will help design, develop, enhance, and support web applications across the technology stack. You will build new features, improve existing functionality, and help maintain CMS-supported websites. Working closely with stakeholders and colleagues, you will translate requirements into effective technical solutions and contribute throughout the development process, from understanding a need to troubleshooting issues after delivery. The role suits someone who can work independently while communicating clearly and collaborating effectively with others.

Qualifications

You will bring at least two to three years of full stack development experience, with strong skills in Python, React, JavaScript, and PostgreSQL. Practical familiarity with version control using Git or SVN is required. You should also have knowledge of AWS, the LAMP stack, HTML, and CSS, along with the ability to investigate issues, assess options, and deliver well-considered solutions. Clear communication, a proactive approach, and confidence working independently are important to success in this position.

Experience with RESTful APIs, Docker, and Linux would be beneficial. Familiarity with WordPress, Angular, D3, PHP, or other JavaScript frameworks is also desirable. Additional experience with GIS, Power BI, or data visualisation may help you contribute to a broader range of projects. Candidates do not need to have every desirable skill, but should be keen to apply their experience and continue developing their technical capabilities.

Responsibilities

Design, develop, test, and maintain web applications, producing code that is practical, reliable, and suitable for ongoing support. Build features and enhance existing platforms in response to agreed requirements. Collaborate with stakeholders to clarify objectives, understand user needs, and communicate technical considerations. Support CMS websites, investigate reported issues, and troubleshoot problems through to resolution. Use version control as part of a collaborative development workflow, and contribute to the improvement of application functionality and quality. Where appropriate, apply your knowledge of cloud services, APIs, databases, and front-end technologies to deliver cohesive full stack solutions.

Benefits

This opportunity offers hybrid working and flexible working hours, supporting a balanced and adaptable approach to work. The package includes pension and healthcare benefits. You will also have the opportunity to contribute to impactful projects in an international environment, work across a variety of technologies, and collaborate with stakeholders on solutions that support real business and user requirements.

Equal Opportunity

IT Talent Solutions is committed to fair and inclusive hiring. Applicants will be considered on their skills, experience, and suitability for the role. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and are committed to providing a respectful recruitment process and workplace.

title: [CLS] 대외협력 담당자 (물류 인프라 개발 및 인허가)
description:
회사 소개

CLS (Coupang Logistics Services)는 택배사업, 화물운송, 화물주선, 물류창고, 화물분류 등 종합 물류 서비스를 제공하는 쿠팡의 물류전문 계열사입니다. CLS는 국토교통부로 지정 받은 택배운송사업자로서 전국단위의 배송캠프에서 업계 최초로 도입한 분류작업전담인력과 직영 전문 배송직 쿠팡친구, 그리고 전국 단위 택배 영업점을 통해 고객에게 최적의 배송서비스를 제공하면서 쿠팡의 로켓배송을 완결하는 역할을 담당하고 있습니다. 로켓배송을 통해 미래 물류의 혁신을 이끌어 온 종합물류서비스 기업으로서 CLS는 로켓배송의 노하우, 인프라, 네트워크 등을 연계하여 물류 혁신을 통한 더 나은 고객감동을 만들어 나갈 것입니다.

관련 법령 및 제도 동향을 분석하고 운영 개선 과제를 발굴하며, 현업과의 협업을 통해 효율적이고 안정적인 운영 환경 구축을 지원합니다.
또한 물류 현장에서 발생하는 다양한 운영 이슈와 민원 사항에 대한 검토 및 지원 업무를 수행합니다.

  • 물류 인프라 운영 현황을 관리하고 운영 효율화 및 개선 과제 발굴

자격 요건

  • 7년 이상의 관련 업무 경력 보유자
  • 물류 운영(1P, 3PL 등) 경험을 바탕으로 물류 인프라 개발, 구축 또는 임대차 관련 업무를 수행한 경험이 있으신 분
  • 대내외 이해 관계자와의 협업을 통해 프로젝트를 추진한 경험이 있으신 분
  • 복잡한 운영 이슈를 분석하고 실행 가능한 개선 방안을 도출할 수 있는 분

    • 서류전형 - 직무 적합성 인터뷰 - 핵심 역량 인터뷰 - 최종 합격

title: Full-Time Lobby Attendant, 2nd Shift
description:
Be the First Impression That Makes a Lasting Impact!

At Blackwell, Inc., we're looking for friendly, professional, and service-oriented individuals to join our team as Lobby Attendants. title: Data Security Engineer
description:
Data Security Engineer

A Career with Point72's Technology Team

As Point72 reimagines the future of investing, our Technology team is constantly evolving our firm’s IT infrastructure and engineering capabilities, positioning us at the forefront of a rapidly evolving technology landscape. We’re a team of experts who experiment and work to discover new ways to harness open-source solutions, modern cloud architectures, and sophisticated Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions, while embracing enterprise agile methodologies. Our commitment to building and innovating in the AI space provides the framework intended to drive smarter decision making and enhance how we build and operate our platforms and applications.

As a member of Point72’s Technology team, we encourage and support your professional development from day one—helping you advance your technical skills, contribute innovative ideas, and satisfy your own intellectual curiosity—all while delivering real business impact for our multi-billion-dollar global business.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

You will shape how the firm identifies, protects, and governs sensitive data across workplace and cloud environments. You will have hands-on ownership of the control estate within Infrastructure Security, reporting to the Head of Infrastructure Security. Specifically, you will:

  • Design and operate enterprise data loss prevention controls across endpoints, email, collaboration platforms, and cloud storage
  • Deploy data protection policies across email, file storage, collaboration platforms, and endpoint devices
  • Build and maintain the classification taxonomy, sensitivity labels, auto-labeling rules, sensitive information types, and trainable classifiers that improve policy matching
