title: Avoin hakemus datakeskusrakentamisen projekteihin
location: Kymenlaakso, Hamina, Kotka, Kouvola, Pohjanmaa, Vaasa, Päijät-Häme, Heinola, Hollola, Lahti, Orimattila, Uusimaa, Espoo, Helsinki, Kauniainen, Kerava, Kirkkonummi, Lohja, Nurmijärvi, Siuntio, Tuusula, Vantaa, Vihti, Loviisa, Porvoo, Sipoo
description:
Etsitkö töitä nopeasti kasvavalta datakeskusrakentamisen alalta? Haluatko hyödyntää omaa osaamistasi pitkässä projektissa tai tarttua lyhyempään työmahdollisuuteen Uudellamaalla tai eri puolilla Suomea?

Datakeskushankkeet tarjoavat työmahdollisuuksia monenlaisille osaajille. Kerro meille osaamisestasi, kiinnostuksenkohteistasi ja siitä, missä haluat työskennellä, niin etsimme sinulle sopivan projektin.

Datakeskusrakentaminen on yksi rakennusalan nopeimmin kasvavista sektoreista ja etsimme jatkuvasti uusia osaajia erilaisiin työtehtäviin asiakkaidemme työmaille. Työmahdollisuuksia on tarjolla niin Uudellamaalla kuin reissutyönä muualla Suomessa. Tarjolla on sekä lyhyempiä että useita kuukausia tai jopa vuosia kestäviä projekteja.

Haemme avoimella hakemuksella tekijöitä monipuolisiin datakeskusprojekteihin. Työtehtävät voivat vaihdella työmaan spotteritehtävistä työnjohtoon sekä putkiasennuksista maanrakennus- ja koneenkuljetustehtäviin. Etsimme esimerkiksi spottereita, maanrakennustyöntekijöitä, putkiasentajia, sähköalan osaajia, toimistotyöntekijöitä, kaivinkoneenkuljettajia, logistiikan ammattilaisia sekä työnjohtotehtävissä toimivia osaajia.

Kerro hakemuksessasi aiemmasta työkokemuksestasi, koulutuksestasi, mahdollisista pätevyyksistäsi sekä siitä, millaisista työtehtävistä olet kiinnostunut. Mainitse myös, oletko kiinnostunut työskentelemään Uudellamaalla, reissutyössä vai molemmissa.

Sovit tähän työhön, jos sinulta löytyy:

  • Kokemusta rakennus-, teollisuus-, talotekniikka-, maanrakennus- tai vastaavista työtehtävistä
  • Hyvä asenne työntekoon ja halu oppia uutta
  • Sitoutuminen turvallisiin työtapoihin
  • Kyky työskennellä itsenäisesti sekä osana työryhmää
  • Suomen ja englannin kielen taito työtehtävästä riippuen
  • Voimassa oleva työturvallisuuskortti tai valmius suorittaa se

Hienoa (muttei välttämätöntä) on, jos sinulla on lisäksi:

  • Aikaisempaa kokemusta datakeskus- tai teollisuusrakentamisesta
  • Tulityökortti, tieturvakortti tai muita alan pätevyyksiä
  • Koneiden tai laitteiden käyttöön liittyviä lupia ja pätevyyksiä
  • Työnjohto- tai projektinhallintakokemusta
  • Valmius reissutyöhön

Me tarjoamme sinulle:

  • TESin mukaisen tai sitä paremman palkan, joka maksetaan aina ajallaan. Tässä työssä tuntipalkkasi asettuu 14-20 euron välille, ja se määritellään osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi mukaan.
  • Hyvät työvaatteet ja muut työssä tarvittavat varusteet
  • Mukavan ja rennon työporukan
  • Oman Workerin yhteyshenkilön, joka on helposti tavoitettavissa ja auttaa sinua henkilökohtaisesti kaikissa työsuhteeseesi liittyvissä asioissa

Miksi kannattaa hakea töitä juuri Workerin kautta:

”Workerilla voin luottaa siihen, että he näkevät potentiaalini, mihin pystyn ja mikä haastaa minua sopivasti”, kuvailee kauttamme työn löytänyt ammattilainen.

Me teemme sen, minkä lupaamme. Haluamme olla rekrytoijana ja työnantajana joustava, luotettava ja oikeudenmukainen. Käytännössä tämä tarkoittaa, että:

  • Meillä on reilu meininki. Saat aina työsopimuksen ja palkan ajallaan. Teemme sen minkä lupaamme, emmekä lupaa asioita, joita emme voi pitää.
  • Panostamme henkilökohtaiseen palveluun. Saat oman yhteyshenkilön, joka vastaa, kun soitat – niin pienissä kuin isommissakin työasioissa. Olet myös aina tervetullut piipahtamaan konttorillamme, tarjoamme kahvit! Toimipisteitä meillä on ympäri Suomen yhteensä 13.
  • Olemme puolellasi. Varmistamme, että saat asianmukaiset työvaatteet ja varusteet. Panostamme myös erityisen paljon työturvallisuuteen. Yhteyshenkilösi myös tukee sinua tarvittaessa työelämän kiemuroissa.
  • Tarjoamme paljon erilaisia työmahdollisuuksia. Oli tähtäimessäsi sitten alasi huippu, työelämässä rennosti surffailu tai kokonaan uusi ala, meiltä löytyy mahdollisuuksia ympäri Suomen. Voimme auttaa sinua myös löytämään urallesi uuden suunnan.

Kiinnostuitko? Jätä hakemuksesi!

Jätä hakemuksesi klikkaamalla hakupainiketta. Käymme hakemuksia läpi jatkuvasti, eli jätä hakemuksesi pian! Toivomme, että voisit aloittaa työt mahdollisimman pian.

Hakemisen jälkeen kuulet meistä lyhyen ajan kuluessa. Jos etenet rekrytointiprosessissa, tapaat ensin Workerin työntekijän rennossa haastattelussa, jonka tavoitteena on tutustua tarkemmin sinuun ja osaamiseesi. Viimeisessä vaiheessa pääset tapaamaan myös asiakasyrityksen yhteyshenkilön.

Odotamme innolla hakemustasi!

  • Drive root-cause analysis, the customer-facing report and the post-mortem, and make sure corrective and preventive actions are delivered.

Requirements

  • 7+ years in customer-facing technology, incident or escalation roles, including first-hand experience as an Incident Commander or crisis lead.
  • Programme management expertise, including recovering troubled programmes through planning, risk management, governance and change control.
  • Track record of owning high-impact outages and severe escalations end to end, running the war room and mobilising teams with no reporting line.

title: Behandelmedewerker GIT-PD
description:
Ben jij een gepassioneerde behandelmedewerker die klaar is voor een uitdagende en dynamische rol binnen de specialistische GGZ Altrecht Persoonlijkheidsstoornissen? Wij zijn op zoek naar een gedreven professional om ons team in Zeist te versterken!

Bij Altrecht Persoonlijkheidsstoornissen bieden we gespecialiseerde GGZ-behandeling aan mensen met ernstige persoonlijkheidsstoornissen. Onze zorgeenheid is verspreid over verschillende locaties, waaronder Utrecht, Nieuwegein, Zeist, en Woerden. We streven ernaar om individuen te helpen bij het (her)pakken van hun rol in de samenleving.

Wat ga je doen?

Samen met collega's werk je vanuit onze locatie Zeist en voer je de behandeling en begeleiding uit, gericht op het bevorderen van herstel-ondersteunende zorg. Hierin staan het opbouwen van een behandelrelatie en het herstelproces centraal. Als behandelmedewerker coördineer je de behandeling van een aantal patiënten, in samenwerking met de regievoerend GZ-psycholoog, psychiater of klinisch psycholoog en andere leden van het multidisciplinair team. Dit betekent dat je het initiatief neemt in de verschillende stappen van het behandelproces, zoals het doen van intakes, schrijven van intakeverslagen, voortgangsbrieven en dergelijke, het aangaan en onderhouden van een behandelrelatie, het opstellen van het behandelplan, CPAP en de zorgmonitor. Wij vinden ‘shared caseload’ en het gezamenlijk uitvoeren van een behandeling belangrijk en streven er dan ook altijd naar om met meerdere collega’s bij elke patiënt betrokken te zijn. Samen weten we immers meer dan alleen. In je rol als behandelmedewerker voer je individuele gesprekken met patiënten en zoek je actief samenwerking met ketenpartners en het systeem rondom de patiënt. Ook lever je een bijdrage aan groepsgerichte activiteiten zoals de GIT-PD, groepspsychotherapie, werkdoelen-groep, de VERS, zelfbeeldgroep en dergelijke. Het team GIT-PD Zeist is een stevig team waarbij er korte lijnen zijn tussen alle verschillende behandelaren. Aangezien het gaat om complexe problematiek leggen wij veel nadruk op een prettige en veilige samenwerking met elkaar. Een ander voordeel van ons team is dat er nog veel ruimte voelbaar is waar er nog verder vormgegeven en doorontwikkeld kan worden. Je bent dan ook van harte welkom om ook actief mee te denken bij potentieel nieuw aanbod, aanpassingen rondom de GIT-PD methodiek of verdere ontwikkeling van de eigen interessegebieden.

Taken bij deze functie

  • Behandelen en begeleiden van patiënten middels individuele contacten

  • Het doen van intakes, schrijven van intakeverslagen en brieven naar de huisarts

  • Het vormgeven van de instroom, contracteer, behandel en uitstroomfase

  • Afstemmen van de zorg met behandelverantwoordelijke en andere teamleden

  • Bijdrage leveren aan de groepsgerichte activiteiten, zoals de verschillende GIT-PD groepstherapieën of de VERS, zelfbeeld module

  • Bijdrage leveren aan ontwikkeling van het aanbod en de kwaliteit van zorg, o.a. op het gebied van herstel, betrekken van netwerk, implementeren GIT PD

  • Geven van informatie en advies aan andere disciplines en externen m.b.t. het zorgaanbod en de doelgroep.

Wat hebben we jou te bieden?

Bij Altrecht heeft je werk betekenis: samen met bevlogen collega’s en een sterk netwerk van zorg- en kennispartners maak je écht verschil in de ggz. Je krijgt de ruimte om jezelf te zijn, mee te denken en te groeien, als professional én als mens.

Je komt te werken in een organisatie vol mogelijkheden, met diverse (TopGGZ) specialismen en meerdere werklocaties in en rondom Utrecht. We kijken naar jou als persoon, je ambities en je voorkeuren zoals behandelprogramma’s en woon-werkafstand. Samen vinden we de rol die het beste bij je past.

Daarnaast krijg je van ons:

  • Een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 3.560,- tot € 5.294,- (FWG 50/55 in de cao GGZ, afhankelijk van werkervaring) op basis van 36 uur per week.

  • Een volledige dertiende maand (8,33% eindejaarsuitkering) en 8,33% vakantiegeld.

  • 166 vakantie-uren en 35 levensfase-uren per jaar (o.b.v. 36 uur per week). Extra tijd voor jezelf? Je kunt tot 36 uur extra verlof bijkopen.

  • Een jaarlijks balansbudget. Je kunt het bedrag uit laten betalen, extra verlof kopen of het bedrag verhogen tot € 1.400,- als je het inzet voor een vrijetijdscursus.

  • Pensioenopbouw bij Pensioenfonds Zorg en Welzijn, collectieve inkomensverzekering en korting op aanvullende zorgverzekering (IZZ of Zilveren Kruis).

  • Alflex, ons meerkeuzesysteem voor extra arbeidsvoorwaarden. Kies bijv. voor een fiets, sportschoolabonnement of reiskostenvergoeding.

  • Ruimte en mogelijkheden voor (door)groei! Je kunt scholingen volgen bij de Altrecht Academie, deelnemen aan organisatiebrede kennis & expertisenetwerken, meewerken aan onderzoek of jezelf verder ontwikkelen in de praktijk, via opleidingen en intervisie.

Wie ben jij?

Wat breng je mee?

  • Je beschikt over een afgeronde opleiding HBO-V, SPV, of SW met uitstroomprofiel GGZ agoog

  • Je hebt een BIG-registratie en beschikt over een AGB-code

  • Je hebt affiniteit en bij voorkeur ervaring in het werken met patiënten met ernstige persoonlijkheidsstoornissen

  • Je bent in staat om zelfstandig en samen te werken

  • Je bent iemand die oog en oor heeft voor het hele verhaal van de patiënt en juist daarom ben je sterk in het maken van contact met patiënten, naasten en netwerkpartners

  • Je bent flexibel, hebt doorzettingsvermogen en tegelijkertijd ben je in staat op een adequate manier grenzen te stellen. Met andere woorden, het werk stelt je geregeld voor een puzzel, maar dat is voor jou nou net een deel van het plezier

  • Je bent in staat en bereid om op je eigen functioneren te reflecteren en een zekere mate van openheid en oprechtheid naar collega's en patiënten te laten zien

  • Je vindt het leuk om jezelf te ontwikkelen en je vakkennis te vergroten.

  • Je houdt van aanpakken en beschikt over een gezonde dosis humor en het vermogen te relativeren.

Daarnaast herken jij jezelf in onze kernwaarden: passend, vertrouwen, verbindend en (veer-)krachtig.

Wie zijn wij?

Het behandelteam GIT-PD Zeist streeft ernaar zo veel mogelijk patiënten een passende behandeling te geven. Dit doen wij onder andere door het GIT-PD (Guideline-Informed Treatment for Personality Disorders) kader te gebruiken als basis om iedereen een kwalitatieve behandeling te bieden. GIT-PD is een relatief nieuw behandelkader dat ondersteund wordt door het Kenniscentrum Persoonlijkheidsstoornissen Nederland en die bewezen werkzame elementen van verschillende psychotherapeutische methodieken combineert. Daarbij wordt binnen het GIT-PD behandelkader vaak gewerkt met verschillende vormen van psychotherapie. De patiënten krijgen binnen ons team een behandeling op maat. Altrecht Persoonlijkheidsstoornissen hoort, als het om de toepassing van GIT-PD gaat, hierin bij de koplopers in Nederland. Het is de bedoeling deze vorm van hulpverlening verder door te ontwikkelen, waarvoor er ook een samenwerkingsverband is met het Kenniscentrum Persoonlijkheidsstoornissen.

Enthousiast en nu?

Solliciteer eenvoudig via de onderstaande button! Wil je eerst meer weten? Stuur gerust een berichtje of bel met Annemarie Oostveen, teammanager via 06-49371488. Je bent ook van harte welkom voor een oriënterend gesprek, zodat je de sfeer bij ons kunt ervaren. We kijken ernaar uit om van je te horen!

Goed om te weten

  • Een dagdeel meelopen kan onderdeel uitmaken van de sollicitatieprocedure. Zo leren wij elkaar beter kennen.

  • Acquisitie op basis van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld.

Are you an experienced grant writer with a passion for making a difference? Join Alternative Family Services (AFS) and help secure funding and build partnerships that support vulnerable children, youth, and families.
AFS is seeking a hands-on fundraising professional who independently carries assigned philanthropic grants and Development projects from research and qualification through proposals, reporting, stewardship and closeout. The Development Grants & Partnerships Specialist maintains the Grant Matrix, obtains Program and Finance inputs, produces accurate and persuasive funding materials, and advances approved third-party fundraising and partnership initiatives within agreed priorities and authority.
We’re looking for a highly organized, proactive nonprofit development professional who can take the lead on grant research, proposal writing, funding coordination, reporting, and relationship-building.
The ideal candidate brings:
  • Experience with grant writing, fundraising, or nonprofit development.
  • Strong research, writing, and project management skills.
  • The ability to independently manage multiple projects and deadlines.
  • Excellent communication, organization, and follow-through.
  • A passion for supporting children, youth, and families in our communities.
This role will report to the Chief Executive Officer (CEO), also working closely with the Senior Program Development Proposal Writer. Candidates should be based in northern California, with ability to travel between the various Alternative Family Services (AFS) offices. This is part-time, non-benefited role and will be approximately 20 hours per week.
About Alternative Family Services:

Alternative Family Services is a Foster Family, Adoption and Mental Health Agency that has been serving abused and neglected children in our community since 1973. Our mission is to support vulnerable children and families in need of stability, safety, and well-being in communities. We provide a wide range of foster, adoption, mental health and transition-aged youth services in English and Spanish. We have eight locations throughout the Bay Area and 200 employees. We celebrate diversity, equal opportunity, and excellence.
Qualifications:
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • Associate’s degree or equivalent combination of education and two years of related experience required; Bachelor’s degree preferred. Experience in grant writing, fundraising, nonprofit development, or social services preferred.
  • Strong research, writing, editing, analytical, and communication skills, with the ability to prepare accurate, persuasive proposals and reports.
  • Excellent organizational skills, sound judgment, and ability to work independently, manage multiple deadlines, maintain accurate records, and handle confidential information.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, spreadsheets, shared files, and grant portals; experience with donor or grant management systems preferred. Ability to learn DonorPerfect and AFS Hub.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and ability to represent AFS professionally with funders, public agencies, community partners, and internal stakeholders.
  • Commitment to cultural humility and providing culturally responsive services to diverse children, youth, and families.
  • Ability to work remotely from California using approved technology and secure information-handling practices.
  • Must meet required background and criminal record clearances.
  • Must possess a valid California driver’s license, acceptable driving record, current auto insurance, and vehicle registration, with the ability to travel for AFS business.
Essential Functions and Responsibilities:
  • Monitor funding sources for upcoming RFPs and program development opportunities. Conduct research as requested by the Grant Writer, CEO, and CPO.
  • Assist in maintaining the annual calendar of fund development activities, events, mailings, and grant deadlines.
  • Assist in maintaining the annual calendar of fund development activities, events, mailings, and grant deadlines.

title: Senior Software Engineer, OS Integration
description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About the OS Integration team:

The OS Integration team ensures Firefox works well with the host operating system and environment. We’re a distributed team with expertise in Windows, macOS, and Linux-based operating systems. Our responsibilities include developing fixes and improvements for Firefox related to Windows, macOS, and Linux environments. This might include integration with a new OS feature or fixing an OS-specific user interface bug. Other responsibilities include native crash reporting, OS abstraction layers, sandboxing, hardening, updater, and enterprise DLP support.

About the role:

As a member of the OS Integration team, you’ll develop fixes, improvements, and new features for Firefox. In many cases work may be cross-platform or have a cross-platform component. This role will include maintenance and development of the installer and updater of Firefox. You’ll contribute to the team through code review and discussion.

What you’ll do:

  • Improve the quality of Firefox and other Mozilla products by debugging and fixing software defects, improving the browsing experience for hundreds of millions of users.
  • Contribute to new features and improvements.
  • Break down tasks and work with others to deliver solutions.
  • Collaborate with experienced software engineers.
  • Perform code reviews and provide technical direction.
  • Work with a geographically-distributed development team.
  • Interact with teams throughout the organization.

What you’ll bring:

  • 5+ years of overall software engineering experience
  • Strong knowledge of C and C++
  • Experience with desktop application development on Windows, macOS, or Linux with C++.
  • Knowledge of web technologies such as Javascript and HTML.
  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and memory safety concerns.
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.
  • Written and verbal communication skills with a collaborative mindset.
  • Willingness to work effectively in a distributed team environment.
  • Commitment to our values:
    • Play to win
    • Build for People first
    • Engage Evidence over Ego
    • Decide and Deliver
    • Ship, learn and repeat

Bonus Points for experience with:

  • Installer and/or Updater development on any OS
  • Windows internals like the BITS server or MSIX packages
  • Open-source contributions or personal engineering projects

What you’ll get:

  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
  • Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together
  • Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
  • One-time home office stipend
  • Annual professional development budget
  • Considerable paid parental leave
  • Employee referral bonus program
  • Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)

About Mozilla

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging

Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientations, gender identities, and expressions.

title: Principal Concept Artist - VALORANT Mobile
description:
Riot Games was established in 2006 by entrepreneurial gamers who believe that player-focused game development can result in great games. In 2009, Riot released its debut title League of Legends to critical and player acclaim. As the most played video game in the world, over 100 million play every month. We’re looking for humble but ambitious, razor-sharp professionals who can teach us a thing or two. We promise to return the favor. Like us, you take play seriously; you’re passionate about games. We embrace those who see things differently, aren’t afraid to experiment, and who have a healthy disregard for constraints.

That's where you come in.

VALORANT Mobile brings VALORANT’s competitive spirit, distinctive style, and vibrant world to millions of players every day. Together with our development and publishing partners, we’re building a tactical shooter where precise gunplay, team strategy, and player creativity create unforgettable competitive moments. As a Principal Concept Artist on VALORANT Mobile, you will shape that creative work, inspiring our partners to push what VALORANT can become while preserving what makes it unmistakably VALORANT.

You will lead the visual direction of major features and moments developed with our development and publishing partners, from Lunar New Year social hub themes and Mobile-original skin explorations to the visual tone of new in-game experiences. Working closely with China product leadership and the VALORANT Creative Director, you will turn product goals and player insights into compelling creative direction and guide partner teams from early exploration through final execution. You will also own the ongoing creative review of partner-developed content, providing clear, actionable feedback that raises craft quality and maintains consistency with VALORANT’s characters, world, and visual identity.

Responsibilities

  • Lead visual direction for major VALORANT Mobile features and moments, establishing creative concepts, visual targets, and quality expectations with external development and publishing partners. Engage early to align on direction, surface creative risks, and reduce avoidable rework
  • Own creative review across partner-developed content, including sprays, emotes, icons, player cards, and other in-game assets. Provide actionable feedback from concept through final execution on craft quality, shape language, composition, stylistic consistency, and character likeness
  • Translate VALORANT’s creative direction and IP foundations into clear briefs, visual references, style guides, and review criteria that help partners deliver consistently high-quality work
  • Partner with the VALORANT Creative Director and relevant discipline and area leads to maintain creative continuity across PC and Mobile, bringing player motivations, Chinese youth culture, and global creative trends into content tailored to mobile audiences
  • Establish a consistent review process with product, production, creative, and publishing partners. Consolidate feedback, clarify priorities, and track creative issues through resolution
  • Resolve creative questions within agreed guidelines and escalate new IP interpretations, significant departures from established direction, and unresolved creative disagreements to the appropriate owners
  • Build trusted relationships with creative leads on our external development and publishing partners, providing direction and coaching that strengthens their creative judgment and ability to deliver high-quality work independently

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in game development with 8+ years leading or directing art teams
  • Deep and demonstrable passion and knowledge of the VALORANT IP, from overarching story to character interactions and dynamics, to character likeness
  • Demonstrable ability to lead creative work across multiple distributed teams and partners
  • Practitioner, mentor, and student of world-class visual design practices able to maintain the highest standards of professionalism and craft across the art org.

title: Staff Security Engineer (Vendor Security Assurance)
description:
회사 소개

쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.

쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.

쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.

직무 소개

Vendor Security Assurance 팀은 쿠팡의 비즈니스 생태계에 참여하는 외부 Vendor, 서비스, 솔루션으로부터 발생할 수 있는 보안 리스크를 식별, 평가, 관리함으로써 회사의 정보자산과 고객 신뢰를 보호하는 역할을 수행합니다.

Vendor 및 Product에 대한 보안 리스크 평가, 위험 완화 및 개선 활동, 수명주기 기반의 리스크 관리, 지속적인 모니터링과 거버넌스 운영을 통해 Third-Party Security Risk Management 체계를 강화합니다. 또한 다양한 이해관계자와 협업하여 비즈니스 성장과 혁신을 지원하면서도 적정 수준의 보안 통제를 유지할 수 있도록 보안 의사결정을 지원합니다.

역할 및 책임 (Responsibilities)

  • Vendor 보안성 검토
    • SaaS, Generative AI, 아웃소싱, 개인정보 수탁사등의 보안 정책, 절차, 통제 기술등 보안수준 평가
    • 보안요구사항 이행 관리 : 인증/인가, 취약한 구성/설정, Privacy & Compliance, 모니터링(로깅), 내부 시스템 연동 등
  • Vendor 보안 위험 관리 : 보안 리스크 식별, 위험 완화 및 개선 활동, 수명주기 기반의 리스크 관리, 지속적인 모니터링과 거버넌스 운영
  • 새로운 보안 위협, 업계동향, 규제 변화를 파악하여 외부 협력 vendor 보안평가를 위한 방법론 개발 및 개선

자격 요건 (Qualifications)

  • 어플리케이션 인증, 인가, 로깅, API 연동에 대한 충분한 이해
  • 정보보안, IT, 인프라, 네트워크, 기반 기술에 대한 충분한 이해
  • 개인정보처리 시스템 보안 관리 경험
  • 정보보안 시스템 기획, 구축, 운영 및 모니터링 경험
  • 유관 부서와의 협업 및 유연한 커뮤니케이션 스킬
  • 정보기술, 정보보안, 컴퓨터 과학 또는 관련 분야 학사 학위 이상
  • 최소 8년 이상의 정보보안 업무 경력

우대 사항 (Preferred Skills)

  • 보안성 심의/검토 등 유사 업무 경험
  • 3rd-prary vendor 보안 Risk 식별 및 관리 업무 경험
  • SSPM (SaaS security posture management) 경험
  • 보안 아키텍처 설계 및 직접 Hands-on 하여 구현한 경험
  • 정보통신망법, 전자금융거래법, 개인정보보호법 등 Compliance에 대한 이해
  • e-Commerce 및 물류 비즈니스에 대한 이해
  • 영어 커뮤니케이션 스킬
  • CISA, CISSP, ISO/IEC 27001 등 정보보안 관련 자격증

전형 절차 및 안내 사항

  • 전형절차
    • 서류전형 - 직무 적합성 인터뷰 - 핵심 역량 인터뷰 – 최종 합격
    • 전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.
    • 전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.
  • 참고사항
    • 본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
    • 지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.
    • 취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.
    • 직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.
    • 채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.

개인정보 처리방침

  • 쿠팡 그룹은 입사지원자 개인정보 처리방침(아래 링크)에 따라 귀하의 개인정보를 수집하여 처리합니다.

서류 반환 정책

  1. 본 고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』 제11조제6항에 따른 것 입니다.
  2. 당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.
  3. 위2항 본문에 따라 채용 서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용 서류 반환 청구서 [채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제 3 호 서식]를 작성하여 이메일 (recruitingops@coupang.com) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14 일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다.
  4. 당사는 위2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.
  5. 단, 위 1항 내지 4항의 내용은 대한민국의 노동 관계 법령이 적용되는 경우에만 적용됩니다. 그 이외의 경우에는 적용되지 않습니다.

title: Project Manager - IT
description:
Position Summary

Flatter, inc. (Flatter) is hiring an IT Project Manager to support full lifecycle IT and cyber services required to operate and coordinate for the support, defense, and sustainment of ICBM enterprise IT environments across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid architectures. The IT Project Manager will deliver scalable, resilient, and compliant services that maintain security, availability, and mission readiness as ICBMSD enterprise needs evolve. The IT Project Manager will provide proactive and reactive support across the functional areas.


Plans and directs IT projects, sprints, and mission-support initiatives from requirements definition through Government acceptance. The project manager integrates scope, schedule, cost, risk, quality, communications, staffing, and technical dependencies using the methodology directed for each effort.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

• Develop and maintain project management plans, implementation roadmaps, schedules, milestones, work breakdowns, risk registers, communications plans, and quality controls.

• Apply Agile SCRUM, traditional Waterfall, or a hybrid approach based on Government direction, project complexity, and risk.

• Facilitate sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, retrospectives, milestone reviews, and other governance activities.

• Coordinate stakeholders, technical teams, vendors, construction personnel, security organizations, and Government leads to manage dependencies and decisions.

• Track scope, schedule, labor, cost, quality, risks, issues, assumptions, actions, and deliverable status and provide accurate leadership reporting.

• Develop or coordinate SOPs for activities requiring Government participation or approval and ensure teams use the latest approved plans and baselines.

• Prepare technical approaches, labor mixes, cost inputs, milestones, acceptance criteria, and deliverable plans for surge and sprint requirements.

• Manage change, obtain required approvals, and ensure completed work meets established acceptance and work-completion criteria.


Security Clearance: Must have an active Secret, or higher level clearance


Security Compliance and Performance Expectations

• Perform work within authorized Government policies, plans, processes, tools, and environments across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid architectures.

• Protect Government systems and data at the assigned classification and impact level, and maintain the required clearance, special access, privileged-access approval, and DoD 8140/8570-aligned certification.

• Document work, decisions, risks, issues, and resolutions in Government-approved systems and support audits, quality reviews, and monthly status reporting as directed.

• Participate in Government-directed training, modernization initiatives, working groups, surge support, and continuous process improvement activities.

Required Knowledge Skills and Capabilities

• Highly organized and detail-oriented with strong management skills

• Knowledge/experience in requirements capture, design, and decomposition

• Capability to elicit and specify stakeholder needs

• Effective verbal and written communication skills with high degree of emotional intelligence

• Able to work independently or in a team setting

• Experience in integrating multiple projects including maximizing use of resources/personnel, scheduling, and costing.

• Problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and follow through

• Knowledge of ICBMs and acquisition lifecycle helpful/preferred

• Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint

• Principal skill set includes ability to perform all stated/implied duties within this tier and those reasonably derived from preceding

title: DevOps Engineers
description:
At CGI, our DevOps Engineers play a vital role in delivering secure, innovative technology that supports national security and helps protect the UK. Working within our Space, Defence and Intelligence business, you’ll help design, automate and enhance mission-critical platforms that enable our clients to operate with confidence. You’ll take ownership of meaningful engineering challenges, explore creative approaches to improving performance and reliability, and collaborate with talented professionals across our delivery teams. With access to continuous learning, technical expertise and a supportive environment, you’ll have the opportunity to develop your skills while contributing to solutions that make a lasting difference. Join CGI and help shape the future of secure digital services.

CGI was recognised in the Sunday Times Best Places to Work List 2025 and has been named a UK ‘Best Employer’ by the Financial Times. We offer a competitive salary, excellent pension, private healthcare, plus a share scheme (3.5% + 3.5% matching) which makes you a CGI Partner not just an employee. We are committed to inclusivity, building a genuinely diverse community of tech talent and inspiring everyone to pursue careers in our sector, including our Armed Forces, and are proud to hold a Gold Award in recognition of our support of the Armed Forces Corporate Covenant. Join us and you’ll be part of an open, friendly community of experts. We’ll train and support you in taking your career wherever you want it to go.

Please note: This role is primarily based on a secure client site, requiring attendance five days per week. Occasional flexibility may be available subject to business needs and security requirements. Due to the level of security clearance required, applicants must be sole British nationals, have resided in the UK for the past 10 years and must not have spent more than 28 consecutive days outside the UK within the last five years. Candidates who do not currently hold clearance are encouraged to apply and may also be considered for other suitable CGI opportunities.

Candidate Profile

In this role, you will design, develop and maintain secure, scalable infrastructure and automated delivery solutions that support CGI’s mission-critical systems across Defence and National Security. You’ll take ownership of complex engineering challenges, applying your technical expertise to improve platform reliability, streamline deployments and strengthen operational performance. Working with modern containerisation, infrastructure automation and continuous integration technologies, you’ll contribute to delivering resilient solutions that meet demanding security and performance requirements.

You’ll collaborate with developers, testers and platform specialists to identify opportunities for innovation, resolve technical challenges and continuously improve engineering practices. Supported by a knowledgeable, cross-functional team, you’ll have the freedom to explore new approaches, develop your capabilities and contribute to technical decisions that deliver meaningful outcomes for our clients.

  • Design & Deliver: Build, configure and maintain secure, scalable DevOps infrastructure supporting mission-critical applications.
  • Automate & Optimise: Develop and enhance CI/CD pipelines, reducing manual processes and improving deployment efficiency.
  • Manage & Orchestrate: Support containerised applications using Kubernetes, Argo and Rancher to ensure reliable platform operations.
  • Engineer & Maintain: Configure and manage Linux environments, including package management and infrastructure automation using Puppet or similar tools.
  • Develop & Integrate: Apply scripting and programming expertise to automate workflows, troubleshoot issues and enhance system functionality.
  • Test & Assure: Validate configurations, recreate technical issues and support quality assurance throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Collaborate & Innovate: Work closely with multidisciplinary teams to solve complex technical challenges and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
  • Plan & Improve: Participate in Agile delivery practices, including Scrum and Kanban, to prioritise work and deliver high-quality engineering outcomes.

Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role

To succeed in this role, you should have practical experience in DevOps engineering, infrastructure automation and modern deployment technologies, combined with strong Linux administration and troubleshooting capabilities. You'll be comfortable working across complex technical environments, collaborating with multidisciplinary teams and taking ownership of engineering challenges. A proactive approach to problem-solving, enthusiasm for continuous improvement and willingness to develop new skills will help you thrive within CGI's supportive engineering community.

  • Containerisation & Orchestration: Strong experience with Kubernetes, Argo and Rancher for managing and deploying containerised applications.
  • Linux Administration: Proven experience managing Linux environments, including RPM/Yum package management.
  • Infrastructure as Code: Practical experience with Puppet or similar infrastructure automation and configuration management tools.
  • Programming & Development: Working knowledge of Java and Go, with the ability to understand, troubleshoot and support application development.
  • Scripting & Automation: Proficiency in Python and Bash for developing automation scripts and improving operational efficiency.
  • Version Control: Experience using Git and/or SVN for source code management and collaborative development.
  • CI/CD & DevOps Practices: Experience supporting automated build, test and deployment pipelines within complex technical environments.
  • Problem-Solving & Troubleshooting: Proven ability to investigate technical issues, validate configurations and implement reliable solutions.
  • Agile Collaboration: Experience working within Scrum or Kanban teams, contributing to planning, prioritisation and continuous improvement.

title: Security Supervisor I
description:
Lead the Shift. Own the Mission. Keep Coverage Strong.

At Blackwell Professional Support Services, Inc., our Security Supervisors don’t just “work a post”—they lead operations, support their teams, and ensure our clients receive consistent, professional security coverage around the clock. This is a hands-on leadership role designed for experienced security professionals who thrive in fast-moving, real-world environments and understand that security doesn’t clock out.

Why This Role Is Different

  • You’ll help oversee a security operation that consists of one to two shift differentials (not 24/7).
  • You’ll work alongside a dedicated Territory Manager (your direct manager) —you are never operating alone.
  • You’ll have the authority and responsibility to step in when coverage matters most.
  • You’ll lead from the front—supporting officers, resolving issues, and maintaining continuity when schedules flex and emergencies arise.

If you’re looking for a role where your leadership actually matters, this is it.

Primary Schedule:

Tuesday - Saturday: 11:00 pm - 7:00 am (40-hours per week)

The Role at a Glance

As a Security Supervisor, you are a critical part of our management team. You oversee daily operations at an assigned property, supervise and coach Security Officers, and ensure that essential security coverage is always maintained—even when circumstances change.

While a primary work schedule is established, this position requires schedule flexibility. When call-offs occur, emergencies arise, or coverage gaps remain after overtime or flex officers are utilized, management team members—including supervisors—are expected to step in. This expectation is non-negotiable and mission-critical to our operation.

What You’ll Be Responsible For

  • Supervising and supporting a team of Security Officers across assigned shifts
  • Partnering closely with the Territory Manager to manage a security operation
  • Serving as the first point of contact for officer questions, concerns, and guidance
  • Creating, adjusting, and maintaining weekly schedules to ensure full coverage
  • Reviewing and approving timesheets accurately and on time
  • Training new officers through hands-on instruction and job shadowing
  • Coaching officers through regular inspections, feedback, and performance development
  • Communicating policy updates and procedural changes clearly and consistently
  • Maintaining strong client, resident/tenant, vendor, and visitor relationships
  • Ensuring property access is limited to authorized individuals
  • Completing detailed reports and maintaining clear, timely communication
  • Protecting resident/tenant privacy and confidentiality at all times
  • Executing all duties of assigned posts when coverage requires it
  • Stepping in to fill critical coverage gaps when other staffing solutions are exhausted
  • Supporting additional property-specific needs as required

What We’re Looking For

  • 21+ years of age
  • Current St. Louis Security License (or ability to obtain)
  • High school diploma or GED
  • 3+ years of customer service experience
  • 1+ year of supervisory or management experience
  • Security or loss prevention experience strongly preferred
  • Strong communication skills—verbal and written
  • Excellent organization, follow-up, and problem-solving abilities
  • Comfortable making decisions in dynamic environments
  • Dependable, punctual, and team-oriented
  • Computer literacy with an emphasis on report writing
  • Experience with Microsoft Office a plus
  • Ability to work weekends, holidays, and varied shifts as needed
  • Schedule flexibility and a leadership mindset are essential

title: Sr. Regulatory Counsel, Data Center Power & Utilities
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

SR. REGULATORY COUNSEL, DATA CENTER POWER & UTILITIES

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provide expert legal guidance on regulatory matters for power and utility service at SpaceXSI datacenter and compute sites, including authorization to take and use large amounts of power, interconnection, tariffs, and related utility approvals
  • Lead engagement with federal, state, and local regulators, public utility commissions, grid operators, and utilities to obtain the approvals required to power datacenter operations
  • Advise on large-load interconnections, retail and wholesale power arrangements, utility service applications, and special contracts or tariffs for high-demand sites
  • Assess regulatory pathways, timelines, and risk for new sites and expansions, including siting, generation, transmission, and behind-the-meter options
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to brief regulators and utility counterparties and to align legal strategy with site development, engineering, and operations
  • Draft and negotiate utility and power agreements that implement approved service, including interconnection, service, and related operational terms
  • Support permitting and compliance for energy infrastructure tied to datacenter load, and coordinate with environmental, real estate, and construction counsel where those issues affect power authorization
  • Track regulatory developments that affect datacenter power use and standardize playbooks so teams can move new sites through approval faster and with less risk

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • JD or foreign equivalent from an ABA-accredited law school
  • 8+ years of legal experience focused on utilities, energy, or power, including work with government agencies, regulatory bodies, or utilities

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Direct experience obtaining authorization for significant power usage, ideally for datacenters, large industrial loads, or other high-demand facilities
  • Knowledge of state utility commission practice, federal energy regulation, interconnection processes, and utility tariffs
  • 8+ years of relevant regulatory experience, ideally a mix of:
    • Top-tier law firm training in energy, utility, or infrastructure regulation
    • In-house experience at a utility, datacenter or technology company, energy developer, or industrial operator
  • Demonstrated experience advising on regulatory strategy and drafting filings, applications, and utility agreements with limited outside-counsel reliance
  • Ability to drive approvals end to end on accelerated timelines
  • Prior exposure to large-scale power infrastructure, mission-critical facilities, or complex generation and interconnection projects
  • Comfort working where the regulatory pathway for new load is evolving or unsettled
  • Demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced environment with minimal turnaround time

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Must be admitted to the bar, in good standing, in at least one U.S. state
  • Must be available to work extended hours and weekends as needed
  • Willingness to travel 4 to 6 times a year to different SpaceX offices for a week at a time
  • This position requires being onsite at a designated SpaceX office; remote work will not be considered

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

  • To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. title: Senior Fullstack Java Developer
description:
Avanti Recruitment is recruiting for a Senior Java Full Stack Developer to join an established, international software company based in Central London.

The company develops complex, business-critical enterprise software used by major organisations internationally. Its products support high-volume transactions and essential business operations, giving engineers the opportunity to work on technically challenging, large-scale applications.

This is a hands-on development position with a strong emphasis on Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs and microservices, alongside commercial frontend development using Angular, React or Vue.

The company is continuing to modernise its established software platforms, creating an opportunity to work with modern technologies while improving and extending existing enterprise applications.

The position would suit an experienced Java developer who enjoys solving complex technical problems, wants to remain hands-on rather than move into management, and is comfortable working across both backend and frontend development.

Strong mid-level developers ready to step into a senior position will also be considered.

The Role

You will be responsible for designing, developing and enhancing the company's core software products, working closely with developers, architects and project managers to deliver robust, scalable and maintainable solutions.

Responsibilities will include:

  • Designing and developing Java and Spring Boot applications.
  • Developing RESTful APIs and microservices.
  • Building and enhancing frontend functionality.
  • Working with relational databases and SQL.
  • Contributing to technical architecture and design discussions.
  • Modernising existing applications and improving performance, scalability and maintainability.
  • Troubleshooting complex technical problems, conducting code reviews and supporting testing and releases.
  • Collaborating with an established international engineering team.

Essential Skills & Experience

  • Strong commercial development experience with Java and Spring Boot.
  • Hands-on experience designing and developing RESTful APIs and microservices.
  • Genuine commercial frontend development experience using Angular, React or Vue.js.
  • Good understanding of relational databases, including writing and troubleshooting SQL queries.
  • Strong understanding of object-oriented programming, software engineering principles and design patterns.
  • Experience developing and maintaining complex enterprise applications.
  • Familiarity with Git, testing, debugging and modern software development practices.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to explain technical implementations in detail.
  • Comfortable working across both backend and frontend development.

Angular is the company's preferred frontend framework, but developers with commercial React or Vue experience who are willing to learn Angular will also be considered.

Desirable Skills

  • Docker, Kubernetes or OpenShift.
  • Cloud technologies and DevOps/CI/CD pipelines.
  • Jenkins, Maven and other build tools.
  • Experience with J2EE, JBoss or established enterprise systems.
  • Experience with large-scale transactional systems, billing platforms or telecommunications software.
  • Oracle or PL/SQL experience.

Interview Process

  • First stage: Technical video interview covering previous development experience, Java, Spring Boot and architecture. Practical coding exercises may be included.
  • Second stage: Onsite technical assessment and interview at the office.

Salary & Benefits

  • Salary: 65,000 - 75,000 depending on experience
  • Hybrid working: 2 days in the office, with 3 days working from home
  • Working hours: Generally 9:00am - 5:30pm
  • Holiday: 25 days + Bank holidays
  • Private healthcare: Vitality, after 6 months
  • Life assurance: 4x basic salary
  • Income protection
    Pension:     4% employer contribution with 4% employee contribution
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Office lunches, fruit and pastries provided
  • Cycle-to-work scheme

The employer is unable to provide visa sponsorship for this vacancy.

This is an excellent opportunity for a developer who enjoys hands-on coding, solving complex engineering challenges and taking ownership of technical solutions within an established product development environment.

title: Project Manager
description:

Site: Cleveland, OH - 17000 Saint Clair, Cleveland OH 44110
Position Summary
The Project Manager supports externally funded research and development programs focused on advanced ballistic helmets. The role keeps programs on schedule, on budget, and in line with contract requirements by managing plans, milestones, deliverables, and communication between engineering teams and external sponsors, including the Department of Defense and university partners.

title: NOC Engineer
description:
What are we building?

Hard Rock Digital is a fiercely focused team working to become the best online sportsbook, casino, and social gaming company in the world. We're building a deeply curious team with a passion for learning, operating, and building new products and technologies for millions of consumers. We're customer-obsessed — we care about each customer interaction, experience, behavior, and insight, and strive to ensure we're always acting authentically.

Rooted in the kindred spirits of Hard Rock and the Seminole Tribe of Florida, Hard Rock Digital taps a brand known the world over as the leader in gaming, entertainment, and hospitality. We're taking that foundation of success and bringing it to the digital space - ready to join us?

What’s the position?

We are seeking a motivated and technically skilled Network Operations Center (NOC) Engineer who excels at end-to-end incident management and is excited about the intersection of traditional operations excellence and modern AI-driven workflows. This role plays a crucial part in maintaining the reliability and performance of our applications and infrastructure while championing the integration of AI tooling and agentic automation into incident response and day-to-day operations.

The ideal candidate is a problem-solver who owns incidents from detection to resolution, embraces AI as a force multiplier, thrives in a dynamic and highly transactional always-on environment, and wants to help shape how intelligent automation transforms gaming operations.

Key Responsibilities

Incident Management

  • Own the full incident lifecycle from initial detection and triage through containment, resolution, and post-incident review, ensuring incidents are resolved efficiently and with minimal customer impact.

  • Serve as the Incident Commander during major and critical incidents: facilitate bridge calls, coordinate cross-functional response teams, drive clear communication, and maintain a real-time incident timeline.

  • Classify and prioritize incidents according to defined severity levels (P1–P4), applying appropriate escalation paths and SLA adherence at every stage.

  • Author and maintain high-quality incident reports and post-mortems, capturing root cause analysis, contributing factors, timeline of events, and actionable follow-up items that drive systemic improvement.

  • Develop, maintain, and continuously improve incident response runbooks and standard operating procedures (SOPs) so the team can act decisively during high-pressure situations.

  • Track and report on key incident management metrics (MTTR, MTTD, incident frequency, and availability), surfacing trends and driving initiatives to improve operational resilience.

  • Coordinate with engineering, DevOps, and SRE teams to ensure problem management follow-through: turning recurring incidents into tracked problems with root cause elimination plans.

  • Lead and participate in GameDay exercises and chaos engineering drills to proactively validate the team's readiness and identify gaps before real incidents occur.

  • Build and maintain an incident knowledge base capturing resolution patterns, known issues, and tribal knowledge to accelerate future response times.

AI & Agentic Workflow Integration

  • Design, build, and maintain agentic workflows that automate incident triage, alert correlation, and remediation, reducing manual toil and accelerating MTTR.

  • Leverage AI-powered observability tools to surface anomalies, predict failure patterns, and generate actionable insights before issues escalate into incidents.

  • Develop and iterate LLM-assisted runbooks and automated response playbooks that enable NOC agents to resolve incidents autonomously or with minimal human intervention.

  • Collaborate with SREs and DevOps engineers to embed AI/ML-driven automation into the CI/CD pipeline and monitoring stack.

  • Evaluate emerging AI tools and frameworks (e.g., LangChain, AutoGen, Claude API, OpenAI) for operational applicability and prototype integrations for the team.

  • Champion responsible AI usage in operations: ensure agentic systems have clear escalation paths, audit trails, and fail-safes to maintain operational integrity.

  • Contribute to a growing internal AI operations knowledge base, documenting prompt engineering patterns, workflow designs, and lessons learned.

Core NOC Operations

  • Monitor application health, network, infrastructure, and related systems for performance, availability, and security anomalies.

  • Respond to alerts and incidents promptly, applying structured incident management practices to diagnose and resolve issues at pace.

  • Prioritize and manage multiple incidents simultaneously across 1st and 2nd shifts.

  • Lead process improvements and reporting efforts for the NOC team.

  • Train and share knowledge, including incident management frameworks, AI, and automation best practices.

  • Identify opportunities for service improvement and configuration standards.

  • Document operational procedures and contribute to knowledge sharing within the team.

What are we looking for?

  • 2–4 years of experience in a NOC, SRE, or similar operational role.

  • Demonstrated ownership of incident management end-to-end (triage, escalation, resolution, and post-mortem) in a high-availability, high-traffic production environment.

  • Experience leading incident bridge calls and coordinating multi-team response efforts under pressure.

  • Proven track record of writing clear, structured post-mortems and RCA documentation that drive lasting improvements.

  • Hands-on experience building or operating agentic/AI-augmented workflows (e.g., automated incident triage, LLM-assisted runbooks, AI-driven alerting pipelines).

  • Demonstrated ability to use AI coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT) to accelerate scripting, documentation, and automation tasks.

  • Experience with incident and problem management processes and ticket-tracking systems (Jira, PagerDuty, ServiceNow, or similar).

  • Proficiency in MS Office and modern communication tools (Slack, MS Teams, Zoom).

Technical Knowledge (Familiarity With)

  • Networking protocols and concepts.

  • Grafana, Prometheus, and Alert Managers.

  • Live site KPIs: MTTR, MTTD, MTTF, availability, and incident severities.

  • ITIL or similar incident/problem/change management frameworks.

  • Prompt engineering basics and how to structure effective instructions for LLMs in operational contexts.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong communication and collaborative teamwork abilities, especially under the pressure of an active major incident.

  • Decisive, calm, and organized in high-severity situations, with the ability to keep a bridge focused and moving.

  • Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills with a structured, hypothesis-driven approach.

  • Keen attention to detail and documentation discipline.

  • Ability to multi-task in a fast-paced, high-stakes environment.

  • Growth mindset: eagerness to continuously learn and adopt new AI tools and methodologies.

Education & Certifications

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.

  • Certifications in relevant areas (e.g., CCNA, AWS Certified DevOps Engineer).

  • ITIL Foundation certification or equivalent incident/service management training.

  • Coursework or certifications in AI/ML fundamentals or prompt engineering.

Preferred qualifications

Incident Management & SRE

  • Experience with on-call rotation management and escalation policy design (PagerDuty or similar).

  • Experience running blameless post-mortems and facilitating cross-functional retrospectives.

  • Background in change management and release coordination to reduce change-induced incidents.

AI & Agentic Workflow Experience

  • Experience with agentic frameworks such as LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar multi-agent orchestration tools.

  • Familiarity with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) patterns applied to operational runbooks or knowledge bases.

  • Exposure to LLM APIs (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI GPT-4, etc.) and building workflow integrations against them.

  • Understanding of AI observability: evaluating and monitoring LLM performance, reliability, and accuracy in production.

Technical Experience

  • Observability tools: Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or related platforms.

  • Automation tooling and scripting: Python, Bash, Ansible.

  • Containerization technologies: Docker, Kubernetes.

  • Cloud computing platforms: AWS, Azure, or GCP.

  • Version control and collaborative development: Git.

  • Understanding of DevOps and CI/CD principles.

Role Impact

This is not just a monitoring role; it is a seat at the center of the action. The engineer in this role will own incidents that matter, work alongside engineers actively deploying agentic systems, and contribute to tooling that shapes how AI and automation get used across a high-scale gaming platform, developing a rare combination of rigorous incident management discipline and cutting-edge AI operations skills.


What’s in it for you?

We offer our employees more than just competitive compensation. Our team benefits include:

  • Competitive pay and benefits

  • Flexible vacation allowance

  • A hybrid / remote working environment

  • Startup culture backed by a secure, global brand

Roster of Uniques

We care deeply about every interaction our customers have with us, and trust and empower our staff to own and drive their experience. Our vision for our business and customers is built on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where regardless of background or beliefs you feel able to be authentic and bring all your talent into play. We want to celebrate you being you (we are an equal opportunity employer).

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Are you ready to shape the backbone of a data‑driven organisation? NewDay are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to lead the design, build, and evolution of the core pipelines and platforms that power analytics, reporting, and sophisticated data science across our business.

How you'll contribute

  • Leading the development and optimisation of ingestion and transformation pipelines using technologies such as Spark, Scala, Python, AWS, DBT, and Snowflake
  • Architecting and evolving the organisation’s Data Lake environment to ensure it remains robust, scalable, secure, and future‑ready
  • Owning and improving ETL processing, table refreshes, defect resolution, and other BAU activities, while driving automation to reduce manual effort
  • Championing performance optimisation through concurrency, multi‑threading, automation, and best‑practice engineering patterns

  • The ability to design and guide modern data engineering solutions, with knowledge of data modelling, ETL/ELT, data warehousing and scalable data pipelines.
  • The ability to lead and develop Data Engineers, combining hands‑on technical contribution with coaching, technical direction and ownership of delivery.
  • An interest in AI and automation, with the technical curiosity to explore how emerging technologies could improve engineering quality, productivity and ways of working.

  • Experience using AWS or another major cloud platform. Our environment includes EMR, Athena, Lambda, S3, Glue and Step Functions, but we're open to transferable experience solving similar problems.

  • Knowledge of real‑time data processing, data governance, data quality or observability.

We know great candidates don't always meet every requirement. If you have strong data engineering foundations, hands‑on DBT experience and experience solving sophisticated problems at scale, we'd encourage you to apply even if you haven't worked with every technology listed above.

title: Principal Database Engineer (ClickHouse)
description:
Principal Database Engineer (ClickHouse)

Location: Hyderabad, India (3 days per week in office)

Role Overview

Nasuni is expanding its data intelligence and governance capabilities following the acquisition of DryvIQ. As we integrate DryvIQ’s technology into the Nasuni platform, we’re looking for a Principal Database Engineer with deep ClickHouse expertise to architect and scale the analytical database infrastructure powering customer reporting and data intelligence.
Our customers rely on flexible, self-service reporting to analyze their data, applying their own filters, groupings, and queries. As data volumes grow from hundreds of millions to billions—and potentially tens of billions—of records, delivering fast, reliable reporting becomes an increasingly complex engineering challenge. We need someone who can design ClickHouse architectures that perform at scale, not simply optimize individual queries.
Our architecture uses PostgreSQL as the transactional system of record, with data replicated into ClickHouse to power customer-facing analytics and reporting. While PostgreSQL is well established, ClickHouse represents our greatest opportunity to improve performance, scalability, and the customer experience. The challenge is designing efficient data models, ingestion pipelines, and query strategies that deliver responsive reporting even as data volumes and query complexity increase.
In this hands-on, design-focused role, you’ll take technical ownership of ClickHouse architecture, data modeling, ingestion, replication, and query performance. You’ll work closely with application, platform, and infrastructure engineers to make critical architectural decisions, solve complex performance challenges, and build a scalable foundation for future growth.
This is not a traditional DBA maintenance role or an application development position.About the role

Nasuni acquired DryvIQ to expand its data intelligence and governance capabilities, and we're now integrating the DryvIQ platform into Nasuni. PostgreSQL is the system of record, holding the state of every item. That data is replicated into ClickHouse, which powers all customer reporting through a flexible web UI where customers build their own queries.

PostgreSQL runs well today. ClickHouse is where the biggest challenge, and the biggest opportunity, lives. You'll take technical ownership of how data is modeled, laid out, and queried across the whole system, working side by side with application, platform, and infrastructure engineers. This is a design-first, hands-on role.

What you'll do

  • Design, implement, and optimize ClickHouse databases supporting billions to tens of billions of rows of analytical data.
  • Make architectural decisions involving ClickHouse table engines, MergeTree-family configurations, materialized views, projections, partitioning, sorting keys, and data layout.
  • Design efficient schemas for high-dimensional reporting workloads, including exceptionally wide tables approaching 1,000 columns.
  • Optimize analytical SQL queries, query execution, and customer-facing reporting performance.
  • Engineer and improve data ingestion, replication, and log collection workflows.
  • Evaluate tradeoffs among query latency, ingestion throughput, data freshness, storage efficiency, and cost.
  • Diagnose bottlenecks across databases, ingestion pipelines, and application-generated SQL.
  • Collaborate with application engineers to understand ORM-generated queries and improve database access patterns without requiring application coding.
  • Establish performance benchmarks, monitoring, capacity planning, and scale-testing practices.
  • Use approved AI-assisted tools for investigation and analysis, validating recommendations for correctness, security, and performance.

What you'll bring

Must-Have Qualifications

  • Deep hands-on experience designing, implementing, tuning, and operating ClickHouse in production.
  • Strong knowledge of ClickHouse table engines, particularly MergeTree-family engines, materialized views, and projections.
  • Demonstrated experience designing analytical databases for billions of rows, with ownership of architectural and performance decisions.
  • Advanced SQL, query optimization, execution analysis, and data modeling expertise.
  • Experience with large-scale ingestion pipelines, replication architectures, or analytical processing workflows.
  • Ability to balance ingestion performance, query responsiveness, freshness, and infrastructure efficiency.
  • Experience diagnosing production performance issues and delivering measurable improvements.
  • Ability to read application code, understand database access patterns, and collaborate with software engineers.

Preferred Qualifications

  • PostgreSQL as an OLTP system of record, or comparable Oracle, SQL Server, or other relational OLTP experience.
  • Experience with exceptionally wide analytical tables, including hundreds or approximately 1,000 columns.
  • Familiarity with ORM frameworks and inefficient application-generated SQL.
  • Distributed ClickHouse, replication, sharding, and high-availability configurations.
  • Customer-facing SaaS analytics or reporting environments.
  • Database observability, performance automation, and capacity modeling.

Nice to have

  • Experience scaling databases to hundreds of terabytes or beyond.
  • Experience supporting database-intensive SaaS products and C#/.NET application teams.
  • Familiarity with Linux and Kubernetes-based production environments.
  • Experience with database automation, capacity modeling, and large-scale performance testing.
  • ClickHouse certification.

Ideal Candidate

Has personally designed and optimized production ClickHouse environments at multi-billion-row scale, understands analytical architecture tradeoffs, and can demonstrate measurable improvements in query responsiveness. Takes ownership of complex decisions and collaborates across ingestion, database, and application teams.

Experience Guidelines

Typically 9+ years in database engineering, data infrastructure, or related software engineering, including substantial recent hands-on ClickHouse production experience. Direct ClickHouse expertise, architectural ownership, and performance outcomes matter more than an exact number of years or a specific OLTP database.

About Nasuni and Hyderabad

Nasuni is the unstructured data foundation for enterprise teams, and the AI that supports them. We manage, protect, and activate the world's unstructured data so organizations can work smarter, spend wisely, and create safely without limits. As a Vista-backed SaaS data infrastructure company, we're turning massive file stores into secure, actionable data for automation, analytics, and global collaboration.

In Hyderabad, you'll collaborate with global engineering teams on hard problems at the intersection of cloud and enterprise data infrastructure. With Vista Equity Partners' backing, you also get access to a worldwide network of software leaders, cross-portfolio learning, leadership programs, and AI innovation communities.

This privacy notice relates to information collected (whether online or offline) by Nasuni Corporation and our corporate affiliates (collectively, “Nasuni”) from or about you in your capacity as a Nasuni employee, independent contractor/service provider or as an applicant for an employment or contractor relationship with Nasuni.

title: Aquatics Director
description:
ABOUT STEWIE THE DUCK SWIM SCHOOL
In 1989, Kim and Stew Leonard, Jr. lost their 21-month-old son, Stewie, in a drowning accident. Since then, they have dedicated their lives to preventing this tragedy from striking other families. This includes founding the Stew Leonard III Water Safety Foundation, which has provided millions of dollars in funding for swim lesson scholarships for children in need and writing children’s books on water safety. In 2025, they will open the second Stewie the Duck Swim School in Clifton, New Jersey, next to Stew Leonard’s farm fresh food store. Stewie the Duck Swim School’s mission is to save a life one swim lesson at a time. All proceeds from the school will be used to fund swimming lessons for underserved children.
The first Stewie the Duck Swim School opened June 2023 in Norwalk CT and is a premier, best-in-class learn-to-swim facility that makes learning to swim fun while incorporating the Stew Leonard’s stores passionate approach to customer service, world class employee training, and professional growth. Stew Leonard's has been named on Fortune's list of "100 Best Companies to Work for in America." The company’s culture is built around an acronym for S.T.E.W. which stands for, Satisfy the customer; Teamwork gets it done; Excellence makes it better; WOW makes it fun.
ROLE SUMMARY:
The Aquatics Director position at Stewie the Duck Swim School will oversee management of the team, the facility, safety and customer service as they relate to the aquatics program. title: Community Mobilisation Officer
description:
POSITION OVERVIEW:
The position acts as the vital bridge between the healthcare facility and the surrounding communities. The incumbent’s core mission is to raise awareness, reduce stigma around treatable medical conditions, identify patients who need care, and ensure they can safely access treatment. Through his/her work, the Community Mobilisation Officer will seek to increase community (local authorities and beneficiaries) involvement through working with all institutional arrangements agreed upon with other NGOs and the Ministry of Health. This selected candidate will also provide input for the development of training materials relevant to community mobilisation.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES
  1. Organise and execute mobile screening clinics in urban and remote, rural or underserved regions to identify children suffering from treatable surgical deformities such as (clubfoot, knocked knees, bowed legs, windswept and cleft lip/palate and burn contractures, among others)
  2. Coordinate and supervise the work of the Village Health Workers (VHWs) in mobilizing patients for the forthcoming mobile clinic in any area across the country.
  3. Training of VHWs on correctable deformities that can be treated at Cure Zimbabwe and sharing the necessary information and referral pathways.
  4. Maintain a list of patients who have been referred to CURE Hospital from the mobile site.
  5. Follow up patients who might have missed an appointment or surgery date in liaison with the OPD In-Charge Nurse.
  6. Prepare and implement a coordinated response to the needs of the communities;
  7. In collaboration with other departments in the hospital (e.g. OPD, Physio & others) in implementing the Zimbabwe Patient Mobilization strategy 2026 guided by the Mobile Clinic Committee/Team.
  8. Ensure the integration of community mobilization activities into communication and advocacy campaigns and initiatives;
  9. Ensure close and effective collaboration with all key stakeholders and ensure their active participation in all project activities and committees;
  10. Ensure community participation includes the most vulnerable and marginalized groups;
  11. Promote CURE Zimbabwe by providing substantive input for stories, articles, and other PR activities in consultation with the Programs Manager and Communication Officer.
  12. Perform other duties as required.
EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS:
  1. Bachelor’s degree in public administration / social science/business administration.
  2. Class 4 Driver’s License and Defensive driving certificate will be an added advantage.
  3. An appreciation of vehicle maintenance/ mechanics would be an added advantage.
  4. A minimum of 3 years’ relevant experience in humanitarian activities and/or food security, Health and/or community mobilisation, or related areas is required. Preferably with experience in a healthcare organization or NGO
  5. Experience in community development and civic engagement is an added advantage;

title: MongoDB Specialist

N/A
