title: Director, Project Planning & Development
description:
Kraus-Anderson offers an opportunity to make an immediate impact with an industry leader!

Core Purpose: Building enduring relationships and strong communities

Core Values:

  • Integrity – Do the right thing…always be respectful, honest and fair
  • Commitment – Take ownership, work hard, and keep promises
  • Teamwork – Collaborate to foster trust and success for all
  • Value People – Support each other in a safe, positive environment where people are recognized and appreciated for their contributions

Our Company

For more than a century, Kraus-Anderson has been transforming the American landscape.

Founded in 1897 and privately owned and managed by the Engelsma family for more than 70 years, KA is consistently ranked by Engineering News Record among the top 50 general contractors in the United States. Our base of operations in Minnesota is supplemented with regional offices, extending our capabilities coast to coast.

We take a highly collaborative approach to our work. We work closely with owners, architects and the entire planning team well before ground is broken; providing cost analyses, scheduling information, and value engineering services to ensure that our client can make informed decisions leading to a timely finish of the highest quality and the best value.

Summary

This position will be responsible for providing strategic leadership for marketing and business development initiatives that drive company growth and aligns with organizational goals. Developing and executing the annual business development/marketing plans and budgets, leading CRM-based business development meetings, and tracking/reporting activity through company tools and processes. All while promoting a “seller-doer” culture by supporting project teams and key account plans, and development efforts, while conducting market analysis to identify opportunities, partners, and target clients. This role is responsible for strengthening KA’s market presence by building and maintaining strategic relationships, participating in industry and community organizations, and leading pursuit strategy for proposals and interviews, while adapting to evolving organizational needs.

This role will focus on commercial markets to include: manufacturing, higher education, and mission critical.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Leadership & Business Planning

  • Collaborate with the Director of Operations (DOO), marketing, and market sector leaders (Construction Executive & National Director) to align market sector and/or office specific development initiatives with company-wide growth strategies.
  • and manage annual marketing and business development plans; prepare and manage the annual marketing budget for specific market sector and/or office
  • Lead market sector and/or office business development meetings, and manage the tracking and reporting of all business development activities within company tools/processes
    • Utilize internal CRM and market research to track and develop intentional pipelines for growth
    • Engage operations team in use and development of CRM in client engagement strategies
  • Actively trains and coaches "seller-doer" culture among project managers and assist in developing key account management plans.
  • Identify and assess new/existing market initiatives, analyze business opportunities, and evaluate potential business partners and clients.
  • Defines the multi-year growth roadmap for the office and/or market sector

Project Development & Technical Consulting

  • Provide strategic guidance on construction operations, including risk mitigation, profit optimization, project manager development, and adherence to project delivery standards to support consistent execution and strong project outcomes.
  • Guide clients through early project development by coordinating in-house resources for facility assessments, pre-design, and pre-construction services that help define project needs, scope, and feasibility.
  • Collaborate with design teams to support master planning and space programming efforts that define and address specific client needs and align project concepts with long-term goals.
  • Facilitate conceptual budgeting and estimating, including the development of preliminary construction and phasing schedules to support informed planning and decision-making.
  • Assist clients and stakeholders in identifying, securing, and analyzing funding mechanisms for capital improvements and deferred maintenance needs, while supporting alignment between available resources and project priorities.

Market Engagement

  • Identify potential customers and partners, developing the strategic relationships necessary to secure opportunities and negotiate agreements.
  • Maintain an active role in trade associations and exhibit at trade shows
  • Lead community involvement activities and partner with marketing to establish KA brand in your office and/or market sector
  • Lead and support the proposal and interview process, including the development of winning strategies for specific office/market sector.
    • Leads capturing planning process and mentors all team members in effective market intelligence gathering and relationship building to position KA before competitive pursuit
  • Represents and engages other KA team members in industry thought leadership opportunities such as presentations, social media, and/or other mediums that influence industry standards
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Construction Management, Architecture, Business Development, Marketing, Public Relations or related coursework.
  • Minimum ten years related experience. Construction/Design/Engineering Industry Required.
  • Proficient working with customer relationship management (CRM) Systems
  • Competent in construction delivery models
  • Competent in the commercial real estate development process including entitlement and financial resources
  • Competent in project planning including defining scope, schedule and budget
  • Demonstrated computer proficiency (MS Office 365 – Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook).
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including ability to effectively communicate with internal and external customers.
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines, while maintaining a positive attitude and providing exemplary customer service.
  • Ability to use time productively, maximize efficiency and meet challenging work goals.
  • Ability to maintain compliance with all company policies and procedures.
  • Ability to possess and maintain exceptional work ethic as well as uphold company values and demand the highest standard of conduct from self and others.
  • Creative problem solving and collaboration skills

Other:

Physical Demands:

The physical demands described are representative of those that must be met by any employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Essential functions include items such as ability to:

  • Clearly communicate information (both written and verbal) to colleagues and key stakeholders

  • Use a computer/laptop/iPad in open office environment with natural and/or florescent lighting

Why KA?

We believe in building leaders. KA offers a wide range of enrichment and professional growth opportunities through KA University and community service opportunities through our KA Has Heart Volunteer Program.

title: Senior Software Engineer, OS Integration
description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About the OS Integration team:

The OS Integration team ensures Firefox works well with the host operating system and environment. We’re a distributed team with expertise in Windows, macOS, and Linux-based operating systems. Our responsibilities include developing fixes and improvements for Firefox related to Windows, macOS, and Linux environments. This might include integration with a new OS feature or fixing an OS-specific user interface bug. Other responsibilities include native crash reporting, OS abstraction layers, sandboxing, hardening, updater, and enterprise DLP support.

About the role:

As a member of the OS Integration team, you’ll develop fixes, improvements, and new features for Firefox. In many cases work may be cross-platform or have a cross-platform component. This role will include maintenance and development of the installer and updater of Firefox. You’ll contribute to the team through code review and discussion.

What you’ll do:

  • Improve the quality of Firefox and other Mozilla products by debugging and fixing software defects, improving the browsing experience for hundreds of millions of users.
  • Contribute to new features and improvements.
  • Break down tasks and work with others to deliver solutions.
  • Collaborate with experienced software engineers.
  • Perform code reviews and provide technical direction.
  • Work with a geographically-distributed development team.
  • Interact with teams throughout the organization.

What you’ll bring:

  • 5+ years of overall software engineering experience
  • Strong knowledge of C and C++
  • Experience with desktop application development on Windows, macOS, or Linux with C++.
  • Knowledge of web technologies such as Javascript and HTML.
  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and memory safety concerns.
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.
  • Written and verbal communication skills with a collaborative mindset.
  • Willingness to work effectively in a distributed team environment.
  • Commitment to our values:
    • Play to win
    • Build for People first
    • Engage Evidence over Ego
    • Decide and Deliver
    • Ship, learn and repeat

Bonus Points for experience with:

  • Installer and/or Updater development on any OS
  • Windows internals like the BITS server or MSIX packages

title: Department Manager for Women's Health Care
description:
BOTHWELL REGIONAL HEALTH CENTER
JOB DESCRIPTION
________________________________________________________________________
Job Title: Unit Manager/Educator - Women’s Health & Newborn Care/NICU/Labor & Delivery Nursery
Job Code:
Hours: 80, plus call Salary Position ________________________________________________________________________
A. MISSION AND CODE OF CONDUCT
It is expected that all of the duties and responsibilities of this position will be performed in a manner that reflects the Bothwell Regional Health Center Mission of Working together to provide exceptional health and wellness services. In addition, each employee is expected to demonstrate the Four Key Basics - - Safety, Courtesy, Professionalism, and Efficiency - - in every aspect of the position, with a commitment to fostering an inclusive, respectful, and collaborative team environment aligned with the hospital's values and cultural objectives.
B. SUMMARY OF POSITION
The Unit Manager/Educator - of Women’s Health & Newborn Care/NICU/Labor & Delivery is accountable for excellence in the overall management of shift-to-shift operations. Oversight delivered through practice standards, regulatory adherence, and safety compliance. Supervision of the clinical practice of nursing, delivery of patient care along with providing a strategic pathway for patients, families, and employees success. The manager is responsible for supervising human, fiscal, and other resources as needed to manage clinical nursing practice and patient care.
The manager is responsible for achieving and maintaining high standards in patient care and education, aligning with strategic goals in women’s health, neonatal, and labor and delivery services. This role also involves identifying areas for improvement and spearheading departmental initiatives to enhance quality and safety.
The Unit Manager /Educator- of Women’s Health & Newborn Care/NICU/Labor & Delivery reports directly to the Department Director and the Director of Nursing Services.
C. JOB SPECIFIC RESPONSIBILITIES AND ACCOUNTABILITIES
  1. Manager-
    1. Ensures hospital compliance with professional, regulatory, and government standards of care. Demonstrates the knowledge of needs for this specific department, which relates to insurance of adequate supplies and resources within budgetary guidelines. Engages in budget forecasting and supply management to ensure cost-effective department operations while maintaining quality and safety standards.
  1. Ensures clinical and operational effectiveness through strategic planning, coordination of departmental meetings, and multidisciplinary collaboration to drive quality improvements.
  1. Organize, supervise, and evaluate nursing activities to provide continuity of patient care by anticipating and maintaining staffing (through appropriate acuity measures, staffing regulations, and utilizing a multidisciplinary team approach. Collaborate with department leadership on long-term staffing and resource planning to accommodate census and acuity fluctuations.
  1. Evokes in staff sense of responsibility and accountability for their work and continuous improvement of their performance. Develop and maintain departmental performance metrics; provide regular feedback and performance assessments to staff.
  2. Participates in committees and task force functions as assigned or needs identified.
  1. Educator-
    1. Based on evidence based practice maintain patient teaching records and materials for both inpatient and outpatient services.
    2. Maintain all educational records for hospital and department specific compliance in required classes and certifications.
    3. Plan and coordinate all department supplies and equipment in-services
    4. Coordinate and plan all new hire orientation needs, including onboarding requirements and department training
    5. Monitor and detect any educational gaps in nursing care or documentation and provide action to mitigate gaps
    6. Conduct annual department-specific skill labs, periodic competency assessments, and individual skill checks tailored to current clinical practices.
    7. Provide quarterly mocks and simulations in both obstetrical and neonatal care
    8. Implement a structured feedback mechanism to continually assess educational effectiveness and incorporate staff input.
  1. Oversee the development of educational materials that reflect current evidence-based practices in obstetric and neonatal care, ensuring accessibility and relevance for both experienced staff and new hires.
D. QUALIFICATIONS
  1. Education
a.) Bachelor’s degree in Nursing required, or equivalent combination of experience and education. Master’s degree in Nursing or related field preferred
  1. Licensure/Certification
    1. Current RN license in the state of Missouri.
    2. Current Basic Life Support (BLS) certification/Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation (CPR) required.
    3. Other Hospital Required Certifications as assigned.
    4. NRP
    5. S.T.A.B.L.E.
    6. Fetal Monitoring update every 2 years
    7. ACLS
    8. Advanced certifications in Obstetrics, Neonatal Nursing, or Maternal/Child Health (such as RNC-OB, RNC-NIC, or IBCLC) preferred
  2. Work Experience
    1. A minimum of seven years in a hospital or health system with responsibilities in developing, managing, monitoring and refining various aspects.
      1. Experience should include demonstrated success in leadership, with a focus on team-building, conflict resolution, and quality improvement initiatives.
    2. Direct experience in education, training, or preceptorship within women’s health, neonatal, or L&D settings is highly desirable.
    3. Strong communication and interpersonal skills to facilitate multidisciplinary collaboration, engage staff, and foster a positive work culture.
    4. Ability to mentor and develop staff through effective coaching, feedback, and performance improvement strategies.
E. WORKING CONDITIONS
  1. Direct patient contact, possible exposure to infections, communicable diseases and blood borne pathogens.
  1. Occasionally exposed to radiation and electromechanical hazards.
  1. Works indoors in a well-lighted and ventilated office environment.
  1. Handles emergency or crisis situations
  1. Occasionally subjected to irregular hours
  1. Subject to frequent interruptions.

title: Delivery CritSit Expert
description:
The CritSit Industry Expert is a senior member of the Critical Situations team. Your mission is to rapidly diagnose, stabilise and resolve complex customer crises on Sapiens insurance platforms, combining deep insurance expertise, technical curiosity, rigorous root cause analysis and unconventional problem solving.

You are an insurance expert with an engineering mindset who takes personal ownership of finding a viable solution. You work out what the product should be doing, what it is doing and what the business needs, then define the fix and drive it to resolution with Product Engineering, Delivery and CloudOps.

You bring deep expertise in one line of business: P&C, Life and Annuities, or Reinsurance. You stay composed when the customer is under pressure, explain complex problems simply, and insist on root cause rather than symptom relief.

This is an individual contributor role reporting to Critical Situations leadership, working alongside CritSit Managers, Engineering, Delivery and Support. Based at a regional hub, hybrid, with on-site visits at short notice.

Responsibilities

  • Join critical situations early and diagnose them rapidly, working out how the product, configuration, data and the customer's business process interact.
  • Analyse business requirements, product behaviour, logs and data extracts, and test hypotheses until the cause is clear.
  • Use approved AI tools to speed up analysis of logs, documentation and past cases, and verify every output before relying on it or sharing it with a customer.
  • Define a working fix or safe workaround that stabilises the customer's live operation, and agree it with Engineering and Delivery.
  • Translate business impact into clear requirements, expected behaviour and acceptance criteria, and stay accountable until the customer confirms resolution.
  • Design and assess unconventional solutions, such as process changes or configuration alternatives, weighing business and product risk before recommending them.
  • Find and document the root cause of every escalation, verify the fix holds, and prevent repeats: no stabilised escalation recurs within 90 days.
  • Turn each case into reusable diagnostics and fixes, and add them to the playbook every quarter.
  • Explain complex problems and options simply to customer executives, delivery leads and engineers, and give the CritSit Manager accurate findings and next steps.
  • Work with Support, Delivery, Engineering and Product to hand over fixes, share product know-how, and give clear feedback on gaps, defects and enhancement needs.
  • Keep current with Sapiens platform releases and the customer's configuration, so diagnosis starts from knowledge, not guesswork.

Requirements

  • 10+ years in insurance core systems, on the insurer, consultancy or vendor side, with deep expertise in one line: P&C, Life and Annuities, or Reinsurance.
  • Process depth in that line: product and rating, policy administration, billing and claims; for Reinsurance, treaty and facultative, cessions, bordereaux and accounting.
  • Strong product knowledge of core insurance platforms, with a working understanding of data models, integrations and data migration, enough to analyse problems and direct technical teams.
  • Strong business analysis skills, including requirements elicitation, process mapping, impact analysis and root cause analysis.
  • Practical experience applying AI to problem solving, such as analysing logs, documentation and past cases, with sound judgement to verify outputs and protect customer data.
  • A track record of resolving live problems in production or troubled implementations by defining the solution and working with technical teams to deliver it.
  • Ability to explain complex problems simply to executives and engineers alike.
  • Fluent English, hybrid working from a regional hub, and availability to be on site at short notice.

The CritSit Industry Expert is a senior member of the Critical Situations team. Your mission is to rapidly diagnose, stabilise and resolve complex customer crises on Sapiens insurance platforms, combining deep insurance expertise, technical curiosity, rigorous root cause analysis and unconventional problem solving.

An advantage: experience of Sapiens platforms such as IDIT, CoreSuite and ReinsurancePro, cloud and SaaS experience, an underwriting or actuarial background, and data analysis skills or a business analysis certification.

title: Head of Brand Partnerships- Middle East & Africa

We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.

title: Pet Welfare Assistant - Off-site Services
description:
Contract: Permanent, full time, 37.5 hours per week
Salary: £24,976 per annum
Location: Hitchin, SG4 8EU
Closing date: Wednesday 25th November 2026
1st stage interview dates: 1st & 2nd December 2026

We’re recruiting a Pet Welfare Assistant for off-site animal care, for our Rehoming & Fostering team in Hertfordshire!
At Blue Cross, we're dedicated to providing the best care possible for pets in need. As a Pet Welfare Assistant for our off-site services, you'll play an important role in our mission, ensuring that every pet receives the love, attention, and support they deserve whilst they are in our off-site care.

Our Hertfordshire rehoming centre, based in Kimpton, originally opened in the 1940s and have facilities for dogs, cats and small pets. Our newly refurbished facilities include 20 kennels, five puppy pens and 29 cat pens, which includes a mother and kitten unit. We also have indoor rabbit space and rooms for small pets.

Our dedicated Rehoming & Fostering team, supported by an incredible network of volunteers, helps pets and people across Hertfordshire and beyond. The team plays a vital role in finding loving new homes for pets through both centre-based adoptions and our Home Direct scheme, which allows pets to remain in a home environment while they wait to be adopted. By working closely with adopters, owners and foster carers, the team helps ensure every pet has the best possible chance of finding the right home.
As a Pet Welfare Assistant - Off-site Services, you will be responsible for expertly managing a specific number of pet cases within the off-site pet care service, these can be rehoming pets in foster care or Home Direct service or pets in temporary crisis care.
You will be ensuring welfare standards are met and that rehabilitation plans are followed and supported for pets in foster homes. As we want to help as many pets as possible, this role will be responsible for ensuring the assessment of pets preparing for a new home in off-site services is completed in the quickest amount of time.
For many, the centre will be the ‘public face’ of Blue Cross so you will need to ensure that good customer service is at the heart of every interaction. At Blue Cross we are ambitious, and the work carried out by our centres is key in achieving our strategy and ensuring that ultimately, we help more pets and people.
At our Hertfordshire rehoming centre, we provide onsite accommodation for pets in our care 24/7. Overnight shifts are usually undertaken by team members who live on site. Occasionally, you will be expected to carry out night checks or stay in onsite accommodation overnight when the resident team members are either not working or away for a period of time.
This is a full-time role working 37.5 hours per week on a two-week rota which includes every other weekend:
Week one: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Saturday & Sunday
Week two: Monday, Wednesday, Thursday & Friday
If you excel in an environment where you can see the difference you make every day, then this is the role for you. Interested? Then apply and let’s work together to see if this is the role for you.
The person will be empathetic, intuitive, and focused on animal welfare, with experience in a similar environment. You can assess pet needs, recognise behavioural signs, and have a basic understanding of medications. Self-motivated and collaborative, you bring practical, creative solutions for the best care outcomes.
Your communication skills are first-class, making you approachable and effective in sharing critical information with fosterers, clients, and stakeholders. You're resilient and emotionally intelligent, able to thrive in emotionally charged situations while supporting both clients and colleagues with empathy.
Knowledge, skills, and experience
  • Experience of having previously worked or volunteered with domestic animals or in an animal welfare environment.
  • Good experience of recording information and being able to accurately convey this when communicating with others
  • Previous experience in working in a customer focused environment and used to achieving a high level of customer satisfaction.
  • Good organisational and administration skills to include computerised systems.
  • A full driving licence.
  • The ability to demonstrate, understand and apply our Blue Cross values.
Although not essential, it would be great if you also had:
  • Qualification or similar experience in animal behaviour or animal training.
  • Experience of cash handling.
  • Experience of working to strict health and safety procedures.
  • Understanding of safeguarding issues.
The first stage of the recruitment process will be a competency-based interview via Microsoft Teams. Candidates who are successful at this stage will be invited to attend a second-stage practical animal handling assessment on-site at our Hertfordshire rehoming centre.
How to apply
Click the apply button below and complete the online application process before the closing date.
We reserve the right to close this vacancy early should we receive an overwhelming response.

Using AI in your application
We’re happy for you to use AI tools to help you prepare your application, for example to organise your thoughts, improve clarity or check spelling and grammar. However, your application must be an honest reflection of your own skills, experience and achievements, and AI should not be used to write your application for you or create examples that aren’t your own.

Please read our guidance on using AI when applying to Blue Cross before submitting your application.
Our people are the most important part of delivering our purpose. If it were not for their amazing efforts and commitment, we would not be able to make the difference that we do today.
In return, Blue Cross wants to ensure we provide you with the best working environment we can. We want you to be happy working for us and will do everything we can to make sure you are.

Sr. Director Data Engineering and Operations - Erlanger, KY

Role Summary
The Head of Data Engineering & Operations leads data engineering as a capability at ADM: the talent, engineering standards, and delivery quality of the data engineers who work inside data product and digital product teams. You are one of the builders of the enterprise data foundation, working in partnership with Platform & Architecture and the Product teams. Key Responsibilities
Scope & Parterships

What you lead

  • Data engineering as a capability across data product and digital product teams, including ACC engineers: talent, standards, and delivery quality.

  • Operations, including the managed-services partner relationship, as part of a planned path to full integration into the product model.

  • Managing budgets, capacity, sourcing strategy, and vendor performance.

  • Lead and partner with globally distributed teams across North America, EMEA, LATAM, APAC, and the ADM Capability Center, overseeing employees and contractors, including data engineers embedded within Data Product and Digital Product teams, as well as Data Operations.

  • Communicating strategy, progress, risk, and value to executives, product leaders, and business partners.

  • Measure and report the value of the capability including productivity, cost, quality, retention, and innovation output.

Who you partner with

  • Platform & Architecture, who own the data platform and architectural direction. You make sure engineers build well on them and bring what teams need back to them.
  • Product teams, who own product priorities and roadmaps. You make sure they have the engineering talent and delivery quality to meet them.
  • Data Governance and MDM teams, on data quality, metadata, lineage, and validation.
  • Advance Analytics and AI teams to ensure data is trusted, accessible and AI ready.

Outcomes You Will Deliver

1. Data products the business trusts and uses

Production-grade, reusable data products, built and run by product teams, that are adopted across the enterprise.
  • Secure, scalable pipelines and data products with clear ownership, defined data contracts, and service levels for availability, freshness, quality, and resolution time.
  • Production health visible by design: observability, incident and problem management, and release readiness built into every product, with Operations performance reported against agreed service levels.

2. ACC leverage

The ADM Capability Center is a fully integrated global engineering team
  • ACC engineers work as full members of product teams, under the same standards, expectations, and career paths.
  • Depth, ownership, and scope in ACC across design, build, and operations, will be measured through productivity, quality, retention, and innovation output.

3. Engineering practices

Consistent, modern engineering practices in every data and digital product team.
  • Engineering standards and patterns adopted by teams, including testing, CI/CD, code review, security, privacy, and ITGC and SOX controls, as guardrails that speed delivery rather than gates that slow it.
  • AI-assisted engineering and other emerging capabilities evaluated through disciplined pilots, then operationalized where they work.

4. Talent for both product models

A deep bench of data engineering talent that grows and moves across data product and digital product teams.
  • Hiring, development, retention, and succession for a global team, supported by a strong team culture, clear communication rhythms, and knowledge-sharing across regions and time zones.
  • Capacity, sourcing, and partner mix matched to the demands of both product models, with budgets and partner performance managed to plan.

5. Data readiness

Enterprise data that is trusted, governed, and ready for analytics, operations, and AI.
  • Data quality, metadata, lineage, and validation built into engineering work in partnership with Data Governance, MDM, and Platform & Architecture.
  • Integration across applications, files, APIs, and operational and IoT sources following shared patterns, so analytics and AI use cases move from pilot to production.

Qualifications
Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field (Master's preferred).
  • Minimum 12 years in data engineering, data platforms, or data operations, with 5+ years leading large, global teams.
  • Experience leading engineering talent embedded in product teams, and partnering effectively with platform, architecture, and product leaders.
  • Experience building global teams in which capability center engineers work as full members of product teams.
  • Proven delivery of production-grade data products on enterprise-scale cloud data platforms (Lakehouse/data lake, Data warehousing, ETL, batch and streaming ingestion).
  • Experience setting and driving adoption of engineering standards and practices across multiple teams.
  • Experience running production data operations with SLAs, observability, incident management, and ITGC/SOX-type controls, ideally within a product-aligned operating model.
  • Experience managing managed-service partners alongside internal teams.
  • Experience contributing to large-scale technology transformation and aligning data capabilities to enterprise strategy.
  • Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, and financial acumen.

Preferred

  • Hands-on exposure to AI/ML or generative and agentic AI enablement, including AI-assisted engineering.
  • Background in a global, regulated, or manufacturing/supply-chain enterprise, including operational technology (OT) or IoT data.
  • Familiarity with enterprise application data landscapes (e.g., ERP).
  • Relevant cloud or data platform certifications.

title: Vulnerability Management Analyst
description:
TQI Solutions seeks proactive, visionary thought leaders to drive impactful solutions for clients. We value our team, offering work-life balance, excellent benefits, and career growth. Join us and immerse yourself in a rewarding experience like no other.

TQI Solutions is actively seeking a collaborative and skilled Vulnerability Management Specialist to join our dedicated team supporting the Pearl Harbor Naval Shipyard & Intermediate Maintenance Facility (PHNSY & IMF) at Joint Base Pearl Harbor-Hickam in Honolulu, HI. This role will provide critical cybersecurity support within the Network Operations Security Center (NOSC), focusing on vulnerability identification, assessment, tracking, reporting, and remediation coordination across Navy IT systems and networks. The ideal candidate will possess strong technical and analytical skills, with experience utilizing cybersecurity tools such as ACAS and VRAM to strengthen cybersecurity readiness, reduce operational risk, and maintain compliance with Department of Defense (DoD) and Department of the Navy (DON) requirements.

The estimated salary range for this role is $60,000 - $90,000 per year. Final compensation is dependent upon the candidate's skills, qualifications, contract-specific guidelines, and geographic location. TQI is committed to pay equity and compliance with Hawaii pay transparency requirements. We do not request or consider prior salary history when making employment offers.

Responsibilities:

• Conduct routine vulnerability assessments using Assured Compliance Assessment Solution (ACAS), including Tenable Nessus and Tenable Security Center.

• Monitor and analyze vulnerability scan results to identify security weaknesses, configuration deficiencies, and potential cybersecurity risks.

• Evaluate vulnerability findings to determine severity, affected assets, operational impact, and remediation priorities.

• Maintain vulnerability scanning schedules and coordinate assessments with system and network administrators to minimize operational disruptions.

• Investigate scan discrepancies, incomplete results, and potential false positives to ensure accurate vulnerability reporting.

• Utilize Vulnerability Remediation Asset Manager (VRAM) and other authorized DoD systems to track, document, and report identified vulnerabilities.

• Coordinate with system administrators, network administrators, and cybersecurity personnel to facilitate timely remediation and corrective actions.

• Monitor remediation progress, validate corrective actions through follow-up assessments, and document closure of vulnerability findings.

• Track vulnerabilities associated with Information Assurance Vulnerability Alerts (IAVAs), Information Assurance Vulnerability Bulletins (IAVBs), and other applicable cybersecurity directives.

• Identify overdue vulnerabilities, recurring deficiencies, and remediation challenges requiring escalation.

• Support the development and maintenance of Plans of Action and Milestones (POA&Ms), as applicable.

• Ensure vulnerability management activities align with applicable DoD, DON, Defense Information Systems Agency (DISA), and Navy cybersecurity policies and standards.

• Assist with implementation and validation of Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs) and security configuration baselines.

• Support cybersecurity assessments, inspections, audits, Risk Management Framework (RMF) activities, and authorization documentation requirements.

• Develop and maintain vulnerability status reports, remediation metrics, compliance documentation, and tracking records.

• Communicate vulnerability trends, outstanding findings, remediation progress, and cybersecurity risks to technical teams and leadership.

• Participate in NOSC operational meetings and collaborate with technical teams to improve vulnerability management processes.

• Assist in developing and maintaining standard operating procedures (SOPs) for vulnerability scanning, tracking, reporting, and remediation.

• Support cybersecurity incident response activities and other NOSC operational requirements as assigned.

This is a full-time, on-site position located at Joint Base Pearl Harbor-Hickam in Honolulu, HI.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related technical field, or an equivalent combination of education, certifications, and relevant experience.

• Three or more years of experience in cybersecurity, vulnerability management, information assurance, network administration, or related IT security functions.

• Relevant cybersecurity certifications such as CompTIA Security+, CySA+, or other certifications aligned with applicable DoD 8140 requirements.

• Experience utilizing ACAS, Tenable Nessus, Tenable Security Center, or comparable vulnerability scanning technologies.

• Familiarity with VRAM or similar vulnerability tracking and remediation management systems.

• Strong understanding of vulnerability assessment methodologies, patch management, cybersecurity remediation, and risk management processes.

• Knowledge of DoD cybersecurity requirements, DISA STIGs, and applicable Navy cybersecurity policies and standards.

• Familiarity with Windows and/or Linux operating systems, networking fundamentals, and enterprise IT environments.

• Experience supporting cybersecurity compliance activities, vulnerability reporting, and remediation tracking.

• Ability to analyze technical findings, document results, and communicate remediation requirements to technical stakeholders.

• Strong organizational, analytical, troubleshooting, and written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a multidisciplinary IT operations environment.

• Ability to obtain and maintain required DoD cybersecurity workforce qualifications applicable to the assigned position.

The incumbent of this position will be subject to a background investigation and will be required to maintain a Government-granted security clearance.

TQI Solutions, Inc. is a Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business with staff located in VA, WA, DC, GU, HI, and CA. We provide Mission and IT Support Services to a wide range of DoD clients. We take pride in fully embracing our clients' missions as our own and consistently delivering world-class technical solutions. Our team comprises dedicated problem solvers who prioritize building lasting and mutually trusting relationships with our customers.

title: Senior Software Engineer, OS Integration
description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About the OS Integration team:

The OS Integration team ensures Firefox works well with the host operating system and environment. We’re a distributed team with expertise in Windows, macOS, and Linux-based operating systems. Our responsibilities include developing fixes and improvements for Firefox related to Windows, macOS, and Linux environments. This might include integration with a new OS feature or fixing an OS-specific user interface bug. Other responsibilities include native crash reporting, OS abstraction layers, sandboxing, hardening, updater, and enterprise DLP support.

About the role:

As a member of the OS Integration team, you’ll develop fixes, improvements, and new features for Firefox. In many cases work may be cross-platform or have a cross-platform component. This role will include maintenance and development of the installer and updater of Firefox. You’ll contribute to the team through code review and discussion.

What you’ll do:

  • Improve the quality of Firefox and other Mozilla products by debugging and fixing software defects, improving the browsing experience for hundreds of millions of users.
  • Contribute to new features and improvements.
  • Break down tasks and work with others to deliver solutions.
  • Collaborate with experienced software engineers.
  • Perform code reviews and provide technical direction.
  • Work with a geographically-distributed development team.
  • Interact with teams throughout the organization.

What you’ll bring:

  • 5+ years of overall software engineering experience
  • Strong knowledge of C and C++
  • Experience with desktop application development on Windows, macOS, or Linux with C++.
  • Knowledge of web technologies such as Javascript and HTML.
  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and memory safety concerns.
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.
  • Written and verbal communication skills with a collaborative mindset.
  • Willingness to work effectively in a distributed team environment.
  • Commitment to our values:
    • Play to win
    • Build for People first
    • Engage Evidence over Ego
    • Decide and Deliver
    • Ship, learn and repeat

Bonus Points for experience with:

  • Installer and/or Updater development on any OS
  • Windows internals like the BITS server or MSIX packages
  • Open-source contributions or personal engineering projects

What you’ll get:

  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
  • Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together
  • Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
  • One-time home office stipend
  • Annual professional development budget
  • Considerable paid parental leave
  • Employee referral bonus program
  • Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)

About Mozilla

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging

Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. title: Deli PIC
location: Palmer C Store, Palmer, AK, US
description:
Role Description

The Deli Person in Charge (PIC) is a department leader responsible for overseeing the daily operations and performance of the Deli Department. This role includes directing department team members, managing food production and ordering, maintaining product quality and availability, and monitoring sales, labor, shrink, sanitation, food safety, and customer service. The PIC is responsible for department execution and works closely with the Store Manager to maintain Company standards and achieve operational goals.

Required Skills/Abilities:

  • Lead, direct, train, coach, and schedule Deli team members to meet production, customer-service, sanitation, and department operating expectations.

  • Plan daily production, merchandising, product selection, and order quantities to support sales, product availability, freshness, and shrink control.

  • Direct and perform preparation, cooking, packaging, weighing, labeling, stocking, rotation, markdown, and culling of Deli products according to Company procedures and applicable requirements.

  • Ensure proper temperatures, sanitation, cleaning, product rotation, expiration-date controls, and safe operation of ovens, slicers, dishwashers, scales, and other Deli equipment.

  • Monitor sales, labor, staffing, inventory, shrink, product quality, and department execution and take or recommend corrective action when performance is outside expectations.

  • Maintain clean, organized, and safe food-preparation, service, storage, cooler, equipment, and customer areas.

  • Provide prompt and courteous customer service, including special orders and customer requests, and resolve department-level concerns.

  • Provide documented performance feedback and participate in evaluations and recommendations concerning training, recognition, corrective action, promotion, or other personnel actions within delegated authority.

  • Communicate department performance, staffing needs, inventory concerns, food-safety issues, equipment problems, and operational priorities to the Store Manager.

  • At locations equipped with forklifts, maintain required forklift certification and be prepared to operate a forklift as operational needs require, in accordance with Company procedures and applicable safety requirements.

  • Maintain required propane certification and perform propane filling and related customer service in accordance with Company safety procedures.

  • Demonstrate department leadership, accountability, and consistent follow-through.

  • Organize work, establish priorities, and direct multiple tasks in a fast-paced retail environment.

  • Train, coach, and provide clear performance feedback to department team members.

  • Use sound judgment and problem-solving skills to address customer, inventory, staffing, merchandising, and operational issues.

  • Communicate effectively with team members, Store Management, customers, vendors, and other departments.

  • Maintain attention to product quality, inventory accuracy, merchandising, shrink, labor, safety, and customer service.

  • Work independently while collaborating effectively with Store Management and other department leaders.

  • Maintain composure and professionalism during high-volume or time-sensitive situations.

  • Assist with other store functions as assigned, consistent with position responsibilities and qualifications.

Experience/Education:

  • Previous food-preparation experience is required.

  • A High School Diploma or GED is preferred.

  • Previous Deli, food-service, grocery, or related retail experience is preferred.

  • Previous supervisory, ordering, production-planning, or fresh-food leadership experience is preferred.

  • Demonstrated ability to direct, train, coach, and organize the work of department team members.

  • Ability to use Company retail, ordering, inventory, communication, and other systems applicable to the department.

  • Forklift certification is required at locations equipped with forklifts.

  • Ability to obtain and maintain a required food worker/food-handler credential when required for assigned duties or location.

  • Ability to obtain and maintain required propane certification.

Company Description

Three Bears Alaska is a family-owned chain of Alaskan grocery stores with so much more. We are committed to providing customers with quality goods and services at the lowest possible price. We strive to meet the needs of our customers by offering a diverse range of products and exceptional customer service. With multiple locations throughout Alaska, Three Bears Alaska, Inc. is dedicated to serving the local community and creating a positive shopping experience.

Benefits:

  • Health insurance

  • Dental insurance

  • Vision insurance

  • Colonial Life Elective Benefits

  • 401(k)

  • Paid time off

  • Holiday Pay

  • Automatic raise of $1.00/hr every 1,040 hours worked
    Auto raises will be provided based on straight-time hours worked until top of pay scale is reached.

Pay Range:

Starting at $17.00/hr (DOE)

  • Full-time/Part-time

  • Early mornings, evenings, nights, weekends, holidays, and additional hours may be required based on department and store needs.

Office Location and Travel:

  • LOCATION: In person

  • Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

Working Environment

Work is performed primarily in a retail Deli environment, including food-preparation, cooler/freezer, dishwashing, storage, and sales-floor areas with concrete and/or tile flooring. Working conditions include regular exposure to food products and equipment, with occasional exposure to oven and display-case heat, wet or humid dishwashing conditions, refrigerated and freezer temperatures, and cleaning and sanitizing chemicals.

Physical requirements include standing and walking for extended periods throughout the work shift. Employees must be able to frequently bend, squat, and reach at or below shoulder level, with occasional climbing and reaching above shoulder level. Frequent pushing, pulling, grasping, and repetitive hand motions are required while handling products, stocking, merchandising, and operating department equipment.

Frequently lifting and carrying products weighing up to 50 pounds and occasionally lifting and carrying products weighing up to 75 pounds may be required. Employees must be able to read product labels, pricing, signs, order information, and electronic records; safely navigate customer, stockroom, cooler/freezer, and receiving areas; and hear and communicate with customers and team members while recognizing equipment alarms, warnings, and forklift beepers.

Employees must also be able to safely mount, dismount, and operate a forklift and other Company-authorized material-handling equipment when required by the work assignment.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.

title: AI Consultant for Science
description:
# AI Consultant for Science

Are you passionate about using artificial intelligence to solve complex, interdisciplinary challenges? Are you interested in transforming theoretical AI concepts into practical, scalable solutions on high-performance computing (HPC) systems? If so, we invite you to join our AI Consulting Team at the Jülich Supercomputing Centre (JSC), home to Europe's most advanced supercomputing infrastructure, including JUPITER, Europe’s first Exascale system. Our team explores new applications of AI in collaboration with the diverse scientific disciplines associated with the Helmholtz Association.

Within our lab “Applied Machine Learning”, you will play a crucial role in the implementation and development of state-of-the-art machine learning applications for scientific research. Join us in shaping the future of science with AI, where your expertise will contribute to groundbreaking interdisciplinary projects.

## Your Job

In this position, you will be an active part of our AI Consulting Team. Together with our partners, we develop new and innovative applications of Machine Learning. You will connect to scientists and investigate possible applications of ML in fields like Chemistry, Numerics, Computational Biology, Astrophysics, Particle Physics etc. You will be involved in all phases of this process. You will

  • Identify new applications for Machine Learning in science, engineering, and technology
  • Develop, implement and refine ML techniques
  • Implement parallel ML training on the High Performance Computers
  • Engage in national and international ML/DL communities, most importantly in the Helmholtz AI platform (https://www.helmholtz.ai/)
  • Present research results at scientific meetings, conferences, and as scientific papers
  • Contribute to educational events, such as courses and hackathons

## Your Profile

  • Broad knowledge and practical experience in AI and applied Machine Learning is a must
  • Excellent Master and subsequent PhD degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, or other related fields
  • Broad interest in diverse scientific topics
  • Self-motivated personality with a curiosity for working in a multidisciplinary team environment on scientifically challenging problems
  • Excellent communication skills in written and spoken English with extensive vocabulary is required (at least B2 level according to the [CEFR](https://go.fzj.de/languagerequirements))
  • Hands-on experience with ML/DL workflows and common software libraries
  • Experience with statistical machine learning, including uncertainty quantification, probabilistic modeling, and learning from noisy or incomplete data is a plus
  • Practical experience with High Performance Computing (HPC) systems is an advantage
  • Your experience should be documented in research papers and Open Source code projects

## Our Benefits for You

  • **Meaningful tasks:** The position offers a varied and diverse role in an international environment
  • **Work-life balance:** Optimal conditions for balancing work and private life, as well as a family-friendly company policy. The option of flexible working (in terms of location) is generally available after consultation and in line with upcoming tasks and (on-site) appointments
  • **Vacation:** You will receive 30 days of vacation plus additional days off (e.g. between Christmas and New Year's)
  • **Flexibility:** Flexible working time models, [including options close to full-time](https://go.fzj.de/near-full-time), allow you to tailor your working hours to suit your individual needs
  • **Knowledge & further training:** Your professional development is important to us – we provide targeted, individual support
  • **Successful start:** It is important to us that you quickly settle into the team and are given structured training for your tasks. We also support you from the very beginning and make your start easier with our [Welcome Days and Welcome Guide](https://go.fzj.de/welcome)
  • **Fair remuneration:** Depending on your existing qualifications and the tasks assigned to you, you will be classified in pay grade 13 of the TVöD-Bund (Collective Agreement for the Public Service). All information on the TVöD-Bund collective agreement can be found on the[BMI website](https://go.fzj.de/bmi.tvoed). The monthly salaries in euros can be found on page 74 of the PDF download
  • **Additional benefits:** Benefit from attractive additional services such as a company pension scheme with employer contribution. In addition to the basic salary, there is an additional year-end bonus under the collective pay agreement amounting to 75 % of a monthly salary, as well as capital-forming benefits
  • **Fixed-term:** The position is initally limited to 2 years

In addition to exciting tasks and a collegial working environment, we offer you much more: [https://go.fzj.de/benefits](https://go.fzj.de/benefits)

We welcome applications from people with diverse backgrounds, e.g. in terms of age, gender, disability, sexual orientation / identity, and social, ethnic and religious origin. A diverse and inclusive working environment with equal opportunities in which everyone can realize their potential is important to us.

The following links provide further information on diversity and equal opportunities: [https://go.fzj.de/equality](https://go.fzj.de/equality) and on specific support options for women: [https://go.fzj.de/womens-job-journey](https://go.fzj.de/womens-job-journey). International applicants can find more information here: [https://go.fzj.de/job-journey-internationals](https://go.fzj.de/job-journey-internationals)

**Place of Employment:**Jülich

**Start Date:** To the next possible date.

**Working Hours:** 39 Hours / Week

**Salary:** Pay Group 13 TVöD-Bund

**Application Deadline:** The position will be published until it is successfully filled

**Index number:** 2026T-0876

title: AI Engineering Lead  Agentic System
description:
Benefits:
  • Long Term
  • Competetive Salary
  • Oppurtunity for Advancement
AI Engineering Lead – Agentic Systems
Work Type: Full-Time, Onsite
Location: Dallas, Texas
Interview Mode: In-Person
Work Auth : Must be authorized to work in the U.S.
Domain: Enterprise AI / Agentic AI / AWS Bedrock
Compensation: Competitive, commensurate with experience


Role Overview
As Tech Lead, Agentic AI Solutions, you will lead the design and delivery of enterprise-grade agentic AI architectures that enable autonomous and semi-autonomous agents to perform complex, cross-functional business tasks.
You will define the frameworks, orchestration patterns, and governance standards that ensure our agentic AI systems operate with safety, reliability, and scalability across enterprise environments. This position blends deep technical leadership with innovation in AI orchestration, distributed systems, and multi-agent coordination.
This is an ideal opportunity for an experienced technologist who thrives in a dynamic environment and is passionate about shaping the next generation of intelligent agent platforms within the enterprise.

Key Responsibilities
  • Architect & Lead Development: :Design and implement scalable agentic AI frameworks, including multi-agent orchestration, task planning, and execution pipelines.
  • Integration & Protocol Design: Architect secure protocols and integrations—such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, API gateways, and tool registries—to enable seamless agent-to-agent and agent-to-human collaboration.
  • Technical Roadmap Ownership: Define and execute the roadmap for agentic AI solutions, continuously evaluating and adopting emerging frameworks like LangGraph, Bedrock Agents, CrewAI, and Strands.
  • Reusable Registries: Establish governed agent, prompt, and tool registries for standardized, reusable components.
  • Reliability & Performance: Engineer high-reliability orchestration with low latency, intelligent fallback, and self-healing mechanisms.
  • Observability & Governance: Implement traceability, explainability, and observability tools to ensure transparent, auditable agentic workflows.
  • Security & Compliance: Define security standards for API access, RBAC, data sanitization, and policy-gated tool execution; ensure compliance with NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, and privacy-by-design principles.
  • Monitoring & Evaluation: Develop real-time monitoring pipelines that track agent decision quality, execution success/failure, and dependency health.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Product Managers, Data Engineers, Legal/Compliance, and Business stakeholders to translate strategic objectives into robust agentic capabilities.
  • Innovation: Advance methods in planning, memory, context engineering, and knowledge integration to enhance autonomy, reliability, and reasoning capabilities.
  • Technical Leadership: Mentor engineers, promote best practices in AI infrastructure, and guide teams in developing modular, scalable, and compliant agentic systems.

Required Qualifications
Education:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).

Experience:
  • 8+ years of software engineering experience in AI/ML, distributed systems, or platform engineering.
  • 3+ years in senior technical leadership or architecture roles guiding multi-disciplinary teams.
Technical Expertise:
  • Strong proficiency in Python and experience with multiple programming paradigms.
  • Deep experience with the AWS ecosystem (Bedrock, SageMaker, Lambda, S3, Redshift, VPC).
  • Proven ability to design agent-safe protocols (MCP, API sandboxes, secure tool registries).
  • Expertise in distributed systems, asynchronous processing, and low-latency orchestration.
  • Hands-on experience with AI observability and traceability systems.
  • Familiarity with metadata management, data lineage, and knowledge graph integration for agent context enhancement.
  • Leadership & Governance:
  • Skilled in agile methodologies and iterative delivery of complex AI infrastructure.
  • Demonstrated success implementing AI governance and compliance frameworks.
  • Exceptional ability to communicate complex technical concepts to both engineers and executives.
  • Strong track record of mentoring, team building, and fostering inclusive, high-performing teams.
  • Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, Bedrock Agents, CrewAI, or LLMOps frameworks.
  • Knowledge of GraphRAG, memory management, and context-aware planning in multi-agent systems.
  • Exposure to regulated environments such as healthcare, finance, or aviation.
  • Familiarity with AI risk management, auditability frameworks, and policy-driven AI governance.

title: Tier I Service Desk Technician
description:
Position Summary

Flatter, inc. (Flatter) is hiring a Tier I Service Desk Technician to support full lifecycle IT and cyber services required to operate and coordinate for the support, defense, and sustainment of ICBM enterprise IT environments across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid architectures. The Service Desk technician will deliver scalable, resilient, and compliant services that maintain security, availability, and mission readiness as ICBMSD enterprise needs evolve. The Service Desk Technician will provide proactive and reactive support across the functional areas.


Serves as the single point of contact for IT incidents and service requests across the ICBMSD enterprise. The technician restores service, fulfills routine requests, communicates outage status, and ensures every action and resolution is recorded in the Government-approved service management system.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities

• Receive, classify, prioritize, document, route, and resolve IT incidents and service requests from initial report through closure.

• Apply Government-defined incident priorities based on urgency and mission impact, and process service requests as Standard or Expedited when directed.

• Provide Tier I and Tier II troubleshooting for user access, hardware, software, communications, and common enterprise-service issues.

• Maintain accurate ticket histories that capture user impact, diagnostic steps, actions taken, escalation activity, and the final resolution.

• Provide immediate and continuing situational awareness to the assigned Government lead during significant outages, using the update cadence required for the priority level.

• Route unresolved or specialized issues to the appropriate client support or technical organization and monitor progress through completion.

• Create, validate, and maintain knowledge articles and self-service content that improve first-contact resolution and support end-user self-help.

• Identify recurring incidents and workflow bottlenecks and contribute data and recommendations for service improvement.


Security Compliance and Performance Expectations

• Perform work within authorized Government policies, plans, processes, tools, and environments across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid architectures.

• Protect Government systems and data at the assigned classification and impact level, and maintain the required clearance, special access, privileged-access approval, and DoD 8140/8570-aligned certification.

• Document work, decisions, risks, issues, and resolutions in Government-approved systems and support audits, quality reviews, and monthly status reporting as directed.

• Participate in Government-directed training, modernization initiatives, working groups, surge support, and continuous process improvement activities.


* This position is in support of a proposal

title: Hitsaaja, Sastamala
location: Pirkanmaa, Akaa, Hämeenkyrö, Nokia, Pirkkala, Punkalaidun, Sastamala
description:
Etsimme osaavaa hitsaajaa Sastamalaan vakituiseen työsuhteeseen.

Työ on alihankintakonepajassa, jossa valmistetaan kappaleita myös isoille teollisuusyrityksille, joten työpäivät ovat vaihtelevia ja monipuolisia. Hitsattavat kappaleet vaihtuvat, ja siksi kuvienlukutaito on tärkeä osa päivittäistä tekemistä. Työssä hitsataan pääosin terästä. Käytössä on mig/mag hitsaus sekä mahdollisesti myös tig- ja puikkohitsausta.

Työskentely vaatii itsenäistä työotetta, oma‑aloitteisuutta ja kykyä hoitaa annetut tehtävät laadukkaasti alusta loppuun. Itsenäisen työnkuvan tueksi saat kuitenkin mukavan työporukan, monipuolisesti vaihtelevia tehtäviä sekä mahdollisuuden suorittaa hitsausluokat työpaikalla työn ohessa.

Työ tehdään päivävuorossa arkisin ja viikkotyöaika on 40 tuntia. Kyseessä on pitkäaikainen ja vakituinen työpaikka, jossa palkkaa maksetaan kokemukseen perustuen noin 15-18€/h.

Seuraava työpaikkasi? Hae järjestelmän kautta paikkaa, haastattelut aloitetaan jo hakuaikana. Työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan, sopivan tekijön löydyttyä.

title: Lumenpudottaja, PK-seutu
description:
Etsimme lumenpudottajia kauden 2026-2027 lumisesonkiin!

Haussa on reippaita tekijöitä ja työpareja tulevan talven lumikaaoksen hallintaan. Työt alkavat heti lumien tultua ja kestävät koko sesongin läpi kevääseen asti. Työtehtäviisi kuuluu pääasiallisesti lumenpudotustyöt pääkaupunkiseudun katoilla, mutta myös asuinkiinteistöjen piha-alueiden käsilumityöt lumikolalla ja -lapiolla. Vaikka asiakkaamme kohteet ovat pääasiassa tasakattoja ja lippakatoksia eli niin sanotusti vähän helpompia hommia niin korkeanpaikankammoisena paikkaa ei kannata hakea.
Voit siis olla joko kokenut konkari tai aloitteleva lumityöntekijä - työhön perehdytetään ja kokemusta entuudestaan ei vaadita, asenne ratkaisee!
Työ on luonteeltaan osa-aikaista ja hälytysluonteista, joten se sopii mainiosti esim. opiskelijalle, jonka opinnot eivät ole vuorokaudenaikaan sidottuja! Työtuntien määrään voi toiveen mukaan itse vaikuttaa, mutta mitä vapaampi kalenterisi on töille, sitä todennäköisemmin olet juuri etsimämme henkilö.
Ajokortti on työssä vaatimuksena, sillä kohteet sijaitsevat ympäri pääkaupunkiseutua. Oma auto ei ole vaatimus, mutta helpottaa työn logistiikkaa huomattavasti ja katsotaan hakijalla eduksi.

Hakeaksesi tätä työpaikkaa, sinulla tulee olla:

  • Hyvä työmoraali – työ on itsenäistä ja vastaat itse työnjäljestäsi.
  • Ajokortti ja auton käyttömahdollisuus - alueet ovat lähekkäin, mutta siirtymät välineineen on silti helpoin hoitaa autolla.
  • Suomen kielen taito - työnjohtokielenä on suomi.
  • Luotettavuutta - me luotamme sinuun työntekijänä, joten toivomme että luotat meihin työnantajana.

Vision työntekijälupaus

Kun sinulla on visio, mitä työelämältäsi haluat, me autamme sinua toteuttamaan sen. Varmistamme, että niin työolosuhteet kuin varusteet ovat kunnossa ja ammattilaisena saat työstä osaamista vastaavan palkan. Olemme tukena ja turvana, jos sellaista tarvitset. Meille on tärkeää, että viihdyt työssäsi.

Visiolaisena saat tässä tehtävässä:

  • Palkkaa, joka määräytyy työntekijän osaamisen mukaan.
  • Palkanmaksun kaksi kertaa kuukaudessa.
  • Jokaiseen työtehtävään soveltuvat työvarusteet.
  • Päivittäisen tuen työasioissa.

Onko meillä yhteinen visio?

Haastattelemme jo hakuaikana potentiaalisia hakjoita, joten mikäli koet olevasi etsimämme työntekijä, niin nyt on aika jättää hakemus. Tee se ohessa olevan linkin kautta!

Hakemuksia tulee paljon, ja jotta hakuprosessi on kaikille reilu, voimme ottaa huomioon vain järjestelmässä tehdyt hakemukset. Voit parantaa omia mahdollisuuksiasi tulla valituksi, kun:

  • liität hakemukseesi ansioluettelon (CV) tai kirjaat aikaisemmat työpaikkasi kuluneelta viideltä vuodelta,
  • kerrot, miten aiemmissa työpaikoissa opitut asiat tukevat sinua pärjäämään hakemassasi uudessa tehtävässä.

Me emme vastaanota kyselyitä puhelimitse, vaan mikäli haluat lisätietoja tehtävästä, niin lähetä meille sähköpostia otsikolla "haettu työ" osoitteeseen uusimaa(at)visiohr.fi.

Visio Henkilöstöratkaisut on vuonna 2020 perustettu kotimainen henkilöstöpalvelualan yritys, joka pelaa reilua peliä. Tarjoamme töitä niin raudanlujille ammattilaisille, kuin sellaiseksi kehittyville. Työntekijöitä autamme löytämään oman visionsa mukaisen työpaikan. title: Product Manager Trading Experience (M/F/D)
description:
As Product Manager Trading Experience, you own everything a client touches while trading on LYNX’s platforms, from spotting an opportunity, through analysis and order execution, to monitoring performance afterwards.

You set the vision for making our trading platforms the client’s daily companion, not just a tool they open occasionally, and you turn that vision into a roadmap your squad can actually deliver.

You’ll work closely with Engineering, Design and Data, and be judged on whether clients genuinely adopt and rely on what you ship.

What you’ll do

• Define the vision and outcomes for the complete trading experience across LYNX’s platforms.

• Own and prioritise a living roadmap, balancing quick wins with longer-term bets.

• Drive initiatives end-to-end: write epics and stories, make trade-offs, keep delivery on track.

• Run customer and market research to inform decisions and find opportunities for differentiation.

• Align Engineering, Design, Data and QA on goals and unblock progress.

• Own domain KPIs (adoption rate, CSAT, monthly active users) and iterate through experimentation.

• Partner with Compliance/DevOps/QA to keep delivery reliable, secure and within risk appetite.

• Coach Product Owners and Business Analysts growing on the PM track.

Who you are

• 3–5 years in product management, including experience as a Product Owner or similar.

• Deep interest in trading strategies, financial products and the regulatory environment (MiFID, privacy, security).

• Skilled at discovery: customer interviews, usability testing, opportunity sizing.

• Writes clear PRDs, epics, user stories and acceptance criteria, including non-functional requirements.

• Comfortable with data — funnels, cohorts, experimentation, basic SQL/BI.

• Strong stakeholder management across Leadership, Compliance, Ops and go-to-market teams.

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Engineering or a related field.

Nice to have

• Fintech/brokerage/payments experience and familiarity with regulatory audits.

• API/platform product experience and understanding of event models.

• A genuine passion for trading strategies and financial products.

What we offer

• A competitive salary based on experience.

• Flexible working hours at our office in the heart of the city.

• A fixed 13th-month salary.

• Pension scheme.

• Travel expense reimbursement.

• An annual training budget of €2,000, freely allocated to your professional development.

• Team outings, social drinks, and an annual weekend trip with the entire team.

Who we are

“LYNX helps you invest in yourself.” “Working at LYNX means joining the LYNX family.” “The development opportunities make LYNX the best place to work.”

This is what our employees say about LYNX, and it reflects exactly what we aim to offer: an environment where you can get the best out of yourself.

From our offices in Amsterdam, Ghent, Berlin, and Prague, we work every day to provide private and professional clients with the best trading opportunities through a fast, user-friendly, and reliable platform.

LYNX is an international FinTech company where around 300 colleagues contribute to client success across Europe in an informal, collaborative, and growth-oriented environment.
