title: Senior Java Engineer - Distributed Systems, Serverless - Elasticsearch
description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What Is The Role:

We are on the lookout for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Elasticsearch - Distributed Systems team and focus on how Elasticsearch provides scale, performance, and resilience, especially in the context of our Serverless offering. You will be tackling deep distributed systems challenges in how nodes in an Elasticsearch cluster communicate, and how data are indexed, allocated, and managed across nodes.

What You Will Be Doing:

  • Leveraging your distributed systems expertise to build, and operate core pieces of our next-generation Serverless Elasticsearch offering, directly impacting the experience of customers worldwide.
  • Improving Elasticsearch’s components that support concurrent and consistent indexing across multiple machines.
  • Maintaining our cluster coordination system to keep performance high even though nodes come and go from the cluster and data moves around, while maintaining the safety and liveness properties of the system as a whole.
  • Pushing the limits on the number of shards, nodes, and petabytes that Elasticsearch can handle today.
  • Looking into all kinds of issues, including performance or concurrency issues, and proposing solutions.
  • Supporting our support engineers with the harder problems.
  • Owning operational investigations end-to-end, until performance or stability issues are successfully resolved.

What You Bring:

  • You have a deep background in distributed systems and consensus algorithms.
  • You have strong skills in core Java and are conversant in the standard library of data structures and concurrency constructs, as well as newer language features.
  • You have a deep technical proficiency in algorithms.
  • You have shown your ability to understand and work on complex, highly distributed systems, rather than making use of off-the-shelf services.
  • You demonstrate the ability to build and debug features with a broad impact, running on multiple machines.
  • You are able to own projects from beginning to end. This covers both technical design and working with others to develop needed components.
  • You have a proven track record of using AI to accelerate development, debug complex systems, and optimize code, while still owning the final outcomes.
  • You possess the ability to collaborate across functions and teams and seamlessly transition between different projects, codebases, or teams based on business priorities.
  • You can work autonomously, drive decisions and results in a distributed team by leveraging asynchronous, direct, and transparent communication.

Bonus Points:

  • Data stores
  • Search, analytics, Lucene
  • Strong knowledge of the JDK
  • Asynchronous event-driven network frameworks such as Netty.

Compensation for this role is in the form of base salary. This role does not have a variable compensation component.

At Elastic, our compensation philosophy aims to provide fair, competitive and transparent remuneration. Salary ranges are established based on a combination of external market benchmarks, internal pay equity considerations, and the responsibilities and complexity associated with each role. This approach helps ensure consistency across comparable roles while remaining competitive within the relevant labour markets.

The final compensation offered within the applicable range will be determined based on several objective factors, including relevant professional experience, level of skills and expertise, alignment with the role requirements, and the overall scope and complexity of the position.

The typical starting salary range for this role is:
€85.600—€135.500 EUR

Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People

As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.

We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.

  • Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary
  • Health coverage for you and your family in many locations
  • Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles
  • Generous number of vacation days each year
  • Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service
  • Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love
  • Embracing parenthood with minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave

Different people approach problems differently. We need that. Elastic is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive culture that celebrates different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law, ordinance or regulation.

We welcome individuals with disabilities and strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all individuals. To request an accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please email candidate_accessibility@elastic.co. We will reply to your request within 24 business hours of submission.

title: Trust Officer
description:
Thanks for your interest in applying to the Bank of Utah. My name is Brenda Lambert, and I work as VP Personal Trust Manager. As an introduction to our company, the Bank of Utah was founded in 1952, and is one of Utah’s largest privately owned community banks. We were named S&P Global Top 20 Bank two years in a row and a Top 100 Fastest Growing Company.

Our Mission Statement:

We strive to unlock the potential of our team members, clients, and community. We act with integrity in every decision, build trust through every interaction, and exceed expectations at every opportunity. We seek to responsibly create lasting prosperity today and for generations to come.

Job Opening Details:
If our mission statement piques your interest, we encourage you to apply for the currently open position of Trust Officer to work Monday - Friday at our City Creek Branch located at 50 S 200 E SLC, UT.

To qualify for this Trust Officer position you must have:
 Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
 Five to ten years of relevant experience in fiduciary administration and relationship management.
 CTFA or CFP certifications preferred.

 Proficiency in Microsoft Office, trust accounting software (AccuTrust), edocument management (Director), workflow forms (Unity), and related trust and investment systems.

 Excellent written and verbal skills. Adept with high touch communication with clients.

 Team player who possesses excellent judgment, initiative, and adaptability. Good intrapersonal relationship and service skills.
Regular Duties and Responsibilities:

Administration of assigned accounts includes, but not limited to:

 Respond to client visits, calls, emails, correspondence and other client requests.

 Administer the opening and closing of accounts.

 Account document preparation and review:

 Coordinate with client or client’s attorney to review trust or other fiduciary documents as to administrative feasibility & acceptance.

 Review incoming assets to determine acceptability, transferability, qualification, or disposition.

 Prepare, provide, or execute governing documents to open and administer the account.

 Set up and maintain client and account profile info in the trust system.

 Maintain account opening and closing checklists to confirm accuracy and completion of account set up or closing.

 Administer fiduciary accounts in compliance with the governing documents, and applicable federal and state laws and regulations.

 Prepare, complete, and present account reviews to verify proper administration to Trust Committee.

 Direct and approve receipts and disbursements for posting: checks, inter-account transfers, ACHs, and wires.

title: Maintenance Systems Technician
description:
Hungry for a new career?

Imagine...working for a company that knows that its people are the key to its success in the marketplace. A company in which achieving extraordinary results and having a stimulating work experience are part of the same process.

We cultivate and embrace a diverse employee population. We recognize that people with diverse backgrounds, experiences and perspectives fuel our growth and enrich our global culture. We are looking for a skilled Maintenance Systems Technician Level I, II, III to join our team in Columbus, OH.

Reporting to the Maintenance Systems Supervisor, the Maintenance Systems Technician will maintain, adjust and repair plant machinery to industry standards while ensuring compliance with all applicable safety, food safety and regulatory requirements.

Depending on skills and experience, and the current needs of the business, this role may be offered as a Maintenance Systems Technician I, II or III. The pay range posted is entry to maximum across these three levels.

Essential Duties

  • Repair down equipment in a fast-paced, time-critical environment.
  • Execute tasks and instructions as described on assigned work orders.
  • Perform basic or advanced troubleshooting and problem-solving on damaged, degraded or downed equipment.
  • Perform basic or advanced industrial electrical troubleshooting, repair and multimeter use.
  • Maintain complete and accurate records of repair time, actions and parts utilizing the maintenance management software.
  • Recommend equipment modifications to improve the process, productivity, reliability and finished good quality.
  • Train and coach associates on equipment details and technical duties.
  • Recognize production as the customer and strive to meet the requirements of all plant functions who request Maintenance support.
  • Utilize mechanical and electrical prints, equipment manuals and procedures to effectively maintain, troubleshoot and repair equipment.
  • Other duties as assigned.


Regular and predictable attendance is an essential function of this position.

EDUCATION and EXPERIENCE

Maintenance Systems Technician I: High School Diploma or general education degree (GED) and 2 or more years in an industrial maintenance/auto mechanic/industrial equipment service role, or 4 years equipment operational experience in a manufacturing or industrial setting, or 2-year trade school certificate. Or equivalent combination of experience and qualifications.

Maintenance Systems Technician II: High School Diploma or general education degree (GED), a 2-year trade school certificate and 2 or more years of operational or maintenance/automotive mechanic/industrial equipment service-related experience. Or equivalent combination of experience and qualifications.

Maintenance Systems Technician III: High School Diploma or general education degree (GED), a 2-year trade school certificate and 5 or more years of experience in an industrial maintenance/automotive mechanic/industrial equipment service role. Or equivalent combination of experience and qualifications. A professional Maintenance Technician certification is preferred.

MST I REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, ABILITIES

  • Hand tool knowledge and experience
  • Power tool knowledge and experience
  • Understanding of and ability to use basic measurement tools
  • Computer proficiency with basic data entry skills. Ability to learn and effectively use maintenance management software.


MSTI II & III REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, ABILITIES

  • For all levels, computer proficiency with basic data entry skills. Ability to learn and effectively use maintenance management software.

Technician II must have basic understanding of all, and demonstrated expertise in at least 4 of the following skill areas. Technician III must have basic understanding of all, and demonstrated expertise in at least 8 of the following skill areas:

  • Welding and Fabrication. Includes: MIG and TIG welding, Oxy-Acetylene torch, metal cutting using plasma cutter, cut-off wheels or cutting saws.
  • Industrial electrician skills. Includes: Troubleshooting safety and control circuits, understanding 3-phase wiring and rotation, running and terminating power and control wiring, running conduit and pulling wire.
  • Industrial controls. Includes: Programming variable frequency drives, troubleshooting PLCs, programming or calibrating sensors. Interpreting control wiring diagrams and working/troubleshooting within control panels.
  • Pneumatics. Includes: troubleshooting pneumatic control systems, solenoids, valves. Reading pneumatic schematics. Experience in rebuilding cylinders, replacing seals and gaskets.
  • Hydraulics. Includes: troubleshooting hydraulic control systems, pumps, valves. Reading hydraulic schematics. Understanding importance of hydraulic oil condition and cleanliness.
  • Print reading and drawing. Includes interpretation of mechanical assembly drawings, electrical schematics, process and instrumentation drawings. Ability to create fabrication or layout drawings, to draw electrical circuits. Ability to navigate auto-cad drawings.
  • Machining. Has training and skills that allow safe operation of machine tools including: manual lathe, vertical mill, brake press and drill press.
  • Precision maintenance and measurement. Includes: performing dial indicator shaft alignment, laser alignment, pulley alignment methods, use of feeler gauges and precision shims, micrometers, bore gauges, levels and chain wear gauge tools.
  • Predictive maintenance tools and methods. Includes use of IR camera, Ultrasonic detector for air born and structure born ultrasound, vibration analysis fundamentals, understanding of motion amplification, motor circuit analysis, use of strobe light.
  • Lubrication technician skills. Includes: proof of completing a lubrication training class, knowledge of ISO oil cleanliness standards, experience using oil filtration, performing oil sampling. Understanding of grease types, properties and compatibility.
  • OSHA 30 certification. Certificate is current, up to date.

Additional Essential Duties, Maintenance Technician III:

  • Complete Root Cause Analysis following unplanned failures and practice continuous improvement concepts in all aspects of equipment and facility maintenance.
  • Provide input and constructive feedback on job plans and preventive maintenance procedures.
  • Train and coach associates on equipment details and technical duties, and maintenance skills.

title: Python Developer with MongoDB
description:
Project description

The programme is building a resilient, secure, production-grade platform of Python backend services, REST APIs, asynchronous processing components and external integrations, backed by MongoDB and delivered through a React/TypeScript operational user interface with auditable operations and role-based enterprise user journeys. As a Python backend developer with MongoDB exposure, you will design and deliver well-structured, testable, asynchronous backend services and APIs for the platform, with a full-stack delivery mindset – owning features from data model through API to UI.

Responsibilities

  • Design well-structured, testable backend services and APIs with clean module boundaries and separation of concerns.
  • Build asynchronous services with FastAPI/Uvicorn and Pydantic-based data modelling.
  • Apply SOLID, object-oriented design and pragmatic design patterns (factory, strategy, repository, adapter, state, saga, outbox, CQRS).
  • Drive design through TDD with strong unit and integration coverage of business-critical paths.
  • Engineer resilience for external dependencies: circuit breakers, retry with exponential backoff and jitter, bulkheads, timeouts and stale-data fallback.
  • Build security into the control flow: OAuth2/OIDC, mTLS, RBAC, maker-checker, secrets management.
  • Integrate REST APIs with OAuth2 bearer flows, retries, idempotency and error mapping.
  • Own features end-to-end from data model through API to UI, using Git/GitLab and CI pipelines.

SKILLS

Must have

  • Years of experience: 8+ Must have:
  • Strong Python service design: type hints, clean module/package boundaries, separation of concerns.
  • Async Python (asyncio, async HTTP clients) and FastAPI/Uvicorn with Pydantic.
  • SOLID principles, object-oriented service design and design patterns in practice.
  • Test-driven development (TDD).
  • REST API integration: OAuth2 bearer flows, retries, exponential backoff, idempotency, error mapping.
  • Concurrency and distributed-systems correctness: sagas, outbox, FSMs, idempotency, eventual consistency.
  • Full-stack delivery mindset.
  • Git/GitLab, automated testing and CI pipelines.
  • MongoDB (or comparable NoSQL): data modelling, pymongo/Motor, transactions/replica sets, CQRS read models.
  • React + TypeScript SPA: components, state management (TanStack Query / Redux Toolkit), API integration.
  • Containers & Kubernetes/OpenShift: stateless services, config/secrets, leader election in a CaaS environment.
  • Schedulers/workers (Celery, APScheduler, Temporal, Airflow) and leader-election/queue patterns.

Nice to have

• Payments or RTGS/SWIFT domain experience.

title: Senior Game Designer, Systems - Unpublished R&D Product
description:
Riot Games was established in 2006 by entrepreneurial gamers who believe that player-focused game development can result in great games. In 2009, Riot released its debut title League of Legends to critical and player acclaim. As the most played video game in the world, over 100 million play every month. Players form the foundation of our community and it’s for them that we continue to evolve and improve the League of Legends experience.

We’re looking for humble but ambitious, razor-sharp professionals who can teach us a thing or two. We promise to return the favor. Like us, you take play seriously; you’re passionate about games. We embrace those who see things differently, aren’t afraid to experiment, and who have a healthy disregard for constraints.

That's where you come in.

As a Game Designer, you will design, tweak, and optimize the player experience. Your analytical skills, player insight, and creativity help craft in- and out-of-game experiences that engage and surprise players. You will collaborate with interdisciplinary teams and work with every tool at hand to create and iterate player-focused designs that will delight millions around the world.

As a Senior Game Designer (Systems) on the Unpublished R&D Product team, you will help shape cohesive player experiences across major releases. You will bring together gameplay, systems, and creative intent into a clear design direction, then work with designers and cross-disciplinary partners to carry it from concept through development, release, and iteration. This is a hands-on design role for someone who can lead a broad problem space without losing sight of the details that make a game compelling. You will report to the Game Director of the team.

Responsibilities

  • Own the design direction for major releases, defining player experience goals, design pillars, and the connections between features and content.
  • Bring together gameplay systems, content, and thematic and narrative intent into a cohesive player journey, partnering with craft specialists rather than replacing their expertise.
  • Lead design work across disciplines from early exploration through implementation, testing, release, and post-release iteration; make informed decisions about scope, priorities, quality, and design trade-offs.
  • Identify opportunities for new mechanics and systems, develop multiple viable approaches, and articulate their player impact, dependencies, risks, and long-term implications.
  • Contribute hands-on to the design, prototyping, implementation, and refinement of high-impact systems and features.
  • Use playtests, player insights, and data to evaluate design hypotheses and improve the player experience.
  • Create clear design principles, documentation, and feedback that help partners align and execute; support other designers in raising the quality of their work.

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in professional game design.
  • Experience owning the design of a major release or comparably broad content update for a live game, from planning and development through launch and subsequent iteration.
  • Strong systems design craft, with demonstrated ability to connect multiple features and systems into a coherent player experience and anticipate the downstream effects of design decisions.
  • Strong gameplay instincts and the ability to work with narrative and thematic goals to improve how a game feels and what players experience, without needing to be a narrative specialist.
  • Experience guiding cross-disciplinary teams through ambiguous design problems, building alignment, and making practical quality and scope trade-offs.
  • Ability to communicate design goals, rationale, and implementation needs clearly through documentation, discussion, and feedback.
  • Fluent in Mandarin Chinese.

Desired Qualifications

  • Experience establishing a design vision and leading the development of multiple major updates for a live game.
  • Experience designing and evolving systems that support sustained player engagement.
  • Experience mentoring or coaching other designers.
  • Experience with early-stage development, prototyping, and iterative design.

We operate across Financial Services, Resources, Products, Communications and Health & Public Services. Together these capabilities cover the full spectrum of modern data and AI delivery — from the cloud infrastructure and platforms that underpin AI workloads, through the pipelines that move and transform data at scale, to the data products that turn engineering effort into lasting business value.

Role Overview

As a Data Engineering Manager, you will lead delivery of AI-powered data engineering programmes — owning the full journey from pipeline design and build through to the data products that serve our clients’ AI, analytics and business needs. We operate in an AI-augmented delivery model where AI-assisted pipeline development, automated data quality and agentic data operations are current practice, and our managers are expected to lead teams in adopting and embedding these approaches as standard. You’ll learn, grow and advance in an innovative culture that thrives on shared success, diverse ways of thinking and enables boundaryless opportunities that can drive your career in new and exciting ways. If you’re looking for a challenging career working in a vibrant environment with access to training and a global network of experts, this could be the role for you.

Responsibilities

  • Lead delivery of cloud-scale data engineering programmes and platform migration initiatives across Azure, Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, AWS and GCP
  • Drive AI-assisted pipeline development as standard engineering practice — setting team norms around the use of GenAI tooling for pipeline build, testing and documentation, and governing the quality of AI-generated outputs
  • Design and implement data quality, schema drift detection and lineage capabilities using AI-driven automation — moving teams away from manual quality gates towards intelligent, self-describing pipelines
  • Own data product design and quality end to end — from consumption requirements through data modelling, pipeline delivery and ongoing governance — ensuring what the team builds is fit for business and AI consumption, not just technically correct
  • Lead ETL/ELT modernisation and cloud migration programmes, applying AI-assisted approaches to accelerate analysis, mapping and delivery of legacy-to-cloud transitions

title: Hospital Aide (Full-Time) - MacDill AFB
description:
Job Summary:

The Hospital Aide performs a variety of environmental services duties in support of patient care operations at MacDill AFB, FL. The incumbent is responsible for maintaining clean, safe, and infection-controlled patient rooms, clinical areas, and support spaces in compliance with The Joint Commission (TJC), CDC, OSHA, and AHE standards, and in accordance with the facility’s environmental healthcare procedures and hospital objectives.

Salary: $ 19.53 per Hour

Benefits: All benefits and paid time off will be provided, as set forth by the applicable

Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA)

Duties and Responsibilities:

The Essential Duties and Responsibilities are intended to present a descriptive list of the range of duties performed for this position and are not intended to reflect all duties performed within the job. Other duties may be assigned.

  • Cleans and supplies patient rooms, wards, nursing stations, exam rooms, lounges, lavatories, bathrooms, offices, corridors, and all other assigned areas in accordance with environmental healthcare procedures, hospital objectives, and AHE service level classification standards.
  • Uses cleaning devices including light mops, wringers, microfiber systems, dusters, HEPA-filtered vacuums, and other necessary tools, EPA-registered chemicals, and supplies in accordance with product label instructions and Safety Data Sheet (SDS) requirements.
  • Performs specific cleaning tasks including dusting horizontal and vertical surfaces; emptying and sanitizing waste receptacles and removing trash; damp-wiping and disinfecting furniture and high-touch surfaces; cleaning and polishing metal and porcelain bathroom fixtures; dry-mopping and wet-mopping floors; applying EPA-registered disinfectants with proper dwell times per OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1030 and facility infection control protocols; spot-cleaning walls and windows; replenishing room supplies; making and changing beds; and sorting and distributing linen.
  • Responds to and cleans emergency spills observed or upon request; applies appropriate spill containment, biohazard cleanup procedures, and regulated medical waste (RMW) handling protocols as required by OSHA and facility policy.
  • Maintains assigned equipment in clean, safe, and operational condition; reports equipment defects or needed repairs to the supervisor in a timely manner.
  • Reports observed facility defects in equipment, furniture, building components, and fixtures to the supervisor or facilities management promptly.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

General Requirements:

  • Must wear uniform and comply with all departmental work rules, DoD access control requirements, and MacDill AFB installation security badging standards.
  • Must have knowledge of all department policies, procedures, infection control standards, and OSHA chemical safety (HazCom/GHS) requirements.
  • Must be willing and able to assist in the event of an emergency at the facility, including patient care support, evacuation assistance, and biohazard cleanup.
  • Will receive training in disaster preparedness, Transmission-Based Precaution protocols, and Anti-Terrorism Level I awareness, and must be prepared to respond as directed.

The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Adequate written and oral English language skills are required to read SDS labels, follow written cleaning procedures, and communicate effectively with supervisors and facility personnel.
  • Must be able to take directions, follow established cleaning protocols and infection control procedures, and carry out all assignments thoroughly and completely.
  • Must demonstrate reliability and the ability to perform assigned duties to established quality and productivity standards without constant supervision, consistent with AHE healthcare environmental services guidelines.
  • Must be available for all shifts in a 24/7 operational environment, including evenings, nights, weekends, and federal holidays, as required by the contract and facility operational needs.
  • Must be available to travel as needed to Sabal Park Clinic and the rest of the outside buildings.

HIPAA and Safety:

Must perform all duties in a manner that assures the confidentiality, privacy, dignity, and safety of patients, visitors, and staff at all times, in full compliance with HIPAA regulations and facility patient rights policies. Must comply with all DoD and MacDill AFB installation access control and security requirements, and complete a federal background investigation and pre-employment drug screening prior to start date.

title: Senior Software Engineer, OS Integration
description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About the OS Integration team:

The OS Integration team ensures Firefox works well with the host operating system and environment. We’re a distributed team with expertise in Windows, macOS, and Linux-based operating systems. Our responsibilities include developing fixes and improvements for Firefox related to Windows, macOS, and Linux environments. This might include integration with a new OS feature or fixing an OS-specific user interface bug. Other responsibilities include native crash reporting, OS abstraction layers, sandboxing, hardening, updater, and enterprise DLP support.

About the role:

As a member of the OS Integration team, you’ll develop fixes, improvements, and new features for Firefox. In many cases work may be cross-platform or have a cross-platform component. This role will include maintenance and development of the installer and updater of Firefox. You’ll contribute to the team through code review and discussion.

What you’ll do:

  • Improve the quality of Firefox and other Mozilla products by debugging and fixing software defects, improving the browsing experience for hundreds of millions of users.
  • Contribute to new features and improvements.
  • Break down tasks and work with others to deliver solutions.
  • Collaborate with experienced software engineers.
  • Perform code reviews and provide technical direction.
  • Work with a geographically-distributed development team.
  • Interact with teams throughout the organization.

What you’ll bring:

  • 5+ years of overall software engineering experience
  • Strong knowledge of C and C++
  • Experience with desktop application development on Windows, macOS, or Linux with C++.
  • Knowledge of web technologies such as Javascript and HTML.
  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and memory safety concerns.
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.
  • Written and verbal communication skills with a collaborative mindset.
  • Willingness to work effectively in a distributed team environment.
  • Commitment to our values:
    • Play to win
    • Build for People first
    • Engage Evidence over Ego
    • Decide and Deliver
    • Ship, learn and repeat

Bonus Points for experience with:

  • Installer and/or Updater development on any OS
  • Windows internals like the BITS server or MSIX packages
  • Open-source contributions or personal engineering projects

What you’ll get:

  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
  • Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together
  • Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
  • One-time home office stipend
  • Annual professional development budget
  • Considerable paid parental leave
  • Employee referral bonus program
  • Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)

About Mozilla

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging

Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientations, gender identities, and expressions.

title: Manager, Education & Workforce Policy
description:

​Our client is a non-profit, professional association for Occupational Therapy Practitioners with a mission to advance occupational therapy practice, education, and research.

Position Summary:

The Manager of Education & Workforce Policy is a high-impact policy and advocacy position responsible for leading our client's federal strategy across education, workforce, and school-based practice issues. The role drives legislative and regulatory initiatives impacting occupational therapy in K–12 education, early intervention, higher education, and workforce development, and leads the organization as a thought leader in federal education and workforce policy.

An occupational therapy practitioner is strongly preferred, however candidates with comparable experience in other special education or related-service fields will be considered. All candidates must have a deep knowledge of IDEA and related federal education laws, regulations, and school-based practice policy, along with the ability to translate that expertise into strategic advocacy. The role requires advanced strategic thinking, long-term planning, and policy development, along with independent judgment, high-level relationship management skills, and the ability to educate our organization's members and external stakeholders on complex policy issues. title: Senior Java Engineer - Distributed Systems, Serverless - Elasticsearch
description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What Is The Role:

We are on the lookout for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Elasticsearch - Distributed Systems team and focus on how Elasticsearch provides scale, performance, and resilience, especially in the context of our Serverless offering. You will be tackling deep distributed systems challenges in how nodes in an Elasticsearch cluster communicate, and how data are indexed, allocated, and managed across nodes.

What You Will Be Doing:

  • Leveraging your distributed systems expertise to build, and operate core pieces of our next-generation Serverless Elasticsearch offering, directly impacting the experience of customers worldwide.
  • Improving Elasticsearch’s components that support concurrent and consistent indexing across multiple machines.
  • Maintaining our cluster coordination system to keep performance high even though nodes come and go from the cluster and data moves around, while maintaining the safety and liveness properties of the system as a whole.
  • Pushing the limits on the number of shards, nodes, and petabytes that Elasticsearch can handle today.
  • Looking into all kinds of issues, including performance or concurrency issues, and proposing solutions.
  • Supporting our support engineers with the harder problems.
  • Owning operational investigations end-to-end, until performance or stability issues are successfully resolved.

What You Bring:

  • You have a deep background in distributed systems and consensus algorithms.
  • You have strong skills in core Java and are conversant in the standard library of data structures and concurrency constructs, as well as newer language features.
  • You have a deep technical proficiency in algorithms.
  • You have shown your ability to understand and work on complex, highly distributed systems, rather than making use of off-the-shelf services.
  • You demonstrate the ability to build and debug features with a broad impact, running on multiple machines.
  • You are able to own projects from beginning to end. This covers both technical design and working with others to develop needed components.
  • You have a proven track record of using AI to accelerate development, debug complex systems, and optimize code, while still owning the final outcomes.
  • You possess the ability to collaborate across functions and teams and seamlessly transition between different projects, codebases, or teams based on business priorities.
  • You can work autonomously, drive decisions and results in a distributed team by leveraging asynchronous, direct, and transparent communication.

Bonus Points:

  • Data stores
  • Search, analytics, Lucene
  • Strong knowledge of the JDK
  • Asynchronous event-driven network frameworks such as Netty.

Compensation for this role is in the form of base salary. This role does not have a variable compensation component.

At Elastic, our compensation philosophy aims to provide fair, competitive and transparent remuneration. Salary ranges are established based on a combination of external market benchmarks, internal pay equity considerations, and the responsibilities and complexity associated with each role. This approach helps ensure consistency across comparable roles while remaining competitive within the relevant labour markets.

The final compensation offered within the applicable range will be determined based on several objective factors, including relevant professional experience, level of skills and expertise, alignment with the role requirements, and the overall scope and complexity of the position.

791.300 kr—1.251.700 kr NOK

Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People

As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.

title: Process Engineering Specialist
description:
Join Our Mission at Takealot Fulfilment Solutions | We Are TFS

Revolutionising e-commerce logistics in South Africa with cutting-edge technology and operational excellence. We deliver 30+ million orders annually, empowering businesses and driving economic growth.

Who We're Looking For:

Innovative, ambitious individuals ready to shape the future of e-commerce logistics. At TFS, "Uniquely You" meets "Powerfully Us", where your individuality strengthens our collective mission.

Purpose of this role : The Process Engineering Specialist leads a structured, business-wide programme to create, understand, optimise, and standardise Takealot’s key operational processes -driving measurable business value through process improvement, visibility, and change management. This is a role for an up and coming engineer who is methodical, analytical, and eager to gain deep exposure to the inner workings of a large-scale e-commerce operation. The successful candidate will move across multiple business functions, engaging with process owners and frontline teams to understand how work is performed today, identify where value is trapped or lost, and drive improvements that unlock that value - then codify the optimised processes into clear, standardised documentation that sustains the gains. This is not a documentation-only role. The person in this seat is responsible for the full improvement lifecycle: understanding the current state, identifying optimisation opportunities, quantifying the business case, driving the change with stakeholders, and embedding the improved process through documentation, training, and governance.

This position reports to the Head: Solutions and Architecture (TBC)

Your responsibilities can include:

Process Discovery, Mapping & Visibility :

  • Cross- functional Engagement: Engage with stakeholders across operations teams (including warehouse/inbound, catalogue, customer service,seller onboarding, and other operational functions as scoped with the project lead) to understand and document current-state processes end-to-end.
  • Operational Walkthroughs: Conduct interviews, process walkthroughs, and on-floor observations to capture how work is actually performed, not just how it is intended to be performed.
  • Standardised Notation: Map processes using standardized notations (BPMN, swimlane diagrams, decision-tree formats) to create a shared, visual understanding of how work flows across functions.
  • Dependency Mapping: Identify process owners, inputs, outputs, and interdependencies between functions.
  • End-to-End Visibility: Build process visibility to give stakeholders a clear, shared picture of how work moves through the operation, where bottlenecks sit, and where data, handoffs, or decisions create friction.
  • Gap Identification: Uncover gaps, ambiguities, undocumented workarounds, and hidden process steps in current operations.

Process Optimisation & Business Value Unlocking :

  • Inefficiency Analysis: Analyse mapped processes to identify inefficiencies — unnecessary steps, manual workarounds, duplicate processes across teams, bottlenecks, rework loops, and underutilised automation.
  • Business Case Quantification: Quantify the business impact of identified opportunities (time saved, cost reduction, error reduction, throughput improvement, or capacity unlock) and build lightweight business cases for each.
  • Prioritised Implementation: Recommend and help implement process improvements, working with process owners and the project lead to prioritise by impact and effort.
  • Automation & AI Readiness: Identify opportunities for automation and AI-enablement where structured process data and standardised workflows create a foundation for technology-led improvement.
  • Benefit Tracking: Track and measure the realised benefit of implemented improvements against the baseline, closing the loop between recommendation and outcome.

SOP Documentation & Standardisation :

  • Produce clear, structured Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) documents for each identified process area — capturing both the current state and, where improvements have been implemented, the optimised future state. Each SOP must capture:
  • Data Sources: Databases, reporting dashboards, internal tools, and third-party platforms referenced or relied upon, including purpose and access methods.
  • Existing Scripts & Automation: Capture details of existing SQL queries, Python/Shell scripts, scheduled jobs, API calls, or other automated routines executed as part of the process (including purpose, frequency, owner, and trigger locations).
  • Inputs & Outputs: Specific requirements for each process step, including required approvals or sign-offs.
  • Exception Handling: Procedures for resolving operational issues, escalation contacts, and decision criteria.
  • Security & Compliance: Data access permissions, information-handling requirements, and compliance considerations.
  • Visual Workflows: Flowcharts and process diagrams that complement rather than duplicate written procedures, maintaining clear BPMN/swimlane consistency.
  • SOP Governance: Establish a sustainable review and update cadence so SOPs remain current as processes evolve.

Change Management :

  • Rollout Planning: Plan and support the rollout of process changes with affected teams — ensuring stakeholders understand what is changing, why, and what it means for day-to-day work.
  • Proactive Resistance Management: Identify potential resistance points and work with process owners to address them proactively.
  • Training Aids: Develop or support the development of training materials, quick-reference guides, and onboarding aids that help teams adopt improved processes.
  • Reinforcement & Governance: Ensure process changes are reinforced through updated documentation, system configurations, and governance checkpoints so improvements stick.
  • Post-Implementation Review: Run post-implementation reviews to assess adoption, identify residual issues, and capture lessons learned.

Stakeholder Management & Validation :

  • Validation & Sign-Off: Review draft SOPs and proposed improvements with process owners and stakeholders for accuracy, completeness, and buy-in.
  • Version Control: Incorporate feedback and manage version control of all documentation.
  • Technical Translation: Act as the technical interface between business needs and engineering/data teams, translating operational reality into documentation and improvement recommendations that support automation initiatives.
  • Multi-Stakeholder Alignment: Manage multiple stakeholder relationships simultaneously across functions with differing priorities and operating rhythms.

Qualifications and experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Engineering or a related discipline (Operations Management, Supply Chain Management, Business/Systems Engineering, or Process Engineering).
  • +3 years experience in process engineering, process improvement, industrial engineering, operations, or a related field. Internships, vacation work, and university projects involving process mapping or improvement
    are valued.

Attributes required :

  • Process Mapping Tools: Proficiency in at least one of: Microsoft Visio, Lucidchart, draw.io, or similar.
  • Process Notation Frameworks: Knowledge of BPMN, swimlane diagrams, or other standard process notation frameworks.
  • Data Literacy: Familiarity with basic SQL and data querying concepts; ability to read and interpret query logic and pull data to support process analysis.
  • Basic Scripting Awareness: Ability to recognise, understand at a high level, and document existing scripts, queries, or automated routines (e.g., SQL queries, Python/Shell scripts, scheduled jobs, API calls) used in day-to-day operations.
  • AI / Automation Awareness: Basic understanding of how AI tools and automation platforms consume structured process data; awareness of how documented SOPs and mapped processes enable AI integration.
  • Business Case Development: Ability to quantify process improvement impact in business terms (time, cost, throughput, error rate) and present lightweight justifications for action.

Change Management

  • Understanding of change management principles - how to introduce process changes in a live operational environment without disrupting delivery.
  • Ability to develop or support training materials, quick- reference guides, and onboarding aids.
  • Stakeholder engagement skills to build buy-in and address resistance to change.

Communication & Collaboration

  • Excellent communication skills to interface effectively with business stakeholders, engineering, and data teams.
  • Strong documentation habits and a commitment to knowledge sharing across the team.
  • Collaborative by nature, with the ability to manage multiple stakeholder relationships simultaneously.

Ownership & Delivery

  • Self-driven with a strong bias for action and end-to-end ownership of deliverables.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, iterative environment with evolving priorities.
  • Results-oriented, with a focus on delivering measurable business impact rather than just technical output.

Preferred (Nice-to-Have)

  • Exposure to Lean, Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement methodologies.
  • Experience in an e-commerce, retail, or logistics operations environment.
  • Familiarity with process documentation tools that support AI-enabled workflows (e.g., tools that export structured data for automation pipelines).
  • Experience supporting or leading process change in a live operational environment.

Why Join TFS:

  • Purpose-driven impact: Transform lives through logistics innovation
  • Advanced technology: Work with cutting-edge systems in a fast-paced environment
  • Career growth: Thrive in an agile space that champions continuous improvement
  • Inclusive culture: Your unique perspective drives extraordinary results

At TFS, your growth is our growth. You'll be joining a team powered by Takealot Group's core values.

More than just a job, we offer:

A culture that celebrates individual uniqueness while championing the strength of togetherness. Be part of creating sustainable, scalable solutions that make a difference across South Africa's e-commerce landscape.

Location: Thompson, IA

Job Summary:

As a Sanitation Technician, you will play a critical role in maintaining the cleanliness, biosecurity, and operational efficiency of our processing facilities. Your efforts directly support our mission to produce safe, high-quality eggs and ensure compliance with food safety standards. This role is essential to maintaining daily operations, preparing the facility for continuous production, and performing basic preventive maintenance tasks.


Essential Job Functions

  • Assist in the packaging and stacking of eggs during production hours
  • Clean processing machines and surrounding areas during downtime using approved safety procedures (e.g., Lockout/Tagout)
  • Sanitize processing areas using high-pressure water hoses and approved cleaning chemicals
  • Transport waste to disposal areas and maintain cleanliness of work zones
  • Follow biosecurity and sanitation protocols strictly
  • Perform daily and deep-cleaning tasks as assigned
  • Conduct basic preventive maintenance checks and tasks on equipment
  • Identify and report potential maintenance issues to supervisors
  • Comply with all company policies, including food safety, safety, and animal welfare standards
  • Other duties as assigned

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities (KSAs)

  • Familiarity with sanitation procedures and cleaning chemicals
  • Basic mechanical aptitude to clean, reset, and perform minor maintenance on equipment
  • Understanding of basic preventive maintenance principles and practices
  • Ability to work independently and follow detailed procedures
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to cleanliness, safety, and equipment care
  • Physical stamina to lift, carry, and stand for long periods
  • Ability to communicate effectively with team members and supervisors
  • Basic troubleshooting skills for common equipment issues

Required Qualifications

  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds
  • Availability to work weekends and holidays as needed
  • Strong work ethic and dependable attendance
  • Basic understanding of preventive maintenance concepts

Preferred Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or GED
  • Previous experience in sanitation or food production environments
  • Knowledge of Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) safety procedures
  • Bilingual in Spanish and English

Work Environment

The work environment primarily consists of indoor activities within a food processing plant. Employees can expect exposure to wet and humid conditions, as well as various cleaning chemicals used in sanitation processes. The job involves regular physical activities such as standing, walking, bending, and lifting throughout the workday. To ensure safety, the use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) may be required, including gloves, eye protection, and waterproof gear. Additionally, the role occasionally involves working with basic maintenance tools and equipment as part of preventive maintenance tasks and minor repairs.


About Us

Versova is one of the largest egg producers in the United States, bringing together family-owned farms in Iowa, Ohio, Washington, Oregon, Idaho, Utah, and Colorado. With over six decades of industry experience, our team of more than 2,000 employees is dedicated to exceptional flock care, environmental stewardship, and producing safe, high-quality eggs. More than just a workplace, Versova is a team built on shared values, working together to enrich our communities and uphold the highest ethical standards.

As a family of companies and a company of families, we are guided by a strong set of Core Values: Recognition, Initiative, Safety & Security, Service, Community, Respect, Integrity, Ownership, and Excellence. These values drive our commitment to responsible employment, sustainability, and industry innovation. When you join Versova, you become part of something bigger - working together to lead the future of egg production with integrity and excellence.

title: User Researcher
description:
About Scrumconnect Consulting

Scrumconnect Consulting is a multi-award-winning digital consultancy, recognised for delivering impactful and innovative technology solutions across UK government departments. Our work has positively influenced the lives of over 40 million UK citizens.

We are passionate about user-centred design, agile delivery, and building digital services that make a real difference. Our teams work at the forefront of innovation, helping organisations transform and deliver high-quality, scalable solutions that truly matter.

Role Summary

The Senior User Researcher will lead the user research programme for the SCS-N Discovery, designing and executing a comprehensive research approach to understand the needs, behaviours and pain points of building control authority teams across England.

Operating at SFIA Level 5, this role requires an experienced researcher capable of working autonomously, advising on research strategy and producing high-quality, evidence-based outputs that directly inform the design of a new digital notification system.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the design and execution of the user research strategy for the SCS-N Discovery, including defining research questions, selecting appropriate methods and managing participant recruitment.

  • Plan and facilitate in-depth interviews, focus groups, contextual enquiries and usability sessions with building control authority (BCA) teams across a representative sample of local authorities.

  • Design and deploy surveys, diary studies and other mixed-methods research instruments.

  • Synthesise and analyse large volumes of qualitative and quantitative research data to identify themes, insights and user needs.

  • Produce clear, compelling and high-quality research outputs, including findings reports, insight packs, affinity diagrams, personas and journey maps.

  • Contribute to the 'as-is' process mapping of how BCA teams manage SCS-N notifications.

  • Define and prioritise user needs for the new system (essential vs. desirable), in collaboration with the Business Analyst (BA) and Service Designer.

  • Present research findings clearly and persuasively to senior stakeholders at BSR and MHCLG.

  • Ensure all research is conducted in accordance with GDPR, ethical research standards and the Government Social Research framework.

  • Mentor junior researchers and contribute to raising research standards across the team.

Essential Skills & Experience

  • Significant experience as a User Researcher in UK public sector or government digital delivery.

  • Strong qualitative research skills, including interview design, facilitation, analysis and synthesis.

  • Experience designing and executing large-scale research programmes engaging diverse and geographically distributed participant groups.

  • Proficiency in research tools such as Dovetail, Lookback, Optimal Workshop, Miro or equivalent.

  • Experience producing GDS-standard research outputs, including needs registers, research findings reports and journey maps.

  • Ability to communicate complex research findings in plain English to non-specialist audiences.

  • Knowledge of the GDS Service Standard and the role of research across Discovery, Alpha and Beta.

  • SFIA Level 5 competencies as defined in the SFIA framework.

Desirable Skills & Experience

  • Experience researching local authority, building control or regulatory services.

  • Knowledge of quantitative research methods and survey design.

  • Experience with remote and in-person research facilitation across public sector contexts.

  • Government Social Research (GSR) accreditation or an equivalent professional research qualification.

SFIA Level 5 Behaviours Expected

At SFIA Level 5 (Ensure, Advise), the successful candidate will demonstrate the following core behaviours:

  • Takes responsibility for the quality and rigour of the research programme.

  • Advises on research strategy, method selection and approach at programme level.

  • Works autonomously, self-directing research activities with minimal supervision.

  • Influences decisions on service design and policy through evidence-based research.

  • Demonstrates accountability for research outputs and their impact on delivery.

Diversity & Inclusion

At Scrumconnect Consulting, we believe that diversity drives innovation and better outcomes. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where every individual is valued, respected and supported.

We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and actively encourage individuals from underrepresented groups, including women, people with disabilities and diverse communities, as well as those seeking flexible working arrangements.

As a Disability Confident Level 1 employer, we are committed to providing reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process and during employment to ensure equal opportunities for all.

We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. About the OS Integration team:

The OS Integration team ensures Firefox works well with the host operating system and environment. We’re a distributed team with expertise in Windows, macOS, and Linux-based operating systems. Our responsibilities include developing fixes and improvements for Firefox related to Windows, macOS, and Linux environments. This might include integration with a new OS feature or fixing an OS-specific user interface bug. Other responsibilities include native crash reporting, OS abstraction layers, sandboxing, hardening, updater, and enterprise DLP support.

About the role:

As a member of the OS Integration team, you’ll develop fixes, improvements, and new features for Firefox. In many cases work may be cross-platform or have a cross-platform component. This role will include maintenance and development of the installer and updater of Firefox. You’ll contribute to the team through code review and discussion.

  • Perform code reviews and provide technical direction.
  • Work with a geographically-distributed development team.
  • Interact with teams throughout the organization.

What you’ll bring:

  • 5+ years of overall software engineering experience

  • Knowledge of web technologies such as Javascript and HTML.
  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and memory safety concerns.
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.

  • Willingness to work effectively in a distributed team environment.

title: Simulation, AI and HPC Workflow Specialist
description:
# Simulation, AI and HPC Workflow Specialist

The Jülich Supercomputing Centre (JSC) operates one of the most powerful supercomputer infrastructures in Europe and hosts the first EU Exascale supercomputer JUPITER. Computing resources are provided to scientists in Germany and in Europe. To support users of the systems, JSC uses its expertise in high-performance computing (HPC), artificial intelligence (AI), and data science in general. JSC’s simulation and data laboratory (SDL) “Fluids & Solids Engineering” develops scalable simulation codes for engineering applications, AI models for compute acceleration and the prediction of physical properties, and tools for AI and HPC workflow automatization. The SDL participates in multiple EU-funded projects. The Horizon Europe project RI-SCALE delivers Data Exploitation Platforms (DEPs), which provide scalable environments to co-host scientific data with preconfigured AI frameworks and models on powerful compute resources to unlock full data and AI potential for scientific users, RI operators, and industry. Additionally, the TwinRISE Horizon Europe project delivers a European reference framework for Trusted AI-Generated Digital Twins across research, healthcare, and energy infrastructures. Through these projects, the SDL advances Exascale-demanding and AI-infused workflows for a variety of use cases.

## Your Job

In this position, you will be an active member of the SDL “Fluids & Solids Engineering” and will collaborate strongly with the partners in RI-SCALE, TwinRISE, and with other members of the SDL. You will have the following tasks:

  • You will work together with use case providers, HPC and AI scientists, and platform developers to advance Europe’s compute and data continuum
  • You will invent, implement, and benchmark novel AI tools for the integration in complex Exascale-demanding workflows
  • You will advance the open-source tool itwinai, developed by Forschungszentrum Jülich and CERN, towards agentic use including RAG and interoperable pipeline development
  • You will take responsibility of organizing and drafting compute time applications, manage and oversee resource consumptions, and create connections to the JUPITER AI Factory (JAIF)
  • You will evaluate and document results in the form of open-source software, open-access publications and will advertise developed tools in the community
  • In all of these activities, you will make use of JSC’s cutting-edge HPC- and Quantum-hardware

## Your Profile

  • Master and subsequent PhD degree in computer science, engineering, or other related fields, with a strong focus on AI workflows and agentic AI
  • Experience in programming in Python and C++, and in using scripting languages commonly used on Unix systems. Additional languages or experience with libraries for utilizing GPU hardware efficiently, e.g., CUDA, are a plus.
  • Experience in AI programming with, e.g., PyTorch(-DDP), Horovod, or DeepSpeed, and in hyperparameter optimization (HPO), as well as in designing and implementing AI+HPC+simulation workflows (experience with workflow managers for scientific applications is a plus)
  • Experience in running large-scale simulations on HPC systems with heterogeneous hardware, using CPUs/GPUs, and in analyzing complex, multi-modal data
  • A generalist with an interest to solve challenges using a large set of diverse software tools and applications
  • Excellent communication skills in written and spoken English with extensive vocabulary is required (at least B2 level according to the [CEFR](https://go.fzj.de/languagerequirements)).
  • Ability and willingness to work in an interdisciplinary and distributed team

Note that it is not necessary to fulfil all of these requirements in order to be considered for the position. We want you to fit in with us as a person, not just your profile.

## Our Benefits for You

  • **Meaningful tasks:** A diverse range of activities in an engaged and experienced team
  • **Work-life balance:** Optimal conditions for balancing work and private life, as well as a family-friendly company policy. The option of flexible working (in terms of location) is generally available after consultation and in line with upcoming tasks and (on-site) appointments
  • **Vacation:** You will receive 30 days of vacation plus additional days off (e.g. between Christmas and New Year's)
  • **Flexibility:** Flexible working time models, [including options close to full-time](https://go.fzj.de/near-full-time), allow you to tailor your working hours to suit your individual needs
  • **Knowledge & further training:** Your professional development is important to us – we provide targeted, individual support
  • **Campus experience:** Our research campus in the countryside creates ideal conditions for collegial exchange and sporting activities right on site. Our cafeteria offers a wide range of options—you can enjoy a relaxing lunch break with a lake view
  • **Successful start:** It is important to us that you quickly settle into the team and are given structured training for your tasks. We also support you from the very beginning and make your start easier with our [Welcome Days and Welcome Guide](https://go.fzj.de/welcome)
  • **Fair remuneration:** Depending on your existing qualifications and the tasks assigned to you, you will be classified in pay grade 13 of the TVöD-Bund (Collective Agreement for the Public Service). All information on the TVöD-Bund collective agreement can be found on the[BMI website](https://go.fzj.de/bmi.tvoed). The monthly salaries in euros can be found on page 74 of the PDF download
  • **Additional benefits:** Benefit from attractive additional services such as a company pension scheme with employer contribution. In addition to the basic salary, there is an additional year-end bonus under the collective pay agreement amounting to 75 % of a monthly salary, as well as capital-forming benefits
  • **Fixed-term:** The position is initally limited to 2 years

In addition to exciting tasks and a collegial working environment, we offer you much more: [https://go.fzj.de/benefits](https://go.fzj.de/benefits)

We welcome applications from people with diverse backgrounds, e.g. in terms of age, gender, disability, sexual orientation / identity, and social, ethnic and religious origin. A diverse and inclusive working environment with equal opportunities in which everyone can realize their potential is important to us.

The following links provide further information on diversity and equal opportunities: [https://go.fzj.de/equality](https://go.fzj.de/equality) and on specific support options for women: [https://go.fzj.de/womens-job-journey](https://go.fzj.de/womens-job-journey). International applicants can find more information here: [https://go.fzj.de/job-journey-internationals](https://go.fzj.de/job-journey-internationals)

**Place of Employment:**Jülich

**Start Date:** To the next possible date

**Working Hours:** 39 Hours / Week

**Salary:** Pay Group 13 of TVöD-Bund

**Application Deadline:** The position will be published until it is successfully filled

title: NPD Manager - Hardware (Program Manager)
description:
CWD designs, markets & sells the highest performing consumer electronics that are smart, simple, and stylish. From high fidelity turntables to wireless video connectivity systems, we create innovative products that empower people. Our success is measured in our customer satisfaction ratings and dedicated following. We have been in business since 1961 and our creations can be found in millions of homes. Together in teams, as a company, as a community, we are committed to Creating What’s Different!

CWD is looking for an NPD Manager - Hardware (Program Manager) to join our exceptionally talented and collaborative team! This posting reflects an existing vacancy within our Niagara Falls location. Reporting to the Research & Development Manager, the successful candidate will be responsible for leading the New Product Development (NPD) team, overseeing the product development process from ideation to launch, managing vendor relationships, and driving process improvements to support corporate and departmental goals. This role requires a strategic thinker with strong leadership, project management, and negotiation skills to ensure the successful development and launch of high-quality consumer electronics under our brands, including Fluance, Electrohome, Nyrius, and Magnasonic.

If you are someone that likes a challenge and are continuously striving for excellence, then this is the perfect opportunity for you!
This is a full-time permanent role working 40 hours a week on-site. Our hours of operation are 8:15am to 5:00pm Monday to Friday.
Key Responsibilities:
Leadership
  • Directly lead and manage the NPD team, including Product Managers and Assistant Product Managers, providing clear guidance, support, and performance accountability.
  • Hire, onboard, and train new team members, ensuring alignment with team structure, skill needs, and long-term departmental goals.
  • Set individual and team objectives, aligning departmental KPIs with broader business priorities to drive measurable results.
  • Provide day-to-day leadership through regular check-ins, mentoring, and coaching, fostering a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Delegate responsibilities clearly and ensure adherence to timelines, project standards, and organizational expectations.
  • Identify skill gaps and implement targeted development plans to elevate team capabilities and readiness for future projects.
  • Conduct one-on-one feedback sessions, formal performance reviews, and corrective action conversations when necessary.
  • Optimize team operations through process improvements, system enhancements, and automation to increase efficiency and reduce manual overhead.
  • Act as the key R&D stakeholder in the product launch process, collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure successful delivery.
Project Management for NPD Initiatives
  • Oversee the daily and weekly operational management of NPD projects, ensuring timelines, milestones, and deliverables are on track across multiple projects.
  • Monitor the progress of Product Managers and cross-functional teams, flagging delays, tracking action items, and escalating issues to maintain momentum.
  • Maintain and update project trackers, schedules, and dashboards to provide clear visibility into project status for stakeholders and leadership.
  • Review and consolidate project documentation to ensure accuracy, completeness, and timely submission at each stage of the product development process.
  • Track resource allocation, key dependencies, and critical deadlines to help identify risks early and support resolution planning.
  • Communicate with internal stakeholders on incoming requests and inquiries related to NPD projects; attend meetings with other stakeholders to communicate critical project updates
  • Promote consistent use of project management tools and processes across NPD teams to improve reporting, accountability, and efficiency.
  • Adapt to unexpected project challenges, ensuring quick decision-making to keep milestones on track.
Vendor Management
  • Identify, onboard, and manage external vendors including OEMs, ODMs, component suppliers, and engineering consultants to support project progress.
  • Foster strong, mutually beneficial relationships with key vendors.
  • Monitor vendor performance to ensure timely delivery, quality compliance, and alignment with project milestones.
Other
  • Attend international business trips to meet with overseas vendors and attend trade shows.
  • Support process improvements by enhancing project tracking, system automation, and dashboard updates.
  • Perform additional duties as required to support company goals.
Qualifications:
  • University degree in Business, Engineering, Project Management, or a related field.
  • Minimum 7-10 years in product development within consumer products (mandatory) and electronics (desired).
  • 5-7 years of experience managing teams, conducting performance reviews, and mentoring product development professionals.
  • 5-7 years managing multiple NPD projects with a structured project management process (Stage-Gate or equivalent).
  • Experience working with OEM/ODM manufacturers and factories is highly desirable.
  • Strong negotiation skills, hands-on leadership experience, and a process-oriented mindset.
  • Exceptional communication and critical thinking skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively as well as independently.
  • E-commerce experience is desired.
  • Willing to travel to business partners in United States, Canada, Hong Kong, Taiwan, Japan, Europe and other locations as required (2-4 times per year) as well as industry trades shows (2-4 times per year).
  • Experience with ERP systems.
  • Proficiency using Microsoft Office.
  • Proficiency using project management software (e.g. ClickUp).

What We Offer
Our expected compensation range for this role is $100,000.00 - $110,000.00 annually. The salary you may receive will be determined based on the skills, experience, and qualifications you bring to the position, as well as how they align with the responsibilities and scope of the NPD Manager role. CWD evaluates compensation using a consistent and equitable framework to ensure fair and transparent pay practices across the organization.

Other benefits include:
  • Full comprehensive benefits (dental, medical and eye) 80/20 split-family coverage
  • Annual performance-based bonus
  • Annual professional development fund
  • RRSP Match
  • Fitness incentives
  • Team events
  • 50% off on CWD brands
  • Relocation expense
How We Hire
CWD is an equal opportunity employer and is dedicated to creating a diverse and inclusive work environment. We are committed to providing accommodations for people with disabilities throughout the recruitment process, and upon request, will work with qualified job applicants to provide suitable accommodation in a manner that takes into account the applicant’s accessibility needs due to disability. Applicants must make their accommodation needs known upon requests for interviews.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support certain parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, evaluating responses, or assisting with interview scheduling. These tools are designed to help our recruitment team and do not replace human judgment. All hiring decisions are ultimately made by our team. If you would like more information about how your personal data is processed during this process, please contact us.

CWD only extends employment offers after candidates have had the opportunity to speak directly with both the hiring manager and a member of our HR team. These discussions may take place in person or via video conference. CWD does not issue offers or request personal information through text or other informal channels. If you receive such a request, please disregard it. This policy is in place to ensure a secure and professional hiring process for all candidates.
