title: Materials Engineer, Metals (Starship)
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

MATERIALS ENGINEER, METALS (STARSHIP)

Our Starship Materials Engineering team is serving as experts in various material disciplines to the broader company and working on making the best rockets and spacecraft in the world. As a member of this team you will constantly improve the materials and processes used to make these structures and components. This role will primarily be supporting component level hardware including, but not limited to control devices and mechanisms that drive critical capabilities on Starship/Super Heavy - from regulators and butterfly valves to flap/fin actuators. We design, manufacture, and test valves, regulators, and actuators for maximum reliability in extreme environments, compatibility with various fluids, temperatures ranging from 80 to 800K, and pressures beyond 800 bar.

Special processing of metals including, but not limited to, plate/bar/sheet processing, casting, forging, coatings, and heat treating and expected to make an impact on the design, analysis, and manufacturing of components and mechanisms that spans across all our Starship vehicles. If your goal is to make an impact on the cutting edge of propulsion control devices, materials, and manufacturing technologies, this is the role for you.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Design, develop, and deploy materials and process direction for propulsion, mechanism, and valve system designs and manufacturing
  • Increase reliability of internal design’s manufacturing processes through material and process selection, analysis, development, and test
  • Develop physical, mechanical, and thermal properties for materials
  • Improve our special processes and materials through characterization and development
  • Work directly with component design build and test engineering, design reliability, and production teams on a daily basis
  • Perform root cause investigations using fractography, metallography, and testing
  • Provide technical reviews and advising for design efforts specifically related to drawings, specifications, and material requirements
  • Collaborate with other engineers, subject matter experts, and technicians to solve complex material and processing challenges on our current and next generation vehicles

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree in materials engineering or other engineering discipline with emphasis on materials
  • 2+ years of professional work experience in a materials engineering related role

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Master's degree or PhD in materials engineering or related field
  • Experience and expertise with multiple of the following manufacturing methods: tribological coatings (conversion, inorganic, dry-film lubricants), sheet/plate metal processing, casting, forging, brazing, welding, and heat treating
  • Tribological processes including, but not limited to evaluating and implementing protective coatings (polyurethane, urethane, conversion coating, inorganic coatings, dry-film lubricants, etc.) for internal and external environmental conditions including thermal, wear, atmospheric, and space environments
  • Understanding of mechanical testing methods for metals including wear, tensile, fracture and fatigue and
  • Familiarity with development of design allowables
  • Experience with failure analysis and fractography including characterization techniques such as Fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy (FTIR), Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM), and metallographic analysis
  • Knowledge of aerospace metals including nickel-based alloys, stainless steels, aluminum alloys, and titanium alloys
  • Knowledge of fluid and gas compatibility for various launch vehicle and spacecraft propulsion and fluid systems
  • Hands-on experience in a manufacturing environment
  • Understanding of non-destructive test methods for fracture and fatigue control
  • Maintain working knowledge of regulatory requirements, perform associated required tasks, and complete required documentation per SpaceX specifications and other external specification such as NASA, OSHA, ASTM, NACE, ASME, AWS, ASM, etc.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Extended hours and weekend work may be required to support critical project and mission milestones
  • Up to 10% domestic travel is expected

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range:
Level 1: $100,000.00 - $130,000.00
Level 2: $115,000.00 - $160,000.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees accrue paid sick leave pursuant to Company policy which satisfies or exceeds the accrual, carryover, and use requirements of the law.

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

  • To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to EEOCompliance@spacex.com.

title: Regional Delivery CritSit Leader
description:
The Regional Leader, Critical Situations owns how Sapiens resolves high-severity customer escalations across their region, and works to stop them recurring by spotting risk trends early. You lead a team of CritSit Managers, represent the function with customer C-level executives and the Sapiens senior leadership team, and bring Delivery, Customer Success, Sales, Engineering and Product together when customer trust is most exposed.

The role carries commercial as well as operational accountability: you quantify the financial impact of critical situations and programme delays, and agree the commercial actions that follow. You work to the global CritSit framework and adapt it to your region's needs and regulatory context.

This is a Senior Manager or Director level role in Delivery Program Management, reporting to the Senior Vice President (SVP). Based at a regional hub, hybrid, with regular customer travel.

Responsibilities

  • Set the regional vision, priorities and roadmap for CritSit management, aligned with the global strategy.
  • Build, coach and develop a team of CritSit Managers, and apply the global severity definitions and escalation paths.
  • Act as executive point of accountability for the region's most critical, highest-revenue or reputationally sensitive escalations, engaging customer C-level executives directly.
  • Brief the SVP and senior leadership promptly and candidly, and escalate early when a case needs global attention.
  • Own project and risk management across the regional portfolio, with every critical situation under a named owner and a recovery plan.
  • Spot trends in monthly business and account reviews and act on them before customers do.
  • Quantify the financial impact of CritSits and programme delays, and work with Sales to move projects from time and expenses to fixed pricing where it protects the customer and Sapiens.
  • Work with Engineering, CloudOps and DevOps, Product, InfoSec, Sales, Customer Success, Legal and Communications to prioritise fixes, remove blockers and handle regulatory or public implications.
  • Hold teams to account for corrective and preventive actions with clear owners and deadlines.
  • Run the regional root-cause and post-incident review programme, and report regional KPIs: time to engage, mitigate and resolve, repeat incidents, SLA adherence, CritSit ageing and revenue protected.
  • Contribute to the global CritSit playbook and tooling, and run readiness programmes for regional teams.

Requirements

  • 12+ years in enterprise software delivery or customer success, including 5+ years leading teams through critical situations or programme recovery.
  • Project and risk management experience across a regional portfolio, including reading monthly business reviews and account reviews for trends that precede an escalation.
  • Commercial responsibility and sound judgement: moving projects from time and expenses to fixed pricing, and quantifying the financial impact of a CritSit or programme delay.
  • Proven people leadership, including leading and developing managers across a multi-team or multi-country organisation.
  • Executive presence with customer C-level executives and senior leadership.
  • Insurance industry and core-systems knowledge across the region's lines of business.
  • Technical fluency across cloud infrastructure, APIs and integrations, and working knowledge of incident management tools such as Jira, ServiceNow and Salesforce.
  • Fluent English, availability for regular customer travel, and a bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
An advantage: experience of insurance or financial SaaS platforms, P&L responsibility, a further regional language, and ITIL or PMP certification.

title: AI Architect  Agentic & Generative AI
description:

AI Architect Agentic & Generative AI
Work Type: Full-Time, Onsite
Location: Dallas, Texas
Interview Mode: In-Person
Work Auth : Must be authorized to work in the U.S.
Domain: Enterprise AI / Agentic AI / AWS Bedrock
Compensation: Competitive, commensurate with experience

As AI Architect – Agentic & Generative AI, you will be responsible for defining, building, and scaling enterprise-grade agentic AI architecture on AWS. This role focuses on establishing frameworks, patterns, and guardrails that enable safe, reliable, and cost-efficient AI solutions, leveraging Amazon Bedrock (Agents, Knowledge Bases, Guardrails, Flows) and Claude models.
You will collaborate with cross-functional teams in product, engineering, data, and security to deliver next-generation AI capabilities — including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), multi-agent orchestration, and governed AI operations — driving measurable business impact through intelligent automation and decision-making systems.

Responsibilities
  • Define and evolve the enterprise agentic AI architecture, establishing reusable frameworks and standards for RAG, tool/function calling, and multi-agent orchestration.
  • Design and implement AI solutions using Amazon Bedrock and integrate with core AWS services (Lambda, Step Functions, EventBridge, ECS/EKS, S3, Aurora, OpenSearch, DynamoDB).
  • Drive adoption of agentic AI patterns — planning, memory, and human-in-the-loop — ensuring alignment with enterprise security and compliance frameworks.
  • Guide model selection and optimization (Claude family and Bedrock models), including prompt schema design, adapters, and fine-tuning strategies.
  • Implement advanced RAG pipelines with optimized chunking, reranking, grounding, and hybrid/vector retrieval using OpenSearch and pgvector.
  • Apply Guardrails and data-governance controls (IAM/ABAC, KMS, private networking) to ensure privacy, PII protection, and compliant operations.
  • Establish observability and reliability frameworks — including evaluation pipelines, tracing, cost metrics, fallbacks, and A/B testing.
  • Collaborate with platform and DevOps teams to enable governed AWS landing zones, CI/CD automation, and environment management for AI workloads.
  • Publish architecture blueprints, starter kits, and best-practice guides for AI engineers and developers.
  • Mentor engineering teams and contribute to hiring, training, and AI community enablement initiatives.
  • Research and assess emerging AWS and open-source agentic tools, proposing pragmatic adoption strategies.
Required Skills & Experience
  • 8+ years designing and implementing large-scale distributed or cloud systems (including 4+ years on AWS).
  • 2+ years building AI/ML or generative AI solutions in production environments.
  • Hands-on experience with Amazon Bedrock (Agents, Knowledge Bases, Guardrails) and Claude models.
  • Deep understanding of RAG design, hybrid/vector search (OpenSearch, pgvector), grounding, and citation techniques.
  • Proficiency in Python (preferred) or similar modern programming languages.
  • Solid grasp of AWS orchestration services (Lambda, Step Functions, EventBridge) and CI/CD practices.
  • Applied knowledge of AI governance, security, and observability (IAM, KMS, Guardrails, evaluation, tracing).
  • Excellent communication and architectural documentation skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Expertise in Agentic AI systems, including multi-agent workflows, tool/function calling, and memory architectures.
  • Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, or similar orchestration frameworks.
  • Advanced prompt design, RAG optimization, and model customization experience.
  • AWS Certifications – Solutions Architect (Professional) or Machine Learning Specialty.

An established and growing wealth management organization is seeking an experienced Senior Financial Planner to lead complex financial planning engagements, develop sophisticated planning strategies, and serve as a trusted technical resource to its advisory and planning teams.
This is an excellent opportunity for a seasoned planning professional who enjoys the technical side of wealth management, thrives on solving complex financial challenges, and wants to make a meaningful impact without the pressure of sales production or building a personal book of business.
The ideal candidate brings advanced planning expertise, independent judgment, and a passion for mentoring and developing other planning professionals.

  • Independently manage complex financial planning cases for high-net-worth and affluent clients.
  • Develop comprehensive financial plans and actionable recommendations aligned with clients' long-term goals.
  • Analyze income tax strategies, retirement income planning, estate planning, and investment strategies.
  • Partner closely with financial advisors to evaluate client situations and develop customized planning solutions.
  • Translate complex financial concepts into clear, practical recommendations.
  • Review financial plans, analyses, and recommendations prepared by junior planners and paraplanners.
  • Mentor, coach, and support the professional development of junior planning team members.
  • Help improve planning processes, workflows, and technical standards across the organization.

What You Will Bring
  • CFP® certification required.
  • 5–10 years of comprehensive financial planning experience, preferably working with high-net-worth clients.
  • Strong technical knowledge of income tax planning, retirement income planning, estate planning, and investment planning.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage complex planning cases and develop recommendations.
  • Experience working directly with financial advisors to support client planning strategies.
  • Strong critical-thinking, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience reviewing the work of and mentoring junior planners or paraplanners.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience with eMoney or other financial planning software preferred.
What Will Set You Apart
  • Additional credentials such as AEP®, TPCP, RICP®, CRPC®, or other recognized estate, tax, or retirement planning designations.
  • Extensive experience supporting high-net-worth and complex financial planning relationships.
  • Ability to integrate tax, estate, retirement, and investment strategies into comprehensive recommendations.
  • A track record of serving as a trusted technical resource to financial advisors.
  • A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset and commitment to continuous learning.
  • A genuine interest in mentoring others and helping build a high-performing planning team.
Benefits & Professional Growth
  • Competitive Compensation: Salary commensurate with experience, credentials, and qualifications.
  • Health Insurance: Employer contribution toward medical insurance.

  • Long-Term Incentives: Potential firm-wide profit-sharing opportunities, subject to the firm's plan and eligibility requirements.
  • Recognition & Experiences: Potential advisor incentive trips and other firm-sponsored opportunities, where applicable.
  • Career Growth: Opportunity to expand responsibilities and contribute to the development of comprehensive planning and tax services.
Why Consider This Opportunity?
This is an opportunity to step into a senior-level position where your technical expertise, planning judgment, and leadership can make a lasting impact.
You will have the ability to focus on sophisticated financial planning, collaborate with experienced advisors, mentor developing professionals, and help shape the future of a growing wealth management organization.

About Tamara Group (The Attention, Media, And Relevance Agency): Born from editorial, influencer, and experiential roots, Tamara Group is built to drive growth and disruption through the power of attention and cultural relevance.

Culture is our key and Empathy is how we build it. VaynerMedia APAC is strong with a world-class combination of diverse backgrounds collaborating to put forward innovative, creative and strategic solutions to the one advantage that stands the test of time --- PEOPLE.

ROLE SUMMARY

The Associate Director, CAIT (Creators, Affiliates, Influencers, and Talent) plays a critical mid-level management role within VaynerMedia SEA, responsible for executing and managing our capabilities across Creators, Affiliates, Influencers, and Talent.

This is a strategic and highly operational role for someone who understands how people, platforms, and culture increasingly intersect across the diverse Southeast Asian markets. You will architect breakthrough programs for major global brands and act as the ultimate connector between top-tier talent and creative execution.

You’ll partner closely with Client Partnerships, Strategy, Creative, Media, and Production to ensure CAIT is integrated into the broader agency offering from the outset. From identifying the right creator or talent for a campaign, to negotiating a major partnership, building an always-on influencer program, or developing an affiliate strategy, you’ll connect culture, creativity, and influence to deliver meaningful business outcomes for our clients.

You’ll also champion and elevate the output of junior talent across the team, providing active mentorship, coaching, and a positive team atmosphere built on empathy while establishing best-in-class execution processes.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  1. Campaign Strategy & Execution

    • Architect end-to-end influencer strategies: Turn client business briefs into culturally relevant, high-impact social campaigns across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube and emerging platforms, ensuring the right approach is selected based on the client objective.

    • Cross-functional collaboration: Collaborate seamlessly with cross-functional leads in Creative, Strategy, Production, and Media to establish integrated campaign frameworks and virtual labs for product presentations.

    • Campaign lifecycle management: Own influencer campaign management from initial briefing through to implementation, tracking, and final reporting.

  2. Talent Discovery & Management

    • Command the talent discovery lifecycle: Use an out-of-the-box perspective to spot, vet, and secure high-impact UGC creators, influencers, and tier-one celebrities specific to SEA markets (e.g., Indonesia, Thailand, Philippines, Singapore, Malaysia, Vietnam).

    • Relationship management: Build strong, long-term relationships with creators, talent, managers, agents, affiliate partners, and relevant industry stakeholders across the SEA region.

  3. Commercial Negotiation & Contracting

    • Drive commercial negotiations: Lead and negotiate high-value commercial terms, complex rights usage agreements, and master service contracts while protecting agency health.

    • Brand safety and compliance: Oversee appropriate vetting, disclosure, usage, and contractual processes to protect both clients and the agency, adhering to local regulations across SEA.

  4. Content Execution & Quality Control

    • Build and scale content principles: Develop platform-specific shooting guides and content principles that ensure creator assets remain fiercely authentic while building massive brand equity.

    • Creative integration: Translate broader campaign platforms into creator- and talent-led ideas that feel native to social and give external partners genuine space to bring their own voice to the work.

    • Virtual and remote direction: Establish best practices for guiding creators through self-shot and remotely produced content, improving quality before content reaches client review.

  5. Affiliate & Performance Execution

    • Execute affiliate strategy: Manage scalable affiliate programs that identify, recruit, and nurture creators capable of driving both cultural relevance and measurable commercial outcomes.

    • Performance optimization: Work with Media, Strategy, and Analytics teams to track performance and continuously optimize creator mix, content, and offers.

  6. Client Management & Team Mentorship

    • Client communication: Act as the primary strategic voice and escalation point for active campaigns, presenting polished, high-standard recommendations that inspire absolute confidence.

    • Mentorship: Champion and elevate the output of junior talent across the team, providing active mentorship, coaching, and a positive team atmosphere built on empathy.

THE IDEAL CANDIDATE

    • 7+ years of dedicated experience managing influencer marketing, creator relations, or social strategy, specifically anchored within an agency or fast-paced digital environment.
    • Market Mastery: Deep, insider familiarity with the SEA UGC creator, influencer, and talent landscape across all tiers from micro-creators to top-tier entertainment celebrities.
    • Core Competencies: Advanced talent negotiation, commercial scoping, and contract management. Mastery of digital architecture, social media platform mechanics, and content briefing workflows.
    • Demonstrated experience in full-cycle influencer campaign management from briefing through to implementation, tracking, and reporting.
    • Leadership Track Record: Proven experience managing, mentoring, and developing junior team members in complex, cross-functional environments.
    • Communication Skills: Exceptional presentation, written, and verbal communication skills with a natural ability to command stakeholder rooms.
    • Strong social and creative instincts, with the ability to assess whether an idea or piece of content will work in-feed in specific local markets.
    • Able to move comfortably between execution and management — from troubleshooting a creator negotiation or reviewing content to presenting a campaign strategy.
    • Bonus Points: You are a creator or KOL yourself with hands-on production or community management experience.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

You will execute CAIT programs where creators, influencers, affiliates, and talent are selected with purpose, integrated into the creative process, and managed with a high standard of craft and operational rigor across diverse SEA markets.

You’ll act as the engine that turns strategic vision into tangible, high-performing influencer campaigns, ensuring seamless collaboration between internal teams and external talent.
You’ll build and mentor a mid-level and junior team capable of delivering that work at scale across Southeast Asia, while maintaining strong, authentic relationships with the creators who make it possible.

What you should know about VaynerMedia

Think “lab” and not “agency”. We get excited about solving business problems, not creating advertising for the sake of making advertising. Our entrepreneurship DNA runs deep. We’re willing to break rules, try new things, and test hypotheses if it means better understanding our craft. It’s fun!

Our environment (and pace) feels much more like a start-up than most agencies you might be used to. Hopefully that, and the opportunity to collaborate with the talented and enthusiastic crew, work with big brands excites you, as it does us. We can’t wait to meet you.

Not seeing a role you're looking for? Check out roles with other VaynerX companies.

    • ChukMedia
    • VaynerMedia
    • Gallery Media Group
    • VX Services

title: Slaapdienst GGZ - Gerrie Knetemannlaan- Amsterdam West
description:
Wil jij ’s nachts van betekenis zijn voor mensen met een psychische kwetsbaarheid, terwijl je grotendeels kunt slapen tijdens je dienst? Op onze GGZ-woonlocatie aan de Gerrie Knetemannlaan in Amsterdam-West zorg jij voor rust, veiligheid en nabijheid in de nacht. Jij bent de stabiele factor wanneer een cliënt je nodig heeft.

Wat krijg je van Cordaan?

Onze arbeidsvoorwaarden zijn voor de functie van begeleider conform cao GGZ (FWG 35)

  • Contract: Een jaarcontract van 4 tot 12 uur per week met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband

  • Salaris: Een salaris van minimaal €2.735,00 en maximaal €3.560,00 bruto per maand (FWG 35) op basis van een fulltime dienstverband (36 uur per week)

  • Extra’s: Eindejaarsuitkering van 8,33% van het bruto jaarinkomen en vakantietoeslag van 8% per jaar

  • Overig: Pensioenopbouw via Pensioenfonds Zorg & Welzijn en collectiviteitskorting op je zorgverzekering

  • Ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden: Volop mogelijkheden om je persoonlijk en professioneel te ontwikkelen

  • Collega aandragen? Ontvang in totaal een aanbrengbonus van € 500,- netto

Waar ga je werken?
Op deze woonlocatie in Bos en Lommer wonen 24 volwassenen (30–70 jaar) met een psychische kwetsbaarheid. De cliënten wonen deels zelfstandig in studio’s op de locatie en deels in de wijk. Een goede nachtrust is essentieel voor hun herstel.

In het pand werk je niet alleen. Er zijn meerdere zorgafdelingen aanwezig: een afdeling Verpleging & Verzorging met een wakkere nachtdienst en een VGZ-afdeling met een slaapdienst. Bij calamiteiten, BHV-situaties of onrust trek je samen op.
Je werkt zelfstandig in de nacht, maar maakt onderdeel uit van het vaste team van de locatie. Daarnaast kun je terugvallen op collega’s in het pand en het crisisteam wanneer dat nodig is.

Wat ga je doen?
Je dienst start om 22.00 uur. Je maakt een ronde over de afdeling, begeleidt cliënten waar nodig bij het afsluiten van de dag en zorgt voor een rustige overgang naar de nacht. Daarna ga je slapen op de locatie.

Word je wakker gebeld? Dan kijk je wat de cliënt nodig heeft: een gesprek, geruststelling of praktische ondersteuning. Je bewaart de rust en handelt zelfstandig wanneer dat nodig is. Jouw dienst loopt van 22:00 tot 08:00 uur.
Tijdens slaapperiodes krijg je een vergoeding die is gebaseerd op het minimumloon. Deze uren worden niet meegerekend als contracturen. Voor de uren waarin je daadwerkelijk werkt (actieve uren) ontvang je salaris volgens de cao-schaal, en deze uren tellen wél mee als contracturen.

Wie ben jij?

  • Een mbo-3 diploma in een zorgrichting, of je bent halverwege een opleiding Verpleegkunde of Social Work

  • Je hebt ervaring in de GGZ

  • Je bent bereid om BHV, medicatieveiligheid en veiligheidstrainingen te volgen om zelfstandig in de nacht te kunnen werken

  • Je bent stressbestendig, zelfstandig en kunt goed inschatten wat een cliënt nodig heeft

  • Je straalt rust uit en beschikt over goede communicatieve vaardigheden

Enthousiast?
Ben jij de begeleider die ’s nachts het verschil maakt voor onze cliënten? Solliciteer direct online. Zodra we een geschikte kandidaat hebben gevonden, sluiten we de vacature.
Heb je nog vragen over de vacature? App of bel dan met de manager Hanneke Aldenhuijsen via 06 46185374 of mail haldenhuijsen@cordaan.nl.
We kijken uit naar jouw reactie! Kandidaten met een interessant profiel worden direct uitgenodigd voor een gesprek.

Kleurrijk en betekenisvol met elkaar
Cordaan vindt een inclusief werving- en selectiebeleid belangrijk. We omarmen de eigenheid van collega’s en stimuleren ontwikkeling van talenten. We willen dat cliënten en collega’s zichzelf herkennen in onze organisatie. Dit vraagt om een goede representatie van medewerkers en leidinggevenden met verschillende achtergronden. Cordaan streeft ernaar om meer mensen uit groepen die nog ondervertegenwoordigd zijn, aan te nemen en te behouden.

Deze vacature is gelijktijdig intern en extern uitgezet. Bij gelijke geschiktheid gaat de voorkeur uit naar een interne kandidaat

title: Creative Designer / Motion & Content Creator
description:
🚀 Dołącz do COPUZ jako Creative Designer / Motion & Content Creator!

Do zespołu Creative COPUZ szukamy osoby, która łączy bardzo dobry warsztat graficzny i motion design z praktycznym wykorzystaniem AI i nowych technologii w codziennej pracy kreatywnej.

Szukamy kogoś, kto potrafi sprawnie przejść od pomysłu i referencji do gotowego materiału - statycznego, animowanego lub video. Osoby, która świadomie korzysta z nowych narzędzi, potrafi łączyć różne technologie w jeden proces produkcyjny i wie, jak wykorzystać AI, żeby osiągnąć lepszy efekt i skrócić czas realizacji.

Pracujemy dla marek z różnych branż, tworząc kampanie digitalowe, content do social mediów, materiały reklamowe, identyfikacje i systemy wizualne. Szukamy osoby, która wniesie do zespołu nie tylko sprawny warsztat, ale też ciekawość, dobry visual judgment i chęć rozwijania nowych sposobów tworzenia.

Twoje zadania

  • współtworzenie koncepcji wizualnych, styleframe’ów, layoutów, systemów wizualnych i animacji dla marek oraz produktów cyfrowych – od pomysłu po finalny projekt i render,

  • projektowanie nowoczesnych materiałów graficznych, animacji i video do kampanii digitalowych, social mediów i innych kanałów komunikacji,

  • tworzenie materiałów z wykorzystaniem AI – od koncepcji, promptowania i generowania obrazów lub video, przez selekcję i dopracowanie, po animację, montaż i finalny materiał,

  • łączenie materiałów generowanych przez AI z klasycznym projektowaniem graficznym, motion designem, compositingiem i postprodukcją,

  • projektowanie spójnych sekwencji animacji: świadoma praca z kompozycją, rytmem, typografią, przejściami i uwagą odbiorcy,

  • adaptowanie koncepcji kreatywnych do różnych formatów i kanałów digitalowych,

  • partnerska współpraca z zespołem przy definiowaniu kierunków artystycznych i dbaniu o spójność wizualną realizacji,

  • codzienna współpraca z zespołem projektowym: wspólne rozwijanie pomysłów, konstruktywny feedback oraz wymiana wiedzy i doświadczeń,

  • wspólne rozwijanie workflow zespołu oraz dbanie o czytelną organizację plików i sprawne przekazywanie projektów,

  • testowanie nowych narzędzi i technik, w tym AI, 3D i rozwiązań proceduralnych, oraz wdrażanie ich tam, gdzie pomagają szybciej sprawdzać pomysły, usprawniają powtarzalne zadania lub podnoszą jakość.

Nasze wymagania

  • portfolio pokazujące mocny warsztat w projektowaniu graficznym, motion i/lub video – interesują nas kompozycja, typografia, wyczucie czasu, estetyka i dopracowany detal,

  • praktyczne wykorzystywanie AI i nowoczesnych narzędzi w procesie projektowym – nie tylko do generowania pojedynczych obrazów, ale również jako element szerszego procesu kreatywnego i produkcyjnego,

  • doświadczenie w pracy z narzędziami generatywnymi do obrazu i/lub video, np. Midjourney, Runway, Kling, Adobe Firefly, Google Veo, Higgsfield, Krea lub innymi rozwiązaniami o podobnych możliwościach,

  • umiejętność pracy z promptami, referencjami i iteracjami oraz świadomego kontrolowania stylu i jakości generowanych materiałów,

  • bardzo dobra znajomość After Effects, w tym swobodna praca z Graph Editorem i świadome budowanie tempa, dynamiki oraz płynności ruchu,

  • solidne podstawy projektowania 2D: umiejętność pracy z layoutem, gridem, proporcjami, kolorem i kontrastem oraz budowania kompozycji, które sprawdzają się zarówno w statyce, jak i w ruchu,

  • swobodna praca w Figmie i pakiecie Adobe,

  • umiejętność projektowania spójnych sekwencji – rozumienie roli przejść, cięć i pauz w prowadzeniu uwagi odbiorcy,

  • umiejętność łączenia kilku narzędzi w jeden sprawny workflow i samodzielnego doprowadzania projektu do finalnego materiału,

  • rozumienie specyfiki materiałów tworzonych do social mediów i kampanii digitalowych,

  • umiejętność dzielenia się warsztatem, wyjaśniania decyzji projektowych oraz udzielania i przyjmowania konstruktywnego feedbacku,

  • tworzenie czystych, logicznie zbudowanych plików i projektów, w których inne osoby z zespołu mogą się łatwo odnaleźć,

  • samodzielność, sprawność działania, dbałość o jakość i otwartość na współpracę.

Mile widziane

  • doświadczenie w tworzeniu kampanii reklamowych i contentu dla marek,

  • doświadczenie z narzędziami 3D i systemami proceduralnymi,

  • znajomość Blendera lub Cinema 4D,

  • doświadczenie w compositingu i postprodukcji video,

  • doświadczenie we współtworzeniu identyfikacji wizualnych i systemów motion dla marek,

  • doświadczenie w wykorzystaniu AI przy tworzeniu storyboardów, animatików, scen produktowych i materiałów reklamowych,

  • zainteresowanie automatyzacją produkcji kreatywnej i budowaniem powtarzalnych workflow.

Co oferujemy?

❤️ Zgrany i pomocny zespół

Stawiamy na partnerską wymianę pomysłów, otwarty feedback i dzielenie się warsztatem. Twoje doświadczenie i perspektywa będą ważnym wkładem we wspólne realizacje.

🫶 Realny wpływ na kierunek wizualny marek

Twoje pomysły, rekomendacje i kreatywność będą miały znaczenie. Otrzymasz przestrzeń do proponowania kierunków wizualnych, narzędzi i nowych sposobów tworzenia contentu oraz realny wpływ na finalny kształt naszych realizacji i rozwój workflow zespołu.

🎯 Czas i przestrzeń na pracę w skupieniu

Szanujemy czas potrzebny na projektowanie. Ograniczamy spotkania i usprawniamy procesy, żeby zostawić więcej miejsca na pracę koncepcyjną, animację i dopracowanie detali.

🤖 AI i nowe technologie jako część codziennej pracy

AI traktujemy jako realne narzędzie pracy kreatywnej, a nie tylko przestrzeń do eksperymentów. Wykorzystujemy i testujemy nowe rozwiązania w projektowaniu, animacji, video i produkcji contentu, a jednocześnie szukamy coraz lepszych sposobów łączenia ich z profesjonalnym warsztatem designera.

Zapewniamy również przestrzeń na R&D, testowanie nowych narzędzi i rozwijanie własnych workflow. Podczas Rozwojowych Spotkań Czwartkowych dzielimy się wiedzą i sprawdzamy nowe rozwiązania – najczęściej przy pizzy.

🧑‍💻 Nowoczesne narzędzia i sprzęt

Zapewniamy nowoczesny sprzęt, oprogramowanie oraz dostęp do płatnych narzędzi, modeli, subskrypcji i tokenów potrzebnych do pracy z AI i realizacji projektów.

Jeśli widzisz rozwiązanie, które usprawni produkcję lub pozwoli osiągnąć ciekawszy efekt wizualny, masz przestrzeń, żeby je zaproponować, przetestować i – jeśli się sprawdzi – wdrożyć do pracy zespołu.

🏆 Czytelną perspektywę rozwoju

Doceniamy zaangażowanie i sukcesy. Oferujemy spotkania rozwojowe, udział w szkoleniach, warsztatach i konferencjach branżowych.

W COPUZ możesz rozwijać się pionowo lub poziomo – w kierunku zgodnym z Twoimi mocnymi stronami, np. motion designu, AI creative, video, 3D czy art direction.

😎 Benefity

Oferujemy dofinansowanie aktywności sportowej i prywatnej opieki medycznej, stały dostęp do świeżych owoców, spotkania i wyjazdy integracyjne oraz inne inicjatywy zespołowe.

Jak wygląda rekrutacja?

  1. Wyślij CV oraz portfolio lub przykłady swoich realizacji. Mile widziane będą również projekty, w których wykorzystywałeś/-aś AI, motion lub generatywne video.

  2. Przeanalizujemy Twoją kandydaturę i dopasowanie doświadczenia do roli w zespole Creative COPUZ.

  3. Zaprosimy Cię na rozmowę online – I etap rekrutacji. Porozmawiamy o Twoim doświadczeniu, warsztacie, motywacji, sposobie pracy oraz o tym, jak wykorzystujesz AI i nowe technologie w procesie kreatywnym.

  4. Wybrane osoby zaprosimy na spotkanie stacjonarne – II etap rekrutacji. Na tym etapie możemy poprosić o krótkie zadanie praktyczne i jego prezentację w biurze.

  5. Możliwie jak najszybciej wrócimy z informacją zwrotną.

  6. Jeśli zdecydujemy się na współpracę – witamy w COPUZ! 😊

title: Network Engineer I
description:
About the Opportunity

The Network Engineer I will serve as a key technical resource for the Customer’s enterprise network, configuring, maintaining, and supporting the infrastructure that keeps network operations secure, reliable, and efficient in an on-site work environment. The role covers LAN infrastructure, switching, firewall administration, DNS services, authentication, subnetting, remote connectivity, and network management across Cisco, Fortinet FortiGate, Infoblox, RADIUS, N-Wave, Juniper, and Aruba technologies. The Network Engineer I will work closely with the on-site IT team and coordinate directly with the Customer’s Network Engineer on daily operations, infrastructure changes, maintenance activities, and critical network requirements.

Success in this role looks like a stable, well-documented, and secure network environment where issues are resolved quickly and changes are coordinated smoothly across technical teams.

What You Will Do in This Role

The Network Engineer I configures, administers, and troubleshoots the Customer’s network infrastructure and provides remote technical support to keep the network available and secure.

Responsibilities include:

  • Configure, administer, maintain, and troubleshoot enterprise network infrastructure, including LAN connectivity, switching, routing, and network services.
  • Configure and maintain Cisco switches, including VLAN administration, switch port assignments, and performance tuning.
  • Support Juniper switches in the data center environment and provide Aruba switching support as infrastructure requirements change.
  • Administer Fortinet FortiGate firewalls, including firewall policies, access controls, configuration management, and connectivity troubleshooting.
  • Manage Infoblox DNS and DDI services, including DNS, DHCP, and IP address management.
  • Support RADIUS authentication and assist with LDAP, Active Directory, and other access control services.
  • Support N-Wave connectivity, including subnetting, IP addressing, network segmentation, and troubleshooting between network environments.
  • Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot VPN services for secure remote access.
  • Manage network access, permissions, device connectivity, and infrastructure configurations.
  • Monitor network availability, performance, and system health using enterprise monitoring and management tools.
  • Support the installation, testing, labeling, and documentation of network cabling, and deploy switches in telecommunications and phone closets.
  • Maintain accurate network diagrams, IP address assignments, switch and firewall configurations, cabling records, and infrastructure inventories.
  • Troubleshoot network outages, connectivity issues, authentication failures, DNS issues, and other infrastructure incidents.
  • Coordinate maintenance, configuration changes, and infrastructure upgrades with the onsite IT team and the Customer’s Network Engineer.
  • Provide remote technical support during critical network activities and when onsite coordination is needed.
  • Communicate incidents, troubleshooting results, operational status, and recommended resolutions to technical staff and stakeholders.
  • Respond to network issues and emergencies, including scheduled maintenance windows and after-hours support.
  • Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

What You Will Bring

Required qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Network Engineering, or a related technical field; equivalent education and relevant professional experience may be considered.
  • Demonstrated experience in network engineering, network administration, and enterprise infrastructure support.
  • Experience configuring, administering, and troubleshooting Cisco switches and enterprise LAN infrastructure.
  • Working knowledge of Fortinet FortiGate firewall administration and network security.
  • Experience supporting Infoblox DNS services and DDI environments.
  • Knowledge of RADIUS, LDAP, Active Directory, VPN technologies, and network authentication services.
  • Understanding of N-Wave connectivity, IP addressing, subnetting, VLANs, routing, and switching.
  • Knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, and other network protocols.
  • Experience with network monitoring, management, reporting, and documentation tools.
  • Understanding of copper and fiber-optic cabling standards, telecommunications closets, and physical network infrastructure.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and organizational skills.
  • Ability to work independently, support remote operations, and work effectively with onsite IT staff and customer technical staff.

Preferred qualifications

  • Familiarity with Juniper and Aruba switching technologies.
  • Relevant industry certifications, such as Cisco CCNA, CompTIA Network+, Fortinet, Juniper, or Aruba.

Work authorization/security clearance requirements

  • Ability to obtain a security clearance.

Work Environment

  • This work is normally completed in an on-site environment.

Physical Demands

  • Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
  • Must be able to access and navigate each department at the organization's and client facilities.

Travel Required

  • No

Proficiency Requirement

  • The employee is expected to demonstrate proficiency in all essential job functions, tools, and processes related to this position within the first 90 days of employment. This includes acquiring a thorough understanding of job-specific responsibilities, systems, and workflows as outlined during onboarding and training. Failure to meet this requirement may result in additional training, reassessment, or other actions as deemed necessary by management.

title: Senior Software Engineer, OS Integration
description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About the OS Integration team:

The OS Integration team ensures Firefox works well with the host operating system and environment. We’re a distributed team with expertise in Windows, macOS, and Linux-based operating systems. Our responsibilities include developing fixes and improvements for Firefox related to Windows, macOS, and Linux environments. This might include integration with a new OS feature or fixing an OS-specific user interface bug. Other responsibilities include native crash reporting, OS abstraction layers, sandboxing, hardening, updater, and enterprise DLP support.

About the role:

As a member of the OS Integration team, you’ll develop fixes, improvements, and new features for Firefox. In many cases work may be cross-platform or have a cross-platform component. This role will include maintenance and development of the installer and updater of Firefox. You’ll contribute to the team through code review and discussion.

What you’ll do:

  • Improve the quality of Firefox and other Mozilla products by debugging and fixing software defects, improving the browsing experience for hundreds of millions of users.
  • Contribute to new features and improvements.
  • Break down tasks and work with others to deliver solutions.
  • Collaborate with experienced software engineers.
  • Perform code reviews and provide technical direction.
  • Work with a geographically-distributed development team.
  • Interact with teams throughout the organization.

What you’ll bring:

  • 5+ years of overall software engineering experience
  • Strong knowledge of C and C++
  • Experience with desktop application development on Windows, macOS, or Linux with C++.
  • Knowledge of web technologies such as Javascript and HTML.
  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and memory safety concerns.
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.
  • Written and verbal communication skills with a collaborative mindset.
  • Willingness to work effectively in a distributed team environment.
  • Commitment to our values:
    • Play to win
    • Build for People first
    • Engage Evidence over Ego
    • Decide and Deliver
    • Ship, learn and repeat

Bonus Points for experience with:

  • Installer and/or Updater development on any OS
  • Windows internals like the BITS server or MSIX packages
  • Open-source contributions or personal engineering projects

What you’ll get:

  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
  • Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together
  • Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
  • One-time home office stipend
  • Annual professional development budget
  • Considerable paid parental leave
  • Employee referral bonus program
  • Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)

About Mozilla

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging

Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientations, gender identities, and expressions.

We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, as appropriate. Please contact us at hiringaccommodation@mozilla.com to request accommodation.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race (including hairstyle and texture), religion (including religious grooming and dress practices), gender, gender identity, gender expression, color, national origin, pregnancy, ancestry, domestic partner status, disability, sexual orientation, age, genetic predisposition, medical condition, marital status, citizenship status, military or veteran status, or any other basis covered by applicable laws. Mozilla will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics or any other unlawful behavior, conduct, or purpose.

title: Coördinator Kwaliteit en Backoffice Sociaal Domein
description:

Ben jij een ervaren professional binnen het sociaal domein met expertise in kwaliteitszorg, coaching en procesverbetering? Heb jij ervaring met het begeleiden van consulenten Jeugd en Wmo en het verbeteren van gemeentelijke werkprocessen? Dan is deze functie iets voor jou!

title: Principal Java Engineer - Distributed Systems, Serverless - Elasticsearch
description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What Is The Role:

We are on the lookout for a Principal Software Engineer to join our Elasticsearch - Distributed Systems team and focus on how Elasticsearch provides scale, performance, and resilience, especially in the context of our Serverless offering. You will be tackling deep distributed systems challenges in how nodes in an Elasticsearch cluster communicate, and how data are indexed, allocated, and managed across nodes.

What You Will Be Doing:

  • Leveraging your deep distributed systems expertise to design, build, and operate core pieces of our next-generation Serverless Elasticsearch offering, directly impacting the experience of customers worldwide.
  • Improving Elasticsearch’s components that support concurrent and consistent indexing across multiple machines.
  • Maintaining our cluster coordination system to keep performance high even though nodes come and go from the cluster and data moves around, while maintaining the safety and liveness properties of the system as a whole.
  • Pushing the limits on the number of shards, nodes, and petabytes that Elasticsearch can handle today.
  • Looking into all kinds of issues, including performance or concurrency issues, and proposing solutions.
  • Supporting our support engineers with the harder problems.
  • Owning operational investigations end-to-end, until performance or stability issues are successfully resolved.

What You Bring:

  • You have a deep background in distributed systems and consensus algorithms.
  • You have strong skills in core Java and are conversant in the standard library of data structures and concurrency constructs, as well as newer language features.
  • You have a deep technical proficiency in algorithms.
  • You have experience building large-scale distributed systems, rather than making use of off-the-shelf services.
  • You have experience building and debugging complex features with a broad impact, running on multiple machines.
  • You are able to own projects from beginning to end. This covers both technical design and working with others to develop needed components.
  • You have experience managing projects involving multiple engineers.
  • You have a proven track record of using AI to accelerate development, debug complex systems, and optimize code, while still owning the final outcomes.
  • You possess the ability to collaborate across functions and teams and seamlessly transition between different projects, codebases, or teams based on business priorities
  • You can work autonomously, drive decisions and results in a distributed team by leveraging asynchronous, direct, and transparent communication.

Bonus Points:

  • Data stores
  • Search, analytics, Lucene
  • Strong knowledge of the JDK
  • Asynchronous event-driven network frameworks such as Netty

Compensation for this role is in the form of base salary. This role does not have a variable compensation component.

At Elastic, our compensation philosophy aims to provide fair, competitive and transparent remuneration. Salary ranges are established based on a combination of external market benchmarks, internal pay equity considerations, and the responsibilities and complexity associated with each role. This approach helps ensure consistency across comparable roles while remaining competitive within the relevant labour markets.

The final compensation offered within the applicable range will be determined based on several objective factors, including relevant professional experience, level of skills and expertise, alignment with the role requirements, and the overall scope and complexity of the position.

The typical starting salary range for this role is:
€104.800—€165.700 EUR

Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People

As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.

We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.

  • Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary
  • Health coverage for you and your family in many locations
  • Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles
  • Generous number of vacation days each year
  • Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service

Different people approach problems differently. We need that. title: Network Engineer
description:
Position Summary

Flatter, inc. (Flatter) is hiring a Network Engineer and Administrator to support full lifecycle IT and cyber services required to operate and coordinate for the support, defense, and sustainment of ICBM enterprise IT environments across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid architectures. The Service Desk technician will deliver scalable, resilient, and compliant services that maintain security, availability, and mission readiness as ICBMSD enterprise needs evolve. The Service Desk Technician will provide proactive and reactive support across the functional areas.


Designs, operates, monitors, secures, and sustains enterprise data, voice, and video networks across on-premises, hybrid-cloud, and classified environments. The engineer maintains network health, resolves complex problems, and supports modernization and facility integration.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

• Design and document routing, switching, wireless, software-defined networking, physical and logical network models, and secure enterprise architectures.

• Install, configure, monitor, maintain, patch, and troubleshoot network devices, communications closets, power distribution, voice and video endpoints, and transmission media.

• Analyze uptime, latency, performance, capacity, and mean time to repair and recommend corrective action, modernization, and replacement of end-of-life infrastructure.

• Perform complex protocol-level troubleshooting and coordinate with carriers, service providers, vendors, COMSEC personnel, and other authorized support teams.

• Conduct annual preventive maintenance inspections and maintain network diagrams, configuration records, backups, and operational documentation.

• Enforce approved change, configuration, vulnerability, patch, backup, and disaster-recovery processes for network infrastructure.

• Review facility designs and construction plans, capture IT requirements, validate pathways and cryptographic-device support, and coordinate installation and activation.

• Support secure data transfers, network interoperability, credentialing, edge security, and operations across designated classification domains.


Security clearance: Top Secret, with the ability to be read in SCI

title: 3rd Officer for Saga Cruises
description:
We are currently seeking a 3rd Officer for embarkation on board cruise vessel
Spirit of Discovery

Embarkation on 20 /Dec/2026
Contract of Employment (COE): Competitive wages & contract length

Position Summary
1. To maintain a safe navigational watch on the bridge whilst the vessel is at sea, at anchor and in port in accordance with Company Policies, any National or International standards and any other prescribed regulations. Assisting and supporting the Safety Officer and Navigation Officer in every respect according to the Master’s or Staff Captain’s instructions.

Reporting Structure
1. Reporting to the Captain, Staff Captain and Chief Navigator.
2. Subordinates – Quarter Master, Fire Patrol and Security Guard on duty.

Safety Duties:
1. Participates in crew and passenger safety drills according to instructions.
2. Always complies with the Company’s safety and pollution prevention regulations and operating procedures.
3. Leads by example by taking care of Health and Safety of self and others.
4. Ensures that all work equipment, personal protective equipment, chemicals and safety devices are being used correctly.

Education/Experience/Qualifications:
1. Valid STCW95 certification.
2. Valid CoC A-II/1.
3. Appropriate certification as required by regulations.
4. Thorough knowledge of and ability to use navigational charts and publications, such as sailing directions, tide tables, notices to mariners, radio navigational warnings and ships' routing information
5. Physically and medically fit.
6. Moral integrity is required.
7. Coast Guard and Port State Control experience.

Language requirements:
1. Fluent English (verbal, written and technical). English is the working and safety language on board. This also includes the ability to give and receive instructions in verbal and written forms and to effectively and efficiently engage with guests and crew members. Additional languages are considered beneficial.

Computer knowledge:
1. Good working knowledge Microsoft Office applications.

Physical Demands and Working Conditions:
Required to stand, walk long distances, reaching and sitting. Repetitive motion of bending, going up and down stairs, climbing ladders. Lifting or pushing of up to 50lbs. The position requires overtime work and irregular schedules. Works on the Bridge with light traffic and distracting environments.

Profile:
1. Strong interpersonal skills and ability to lead, motivate and develop a culturally diverse work force.
2. Punctual.
3. Proactive approach to problem solving.
4. Ability to be flexible, well organized, self managed and motivated. Handle multiple demands, remain calm and effective under pressure and resolve issues quickly.
5. Effective, full, clear and concise communications is essential.
6. Safe, professional and personal practices. Fully conversant with VMS and MLC requirements.
7. Well groomed and neat appearance.
8. Ability to deliver a high standard of performance.

Status - Officer.
Salary - Refer to contract.
Rotation - Refer to contract.

1. To act as the Master’s representative during Bridge watch, supervising the ‘on watch’ team and ensuring that watches are carried out properly and Masters standing orders followed. The 3rd Officer shall ensure that adequate rounds of the vessel and reporting equipment malfunctions or breakdowns, performing and directing routine adjustments as necessary. Observing meteorological and tidal conditions and state of the sea. During the watch adheres to the emergency procedures and monitors bridge equipment, fire detection systems and watertight doors status.
2. Ensures that a satisfactory watch is kept when the Captain or the Pilot is in coon, by following the orders given to the helmsman and ensuring the ship’s position on regular intervals as required, with all possible navigational means.
3. Responsible to know the handling characteristics of the vessel, including stopping distance. Has a full knowledge of every aspect of safety features of the vessel. Being fully conversant with the Company’s VMS.
4. Ensures seaworthiness of the vessel.
5. Responsible to be familiar with the operation and location of all lifesaving, fire-fighting and pollution prevention equipment.
6. Keeps log of all watch operations and conditions.
7. Assists the lower-ranked Deck Officers in familiarization with the bridge instruments and equipment.
8. While the ship is in port the Watch Keeping Officer observes gangways, supervises the moorings and is aware of any significant work in progress as well as monitors the in-port manning duties.
9. Whilst the ship is at anchor the 3rd Officer is responsible for the following (to include but not limited to):
a. Determines and plots the ships position on the appropriate chart.
b. Ensures that an efficient look out is maintained.
c. Ensures that inspection rounds of the ship are carried out.
d. Observes meteorological, tidal conditions and the state of the sea.
e. Notifies the Master and undertakes all necessary measures if the ship drags the anchor.
f. Ensures that the main engines are at a state of readiness and other machinery is in accordance with the Masters instructions.
g. Ensures that the ship exhibits the appropriate lights, shapes and sound signals at all times.
h. Ensures that tender or zodiac operations are performed in a safe manner and according to schedule.
10. Monitors the status of the navigational equipment, navigational lights, the proper storage of standard signaling and other emergency signaling located on the Bridge.
11. Carries out operational tests of shipboard navigation equipment whilst at sea as frequently as practicable and as circumstances permit.
12. The Officer of the watch should make regular checks to ensure that the the helmsman or the automatic pilot is steering the correct course.
13. Responsible to ensure that the standard compass error is determined at least once per watch and when possible after any major alteration of course.
14. Responsible to ensure that the automatic pilot is tested manually at least once per watch.
15. Responsible to ensure that the navigation and signaling lights and other navigation equipment are functioning properly.
16. Ensures the use of radars when restricted visibility is encountered or expected and at all times in congested waters, selecting an appropriate range scale, changing at frequent intervals so that echoes are detected as early as possible. Commencing plotting or systematic analysis in ample time.
17. Responsible to be thoroughly familiar with the use of electronic navigational aids, including their capabilities and limitations.
18. Responsible for laying down course lines on all charts and the maintenance of navigational charts. Fixed should be taken at frequent intervals whenever circumstances allow by using more than one method. Positively identifying all relevant navigation marks.
19. Responsible for maintaining the hydrograph including chart’s correction.
20. Constantly checks the latest weather conditions and communicates to relevant parties as needed.
21. Ensures that ECDIS has been updated and navigation plans are created and activated.
22. Accurate communication with the pilot stations and/or any VTS and/or reporting system.
23. Executes calm, concise and clear communications via VHF with other ships/Port Control, VTS, etc, where language barriers are present.
24. Ensuring Bridge operations in regards to emergency equipment testing.
25. Ensures that a comprehensive and accurate handover is prepared for the relieving Officer of the watch (to include but not limited to):
a. Masters standing orders and other special instructions of the Master relating to navigation.
b. Position, course, speed and draught of the vessel.
c. Prevailing and predicted tides, currents, weather, visibility and effects of these factors upon course and speed.
d. Operational condition of all navigations and safety equipment being used or likely to be used during the watch.
e. Error of gyro and magnetic compasses.
f. Presence and movement of ships in sight or known to be in the vicinity.
g. Conditions and hazards likely to be encountered during the watch.
h. Possible effects of heel, trim, water density and squat under keel clearance.
26. Responsible to take frequent and accurate compass bearing of approaching ships as a means of early detection for risk of collision. Takes early and positive actions in compliance with the applicable regulations for Preventing Collision at Sea (COLREGS 72) and subsequently check that such actions is having the desired effect.
27. Responsible to apply and comply with all International Regulations for Preventing Collision at Sea (COLREGS 72) when restricted visibility is encountered or expected, with particular regard to the sounding of fog signals, proceeding at safe speed and having the engines ready for immediate maneuvers.
28. Assists in tendering and zodiac operations as required by the Staff Captain.
29. Attends mooring stations as instructed by the Staff Captain.
30. Supervising crew assigned to mooring stations and ensuring that mooring operations are conducted in accordance with the advice in the Code of Safe Working Practice.
31. Responsible for GMDSS communication in the event of an emergency during his/her duty watch and/or as required.
32. Responsible for the good operation/setting of the GMDSS equipment during his/her duty watch.
33. Whilst the vessel is in Dry Dock, work as instructed by the Staff Captain.
34. Assists the Safety Officer in related crew training if required.
35. Familiarizing with the ship’s stability in order to eventually assist the Staff Captain with this duty.
36. Keeps the Master and Staff Captain promptly and fully informed of all problems and matters of significance.
37. Accurate completion of log books and other assigned documentation.
38. Responsible for keeping the ships official log book, which requires a thorough working knowledge of the applicable Flag State legislation and requirements.
39. Accountable for ensuring that Company, National and International standards are maintained and meeting requirements. Reporting to the Master any instances where the ship is unable or fails to comply.
40. Monitors his subordinates working/rest hours and overtime. Maintaining 100% compliance with Company requirements as well as ILO/MLC.
41. Executes strict practices to ensure that the vessel is operated in accordance with the following regulations and Company policies, during all prevailing circumstances and conditions:
a. International Safety Management Code.
b. ISPS Code.
c. SOLAS.
d. ECDIS.
e. Code of Safe Working Practices.
f. MARPOL.
g. Pollution prevention.
h. COLREG 72.
i. GMDSS.
j. International Code of Signals.
k. STCW.
l. Oil Record Book.
m. ILO/IMO/ITF/MLC 2006.
n. Ballast Water Management.
o. US CDC Vessel Sanitation Program.
p. Stability and Trim.
q. Merchant Shipping Legislation of the Bahamas.
42. Prepares a comprehensive handover of duties according to and via form OP196A.
43. Practices good people management, maintaining proper conduct within the Deck department and other departments around the ship.
44. All other duties as assigned.

title: Benefits Specialist
description:
About Company:

Live Life Healthy (LLH) saw what was happening in industries like hospitality, staffing, and home healthcare. Part-time and temporary workers were left behind. Employers wanted to help but couldn’t afford traditional benefits for everyone. And rising costs were making things worse for everyone.

LLH Healthcare was built to solve both sides of the problem and provide basic healthcare to the under insured. We created a compliant, zero out-of-pocket solution that serves the whole workforce and strengthens the bottom line.

LLH Healthcare is dedicated to providing high-quality, client-focused benefit solutions that improve organizational outcomes and employee well-being. We foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and integrity and seek team members who share our commitment to excellence.

About the Role:

The Benefits Specialist plays a critical role in managing and administering employee benefit programs within the finance and insurance industry. This position ensures that all benefit plans, including health, long-term disability, and leave of absence programs, are effectively communicated and administered in compliance with company policies and regulatory requirements. The specialist acts as a trusted resource for employees, providing guidance on benefit options, eligibility, and claims processes while maintaining strict confidentiality of sensitive information. By leveraging systems such as PeopleSoft, the Benefits Specialist maintains accurate records and processes benefit enrollments and changes efficiently. Ultimately, this role contributes to employee satisfaction and organizational compliance by delivering seamless benefits administration and support.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in benefits administration within the finance or insurance industry.
  • Proficiency in PeopleSoft or similar HRIS platforms for benefits management.
  • Strong knowledge of federal and state regulations including ADA, FMLA, and long-term disability policies.
  • Demonstrated ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive employee information with discretion.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Professional certification such as Certified Employee Benefits Specialist (CEBS) or SHRM-CP/SHRM-SCP.
  • Experience working in a large, multi-state organization with complex benefits programs.
  • Familiarity with benefits compliance audits and reporting requirements.
  • Advanced skills in data analysis and reporting tools related to benefits administration.
  • Experience conducting employee training and benefits communication initiatives.

Responsibilities:

  • Administer and manage employee benefit programs including health insurance, long-term disability, ADA accommodations, Family Medical Leave Act (FMLA), and leave of absence policies.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for employees regarding benefits inquiries, eligibility, claims, and problem resolution.
  • Maintain accurate and confidential employee benefits records using PeopleSoft and other HR information systems.
  • Ensure compliance with federal, state, and local regulations related to benefits administration and confidentiality requirements.
  • Collaborate with insurance carriers, vendors, and internal departments to resolve issues and implement benefit plan changes.
  • Conduct benefits orientations and training sessions for new hires and existing employees to promote understanding of available benefits.
  • Monitor and track leave of absence requests and coordinate with management and healthcare providers as necessary.
  • Prepare reports and documentation related to benefits utilization, costs, and compliance audits.

Skills:

The Benefits Specialist utilizes their expertise in benefit plan design and administration to ensure employees receive accurate and timely information about their benefits. Maintaining confidentiality is paramount, as the role involves handling sensitive personal and medical information daily. Proficiency with PeopleSoft enables efficient management of employee records, benefit enrollments, and leave tracking, streamlining administrative processes. Knowledge of ADA, FMLA, and long-term disability regulations ensures compliance and proper accommodation of employee needs. Additionally, strong communication and problem-solving skills are essential for addressing employee inquiries and collaborating with vendors and internal teams to resolve benefits-related issues effectively.

title: Principal Software Developer (Full-Stack)
description:
FlexTrade Systems is a provider of customized multi-asset execution and order management trading solutions for buy- and sell-side financial institutions. Through deep client partnerships with some of the world's largest, most complex and demanding capital markets firms, we develop the flexible tools, technology and innovation that deliver our clients a competitive edge. Our globally distributed engineering teams focus on adaptable technology and open architecture to develop highly sophisticated trading solutions that can automate and scale with your business strategies.

At FlexTrade, we hold our values close to heart, with pride and gratitude, as they guide us in everything that we do. We are dedicated to giving our clients a competitive edge, taking ownership of our responsibilities, being flexible to adapt to ever changing environment and technology, bringing integrity to ever interaction and we continue to improve, grow together and collaborate as one team. All of these while having fun truly makes FlexTrade a wonderful place to work.

The Team

We are looking for an amazing developer to join our team building FlexTrade's OEMS platform, FlexONE, which is our state-of-the-art, fully integrated Order Management System and Execution Management System. This system was built from the ground up starting in 2013 and is written entirely in Scala.

The FlexONE team is split between our Milwaukee office, where the product was first developed, and our London office, which is now predominantly responsible for development of the UI for the application.

The London team is an experienced group of Java and Scala developers, with a deep understanding of UI and UX design. We deliver our software using agile methodologies, and we encourage best practices such as TDD, code reviews and pair programming for knowledge sharing and learning. Our team owns all aspects of the features they work on, from designing solutions to meet customer or product requirements, through implementation, QA and delivery. Each team member works on every part of the system.

About You

Be part of our FlexONE team and own critical product surfaces across our web and mobile applications. You'll work end-to-end across a Scala + Play Framework backend, and a React + AG-Grid front-end, using gRPC for communication with our core product's backend systems. You will lead the technical direction as we build our Web app from an MVP to a comprehensive companion to the desktop application, as well as continuing the evolution of our Mobile app.

Responsibilities

  • Design & Build: Deliver robust, maintainable features across the stack (Scala/Play backend, React/AG-Grid frontend)
  • Mobile Migration: Define the path from Codename One to a JS-compatible framework (likely React Native), including architecture, incremental migration strategy, and performance/UX parity
  • Quality & Reliability: Champion code quality, testing, observability (metrics, logs, tracing), and performance across the stack
  • Team Growth: Mentor engineers, assist with hiring, onboarding, and capability development as the team scales.
  • Collaboration: Partner closely with the Desktop application development team to ensure feature compatibility and parity
  • Backend: Scala, Play Framework, REST/JSON and gRPC
  • Frontend: React, TypeScript, AG-Grid
  • Mobile: Current app in CodenameOne, target migration to React Native (or similar JS-based cross-platform framework)

Requirements

  • Deep full stack expertise
  • Experience building & deploying production web apps, with significant experience in React and modern TypeScript
