title: VP Enterprise Project Managment
description:
Lead Enterprise Transformation at Achieva Credit Union

Ready to help shape what's next? Join a Top Workplace where innovation, collaboration, and purpose-driven work come together to make a real impact.

✨ Be part of something bigger
Help drive the future of a growing organization
Collaborate with passionate, forward-thinking leaders
Build a career where your contributions truly matter
Position Summary:
The Vice President (VP), Enterprise Project Management, strategically leads the Project Management Office (PMO) and advances Achieva Credit Union's ability to execute organizational priorities, leverages technology, drives meaningful change, and delivers measurable business outcomes. Reporting to the Chief Technology Officer, this role leads the evolution of the PMO into a strategic enterprise capability that strengthens prioritization, business ownership, accountability, and organizational execution.

While most initiatives involve technology, this position requires a strong technology background and experience leading complex technology-driven initiatives. The VP must understand how technology, business processes, people, and organizational strategy intersect and be capable of evaluating opportunities, challenging assumptions, identifying risks, and helping shape effective solutions.

The VP serves as a trusted advisor to executive leadership, bringing external perspective, innovative thinking, and practical recommendations to improve organizational effectiveness. Success requires exceptional relationship-building skills, executive presence, sound judgement, and the confidence to constructively challenge leaders, navigate competing priorities, and establish accountability across all levels of the organization.

This role fundamentally focuses on business transformation. The VP partners closely with executive leadership, business owners, and technology leaders to ensure projects are not simply technology implementations, but opportunities to modernize business processes, improve operational efficiency, strengthen accountability, and transform how Achieva operates. This leader challenges traditional ways of working, promotes business ownership of outcomes, and ensures organizational change and adoption are integrated into project success. Success requires exceptional relationship-building skills, sound judgment, executive presence, and the confidence to constructively challenge leaders, navigate competing priorities, and establish accountability across all levels of the organization.

Key Responsibilities:
Strategic Leadership & Organizational Transformation
  • Lead the evolution of the PMO, establishing a modern, practical approach to project and portfolio management that supports Achieva’s strategic direction.
  • Partner with executive leadership to translate organizational priorities into actionable initiatives with clear ownership, measurable outcomes, and defined accountability.
  • Drive a cultural shift toward business-led initiatives, ensuring business owners actively define requirements, make decisions, commit resources, and own operational readiness and results.
  • Serve as a strategic advisor and change leader, identifying opportunities to improve how Achieva plans, prioritizes, executes, and adopts organizational change.
  • Champion business process transformation through strategic initiatives, challenging existing practices and partnering with business leaders to redesign workflows, eliminate inefficiencies, leverage technology effectively, and achieve meaningful operational improvements and improve member experience.
  • Establish the expectations that business leaders own the process, decisions, operational readiness, and outcomes associated with their initiatives, while Technology serves as a strategic partner in delivering enabling solutions.
  • Leverage technology leadership experience and knowledge to identify opportunities for business improvement and transformation.
Enterprise Portfolio Management, Strategic Alignment & Execution
  • Partner with Executive Leadership to translate organizational strategy into project priorities, portfolio investments, and measurable business outcomes.
  • Lead enterprise project intake, prioritization, portfolio governance, and resource planning, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives, organizational capacity, regulatory compliance, and member experience goals.
  • Provide strategic oversight of complex, high-impact initiatives, ensuring risks, dependencies, competing priorities, and resource constraints are proactively managed.
  • Establish clear accountability for executive sponsors, business owners, project managers, Technology teams, and other stakeholders, ensuring ownership of decisions, deliverables, and business outcomes.
  • Champion business process transformation through strategic initiatives, challenging existing practices and ensuring projects drive operational improvements rather than simply implementing technology or completing deliverables.
  • Partner with business and Technology leaders to ensure business requirements, process redesign, technical delivery, implementation readiness, and organizational adoption are effectively coordinated.
  • Drive timely decisions, remove organizational barriers, and hold stakeholders accountable for commitments, escalating issues when necessary to maintain strategic momentum.
  • Provide executive leadership with meaningful portfolio visibility, performance measures, and recommendations that support informed decisions, prioritization, and accountability.
  • Partner with Technology leadership to understand technical complexity, architecture considerations, resource requirements, and delivery risks while ensuring business owners remain accountable for business decisions and outcomes.
Leadership & Team Development
  • Lead, mentor, coach, and develop high-performing PMO team, establishing clear performance expectations and a culture of ownership and continuous improvement.
  • Establish a culture of shared accountability across the organization, building strong relationships while confidently challenging assumptions, addressing missed commitments, and holding executive sponsors, business owners, and project teams accountable for decisions, deliverables, and outcomes.
  • Facilitate difficult conversations, resolve conflicts, and influence decisions across departments and leadership levels.
  • Serve as a bridge between business and Technology leaders, translating business objectives and technical considerations into a shared understanding, practical decisions, and coordinated execution.
  • Strengthen organizational project management capabilities through coaching, practical governance, and consistent execution standards.
  • Support the professional growth of team members through coaching, development planning, training, and feedback.
  • Build project management competencies and leadership capabilities across the PMO team, contract project managers and within business units.
Governance, Risk & Continuous Improvement
  • Establish and continuously improve scalable project management methodologies, tools, processes, and performance measures.
  • Promote effective change management, stakeholder engagement, testing, implementation readiness, and adoption.
  • Ensure appropriate project governance, risk management, documentation, and compliance with applicable organizational and regulatory requirements.
  • Develop mitigation strategies and escalate concerns appropriately.
  • Ensure project documentation and governance records meet retention, audit, and compliance standards.
  • Partner with Risk, Compliance, Audit, and Information Security teams as needed.
  • Evaluate portfolio and PMO performance, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, execution discipline, and organizational effectiveness.
  • Capture and institutionalize lessons learned and best practices.
Organizational Engagement
  • Represent the credit union with professionalism and courtesy in all interactions.
  • Uphold the highest ethical standards in all interactions and responsibilities.
  • Represent and uphold Achieva’s Strategic Compass and the Achieva Brand Frame.
  • Champion initiatives that position the credit union as a top employer through leadership, integrity and service excellence.

  • Perform other essential functions as needed or assigned.

  • Work flexible hours including weekends and holidays to meet member and business demands.
Requirements:
Education and Experience
  • Bachelor's degree in business administration, project management, information technology, finance, or related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 10+ years’ progressive project, program, or portfolio management experience and vendor management.
  • 5+ years’ leadership experience managing teams and complex organizational initiatives.
  • Demonstrated experience building, transforming, or maturing a Project Management Office.
  • Experience leading enterprise-wide strategic initiatives involving multiple business units.
  • Experience with project portfolio management, governance frameworks, resource planning, and organizational change management.
  • Financial institution experience strongly preferred.
Certifications
  • Project Management Professional (PMP) required.
  • Program Management Professional (PgMP), Portfolio Management Professional (PfMP), Agile, Lean Six Sigma, Change Management, or related certifications preferred.
Skills and Attributes
  • Strategic leadership and business acumen.
  • Strong project, program, and portfolio management expertise.
  • Executive presence and ability to influence across all organizational levels.
  • Strong governance, prioritization, and decision-making capabilities.
  • Exceptional coaching, mentoring, and people leadership skills.
  • Organizational change management knowledge and experience.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to evaluate project metrics, portfolio performance, and organizational impact.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Financial management and resource planning experience.
  • Risk management and issue resolution expertise.
  • Strong relationship-building and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

  • High emotional intelligence and conflict resolution skills
Physical Demands & Work Environment:
Achieva Credit Union is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job.

This role operates in a flexible environment and may include hybrid work, in-field visits, and time in an office setting at Corporate Headquarter and/or Achieva Branch. The role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, and virtual meeting platforms. The employee must be able to remain in a stationary position for extended periods and communicate effectively via phone, video, and electronic messaging. title: Sociaal Werker Jeugd | 24–36 uur per week

Ben jij een ervaren Sociaal Werker Jeugd met een passie voor het ondersteunen van gezinnen en jeugdigen? Heb jij ervaring met complexe gezinsproblematiek, jeugdveiligheid en het voeren van preventieve gesprekken? Dan is deze functie iets voor jou!

Als Sociaal Werker Jeugd ben je het aanspreekpunt en de regiehouder voor gezinnen die ondersteuning nodig hebben. Je brengt de behoeften van jeugdigen en ouders in kaart, coördineert passende hulpverlening en werkt volgens het principe één gezin, één plan, één hulpverlener.

Wat je gaat doen:

  • Begeleiden en ondersteunen van jeugdigen en gezinnen bij uiteenlopende hulpvragen;

  • Fungeren als contactpersoon en regiehouder voor gezinnen met complexe problematiek;

  • Voeren van intakegesprekken en preventieve gesprekken binnen het voorliggend veld;

  • Signaleren en analyseren van problemen op het gebied van opvoeding, ontwikkeling en veiligheid;

  • Begeleiden van gezinnen bij complexe echtscheidingsproblematiek en veiligheidsvraagstukken;

  • Opstellen, uitvoeren en bewaken van gezinsplannen volgens het principe één gezin, één plan, één hulpverlener;

  • Coördineren van hulpverlening en zorgen voor een goede samenwerking tussen betrokken professionals;

  • Ondersteunen van ouders en jeugdigen bij het versterken van hun zelfredzaamheid;

  • Beoordelen welke ondersteuning nodig is en waar mogelijk inzetten van preventieve voorzieningen;

  • Signaleren van onveilige situaties en hierop adequaat handelen;

  • Samenwerken met collega’s binnen het gebiedsteam en andere betrokken hulpverleningsinstanties;

  • Bewaken van de voortgang van hulpverlening en waar nodig bijsturen;

  • Zorgvuldig vastleggen van gesprekken, afspraken en ontwikkelingen in de daarvoor bestemde systemen.

Wat jij meebrengt:

  • Een afgeronde hbo-opleiding in de richting van Social Work, MWD, SPH of Pedagogiek (harde eis);

  • Minimaal 4 jaar relevante en recente werkervaring in een vergelijkbare functie binnen een gemeentelijke organisatie (harde eis);

  • Aantoonbare ervaring met het voeren van preventieve gesprekken binnen het voorliggend veld, met specialisatie jeugd (harde eis);

  • Ruime ervaring met complexe gezinsproblematiek, complexe echtscheidingen en veiligheidsvraagstukken (harde eis);

  • Een geldige SKJ-registratie (harde eis);

  • Een geldige VOG van maximaal 3 maanden oud, passend bij de functie, of de bereidheid deze aan te vragen (harde eis);

  • Ervaring met het werken binnen een gemeentelijk gebiedsteam (pré);

  • Ervaring met het registratiesysteem iSam (pré);

  • Kennis van de Jeugdwet en relevante wet- en regelgeving binnen het sociaal domein;

  • Ervaring met het voeren van regie op complexe gezinscasuïstiek;

  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om vertrouwen op te bouwen met jeugdigen en ouders;

  • Een analytische en oplossingsgerichte werkhouding;

  • Het vermogen om zelfstandig beslissingen te nemen en professioneel te handelen in complexe situaties;

  • Een betrokken, daadkrachtige en stressbestendige persoonlijkheid;

  • Goede samenwerkingsvaardigheden en het vermogen om verschillende belangen samen te brengen.

Wij bieden:

  • Een uitdagende en afwisselende baan met veel verantwoordelijkheid.

title: Regional General Manager
description:
Are you ready to lead with precision, drive profitable growth, and build a high-performing team that delivers exceptional results?

At Doncasters we have an exciting opportunity for a dynamic, results-driven Regional General Manager to lead our structural casting plant in Groton, CT and Springfield, MA. This is an exciting opportunity to provide strong operational, commercial, and people leadership, leveraging operational excellence and our Doncasters Production System to ensure the site consistently delivers against its key performance objectives.

Why join us?
Did you know that every time you take a flight, drive somewhere, or switch on a light, there’s a chance Doncasters played a part in making that happen?

We are a specialist manufacturer of complex precision cast components for aerospace engines and industrial gas turbines, supporting leading OEM programs.

We excel in turning metals into motion, working in alloys and manufacturing complex product designs to offer an unparalleled range of solutions for high performance and specialist applications.

We employ more than 3,000 people across 14 core manufacturing facilities globally, providing the scale and expertise required to serve leading aerospace engine and IGT OEMs.

At Doncasters, we believe in doing things the right way. That means acting with integrity, delivering with commitment, and working as one team to achieve more, together. Whether you're developing precision-engineered components, running world-class manufacturing operations, or supporting our people and processes, your role is part of something much bigger.

Join us and contribute to a legacy built on performance, precision, and the values that drive us forward - excellence, commitment, integrity, and teamwork.

What we can offer you:

• An interesting and varied field to work in
• An environment where you can learn and grow through constant development opportunities
• PTO
• Competitive 401K
• Competitive medical insurance

title: Lead:Service Delivery Manager
description:

title: Game Product Manager II, Summoner's Rift & Modes - Wild Rift
description:
Riot Games was established in 2006 by entrepreneurial gamers who believe that player-focused game development can result in great games. In 2009, Riot released its debut title League of Legends to critical and player acclaim. As the most played video game in the world, over 100 million play every month. Players form the foundation of our community and it’s for them that we continue to evolve and improve the League of Legends experience.

We’re looking for humble but ambitious, razor-sharp professionals who can teach us a thing or two. We promise to return the favor. Like us, you take play seriously; you’re passionate about games. We embrace those who see things differently, aren’t afraid to experiment, and who have a healthy disregard for constraints.

That's where you come in.

As a Game Producer on the Wild Rift product team, you will drive the planning, coordination, and delivery of core gameplay initiatives for Summoner's Rift. As part of the Core Gameplay team, you will translate gameplay goals and product priorities into clear production plans, milestones, and delivery processes across champions, items, runes, map content, objectives, and game pacing.

You will work closely with designers, engineers, artists, quality partners, analysts, researchers, and product leaders to align priorities, manage dependencies and risks, and deliver gameplay improvements that strengthen competitive integrity and the player experience. Data analysis and measurement will be a substantial and ongoing part of your role. You will collaborate with Insights Analysts and Researchers across Shanghai, Singapore, and Los Angeles to monitor gameplay health, investigate performance trends, and translate quantitative data and qualitative player feedback into actionable priorities.

Beyond the core Summoner's Rift experience, you will lead production for proof-of-concept initiatives across the Modes portfolio. You will partner with development teams to define scope, feasibility, success criteria, and validation plans, helping teams make informed decisions before committing initiatives to full production.

You will report into the Wild Rift Game Production Lead of the team.

Responsibilities:

  • Translate core gameplay goals and product strategy into actionable production roadmaps, milestones, schedules, and delivery plans, driving alignment from planning through launch.

  • Coordinate production across core gameplay systems, including champions, items, runes, maps, objectives, and game pacing, partnering with design and development teams to manage scope, dependencies, risks, and execution quality.

  • Establish and maintain operating processes for monitoring core gameplay health, including key metrics, dashboards, reporting, and investigation of meaningful performance changes.

  • Define success criteria, measurement plans, launch-readiness expectations, and post-launch review processes, translating findings into prioritized gameplay improvements.

  • Partner with Insights Analysts and Researchers to combine quantitative analysis and qualitative player research, informing gameplay priorities, production decisions, and follow-up actions.

  • Lead production of proof-of-concept initiatives across game modes, coordinating hypotheses, validation plans, scope, milestones, and decision points before full production.

  • Coordinate production plans and execution across development partner teams, aligning on feasibility, resourcing, requirements, dependencies, and delivery across regions and time zones.

  • Communicate production priorities, tradeoffs, risks, progress, and outcomes to stakeholders and leadership, facilitating decisions and resolving blockers to maintain delivery momentum.

Required Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of professional experience in game production, game product management, game design, or a related field.

  • 2+ years of experience driving delivery of in-game features through ideation, scoping, development, launch, and post-launch iteration.

  • Experience coordinating production for gameplay systems or competitive multiplayer features on a shipped game.

  • Experience working with competitive multiplayer games, including PvP or mobile multiplayer titles.

  • Experience defining and analyzing gameplay or product metrics, working with dashboards, identifying performance changes, and applying quantitative evidence to production decisions.

  • Experience coordinating planning, execution, dependencies, and delivery across multiple teams and stakeholders.

  • Experience managing production risks, prioritizing competing requirements, and communicating tradeoffs and decisions in a changing development environment.

  • Fluency in written and spoken English and Mandarin Chinese.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Experience with advanced data analytics, statistical modeling, experimentation, or related analytical methods.

  • Experience owning or coordinating features across the full development lifecycle on a live game.

  • Experience producing, prototyping, or validating new gameplay formats or experimental features.

  • Experience coordinating cross-functional teams, managing stakeholder relationships, or mentoring production partners.

  • Experience collaborating with distributed development teams across regions and time zones.

For this role, you'll find success through craft expertise, a collaborative spirit, and decision-making that prioritizes the delight of players. We will be looking at your past studies, experience, and your personal relationship with games. If you embody player empathy and care about players' experiences, this could be your role!

title: CRANE OPERATOR
description:
JOB SUMMARY:
Responsible for the safe operation of a stationary or traveling crane to lift, move, position, and reposition loads. Depresses buttons, lifts levers, and ensures load is safely attached to crane before bringing it down.
This position requires the ability to work long hours, including nights and weekends, on short notice
Essential Functions:
  1. Operate crane under general supervision.
  2. Manipulate or depress crane controls to regulate speed and direction of crane and hoist movement according to written, verbal, or signal instructions.
  3. Repair and maintain the crane as needed.
  4. Conducting a pre-operational checklist of the crane prior to operations each day.
  5. Determine if any parts are malfunctioning.
  6. Complete job tickets, service quality summaries and all other necessary paperwork.
  7. Lift, position, and place machinery, equipment or other large objects at job site or facility.
  8. Place blocks and outriggers to prevent capsizing when lifting heavy loads.
  9. Move levers and pedals to rotate crane on chassis to raise and lower crane boom and to raise and lower loan-line.
  10. Bolt boom sections together to extend or modify boom for high lifting.
  11. Work with precise limits and standards of accuracy.
  12. Operate crane according to signals from helpers.
  13. Follow directions carefully.
  14. Conducting a safety brief with the crew on site prior to operations each day.
  15. Walking the job site with the Rigging Foreman or Rigging Supervisor to identify hazards
    or risks prior to operations each day.
  16. Only operating cranes IAW their training and certification, and per the Operator Manual
    and this procedure.
  17. Stopping operations for any UNSAFE issue.
  18. Placing the crane in a safe condition at the end of operations.
  19. Performs other duties as assigned.
QUALIFICATIONS:
  1. Graduation from a standard apprenticeship/trade/vocational school.
  2. High school diploma or GED required and 3 or more years of related experience or equivalent of training and experience.
  3. NCCCO Certifications required.
  4. Class B Driver’s License Required; Class A preferred.
  5. Ability to follow written and verbal instructions, and hand signals.
  6. Ability to gain access to military installations.
  7. Excellent attention to detail.
  8. Excellent eye-hand coordination.
  9. Must pass a drug test and background check.
Physical Requirements:
  1. Ability to lift 50 pounds regularly and seek help with weights over 50 pounds.
  2. Ability to sit and/or stand for long periods of time.
While performing the duties of this job, the employee is required to stand; walk; sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools or controls; reach with hands and arms; climb stairs/vertical ladders; balance; stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl; talk or hear; taste or smell. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by the job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.
This is a physically demanding position and may accommodate some physical disabilities. Physical dexterity may be required when performing walk thru and inspection of job sites. In the performance of the walk thru you will be required to transverse steep stairwells, vertical ladders and bending or stooping thru tight spaces. There may be occasional lifting of materials weighing not more than 50 pounds.
Environmental Conditions:
This position works on the jobsite. There is exposure to hostile environments, loud noises, hazardous chemicals/fumes and airborne particles, smoke, extreme temperatures moving mechanical parts: high, precarious places.
During worksite visits it will be required to wear appropriate PPE including, but not limited to:
Hard hat
Ear plugs or attenuator
Safety shoes
Dust mask or respirator
Gloves

title: Engineering Shift Leader
description:
The Engineering Shift Leader oversees daily maintenance and operational engineering activities during an assigned shift. This role ensures machinery, plant utilities, and automated systems operate at peak efficiency and safety. The Shift Leader manages on-shift engineering technicians, coordinates rapid responses to equipment downtime, and implements preventative maintenance routines while maintaining compliance with health, safety, and environmental standards.
  • Oversee the day to day operations of the engineering and related departments.
  • Primary contact to communicate and coordinate work from other departments.
  • Minimise disruption to guests and hotel operations.
  • Inspect and troubleshoot air handling units (AHUs), fresh air handling units (FAHUs), split air-conditioning units, pumps, boilers, swimming pool equipment, and water treatment systems.
  • Supervise routine electrical, plumbing, and civil maintenance across guest areas, residences, and back-of-house facilities.
  • Use the hotel’s computerised maintenance management system (CMMS) to track work orders, record repairs, and monitor preventive maintenance completion.
  • Conduct plant room inspections, record operating readings, and escalate recurring faults or critical equipment issues to engineering management.
  • Maintain clear shift handovers, including outstanding jobs, equipment status, and follow-up actions.
  • Ensure the team follows hotel safety and permit-to-work procedures.
  • Assist Engineering Director with developing and managing all engineering staff members
  • Ensure regulatory compliance to facility regulations and safety standards.
  • Fire Alarm/Life Safety System - to monitor systems as necessary, to be fully informed of the system operation and to handle emergencies involving the systems. To have a working knowledge of fire sprinkler and emergency power systems.
  • Energy Conservation - to observe energy and utilities usage in the hotel and on the grounds. To look for ways to conserve energy and report any ideas to the Engineering Management
  • Records - to read, log, track and interpret readings from meters, gauges and other measuring units. To maintain a thorough log of each day’s activities and problems that occur and to ensure this information is passed on to other shifts.
  • Departmental Duties - to clean all engineering areas as directed by Engineering Management. To work in a neat and efficient manner, keeping work areas clean and well organized.
  • Performs all duties and responsibilities in a timely and efficient manner in accordance with established company policies and procedures to achieve overall objectives of this position.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in hotel engineering, with at least 2 years in a supervisory role in a 5-star hotel.
  • Minimum diploma in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Excellent spoken and written English, with the ability to communicate professionally with guests, colleagues, and contractors and write clear technical reports.
  • Strong hands-on mechanical troubleshooting skills, particularly with AHUs, FAHUs, split AC units, pumps, boilers, swimming pool systems, and water treatment equipment.
  • Practical knowledge of hotel electrical systems, plumbing, and civil maintenance.
  • Experience using a CMMS for preventive maintenance scheduling, work order tracking, and reporting.
  • Ability to lead and coach technicians, prioritise urgent work, and make sound decisions under pressure.

Technical Skills:
  • Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify the root causes of recurring faults and propose practical, innovative improvements.
  • Knowledge of energy and water conservation, with experience identifying efficiency opportunities in hotel equipment and operations.
  • Familiarity with environmental management practices in hospitality, such as waste segregation, resource monitoring, and sustainability audit support.
  • Engineering administration experience, including preparing shift reports, coordinating team schedules, maintaining records, and following up on work orders.

Important: This is a hands‑on engineering role. Candidates with practical experience building and evaluating AI applications are preferred over those whose experience is limited to AI strategy, architecture documentation, conventional QA automation, or using AI coding assistants.

We seek a Senior/Lead AI Engineer with experience building, orchestrating, monitoring, and evaluating production‑grade Generative AI and Agentic AI applications. The ideal candidate is expert in Amazon Bedrock, AgentCore, LangGraph, LangChain, RAG, LLM observability, and evaluation frameworks. The role focuses on creating reliable, scalable, production‑ready AI applications, emphasizing agent orchestration, AI testing, LLM evaluation, and continuous quality monitoring.

The candidate will collaborate with Engineering, QA, and platform teams to establish best practices for building, testing, monitoring, and improving AI‑powered applications. The testing focus is on GenAI evaluation, RAG pipeline assessment, agent behavior validation, LLM quality benchmarking, and automated evaluation frameworks, not conventional UI test automation.

Key Responsibilities

1. Agentic AI & GenAI Engineering
- Design, develop, and deploy production‑grade agentic and generative AI applications.
- Build and orchestrate AI agents using LangGraph, LangChain, Amazon Bedrock, and AgentCore.
- Implement multi‑agent workflows, tool calling, state management, memory, and orchestration.
- Create scalable LLM‑powered applications and reusable AI components.
- Deploy agentic workflows with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, handling runtime management, tool integration, and execution orchestration.

2. RAG & LLM Application Development
- Design and implement Retrieval‑Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions.
- Develop pipelines for document ingestion, chunking, embedding, retrieval, reranking, and context management.
- Optimize retrieval accuracy, response quality, latency, and cost.
- Apply grounding, hallucination reduction, and context‑relevance techniques.

3. LLM Evaluation & AI Testing
- Build automated evaluation frameworks with RAGAS, DeepEval, and similar tools.
- Evaluate RAG pipelines using metrics such as Faithfulness, Answer Relevancy, Context Precision, Context Recall, and Answer Correctness.
- Implement LLM‑as‑a‑Judge techniques to assess generated responses, retrieval quality, agent behavior, and workflow execution.
- Establish evaluation datasets, benchmarks, and regression‑testing pipelines for continuous quality assessment.

3a. Agent Evaluation and Observability
- Implement end‑to‑end tracing of multi‑agent workflows, including tool invocation, agent handoffs, execution paths, and failure handling.
- Establish observability practices to detect hallucinations, reasoning failures, tool‑calling errors, and execution inconsistencies.

4. AI Observability & Monitoring
- Implement tracing, monitoring, and observability with OpenTelemetry, LangSmith, and Langfuse.
- Track LLM requests, agent execution flows, tool calls, latency, token consumption, errors, and performance.
- Develop debugging mechanisms for complex multi‑step agentic workflows.
- Create monitoring practices to detect performance degradation and operational issues.

5. AWS AI Platform & Production Engineering
- Deploy AI applications using Amazon Bedrock and Bedrock AgentCore.
- Integrate foundation models, agent frameworks, APIs, and enterprise data sources.
- Apply production‑readiness practices covering scalability, reliability, security, and performance.
- Support CI/CD integration and automated evaluation of AI applications.
- Optimize model selection, inference costs, latency, and resource utilization.

6. Technical Leadership & Collaboration
- Provide technical guidance to engineering and QA teams.
- Establish reusable frameworks, implementation patterns, and best practices.
- Collaborate with architecture, DevOps, QA, and engineering teams.
- Participate in design discussions, code reviews, proof‑of‑concept development, and implementation.
- Mentor engineers and help teams adopt effective AI development and testing practices.

Required Technical Skills

Agentic AI & Orchestration
- LangGraph
- LangChain
- Amazon Bedrock
- Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
- AI agents, multi‑agent orchestration, tool calling, workflow management

Generative AI & RAG
- Large Language Models (LLMs)
- Retrieval‑Augmented Generation (RAG)
- Embeddings and vector search
- Prompt engineering and context management
- LLM application development

LLM Evaluation & Testing
- DeepEval
- LLM‑as‑a‑Judge techniques
- Evaluation metrics and benchmarking
- Automated evaluation and regression testing
- Assessment of hallucination, faithfulness, relevance, and response quality
- Hands‑on experience with RAGAS, DeepEval, or equivalent frameworks
- Strong understanding of RAG evaluation metrics (Faithfulness, Answer Relevancy, Context Precision, Context Recall, Answer Correctness)
- Experience building automated evaluation pipelines for RAG‑based applications

AI Observability & Monitoring
- OpenTelemetry
- LangSmith
- Langfuse
- LLM tracing, debugging, and performance monitoring

Production Engineering
- Deploying and operating production‑grade GenAI applications
- API integration and backend engineering
- CI/CD and automated testing integration
- Scalability, reliability, security, and performance optimization
- Strong hands‑on programming experience in Python.
- Experience developing REST APIs and integrating LLM frameworks with enterprise applications.
- Familiarity with asynchronous programming, API integrations, and backend development.

Preferred Qualifications
- 8+ years of software engineering or IT experience.
- Demonstrated hands‑on experience building and deploying GenAI and Agentic AI applications.
- Recent experience in LLM engineering, agent orchestration, and AI evaluation.
- Experience with enterprise‑scale AI implementations.
- Familiarity with AWS cloud services and enterprise AI security practices.
- Experience establishing AI quality standards and evaluation methodologies.
- Strong problem‑solving, communication, and technical collaboration skills.

What Success Looks Like
- Development and deployment of production‑grade agentic AI applications.
- Reliable orchestration and execution of AI agents and workflows.

- Improved AI application accuracy, reliability, observability, and performance.
- Reusable engineering practices for building and maintaining enterprise GenAI solutions.

Je onderzoekt hoe participatie en het uitdaagrecht binnen de gemeente kunnen worden ingericht en vertaalt dit naar concrete voorstellen. Wat je gaat doen:

  • Ontwikkelen en uitwerken van de Participatieverordening op basis van de VNG Model Participatieverordening 2024;

  • Ontwikkelen van voorstellen voor burgerafvaardiging bij de totstandkoming en evaluatie van gemeentelijk beleid;

  • Bewaken van de planning en voortgang van het traject;

  • Bijdragen aan de verdere implementatie en praktische uitwerking van de Participatieverordening na vaststelling.

Wat jij meebrengt:

  • Ervaring als Adviseur Participatie, beleidsadviseur of in een vergelijkbare functie binnen een gemeentelijke organisatie;

  • Kennis van gemeentelijke participatieprocessen en relevante wet- en regelgeving;

title: Pet Welfare Assistant - On-site Services, full & part-time opportunities
description:
Contract: Permanent
Hours: Full-time, 37.5 hours per week, or part-time, 26.25 or 22.5 hours per week
Salary: £24,976 per annum (FTE), pro rata to £17,484 (26.25 hours) or £14,986 (22.5 hours)
Location: Hitchin SG4 8EU
Closing date: Wednesday 25th November 2026
1st stage interview dates: 1st & 2nd December 2026
2nd stage animal handling assessment: 8th - 10th December 2026

We’re recruiting Pet Welfare Assistants for onsite animal care, for our Rehoming & Fostering team in Hertfordshire!
At Blue Cross, we're dedicated to providing the best care possible to pets in need. As a Pet Welfare Assistant for our onsite services, you'll play an important role in our mission, ensuring that every pet receives the love, attention, and support they deserve during their stay at our Hertfordshire rehoming centre.

Our Hertfordshire rehoming centre, based in Kimpton, originally opened in the 1940s and have facilities for dogs, cats and small pets. Our newly refurbished facilities include 20 kennels, five puppy pens and 29 cat pens, which includes a mother and kitten unit. We also have indoor rabbit space and rooms for small pets.

Our dedicated Rehoming & Fostering team, supported by an incredible network of volunteers, helps pets and people across Hertfordshire and beyond. The team plays a vital role in finding loving new homes for pets through both centre-based adoptions and our Home Direct scheme, which allows pets to remain in a home environment while they wait to be adopted. By working closely with adopters, owners and foster carers, the team helps ensure every pet has the best possible chance of finding the right home.
As a skilled animal handler and assessor, you will be responsible for the ‘preparation stage’ with the pets in our care which involves caring, carrying out assessments and rehabilitation plans, preparing them for the ‘adoption stage’ or the best possible outcome for their circumstances with minimal delay.
As a Pet Welfare Assistant, you will ensure that the welfare standards are met and that rehabilitation plans are followed and supported for pets in our care. Working independently and with the team you will carry out meetings with owners giving up their pet, ensuring all information is recorded, paperwork completed and that the pet is immediately assessed for behavioural or veterinary problems. Working closely with the Adoptions Coordinator you will provide additional in person or virtual advice and practical demonstrations to ensure adoptees are fully aware of the work that has been done with the pet and how to continue with any other additional behaviour training or medical provision.
We have three permanent roles available, one full-time role working 37.5 hours per week, one part-time role working an average of 26.25 hours per week and one part-time role working 22.5 hours per week. These are all worked across a two-week rota that includes every other weekend and occasional public holiday shifts.
Full-time working pattern:
Week one: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Friday, Saturday & Sunday
Week two: Monday, Wednesday, Thursday & Friday
Part-time, 26.25 hours per week working pattern:
Week one: Wednesday, Thursday, Saturday & Sunday
Week two: Monday, Wednesday & Friday
Part-time, 22.5 hours per week working pattern:
Week one: Monday, Thursday, Saturday & Sunday
Week two: Monday & Friday
At our Hertfordshire rehoming centre, we provide onsite accommodation for pets in our care 24/7. Overnight shifts are usually undertaken by team members who live on site. Occasionally, you will be expected to carry out night checks or stay in onsite accommodation overnight when the resident team members are either not working or away for a period of time.
If you excel in an environment where you can see the difference you make every day, then this is the role for you. Interested? Then apply and let’s work together to see if this is the role for you.
As a skilled animal handler and assessor, you will be intuitive with pets, empathetic and welfare focused having worked in a similar animal related environment. You will also be used to assessing the needs of a pet, alert to the behavioural signs and have a basic knowledge of the use of medication e.g., hibiscrub, flea and tick treatments, and diabetes management. In addition, you will have a fundamental understanding that the best welfare intervention for a pet is to find a new home and leave on site pet accommodation as quickly as possible.
You will be self-motivated, forward thinking with a collaborative and creative approach to your work, which will ensure to bring your best pragmatic ideas for the care of the pets to ensure the best outcome is achieved. In addition, you will be able to quickly assimilate information, be competent at accurately recording information while also conducting conversations with clients and stakeholders. You will be an excellent communicator, approachable with strong interpersonal skills.
You will know what it is like to work in an emotionally charged environment and have excellent ‘bounce back ability’ and resilience. In addition, you will be emotionally intelligent, showing empathy and knowing how to support clients and colleagues.
Knowledge, skills, and experience
  • Experience of having previously worked or volunteered with domestic animals or in an animal welfare environment.
  • Previous experience in working in a customer focused environment and used to achieving a high level of customer satisfaction.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Good organisational and administration skills to include computerised systems.
  • Current full driving licence.
It would be great (but not essential) if you also had:
  • Qualification or similar experience in animal behaviour or animal training.
  • Experience of cash handling
  • Experience of working to strict health and safety procedures.
  • Understanding of safeguarding issues.
Want to know more detail? Great! We have attached the job description which hopefully gives you everything you need.
The first stage of the recruitment process will be a competency-based interview via Microsoft Teams. Candidates who are successful at this stage will be invited to attend a second-stage practical animal handling assessment on-site at our Hertfordshire rehoming centre.
How to apply
Click the apply button below and complete the online application process before the closing date on Wednesday 25th November 2026.
We reserve the right to close this vacancy early should we receive an overwhelming response.

Using AI in your application
We’re happy for you to use AI tools to help you prepare your application, for example to organise your thoughts, improve clarity or check spelling and grammar. However, your application must be an honest reflection of your own skills, experience and achievements, and AI should not be used to write your application for you or create examples that aren’t your own.

Please read our guidance on using AI when applying to Blue Cross before submitting your application.
Our people are the most important part of delivering our purpose. If it were not for their amazing efforts and commitment, we would not be able to make the difference that we do today.
In return, Blue Cross wants to ensure we provide you with the best working environment we can. We want you to be happy working for us and will do everything we can to make sure you are.
Our generous benefits package includes:
  • Full time equivalent of 38 days holiday rising to 43 with service (including Bank Holidays)
  • Programmes for physical and mental wellbeing support
  • Free access to GP via MetLife- 24/7 GP services, private prescriptions and more for you and your family
  • Health cash plan
  • Unlimited access to an employee assistance programme
  • Pension scheme with enhanced employer contribution
  • Professional fees paid with Continuing Professional Development and personal development support.
  • Life assurance
  • 20% discount on Pet Plan pet insurance
  • Enhanced family friendly policies
  • Recognition scheme
  • Annual volunteer days
  • Charity worker discounts across a variety of retailers
To read more about the benefits Blue Cross has to offer, please visit the 'why work for us' page on our website.

title: YOUTH DEVELOPMENT PROFESSIONAL- EDUCATION - NORTHWEST ALACHUA
description:
YOUTH DEVELOPMENT PROFESSIONAL-EDUCATION - NORTHWEST ALACHUA


This position is designed to ensure that all Club members graduate from high school on time, ready for a post-secondary education and a 21st-century career.

The Education Youth Development Professional is part of a team-oriented Club staff dedicated to serving our youth and creating an optimal Club Experience. This position will plan, supervise and implement a variety of high-yield activities and targeted programs within a health and life skills focus.

This position is responsible for: ensuring youth development principles are incorporated into art programs and activities; providing guidance and discipline to ensure a safe and positive environment for youth; ensuring the incorporation of character development, age appropriate and gender-specific programs and activities; ensuring that culturally diverse programs are implemented; assisting, as needed, in the planning, implementation, and delivery of activities and programs for youth ages 6 to 18.

KEY ROLES (Essential Job Responsibilities):

Prepare Youth for Success

This position's primary responsibilities are:

  • Planning and implementing a variety of Educational programs for members of all ages, including Career Launch, Computer Science Pathway, Diplomas2Degrees, DIY STEM, Money Matters, Power Hour, Summer Brain Gain, Tech Girls Rock, & Ultimate Journey
  • Recruiting and retaining youth for educational programs
  • Working with other staff in the club to help implement these programs throughout the school year
  • Collect and maintain student grades and other educational data

This position helps members to make appropriate choices about their education, career, social, physical and emotional needs as it relates to health and their future goals. The position also assesses the developmental needs, interests and characteristics of youth to develop targeted programs that result in an outcome-driven club experience.

  1. Ensure programs, services and activities prepare youth for success, promoting safety of members, quality in programs and appearance of Club at all times. Provide guidance and role modeling to members.

  • Planning and organizing a range of program services and activities for members, such as field trips, program specific activities, guest speakers, field trips, etc.
  • Initiating new programs with the approval of the Program Director/Unit Director.
  • Promoting and stimulating program participation.
  1. Ensure quality improvement by monitoring and evaluating program achievement against target goals, recommending modifications that respond to member needs and interests and participating in weekly Club staff meetings.
  1. Participate in local, state, regional, and national Boys & Girls Clubs education programs and competitions.

Health and Safety

  1. Ensure a healthy and safe environment, supervising members in program area.
  2. Maintain the cleanliness of program area.
  3. Maintain an inventory of program equipment and supplies in good order. Recommend requisitions as necessary.

Program Administration

  1. Prepare weekly reports for the Program Director/Unit Director regarding activities, special programs, upcoming events, attendance, and other reports as required.
  2. Maintains a daily written schedule. Ensures that programs begin and end on time.

ADDITIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES

  1. May participate in additional special programs and/or events.
  2. Evenings/weekend work may be involved.
  3. May be required to drive the Club van.
    • (Requires valid driver’s license & three-year clean driving record)
  4. Other duties as assigned.

RELATIONSHIPS:

Internal: Maintains close, daily contact with club staff and volunteers, club members, and supervisor to receive/provide information, discuss issues, explain guidelines/instructions; instruct; and advise/counsel.

Requirements

Education

High School diploma or GED

Ability to pass DCF Level II background screening and drug test

Experience

  • Knowledge of youth development
  • Ability to motivate youth and manage behavior issues
  • Ability to work with the public
  • Ability to plan and implement quality programs specific to academic development
  • Ability to organize and supervise members in a safe environment

WORK ENVIRONMENT:

This position generally works M – F, 2 PM – 7 PM, but may require longer hours outside of this schedule and occasional weekends when necessary. Work is conducted indoors and outdoors.

PHYSICAL AND MENTAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Ability to sit, stand and walk for long periods of time; bending and squatting on occasion
  • Ability to lift to 20 lbs. on occasion
  • Ability to hear at a normal conversational level
  • Ability to maintain high energy level when necessary
  • High degree of emotional intelligence

The Boys and Girls Clubs of NE Florida is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer and Drug Free Workplace. To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential job duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform essential job functions.

This position requires a Level 2 background screening through the Care Provider Background Screening Clearinghouse as mandated by Florida Statute 435.12. For more information, please visit the Clearinghouse Applicant Education and Awareness website: https://info.flclearinghouse.com/

title: Service Manager - Change Management
description:
What are we building?

Hard Rock Digital is a fiercely focused team working to become the best online sportsbook, casino, and social gaming company in the world. We’re building a deeply curious team with a passion for learning, operating, and building new products and technologies for millions of consumers. We’re customer-obsessed — we care about each customer interaction, experience, behavior, and insight, and strive to ensure we’re always acting authentically.

Rooted in the kindred spirits of Hard Rock and the Seminole Tribe of Florida, Hard Rock Digital taps a brand known the world over as the leader in gaming, entertainment, and hospitality. We’re taking that foundation of success and bringing it to the digital space — ready to join us?

What’s the position?

We are looking for an experienced Service Manager to strengthen our Service Operations team and play a key role in our Change Management process. You will oversee the full lifecycle of infrastructure change using the 7 R’s approach. That covers Request for Change (RFC) intake, risk assessment, planning, communication, implementation and post-change review.

You will work closely with Release Management, DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), the Network Operations Center (NOC), Compliance, Security, Quality Assurance (QA) and Delivery Management. Together you will make sure changes are controlled, compliant and well coordinated in a fast-moving production environment that includes AWS, Kubernetes, CI/CD, network and platform infrastructure.

Change Management (Primary Scope)

  • Triage, analyze, and classify incoming RFCs for Infrastructure Production systems

  • Check RFCs for quality: completeness, clarity, lower-environment testing, links to projects or incidents, and implementation, validation and back-out plans

  • Assess change risk using the standardized Risk Assessment Matrix

  • Identify when Compliance approval is required (data access, network/firewall changes, firmware/OS updates, database maintenance, vendor-recommended security upgrades)

  • Plan changes within approved Change Windows, in line with the Release Calendar and Major Business Events (e.g., NFL)

  • Prepare and lead the weekly CAB meeting

  • Create, manage, and maintain RFC records through completion, with proper documentation for audit and operational continuity

  • Coordinate with DevOps, SRE, QA and NOC teams so implementations go smoothly and safely

  • Send proactive communications before, during, and after changes across the relevant Slack channels

  • Manage dedicated Slack channels for complex changes so stakeholders have real-time visibility

  • Maintain the Maintenance Calendar and Maintenance Schedule in Confluence

  • Store completed change history for audit, knowledge management, and service continuity

  • Support Emergency Changes, including taking part in Emergency CABs

  • Review and log retrospective changes introduced during major incidents

  • Contribute to Change Performance Reporting against set KPIs and other initiatives

Collaboration with Release Management

  • Coordinate changes that are tied to or depend on bi-weekly releases

  • Understand release workflows, cut-offs, compliance steps, QA validation, and hotfix processes

  • Take part in Go/No-Go meetings and Release Implementations where required

Incident & Problem Management Support

  • Take part in Post-Change Reviews (PCRs) when a change has caused unplanned service impact

  • Feed lessons learned back into runbooks and risk scoring

Other Responsibilities

  • Monitor key Slack channels (e.g., Service Alerts, Production Incidents, DevOps) for issues that could affect upcoming changes

  • Take part in Continual Service Improvement (CSI) initiatives, including process and tooling improvements

  • Build strong communication and collaboration across engineering, product, and operations teams

What are we looking for?

  • 3+ years in Change Management, Service Management, Incident/Problem Management, or similar roles

  • Experience in cloud or distributed infrastructure environments, ideally with AWS, Kubernetes, and DevOps practices

  • Hands-on experience managing changes in ITIL-based or ITIL-aligned organizations

  • Experience in highly regulated organizations

  • Experience running CAB meetings and coordinating technical teams

  • Proficiency with ITSM ticketing tools (e.g., Jira, ServiceNow) and collaboration tools (e.g., Confluence, Slack)

  • Practical experience using AI assistants (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot) to speed up change documentation, RFC quality reviews, and stakeholder communications

  • Experience building or using AI Skills or Agents embedded in ITSM tools (e.g., Claude Skills, Jira Automation AI, Atlassian Intelligence)

  • Familiarity with workflow automation tools that integrate AI (e.g., Power Automate, Jira Automation) to reduce manual work in change routing and notifications

  • Ability to write prompts that produce consistent, accurate output for ITSM workflows (RFC narratives, risk summaries, CAB agenda items, PCR reports)

Skills & Competencies

  • Excellent written and verbal communication

  • Strong analytical mindset and close attention to detail

  • Problem Management

  • Ability to prioritize, multitask, and manage time under pressure, working with the team to renegotiate deadlines when needed

  • Confident stakeholder management, including constructively challenging Change Requestors and Implementors

  • Ability to manage multiple resources and stakeholders when planning and delivering change, especially high-risk or complex change

  • Strong process design and ownership

  • Critical review of AI-generated content before it is used in production workflows or regulatory-facing documentation

  • Clear understanding of where AI-assisted drafts end and human-owned decisions begin, especially in compliance-sensitive changes

Preferred Qualifications

  • Understanding of AWS fundamentals, networking, security concepts, or CI/CD toolchains

  • ITIL Certification (minimum Foundation)

  • Experience in organizations practicing DevOps, SRE, or Continuous Delivery

  • Formal AI literacy training or certification (e.g., Microsoft AI Fundamentals, Anthropic prompt engineering, Google AI Essentials)

What’s in it for you?

We offer our employees more than just competitive compensation. Our team benefits include:

  • Competitive pay and benefits

  • Flexible vacation allowance

  • Startup culture backed by a secure, global brand

Roster of Uniques

We care deeply about every interaction our customers have with us, and trust and empower our staff to own and drive their experience. Our vision for our business and customers is built on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where regardless of background or beliefs you feel able to be authentic and bring all your talent into play. We want to celebrate you being you (we are an equal opportunity employer).

title: Research Associate, UK & Ireland
description:
The role sits within the Ireland research team and presents an opportunity to develop knowledge on a wide array of subjects: renewable and flexibility markets and business model, network analysis and impacts on asset economics and capacity deployment.


As a Research Associate, you will be expected to lead with increasing independence on key workstreams and then whole projects. Key projects include Power and Renewables Market Forecast, Flexible Energy Market Forecast, Strategic Insights Reports (“Group Meetings”), Policy Notes, Grid publications, Chronos externalisation, etc.


The role involves extensive client interaction, through client workshops and group meetings. This role may require travels to Ireland for in-person client meetings and group meetings. Within Aurora, the role will require considerable interaction with modelling, software and advisory teams.

  • Lead a project team with 1-3 colleagues in developing timely and rigorous quantitative analysis on renewable/flexible technologies to enhance the client’s decision making.
  • Monitor the latest European policy and market developments.
  • Maintain and improve Aurora’s tools regarding technology and financing costs by

o analysing key global commodity and supply chain trends


o tracking innovations in energy technologies, and


o collaborating with stakeholders to develop Aurora’s long-term cost forecasts.

  • Coordinate with Aurora’s Global offices to share knowledge on global technology trends and foster alignment of key assumptions.
  • Draw insights out of the analysis you produce and communicate findings to internal and external clients, and at conferences by creating compelling presentations.
  • Engage with clients to thoroughly understand their interests and gain new insights.
  • Contribute to our Pan-European product development, by identifying new opportunities and expanding our capabilities.

Required attributes:
  • At least 3 years of experience at a leading consultancy, energy company, energy project developer, investment bank or other knowledge-driven firms or institutions (e.g. Think tank, Research or university institute).
  • A university degree in either a quantitative subject, coupled with a keen interest in policy developments, or a social science, environmental studies or a related field, coupled with an interest in quantitative analysis.
  • Demonstrated success in leading projects and processes in team-orientated environments.
  • A proven ability to collect, analyse and interpret complex quantitative data and information.
  • An ability to communicate and collaborate with both technical and non-technical parties.
  • Competence in advanced data analytics (e.g. Python, R, Matlab, Advanced Excel, GAMS)
  • Proficiency (C1 Level) in English.
  • Strong interest in energy markets, previous professional or academic exposure to energy beneficial.

Desirable attributes:
  • Experience in working with energy system and/or optimization models.

Some of the benefits we include are:

title: Packhouse Manager (Presorting)
description:

PACKHOUSE MANAGER (PRESORTING)

title: Senior Software Engineer, OS Integration
description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About the OS Integration team:

The OS Integration team ensures Firefox works well with the host operating system and environment. We’re a distributed team with expertise in Windows, macOS, and Linux-based operating systems. Our responsibilities include developing fixes and improvements for Firefox related to Windows, macOS, and Linux environments. This might include integration with a new OS feature or fixing an OS-specific user interface bug. Other responsibilities include native crash reporting, OS abstraction layers, sandboxing, hardening, updater, and enterprise DLP support.

About the role:

As a member of the OS Integration team, you’ll develop fixes, improvements, and new features for Firefox. In many cases work may be cross-platform or have a cross-platform component. This role will include maintenance and development of the installer and updater of Firefox. You’ll contribute to the team through code review and discussion.

What you’ll do:

  • Improve the quality of Firefox and other Mozilla products by debugging and fixing software defects, improving the browsing experience for hundreds of millions of users.
  • Contribute to new features and improvements.
  • Break down tasks and work with others to deliver solutions.
  • Collaborate with experienced software engineers.
  • Perform code reviews and provide technical direction.
  • Work with a geographically-distributed development team.
  • Interact with teams throughout the organization.

What you’ll bring:

  • 5+ years of overall software engineering experience
  • Strong knowledge of C and C++
  • Experience with desktop application development on Windows, macOS, or Linux with C++.
  • Knowledge of web technologies such as Javascript and HTML.
  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and memory safety concerns.
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.
  • Written and verbal communication skills with a collaborative mindset.
  • Willingness to work effectively in a distributed team environment.
  • Commitment to our values:
    • Play to win
    • Build for People first
    • Engage Evidence over Ego
    • Decide and Deliver
    • Ship, learn and repeat

Bonus Points for experience with:

  • Installer and/or Updater development on any OS
  • Windows internals like the BITS server or MSIX packages
  • Open-source contributions or personal engineering projects

What you’ll get:

  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
  • Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together
  • Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
  • One-time home office stipend
  • Annual professional development budget
  • Considerable paid parental leave
  • Employee referral bonus program
  • Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)

About Mozilla

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging

Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientations, gender identities, and expressions.

title: Copy of Weather Forecaster/Observer-Whidbey Island, WA
description:
RedTown Technical Services, LLC seeks an experienced, certified Weather Forecaster/Observer for this part-time, rotating position.


The Weather Forecaster/Observer performs meteorological weather watch consisting of taking, evaluating, recording, and disseminating surface weather observations (METAR/SPECI); issuing Terminal Aerodrome Forecasts; writing DD-175-1s, issuing and disseminating weather watches, warnings, and advisories; and responding to PMSV; and dissemination of PIREPs.


Hourly pay begins $46.34 Forecaster rate and $39.43 per hour Observer rate plus $6.75 per hour for up to 40 hours per week Health & Welfare. The candidate will be paid at the observer rate during the certification process and when working observer-only shifts. Night and Sunday differential is compounded to base pay.


Role and Responsibilities

  • Performs Meteorological Weather Watch, taking, evaluating, recording, encoding, and disseminating surface weather observations
  • Operates the Pilot to Metro Service
  • Monitors radar and satellite imagery
  • Issues weather warnings, watches, and advisories
  • Receives and disseminates PIREPs
  • Provides DD-175-1, canned route, and over the counter briefings
  • Writes and disseminates Terminal Aerodrome Forecasts

Qualifications/Education Requirements

  • Must be a U.S. Citizen
  • Obtain and maintain eligibility for a DoD CAC
  • Resumes must reflect the minimum qualifications of 2 years of aviation forecast experience with a DoD or other government agency that included flight weather briefings and unmanned systems familiarity within the past 10 years.
  • Prior observation certification with the Department of Defense (DoD), Federal Aviation Administration, or National Weather Service, including two years of experience in observing, taking, recording, and disseminating surface weather observations using Meteorological Aviation Routine Weather Report (METAR) code
  • Prior forecaster certification with the Department of Defense (DoD) or National Weather Service, including two years of experience in aviation forecasting.
  • Must have completed a DoD formal training program for weather observing AND forecasting or equivalent National Weather Service program. Must provide proof of completion.
  • Visual acuity correctable to 20/20 with glasses or contacts
  • Demonstrate sufficient ability to operate all meteorological and communications equipment required for certification.
  • Speak, read, and understand English, and communicate well.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with the Navy’s Flight Weather Briefer program
  • Persons currently holding an active Navy CAC or having an active security clearance within the past 2-years
  • Experience operating the Automated Service Operating System (ASOS)

Physical and Mental Requirements


The selected candidate may work solo in an office type atmosphere. Meals are taken in conjunction with the shift and candidates will have access to a refrigerator, microwave, and limited vending machines. The workload will vary and may be stressful at times when bad weather is present. Due to the nature of the position, the candidate can expect to be exposed to the weather elements on a regular basis and may be required to climb stairs. May be required to work nights, weekends, and occasional holidays.

  • Tworzenie dokumentacji wdrożeniowej, instrukcji i runbooków dla zespołu utrzymaniowego.

title: Automotive Embedded Build & CI/CD Engineer
description:
Project description

We are looking for an Automotive Embedded Build & CI/CD Engineer to establish and integrate a software build environment for an automotive Engine Control Module (ECM). The project focuses on implementing a reliable and reproducible build and CI environment, integrating automotive compiler toolchains, ECU software builds, automated testing, and virtual ECU/SIL testing into the customer's development infrastructure.

Responsibilities

  • - Set up and maintain a Linux-based build environment for embedded ECU software. - Integrate and configure TriCore compiler toolchains and related dependencies. - Configure build agents and integrate them with Zuul-based CI pipelines. - Develop and maintain automation using Python, Bash and YAML. - Integrate artifact and dependency management using JFrog Artifactory and Conan. - Support ECU software integration, compilation and automated unit, merge and integration testing. - Integrate and maintain SIL / virtual ECU testing using tools such as Synopsys Silver. - Ensure reproducible builds, dependency/version control and build traceability. - Troubleshoot build, compiler, dependency and CI/CD issues. - Document build environment setup, configuration and troubleshooting procedures.

SKILLS

Must have

  • - Strong experience with embedded software build systems and cross-compilation. - Strong Linux knowledge and build-environment administration. - Experience with CI/CD pipelines, ideally Zuul, Jenkins and Git/Gerrit. - Python, Bash and YAML scripting/automation. - Experience with embedded/automotive compiler and toolchain integration. - Experience with ECU software integration and integration builds. - Good understanding of AUTOSAR and automotive embedded software architecture. - Experience with automated unit and integration testing. - Strong troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills. - Good communication skills and ability to work independently across multiple stakeholder teams.

Nice to have

- Infineon TriCore compiler/toolchain experience. - Synopsys Silver or other virtual ECU/SIL environments. - JFrog Artifactory and Conan. - Ansible, Docker, Packer and Terraform. - Experience with build reproducibility and complex dependency management. - Working knowledge of ISO 26262, including tool qualification considerations

title: Principal Java Engineer - Distributed Systems, Serverless - Elasticsearch
description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What Is The Role:

We are on the lookout for a Principal Software Engineer to join our Elasticsearch - Distributed Systems team and focus on how Elasticsearch provides scale, performance, and resilience, especially in the context of our Serverless offering. You will be tackling deep distributed systems challenges in how nodes in an Elasticsearch cluster communicate, and how data are indexed, allocated, and managed across nodes.

What You Will Be Doing:

  • Leveraging your deep distributed systems expertise to design, build, and operate core pieces of our next-generation Serverless Elasticsearch offering, directly impacting the experience of customers worldwide.
  • Improving Elasticsearch’s components that support concurrent and consistent indexing across multiple machines.
  • Maintaining our cluster coordination system to keep performance high even though nodes come and go from the cluster and data moves around, while maintaining the safety and liveness properties of the system as a whole.
  • Pushing the limits on the number of shards, nodes, and petabytes that Elasticsearch can handle today.
  • Looking into all kinds of issues, including performance or concurrency issues, and proposing solutions.
  • Supporting our support engineers with the harder problems.
  • Owning operational investigations end-to-end, until performance or stability issues are successfully resolved.

What You Bring:

  • You have a deep background in distributed systems and consensus algorithms.
  • You have strong skills in core Java and are conversant in the standard library of data structures and concurrency constructs, as well as newer language features.
  • You have a deep technical proficiency in algorithms.
  • You have experience building large-scale distributed systems, rather than making use of off-the-shelf services.
  • You have experience building and debugging complex features with a broad impact, running on multiple machines.
  • You are able to own projects from beginning to end. This covers both technical design and working with others to develop needed components.
  • You have experience managing projects involving multiple engineers.
  • You have a proven track record of using AI to accelerate development, debug complex systems, and optimize code, while still owning the final outcomes.
  • You possess the ability to collaborate across functions and teams and seamlessly transition between different projects, codebases, or teams based on business priorities
  • You can work autonomously, drive decisions and results in a distributed team by leveraging asynchronous, direct, and transparent communication.

Bonus Points:

  • Data stores
  • Search, analytics, Lucene
  • Strong knowledge of the JDK
  • Asynchronous event-driven network frameworks such as Netty

Compensation for this role is in the form of base salary. This role does not have a variable compensation component.

At Elastic, our compensation philosophy aims to provide fair, competitive and transparent remuneration. Salary ranges are established based on a combination of external market benchmarks, internal pay equity considerations, and the responsibilities and complexity associated with each role. This approach helps ensure consistency across comparable roles while remaining competitive within the relevant labour markets.

The final compensation offered within the applicable range will be determined based on several objective factors, including relevant professional experience, level of skills and expertise, alignment with the role requirements, and the overall scope and complexity of the position.

The typical starting salary range for this role is:
326.400 Lei—516.400 Lei RON

Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People

As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.

We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.

  • Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary
  • Health coverage for you and your family in many locations
  • Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles
  • Generous number of vacation days each year
  • Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service
  • Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love
  • Embracing parenthood with minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave

Different people approach problems differently. We need that. Elastic is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive culture that celebrates different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law, ordinance or regulation.

title: Director of WDLL Enrollment Systems and Services
description:
Job Description
