GENERAL STATEMENT OF JOB

This position manages the operational activities of the Division of Workforce Development and Lifelong Learning including customer service, noncredit registration, collection of fees, and submission of reports and evaluations.

SPECIFIC DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Essential Functions:

  1. Serves as division representative for all Colleague and Modern Campus related issues, including testing of new releases, working with the College’s Information Technology and Destiny Support Team to resolve concerns that may affect registration and transcription of student records.
  1. Acts as a customer service supervisor resolving student complaints that have escalated.
  1. Interacts with Division Directors and staff to maintain success of programs and resolve issues that may occur.
  1. Supervises the division customer service and registration staff, i.e. employee scheduling, time-off approval, training, motivation and performance appraisals.
  1. Develops systems for document control.
  1. Schedules division staff to ensure office coverage: daily, evenings, summers (Monday-Friday) and weekends, as well as for special events such as the Summer Camp Open House.
  1. Oversees preparation of billings and reimbursements for students and online courses as well as professional certification courses.
  1. Directs daily reconciliation of tuition and fees for Workforce Development and Lifelong Learning registrations. Resolves issues with Director, Financial and Student Account Services as needed.
  1. Serves as registrar for the division and oversees preparation and issuance of noncredit certificates, transcripts and completion letters.
  1. Oversees the WDLL Scholarship Committee. Responsible for the scholarship application process, oversight of the WDLL Scholarship Committee, and informing students of scholarship awards. Responsible for invoicing for scholarships.
  1. Assists with inputting courses into the Modern Campus system and proofing of course bulletins.
  1. Oversees the tracking of registrations and tuition received for all WDLL courses each semester.
  1. Oversees Modern Campus and Colleague training of division directors and support personnel.
  1. Works with the Office of Institutional Research to plan and implement routine research concerning enrollments, status, and success of course offerings.
  1. Oversees the WDLL Outreach Committee. Responsible for tracking, outreach requests, and recruiting WDLL staff to represent WDLL at various outreach events.
  1. Ensures that the monthly report for the Board is completed in a timely manner.
  1. Ensures accuracy of division reports, including the SURE Report to Institutional Research and the Department of Higher Education.
  1. Serves as Program Manager and customer service contact person for Ed2go online courses. Assists students with the selection, registration, and payment of online courses. Resolves concerns that may arise during the registration process.
  1. Serves as National Clearing House contact person for non-credit student education verification requests.
  1. Performs other duties as assigned.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree
  • Five (5) years of progressively responsible experience in registration services, enrollment operations, student services, continuing education, workforce development, or a related operational environment.
  • Two (2) years of experience with data retrieval, reporting, reconciliation, or records management.
  • Experience working with registration, student information, enrollment management, or comparable administrative systems
  • Supervisory experience
  • Excellent customer service and organizational skills
  • Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills
  • Strong computer skills with knowledge of Microsoft Office

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Master’s degree
  • Experience with Ellucian Colleague, Modern Campus, or comparable student information and registration systems.
  • Experience supporting noncredit, continuing education, workforce development, or lifelong learning programs in a higher education environment.
  • Experience with student records, registration, enrollment reporting, and/or financial reconciliation processes

SCHEDULE:Monday – Friday, 8:30 a.m. – 4:30 p.m.

Occasional evenings and weekends as needed.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Data Platform (Foundational Engineering)
description:
About Glass Lewis & Clarity AI
Founded in 2003, Glass Lewis is a leading global provider of independent, intelligence-focused corporate governance, stewardship, and proxy voting solutions. The firm serves more than 1,300 investment managers and pension funds globally, who use its high-quality corporate governance research and proxy voting software to carry out their fiduciary duties. Glass Lewis also helps companies understand corporate governance best practices and how investors view them. Headquartered in San Francisco, Glass Lewis has offices in North America, the United Kingdom, Europe, Asia, and Australia.
In September 2026, Glass Lewis and Clarity AI joined forces to integrate sustainability, governance and stewardship. Glass Lewis looks for people who take ownership, act with integrity, remain curious, and make thoughtful decisions that build trust with clients and colleagues. To learn more, visit .

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer in Madrid to own the data platform in the Foundational Engineering team.
You are a software engineer who likes data. You build the systems that send our data to clients. You know how that data moves from its source to the release.
Our team builds the platform that all of Tech uses. On the data side, the platform has two parts:
  • The data release. This is the regular process that sends our ESG and investment data to clients. An application runs it. The application tracks the state of each release and shows teams what is ready, what failed, and what to retry.
  • The pipeline platform. This is Airflow on Kubernetes. Every team depends on it.

Why we are hiring now
Clarity AI and Glass Lewis are now one company. The data platform is at the center of this integration. More data, more products, and more teams will depend on the release. We need a person who can own it in the first months. You will make it more reliable and easier for teams to use on their own. You will also help bring Glass Lewis data into it.

Responsibilities

  • Own the release application. It is a Python service (FastAPI, Postgres, Argo Workflows) with a web UI. It manages release state, product dependencies, readiness checks, retries, and hotfixes.
  • Make the release stable. Find why releases fail and fix the root cause. Automate incident diagnosis, so that each failure tells you its cause.
  • Run the pipeline platform. Keep Airflow on Kubernetes healthy, up to date and secure. This includes Helm, secrets, resource sizes, retries after short failures, and monitoring.
  • Build self-service tools for data teams. They must be able to add a product to the release, see its dependencies and debug their own runs. They must not have to wait for us.
  • Work with the teams that depend on the release: data, product and client teams. Learn what they need. Agree on data contracts with upstream teams. Decide with the team what to build next.
  • Help design how Glass Lewis data comes into our platform and the release.

Requirements

  • 6+ years of software development experience. You have built data-heavy systems or a data platform.
  • Strong Python skills, for example, FastAPI. Good design, automated tests, and clean APIs. Go or TypeScript is a plus.
  • Hands-on work with Airflow or a similar tool. You understand how data moves through pipelines that depend on each other.
  • Good SQL. You know Postgres and a cloud data warehouse. Snowflake is best.
  • Containers, Kubernetes and CI/CD. You can run what you build in production.
  • Testing is part of the work for you, not a step for later. This includes data quality.
  • A product mindset. You care about the people who use the platform and about results.
  • Ownership. You lead technical designs, deliver large pieces of work across several systems, and get agreement from others.
  • Experience with Lean and XP: trunk-based development, TDD, pair and ensemble programming, small safe steps.
  • You use AI agents (Claude Code, Cursor, MCPs, and similar) to build and run systems.
  • Fluent English. Spanish is a plus.
  • You live in Spain. We pair in real time, so we work in the same time zone.

Nice to have
  • dbt, data quality tools (Soda, Great Expectations), and data contracts.
  • Argo Workflows, Helm, Terraform on AWS.
  • Monitoring for pipelines: Grafana, Loki, Datadog.
  • Financial or ESG data, or data products for clients.
  • DDD and Team Topologies.
Work in a scale-up or SaaS company, or in a merger.

Benefits

  • Comprehensive Private Health Insurance coverage
  • Access to Wellhub wellness and fitness programs
  • Professional Development Stipend to support continuous learning and career growth
  • Flexible Benefits Program, including meal vouchers, transportation support, and nursery assistance

title: YDP - ART - Roberts
description:
YOUTH DEVELOPMENT PROFESSIONAL - ART - Roberts


This position is designed to foster creativity in young people and give them outlets for self-expression. From photography to hip-hop, our arts programs have something that will inspire everyone.

The Art Youth Development Professional is part of a team-oriented Club staff dedicated to serving our youth and creating an optimal Club Experience. This position will plan, supervise and implement a variety of high-yield activities and targeted programs within a health and life skills focus.

This position is responsible for ensuring youth development principles are incorporated into art programs and activities; providing guidance and discipline to ensure a safe and positive environment for youth; ensuring the incorporation of character development, age-appropriate and gender-specific programs and activities; ensuring that culturally diverse programs are implemented; assisting, as needed, in the planning, implementation, and delivery of activities and programs for youth ages 6 to 18.

Visual Arts – Visual art created and judged for its beauty and meaning. It may include painting, sculpture, drawing, printmaking, collage, mixed media, graphics and architecture.

Digital Arts – Two- or three-dimensional visual media that uses computers and other technology as an essential part of the creative process. This may include graphic design, animation, photography, movie making, Claymation, game design, music composition and digital illustration.

Performing Arts – Arts that involve public performance, including playing instruments, acting, singing and dancing. This includes performance support roles, such as creating scenery, costumes, lighting and sound manipulation.

Applied Arts – Any art form that applies artistic design to functional objects. This includes industrial design, bookmaking, illustration, printmaking, jewelry making, wood working, ceramics, fashion design, culinary arts, creative writing and commercial art.

KEY ROLES (Essential Job Responsibilities):

Prepare Youth for Success

This position’s primary responsibilities are:

  • Planning and implementing a variety of art programs for members of all ages, including National Arts Contests, Drama Matters, Lyrism 101, Music Makers, Media Making, & National Photography Program.
  • Recruiting and retaining youth for art programs
  • Working with other staff in the club to help implement these programs throughout the school year

This position helps members to make appropriate choices about their education, career, social, physical and emotional needs as it relates to health and their future goals. The position also assesses the developmental needs, interests and characteristics of youth to develop targeted programs that result in an outcome-driven club experience.

  1. Ensure programs, services and activities prepare youth for success, promoting safety of members, quality in programs and appearance of Club at all times. Provide guidance and role modeling to members.
  2. Contribute to the planning and implementation of the strategic plan by:
  • Planning and organizing a range of program services and activities for members, such as field trips, program specific activities, guest speakers, field trips, etc.
  • Initiating new programs with the approval of the Program Director/Unit Director.
  • Promoting and stimulating program participation.
  1. Ensure quality improvement by monitoring and evaluating program achievement against target goals, recommending modifications that respond to member needs and interests and participating in weekly Club staff meetings.

  1. Participate in local, state, regional, and national Boys & Girls Clubs art programs and competitions.

Health and Safety

  1. Ensure a healthy and safe environment, supervising members in program area.
  2. Maintain the cleanliness of program area.
  3. Maintain an inventory of program equipment and supplies in good order. Recommend requisitions as necessary.

Program Administration

  1. Prepare weekly reports for the Program Director/Unit Director regarding activities, special programs, upcoming events, attendance, and other reports as required.
  2. Maintains a daily written schedule. Ensures that programs begin and end on time.

ADDITIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES

  1. May participate in additional special programs and/or events.
  2. Evenings/weekend work may be involved.
  3. May be required to drive Club van.
    • (Requires valid driver’s license & three-year clean driving record)
  4. Other duties as assigned.

RELATIONSHIPS:

Internal: Maintains close, daily contact with club staff and volunteers, club members, and supervisor to receive/provide information, discuss issues, explain guidelines/instructions, instruct, and advise/counsel.

Requirements

Education

High School diploma or GED

Ability to pass DCF Level II background screening and drug test

Experience

  • Knowledge of youth development
  • Ability to motivate youth and manage behavior issues
  • Ability to work with the public
  • Ability to plan and implement quality programs specific to The Arts
  • Ability to organize and supervise members in a safe environment

WORK ENVIRONMENT:

This position generally works M–F, between the hours of 2 PM – 7 PM, but may require longer hours outside of this schedule and occasional weekends when necessary. Work is conducted indoors and outdoors.

PHYSICAL AND MENTAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Ability to sit, stand, and walk for long periods; bending and squatting on occasion
  • Ability to lift up to 20 lbs. on occasion
  • Ability to hear at a normal conversational level
  • Ability to maintain a high energy level when necessary
  • High degree of emotional intelligence

  • Monitor relevant local, state, and federal policy developments, legislative initiatives, public funding mechanisms, and governmental decisions that may affect the agency’s strategic interests, community investment opportunities, or populations served

  • Monitor regional economic development initiatives and emerging community needs that may create opportunities to expand or improve agency services

  • Identify opportunities associated with major regional investments, including PORTS development, and help translate those opportunities into sustainable community benefits

  • Coordinate with program directors and executive leadership to identify organizational capabilities, service gaps, and potential partnerships

  • Facilitate collaboration among public agencies, nonprofit organizations, private employers, and community stakeholders to address identified needs

  • Support community engagement activities that incorporate the perspectives of low-income residents and other populations served by the agency

  • Develop an annual strategic work plan identifying priorities, target relationships, timelines, resource requirements, and measurable outcomes

Functional Area: Corporate Partnerships & Community Investment

Estimated Effort: 20%

  • Identify, cultivate, solicit, negotiate, and steward corporate partnerships, sponsorships, employee engagement opportunities, in-kind contributions, and community investment commitments within delegated authority

  • Build relationships with major employers, corporate foundations, regional economic development entities, utilities, contractors, and other organizations investing in or serving Southern Ohio

  • Develop partnership concepts and investment packages that connect partner priorities with documented community needs and agency programs

  • Coordinate cross-program proposals and partnership activities with program directors, Fiscal, Compliance, communications, and other appropriate staff

  • Ensure partnership commitments are properly documented, approved, tracked, and fulfilled

  • Elevate proposed agreements, restricted gifts, and resource commitments for required review and authorization

  • Protect agency independence, client interests, confidentiality, and mission alignment in all corporate and community relationships

  • Support the development and implementation of community benefit agreements and related investment arrangements

  • Collaborate with Workforce & Business Development leadership to ensure corporate engagement activities complement existing employer services and workforce partnerships

Functional Area: Strategic Initiatives & Major Project Development

Estimated Effort: 20%

  • Support the President/CEO in advancing major organizational development initiatives requiring external partnerships, community investment, or coordination among multiple stakeholders

  • Coordinate resource development and external partnership activities associated with strategic capital projects, including the proposed Bailey Square Wellness Campus

  • Identify potential public, private, corporate, and philanthropic funding partners for major organizational initiatives

  • Support development of financing concepts, partnership proposals, and investment strategies in collaboration with executive leadership and Fiscal

  • Facilitate relationships among project stakeholders, including public agencies, private developers, community organizations, and potential funding partners

  • Track and report strategic development milestones, external funding opportunities, partnership commitments, and outstanding decisions associated with assigned initiatives

  • Support initiatives that connect regional economic growth with expanded access to healthcare, childcare, housing, transportation, workforce services, and other essential community resources

  • Identify opportunities for collaborative projects that strengthen community infrastructure and create lasting benefits for residents

  • Coordinate with program leadership to ensure major initiatives are operationally feasible and consistent with organizational capacity

  • Provide timely updates to the President/CEO regarding significant developments, barriers, emerging opportunities, and decisions requiring executive attention

Functional Area: Fundraising & Private Resource Development

Estimated Effort: 20%

  • Develop, implement, and manage an annual fundraising and private resource development plan, including corporate giving, foundation support, major gifts, sponsorships, special campaigns, and in-kind resources

  • Research and qualify prospective donors and funding partners

  • Maintain a prioritized prospect pipeline with documented next steps, estimated opportunity value, probability, and anticipated decision timelines

  • Prepare or coordinate letters of inquiry, funding proposals, sponsorship requests, presentations, cases for support, and donor investment materials in collaboration with program and Fiscal staff

  • Lead donor cultivation, solicitation, acknowledgement, stewardship, renewal, and recognition activities, ensuring timely and accurate follow-up

  • Coordinate with Program Directors, Fiscal, and current grant development staff to identify private and corporate grant opportunities

  • Avoid duplication of assigned government grant administration or existing grant-management responsibilities

  • Collaborate with the Chief Financial Officer and program leadership to assess funding restrictions, indirect and administrative costs, sustainability, match requirements, reporting obligations, and the full cost of proposed commitments

  • Maintain accurate records that distinguish secured funding, executed commitments, pending requests, and prospective opportunities

  • Ensure unapproved or speculative opportunities are not represented as secured revenue

  • Identify opportunities to secure unrestricted or flexible resources that strengthen the agency’s long-term organizational capacity

Functional Area: Communications, Stewardship & Impact Reporting

Estimated Effort: 10%

  • Develop clear corporate-facing and donor-facing materials that communicate the agency’s mission, services, community needs, outcomes, and opportunities for investment

  • Coordinate partner recognition, approved announcements, site visits, presentations, and other stewardship activities with the President/CEO and appropriate agency staff

  • Collaborate with program and data staff to collect and communicate measurable outcomes associated with funded initiatives and partnership commitments

  • Prepare quarterly reports for the President/CEO summarizing relationship activity, proposals, funding pipeline, commitments received, stewardship status, risks, and recommended actions

  • Prepare an annual community investment and resource development report documenting contributions, partnerships, use of funds as appropriate, and community impact

  • Maintain accurate donor, prospect, agreement, correspondence, and reporting records in agency-approved systems

Functional Area: Administration, Collaboration & Accountability

Estimated Effort: 5%

  • Collaborate across agency departments and programs to coordinate community engagement and resource development activities without assuming operational authority over those departments

  • Develop annual work plans, budgets, performance measures, and a calendar of fundraising and partner-engagement activities for President/CEO review and approval

  • Monitor performance against approved goals and recommend adjustments based on results, funding trends, partner feedback, and changing community needs

  • Follow agency policies and applicable requirements concerning gift acceptance, conflicts of interest, privacy, records retention, financial controls, procurement, lobbying, and use of restricted funds

  • Provide timely information and recommendations to the President/CEO

  • Obtain required approval before executing binding agreements, accepting restricted contributions when approval is required, or committing agency resources

  • Perform other related duties as assigned by the President/CEO that are consistent with the scope and level of the position

Initial Deliverables & Performance Expectations

First 90 Days

  • Develop and present a President/CEO-approved 12-month strategic work plan

  • Complete an organizational assessment of priority resource-development needs and opportunities

  • Develop a stakeholder map and prioritized list of prospective funding and community-investment partners

  • Establish a system for tracking relationships, proposals, funding opportunities, and strategic initiatives

  • Conduct approximately 10–15 substantive stakeholder meetings

  • Identify priority opportunities associated with PORTS, Bailey Square, and other emerging community-development initiatives

  • Establish coordination protocols with Workforce & Business Development and other program leadership

By Six Months

  • Maintain a qualified pipeline of approximately 15–20 prospective funding and partnership opportunities

  • Submit or coordinate approximately 5–8 substantive partnership or investment proposals

  • Develop 3–5 program-aligned community-investment concepts

  • Demonstrate measurable progress on designated strategic initiatives

  • Demonstrate consistent and timely completion of monthly development-pipeline updates and quarterly performance reports

  • Identify opportunities for recurring revenue, unrestricted resources, or sustainable program expansion

By Twelve Months

  • Establish approximately 5–8 active new corporate, philanthropic, or community-investment partnerships

  • Submit or coordinate approximately 10–15 substantive funding or partnership proposals

  • Develop a qualified resource-development pipeline with a preliminary planning target of $1 million–$2 million, subject to market conditions and organizational priorities

  • Develop and actively pursue an initial planning target of $250,000–$500,000 in new philanthropic or corporate commitments, recognizing that actual results depend on available opportunities, funding cycles, organizational priorities, and timing of major strategic investments

  • Demonstrate substantive progress toward securing investment in one or more major organizational initiatives

  • Document the financial and nonfinancial value generated through partnership development and strategic coordination

  • Present a comprehensive first-year performance assessment and recommendations for the position’s continued development and financial sustainability

Minimum Requirements

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Nonprofit Management, Public Administration, Communications, Marketing, Social Sciences, or a related field

  • Equivalent relevant experience may be considered in lieu of the degree requirement

Job-Related Experience

  • Minimum of five (5) years of progressively responsible experience in corporate relations, fundraising, philanthropy, business development, community engagement, nonprofit development, or a related field

  • Demonstrated experience developing partnerships and securing financial or in-kind commitments

  • Demonstrated working knowledge of governmental, political, economic development, and institutional structures in Southern Ohio, particularly Pike County and the surrounding region

  • Knowledge of local, state, and federal governmental decision-making processes, public funding mechanisms, and relationships among elected officials, public agencies, economic development organizations, and private-sector stakeholders that influence community investment and resource allocation

  • Demonstrated ability to establish, maintain, and draw upon productive professional relationships with elected officials, government administrators, business leaders, community organizations, and other institutional stakeholders

  • Strong interpersonal, communication, negotiation, and relationship-management skills

  • Ability to engage effectively across political, organizational, and community boundaries

Licenses & Requirements

  • No specific licenses, certifications, or accreditations are required

People Management Experience

  • Direct supervisory experience is preferred but not required

  • Must demonstrate the ability to lead cross-functional projects and influence others without direct supervisory authority

Preferred Qualifications

  • Established productive professional relationships with local, state, and federal elected officials, government administrators, business leaders, economic development organizations, and other institutional stakeholders in Southern Ohio, particularly Pike County

  • Substantial familiarity with the political landscape, governmental decision-making processes, public funding mechanisms, and institutional relationships affecting Southern Ohio and Appalachian communities

  • Demonstrated ability to navigate governmental and institutional structures effectively while maintaining productive relationships across political and organizational boundaries

  • Experience working with county commissioners, municipal governments, state agencies, legislative offices, congressional offices, private businesses, and community organizations to advance shared initiatives, secure resources, and develop sustainable partnerships

  • Familiarity with major regional economic development initiatives, infrastructure investment, workforce development, and the relationship between economic growth and community well-being

  • Experience translating economic-development opportunities into meaningful benefits for local residents

  • Demonstrated success identifying, cultivating, negotiating, and securing corporate, philanthropic, governmental, or other financial commitments supporting organizational priorities, capital investments, or community-development initiatives

  • Experience coordinating complex, multi-year projects involving multiple organizations, governmental entities, funding sources, and community stakeholders

  • Demonstrated ability to move strategic initiatives from conceptual development toward implementation

  • Established professional reputation for integrity, sound judgment, discretion, collaboration, and effectiveness

  • Demonstrated understanding of the economic and social challenges facing Southern Ohio communities

  • Demonstrated commitment to nonpartisan engagement, ethical public service, community empowerment, and collaborative leadership consistent with the agency’s mission, vision, and organizational values

Working Conditions

  • Position is based in a well-lighted office environment

  • Requires occasional local and regional travel of up to approximately 30%

  • Travel may include engagement with agency programs, departments, community partners, and regulatory agencies

  • Occasional evening and weekend work or travel may be required

  • Work is fast-paced and self-directed

  • Position involves multiple, sometimes competing priorities

  • Requires management of complex projects, details, relationships, and timelines

  • Work may involve moderate-to-high levels of stress

title: Senior Java Engineer - Distributed Systems, Serverless - Elasticsearch
description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What Is The Role:

We are on the lookout for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Elasticsearch - Distributed Systems team and focus on how Elasticsearch provides scale, performance, and resilience, especially in the context of our Serverless offering. You will be tackling deep distributed systems challenges in how nodes in an Elasticsearch cluster communicate, and how data are indexed, allocated, and managed across nodes.

What You Will Be Doing:

  • Leveraging your distributed systems expertise to build, and operate core pieces of our next-generation Serverless Elasticsearch offering, directly impacting the experience of customers worldwide.
  • Improving Elasticsearch’s components that support concurrent and consistent indexing across multiple machines.
  • Maintaining our cluster coordination system to keep performance high even though nodes come and go from the cluster and data moves around, while maintaining the safety and liveness properties of the system as a whole.
  • Pushing the limits on the number of shards, nodes, and petabytes that Elasticsearch can handle today.
  • Looking into all kinds of issues, including performance or concurrency issues, and proposing solutions.
  • Supporting our support engineers with the harder problems.
  • Owning operational investigations end-to-end, until performance or stability issues are successfully resolved.

What You Bring:

  • You have a deep background in distributed systems and consensus algorithms.
  • You have strong skills in core Java and are conversant in the standard library of data structures and concurrency constructs, as well as newer language features.
  • You have a deep technical proficiency in algorithms.
  • You have shown your ability to understand and work on complex, highly distributed systems, rather than making use of off-the-shelf services.
  • You demonstrate the ability to build and debug features with a broad impact, running on multiple machines.
  • You are able to own projects from beginning to end. This covers both technical design and working with others to develop needed components.
  • You have a proven track record of using AI to accelerate development, debug complex systems, and optimize code, while still owning the final outcomes.
  • You possess the ability to collaborate across functions and teams and seamlessly transition between different projects, codebases, or teams based on business priorities.
  • You can work autonomously, drive decisions and results in a distributed team by leveraging asynchronous, direct, and transparent communication.

Bonus Points:

  • Data stores
  • Search, analytics, Lucene
  • Strong knowledge of the JDK
  • Asynchronous event-driven network frameworks such as Netty.

Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People

As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.

We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.

  • Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary
  • Health coverage for you and your family in many locations
  • Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles
  • Generous number of vacation days each year
  • Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service
  • Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love
  • Embracing parenthood with minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave

Different people approach problems differently. We need that. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law, ordinance or regulation.

title: Delivery CritSit Expert
description:
The CritSit Industry Expert is a senior member of the Critical Situations team. Your mission is to rapidly diagnose, stabilise and resolve complex customer crises on Sapiens insurance platforms, combining deep insurance expertise, technical curiosity, rigorous root cause analysis and unconventional problem solving.

You are an insurance expert with an engineering mindset who takes personal ownership of finding a viable solution. You work out what the product should be doing, what it is doing and what the business needs, then define the fix and drive it to resolution with Product Engineering, Delivery and CloudOps.

You bring deep expertise in one line of business: P&C, Life and Annuities, or Reinsurance. You stay composed when the customer is under pressure, explain complex problems simply, and insist on root cause rather than symptom relief.

This is an individual contributor role reporting to Critical Situations leadership, working alongside CritSit Managers, Engineering, Delivery and Support. Based at a regional hub, hybrid, with on-site visits at short notice.

Responsibilities

  • Join critical situations early and diagnose them rapidly, working out how the product, configuration, data and the customer's business process interact.
  • Analyse business requirements, product behaviour, logs and data extracts, and test hypotheses until the cause is clear.
  • Use approved AI tools to speed up analysis of logs, documentation and past cases, and verify every output before relying on it or sharing it with a customer.
  • Define a working fix or safe workaround that stabilises the customer's live operation, and agree it with Engineering and Delivery.
  • Translate business impact into clear requirements, expected behaviour and acceptance criteria, and stay accountable until the customer confirms resolution.
  • Design and assess unconventional solutions, such as process changes or configuration alternatives, weighing business and product risk before recommending them.
  • Find and document the root cause of every escalation, verify the fix holds, and prevent repeats: no stabilised escalation recurs within 90 days.
  • Turn each case into reusable diagnostics and fixes, and add them to the playbook every quarter.
  • Explain complex problems and options simply to customer executives, delivery leads and engineers, and give the CritSit Manager accurate findings and next steps.
  • Work with Support, Delivery, Engineering and Product to hand over fixes, share product know-how, and give clear feedback on gaps, defects and enhancement needs.
  • Keep current with Sapiens platform releases and the customer's configuration, so diagnosis starts from knowledge, not guesswork.

Requirements

  • 10+ years in insurance core systems, on the insurer, consultancy or vendor side, with deep expertise in one line: P&C, Life and Annuities, or Reinsurance.
  • Process depth in that line: product and rating, policy administration, billing and claims; for Reinsurance, treaty and facultative, cessions, bordereaux and accounting.
  • Strong product knowledge of core insurance platforms, with a working understanding of data models, integrations and data migration, enough to analyse problems and direct technical teams.
  • Strong business analysis skills, including requirements elicitation, process mapping, impact analysis and root cause analysis.
  • Practical experience applying AI to problem solving, such as analysing logs, documentation and past cases, with sound judgement to verify outputs and protect customer data.
  • A track record of resolving live problems in production or troubled implementations by defining the solution and working with technical teams to deliver it.
  • Ability to explain complex problems simply to executives and engineers alike.
  • Fluent English, hybrid working from a regional hub, and availability to be on site at short notice.
An advantage: experience of Sapiens platforms such as IDIT, CoreSuite and ReinsurancePro, cloud and SaaS experience, an underwriting or actuarial background, and data analysis skills or a business analysis certification.

title: Työhön osallistuva työnjohtaja Vaasaan
description:

Työtehtävät

  • Spottereiden ja tulityövahtien päivittäisen työn johtaminen ja organisointi.

  • Oman ryhmän työn seuranta ja valvonta.

  • Työtehtävien ja työturvallisuusohjeiden noudattamisen varmistaminen.

  • Toimiminen tarvittaessa itse spotterina ja tulityövahtina.

  • Yhteydenpito työmaan muun työnjohdon kanssa.

  • Työryhmän päivittäisen toiminnan ja työturvallisuuden varmistaminen.

Odotamme sinulta

  • Voimassa olevaa tulityökorttia.

  • Voimassa olevaa työturvallisuuskorttia.

  • Sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa.

  • Hyviä organisointi- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja.

  • Oma-aloitteista, vastuullista ja turvallisuuslähtöistä työotetta.

  • Kykyä toimia sekä esihenkilönä että käytännön työtehtävissä.

Työsuhteen tiedot

  • Työkohde: Datakeskustyömaa

  • Työaika: Maanantaista perjantaihin, noin 10 tuntia päivässä.

  • Työnkuva: Työhön osallistuva työnjohtaja / Spotter / Tulityövahti.

Kolahtiko?

Kuulostaa hyvältä, mutta miksi hakisin töitä juuri Amikon kautta?

Amiko tarjoaa kaiken tasoisille ammattilaisille laajan valikoiman töitä. Olemme sinulle reilu, luotettava ja joustava työelämän kumppani. Amikolla on hyvä maine työmarkkinoilla. Pyrimme aina etsimään parhaat mahdolliset ratkaisut työllistymisesi tueksi.

Amikolaisena saat:
• Vähintään TES:in mukaisen palkkauksen-palkkausjärjestelmämme on kannustava, joskus jopa suurempi kuin työllistyessä suoraan yrityksen palkkalistoille.
• Laajasti erilaisia työmahdollisuuksia- meillä on kattavat verkostot ja laaja työpaikkavalikoimaniin osa-aikaisia, kokopäiväisiä kuin sesonkitöitä monelta eri alalta. Kun sopiva työ löytyy, monille tarjoutuu myös mahdollisuus siirtyä vakituiseksi työntekijäksi asiakasyritykseen.
• Oman yhteyshenkilön ja yksilöllistä työnhakua – Amikolta saat henkilökohtaista palvelua ja oman tutun yhteyshenkilön, johon voit olla suoraan yhteydessä.
• Kattavat työterveyspalvelut, normaalin eläkekertymän ja sairausajan palkan sairauden sattuessa – Vaikka teetkin työsi asiakasyrityksessämme, olet amikolainen ja kannamme sinusta vastuun ja huolehdimme eduistasi.
• … vai kenties jotain ihan uutta urallesi? Autamme myös alanvaihdossa. Räätälöidyt uravalmennukset auttavat päivittämään osaamistasi ja löytämään uuden suunnan urallasi.

Voisiko tässä olla sinulle uusi työpaikka?

Toimimme asiakkaallemme rekrytointikumppanina, käsittelemme saapuvat työhakemukset sekä vastaamme ensimmäisen vaiheen haastatteluista. Jätäthän hakemuksesi pikimmiten tai soita Amikon Visalle 050 470 6073 ja nappaa itsellesi uusi huippuduuni!

Aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana ja täytämme paikan heti sopivien henkilön löydyttyä.

Huomioithan, että emme käsittele sähköpostitse vastaanotettuja hakemuksia vaan jätäthän hakemuksen nettisivujemme kautta tietosuojasyistä.

Please note that we do not process applications submitted by e-mail, so please submit your application via our website for privacy and data protection reasons.

title: Senior Tax Analyst - Pillar II
description:
This is a hybrid role with the flexibility to work both virtually and from our Krakow office as part of a global tax team.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive, diverse team, and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

You will be part of Aon’s global Pillar II team and will work closely with the Manager – Tax Reporting Pillar II based in Amsterdam, as well as regional tax and finance teams around the world.

What the day will look like

As a Senior Tax Analyst – Pillar II, you will support the implementation and ongoing compliance of the OECD/GloBE Pillar II rules across Aon’s global structure. Under the guidance of the Manager – Tax Reporting Pillar II, you will:

  • Assist with the preparation of Pillar II calculations and related workpapers for jurisdictions within Aon’s global footprint.

  • Support the gathering, validation, and analysis of financial and tax data required for Pillar II calculations and reporting.

  • Help with the integration and maintenance of Pillar II data and processes in Aon’s tax systems and tools (e.g., Orbitax or similar).

  • Assist in the preparation of quarterly Pillar II calculations for group and SEC reporting in close coordination with the tax accounting team.

  • Support the monitoring of global and local Pillar II legislative developments and help translate them into practical data and process requirements.

  • Prepare and maintain documentation to support Pillar II calculations, controls, and internal governance requirements.

  • Provide support for internal and external audit requests related to Pillar II (including SOX-related documentation where applicable).

  • Collaborate with tax managers across regions, local finance teams and external advisors in connection with Pillar II data requests, reviews, and compliance.

  • Contribute to process improvements, standardization and automation initiatives within the Pillar II reporting and compliance framework.

How this opportunity is different

You will have the opportunity to work as part of a truly global tax team, focused on one of the most significant international tax reforms in recent years. You will:

  • Gain hands-on experience with Pillar II data, calculations and reporting for a large multinational group.

  • Work closely with the Manager – Tax Reporting Pillar II and a network of regional tax managers, local finance teams and external advisors.

  • Help shape and improve new processes, controls and tools in an evolving regulatory landscape.

Skills and experience that will lead to success

  • Fluent in English (written and spoken).

title: Senior Java Engineer - Distributed Systems, Serverless - Elasticsearch
description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What Is The Role:

We are on the lookout for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Elasticsearch - Distributed Systems team and focus on how Elasticsearch provides scale, performance, and resilience, especially in the context of our Serverless offering. You will be tackling deep distributed systems challenges in how nodes in an Elasticsearch cluster communicate, and how data are indexed, allocated, and managed across nodes.

What You Will Be Doing:

  • Leveraging your distributed systems expertise to build, and operate core pieces of our next-generation Serverless Elasticsearch offering, directly impacting the experience of customers worldwide.
  • Improving Elasticsearch’s components that support concurrent and consistent indexing across multiple machines.
  • Maintaining our cluster coordination system to keep performance high even though nodes come and go from the cluster and data moves around, while maintaining the safety and liveness properties of the system as a whole.
  • Pushing the limits on the number of shards, nodes, and petabytes that Elasticsearch can handle today.
  • Looking into all kinds of issues, including performance or concurrency issues, and proposing solutions.
  • Supporting our support engineers with the harder problems.
  • Owning operational investigations end-to-end, until performance or stability issues are successfully resolved.

What You Bring:

  • You have a deep background in distributed systems and consensus algorithms.
  • You have strong skills in core Java and are conversant in the standard library of data structures and concurrency constructs, as well as newer language features.
  • You have a deep technical proficiency in algorithms.
  • You have shown your ability to understand and work on complex, highly distributed systems, rather than making use of off-the-shelf services.
  • You demonstrate the ability to build and debug features with a broad impact, running on multiple machines.
  • You are able to own projects from beginning to end. This covers both technical design and working with others to develop needed components.
  • You have a proven track record of using AI to accelerate development, debug complex systems, and optimize code, while still owning the final outcomes.
  • You possess the ability to collaborate across functions and teams and seamlessly transition between different projects, codebases, or teams based on business priorities.
  • You can work autonomously, drive decisions and results in a distributed team by leveraging asynchronous, direct, and transparent communication.

Bonus Points:

  • Data stores
  • Search, analytics, Lucene
  • Strong knowledge of the JDK
  • Asynchronous event-driven network frameworks such as Netty.

Compensation for this role is in the form of base salary. This role does not have a variable compensation component.

Salary ranges are established based on a combination of external market benchmarks, internal pay equity considerations, and the responsibilities and complexity associated with each role. This approach helps ensure consistency across comparable roles while remaining competitive within the relevant labour markets.

€67.000—€106.000 EUR

As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. title: YDP - ART (Jacksonville STEM Academy)
description:
YOUTH DEVELOPMENT PROFESSIONAL - ART (Jacksonville STEM Academy)


This position is designed to foster creativity in young people and give them outlets for self-expression. From photography to hip-hop, our arts programs have something that will inspire everyone.

The Art Youth Development Professional is part of a team-oriented Club staff dedicated to serving our youth and creating an optimal Club Experience. This position will plan, supervise and implement a variety of high-yield activities and targeted programs within a health and life skills focus.

This position is responsible for: ensuring youth development principles are incorporated into art programs and activities; providing guidance and discipline to ensure a safe and positive environment for youth; ensuring the incorporation of character development, age appropriate and gender-specific programs and activities; ensuring that culturally diverse programs are implemented; assisting, as needed, in the planning, implementation, and delivery of activities and programs for youth ages 6 to 18.

Visual Arts – Visual art created and judged for its beauty and meaning. It may include painting, sculpture, drawing, printmaking, collage, mixed media, graphics and architecture.

Digital Arts – Two- or three-dimensional visual media that uses computers and other technology as an essential part of the creative process. This may include graphic design, animation, photography, movie making, Claymation, game design, music composition and digital illustration.

Performing Arts – Arts that involve public performance, including playing instruments, acting, singing and dancing. This includes performance support roles, such as creating scenery, costumes, lighting and sound manipulation.

Applied Arts – Any art form that applies artistic design to functional objects. This includes industrial design, bookmaking, illustration, printmaking, jewelry making, wood working, ceramics, fashion design, culinary arts, creative writing and commercial art.

KEY ROLES (Essential Job Responsibilities):

Prepare Youth for Success

This position’s primary responsibilities are:

  • Planning and implementing a variety of art programs for members of all ages, including National Arts Contests, Drama Matters, Lyrism 101, Music Makers, Media Making, & National Photography Program.
  • Recruiting and retaining youth for art programs
  • Working with other staff in the club to help implement these programs throughout the school year

This position helps members to make appropriate choices about their education, career, social, physical and emotional needs as it relates to health and their future goals. The position also assesses the developmental needs, interests and characteristics of youth to develop targeted programs that result in an outcome-driven club experience.

  1. Ensure programs, services and activities prepare youth for success, promoting safety of members, quality in programs and appearance of Club at all times. Provide guidance and role modeling to members.
  2. Contribute to the planning and implementation of the strategic plan by:
  • Planning and organizing a range of program services and activities for members, such as field trips, program specific activities, guest speakers, field trips, etc.
  • Initiating new programs with the approval of the Program Director/Unit Director.
  • Promoting and stimulating program participation.
  1. Ensure quality improvement by monitoring and evaluating program achievement against target goals, recommending modifications that respond to member needs and interests and participating in weekly Club staff meetings.

  1. Participate in local, state, regional, and national Boys & Girls Clubs art programs and competitions.

Health and Safety

  1. Ensure a healthy and safe environment, supervising members in program area.
  2. Maintain the cleanliness of program area.
  3. Maintain an inventory of program equipment and supplies in good order. Recommend requisitions as necessary.

Program Administration

  1. Prepare weekly reports for the Program Director/Unit Director regarding activities, special programs, upcoming events, attendance, and other reports as required.
  2. Maintains a daily written schedule. Ensures that programs begin and end on time.

ADDITIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES

  1. May participate in additional special programs and/or events.
  2. Evenings/weekend work may be involved.
  3. May be required to drive Club van.
    • (Requires valid driver’s license & three-year clean driving record)
  4. Other duties as assigned.

RELATIONSHIPS:

Internal: Maintains close, daily contact with club staff and volunteers, club members, and supervisor to receive/provide information, discuss issues, explain guidelines/instructions; instruct; and advise/counsel.

Requirements

Education

High School diploma or GED

Ability to pass DCF Level II background screening and drug test

Experience

  • Knowledge of youth development
  • Ability to motivate youth and manage behavior issues
  • Ability to work with the public
  • Ability to plan and implement quality programs specific The Arts
  • Ability to organize and supervise members in a safe environment

WORK ENVIRONMENT:

This position generally works M – F, 2.5 - 3 hours per day between the hours of 2PM – 7PM, but may require longer hours outside of this schedule and occasional weekends when necessary. Work is conducted indoors and outdoors.

PHYSICAL AND MENTAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Ability to sit, stand and walk for long periods of time; bending and squatting on occasion
  • Ability to lift to 20 lbs. on occasion
  • Ability to hear at a normal conversational level
  • Ability to maintain high energy level when necessary
  • High degree of emotional intelligence

You’ll join a collaborative, global team pushing the boundaries of scientific innovation. Your ideas and efforts will have a tangible impact, accelerating scientific progress and discovery. Combined, we are now the world’s largest cloud-based scientific research R&D platform. We need your help to keep growing and pioneering the future.

We are Science Driven. We are Customer Centric. We are Better Together.

What do we need

Dotmatics is seeking a DevOps Engineer to join our team working on ground-breaking Scientific Software products such as Luma. In this role, you will have the opportunity to apply your knowledge to help improve our processes, infrastructure and security by applying best practices with the latest technologies. You will be AI fluent and know how AI influences engineering and DevOps

In this role you will get to:

  • Design and manage CI/CD and deployment pipelines for both AWS-native and Kubernetes-based applications
  • Provide advice/assistance to the product teams, clarifying requirements for deployment
  • Collaborate with product teams on cloud and container best practices
  • Manage IT infrastructure in cloud computing environments
  • Automation: Use CI tools to automate code changes, builds, testing, and analysis
  • Monitoring: Monitor performance after release
  • Develop and improve monitoring systems for automated alerts
  • Strategy: Design and manage the DevOps infrastructure, pipelines, and processes
  • SECURITY: Embed security into every stage of the delivery lifecycle (DevSecOps), including automated SAST, DAST, dependency, secrets, and container image scanning in CI/CD pipelines
  • SECURITY: Implement and enforce least-privilege IAM, network segmentation, encryption in transit and at rest, and secrets management (e.g. AWS Secrets Manager, Vault, KMS)
  • SECURITY: Harden Kubernetes clusters and cloud environments using policy-as-code, admission controls, runtime protection, and CIS/NIST benchmarks
  • SECURITY: Support vulnerability management, incident response, audit readiness, and compliance efforts (e.g. SOC 2, ISO 27001)
  • AI: Use AI-assisted tooling to accelerate pipeline development, infrastructure code, troubleshooting, and incident analysis
  • AI: Apply AI/ML-driven capabilities to monitoring, including anomaly detection, alert noise reduction, and automated root-cause analysis
  • AI: Build and operate deployment pipelines and infrastructure for AI/ML and LLM-based workloads, including model serving, GPU-enabled clusters, and cost controls
  • AI: Establish guardrails for responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data privacy, access controls, and review of AI-generated code and configuration

We are looking for people who have 8+ years of experience maintaining high-traffic applications and complex technical infrastructure. You will be someone with a proven background in supporting cloud environments, with hands-on experience translating AWS Well-Architected principles into action.

The key skills we are looking for:

  • Kubernetes clusters/customer cloud environments
  • AWS (ECS, EKS, ALB, EC2, S3, RDS, CloudFront, Route53, etc.)
  • Infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi)
  • CI/CD tools (Octopus Deploy, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, TeamCity, CodePipeline, etc.)
  • APMs and logging (e.g. Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, ELK, App Insights)
  • Networking concepts in cloud environments
  • Software development lifecycle processes/version control
  • Security: DevSecOps practices, AWS security services (IAM, GuardDuty, Security Hub, WAF, Config, KMS), container and supply chain security (image signing, SBOMs), and security scanning tools (e.g. Trivy, Snyk, SonarQube, Checkov)
  • Security: Familiarity with Kubernetes security (RBAC, network policies, Pod Security Standards, OPA/Kyverno) and secrets management
  • AI: Practical experience using AI coding and operations assistants (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Claude, Amazon Q) to improve engineering productivity
  • AI: Understanding of how to deploy and operate AI/ML workloads (e.g. Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, model-serving on Kubernetes) and observe their performance and cost
  • AI: Awareness of AI-specific risks such as prompt injection, data leakage, and insecure AI-generated code

You may also have:

  • Scripting languages (e.g. Python, Bash)
  • Linux administration and networking (e.g. HTTP/2)
  • Microservice and serverless architectures
  • Experience with GitOps tooling (e.g. Argo CD, Flux)
  • Experience building internal tooling or agents that apply AI to DevOps workflows (e.g. automated incident triage, ChatOps)
  • Relevant certifications (e.g. AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, AWS Security Specialty, CKA/CKS)
  • Databases (e.g. PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB)
  • Exposure to AI-enabled tooling or workflows, with openness to incorporating AI into day-to-day work

Total Rewards

Dotmatics utilises a national market-based approach to base pay benchmarking and pay band development. The candidate's final starting pay is based on job-related skills, experience, job specific qualifications & location. In addition to base salary, Dotmatics has implemented a total rewards strategy, which is the combination of compensation, benefits and recognition.

Certain positions are also eligible for variable pay; your recruiter will discuss the full compensation package details.

  • Health Spending Accounts
  • Wellness Benefits (Mental Health Apps and Fitness Perks)
  • Company-paid Life and Disability Insurance
  • 401k Retirement Plan (with 4% company match; immediate vesting)

$122,187—$165,311 USD

title: Fixed Equipment Engineer
description:
Position Summary

The Fixed Equipment Engineer provides technical expertise and engineering support for the inspection, reliability, maintenance, repair, and lifecycle management of fixed equipment throughout the chemical manufacturing facility. This position improves equipment reliability, maintains mechanical integrity, investigates equipment failures, and helps ensure fixed equipment is operated and maintained in accordance with applicable codes, recognized and generally accepted good engineering practices (RAGAGEP), and company standards.
The engineer works closely with Operations, Maintenance, Inspection, Process Engineering, EHS, and capital project teams to support the safe and reliable operation of pressure vessels, piping systems, heat exchangers, storage tanks, reactors, boilers, and other stationary process equipment. The role also supports plant outages and turnarounds, equipment inspections, repair recommendations, root cause investigations, and long-term reliability improvements.

Education and Experience

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a closely related engineering discipline from an accredited institution.
  • General understanding of pressure vessels, process piping, heat exchangers, tanks, and other fixed equipment.
  • Familiarity with mechanical integrity and inspection programs in PSM-covered facilities.
  • Ability to interpret P&IDs, equipment drawings, inspection reports, engineering specifications, and applicable codes.

Preferred

  • Experience in fixed equipment, mechanical integrity, inspection, or reliability engineering in a chemical or petrochemical facility.
  • Experience troubleshooting mechanical equipment problems and developing practical engineering solutions.
  • Knowledge of corrosion and degradation mechanisms encountered in chemical processing environments.
  • Experience supporting major plant turnarounds.
  • Experience with Chempax or another computerized maintenance management system.

Job Title:

Location:

Bangalore

Position Type:

Full-Time

Position Summary

The Billing Analyst plays a critical role in delivering accurate and timely billing that supports the organization's customer experience. This role is responsible for managing daily billing operations, validating invoices, processing RMAs, and ensuring all activities meet internal SLAs and audit standards. The ideal candidate will be detail-oriented, process-driven, and comfortable collaborating with cross-functional teams to resolve discrepancies and drive continuous improvement. This position offers the opportunity to contribute directly to revenue accuracy, operational efficiency, and overall customer satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage daily billing queues in Salesforce, including credit/debit adjustments, ensuring all cases are completed within SLA timelines.
  • Perform end-to-end processing of RMAs, including verification, approval follow-ups, and system entry.
  • Track RMA status, resolve pending approvals, and proactively escalate aging cases.
  • Identify billing discrepancies and ensure timely resolution before billing release.
  • Maintain dashboards and trackers for productivity, RMA status updates, billing accuracy, and quality control results.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to resolve billing and operational issues.
  • Ensure adherence to compliance requirements, audit standards, and internal SLAs.
  • Support process improvement initiatives to enhance billing accuracy and efficiency.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • 2+ years of experience in billing operations, accounts receivable, order management, or a related function.
  • Working knowledge of billing processes and financial operations.
  • Experience using CRM and business applications, preferably Salesforce.
  • Intermediate proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.
  • Strong attention to detail with a high standard of accuracy.
  • Excellent organizational and time-management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience processing RMAs, credit/debit adjustments, and invoice validation.
  • Familiarity with SLA-driven environments and compliance requirements.
  • Experience creating and maintaining operational dashboards and reports.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Effective communication and stakeholder management capabilities.
  • Ability to manage workload during month-end close and high-volume billing cycles.
  • Experience working in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment.

title: Technical Support Specialist - German Fluency
description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

You will be a part of our frontline support team made up of highly skilled and professional Technical Support Specialists. You will be responsible for responding to customer requests for technical assistance over the phone and via email. Your work will be fast-paced and independent in nature as you will be expected to manage yourself in a way to be available to respond quickly to our customers. Your work will also be collaborative, working together with other support representatives in multiple support locations to serve our customers.

Experience in a technical support role, proven customer-facing skills, and strong English communication skills are a must. You should be comfortable handling complex technical issues and working in a fast-paced support environment.

Location/Working Pattern: This is a remote position open to candidates based in the UK

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-caliber team that will encourage you to do your best.

In this Role, You Will:

  • Serve as the initial technical point of contact for basic and complex customer issues, working collaboratively within your first-line support team, across engineering, and product teams to deliver comprehensive solutions.
  • Provide in-depth technical troubleshooting for advanced issues across Samsara’s SaaS platform, hardware devices, and integrations, leveraging a deep understanding of networking, cloud technologies, and IoT systems.
  • Actively contribute to knowledge base development by documenting detailed resolutions, creating technical guides, and mentoring junior agents on your team.
  • Proactively identify trends in customer issues to influence product improvements and optimize support processes, driving continuous enhancement of the customer experience.
  • Deliver professional and clear communication to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, ensuring seamless resolution of escalated issues while maintaining a high level of customer satisfaction.
  • Champion Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team), driving innovation and collaboration within the team and across departments.

Minimum Requirements for this Role:

  • Language: Fluency in German
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree or higher in a technical discipline (e.g., Computer Science, Engineering, Networking) or equivalent experience.
  • Experience: 3+ years of experience in a technical product support or specialist role, preferably within SaaS, IoT, or networking environments. Proven track record of handling complex technical escalations and collaborating across departments to resolve advanced customer issues.

Technical Expertise: An understanding of networking concepts (e.g., TCP/IP, VPNs, DNS), cloud-based architectures, and hardware troubleshooting. Foundational knowledge in Artificial Intelligence.

  • Leadership: Demonstrated ability to mentor and guide junior team members, fostering skill development and knowledge sharing. Experience leading projects or initiatives aimed at improving operational efficiency and customer satisfaction.
  • Problem Solving: Analytical mindset with a proactive approach to identifying, troubleshooting, and resolving both technical and process-related challenges. Exceptional organizational skills to manage multiple escalations, prioritize workload effectively, and meet critical deadlines.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • French Fluency
  • General knowledge about electrical circuits, GPS and telematics.
  • Familiarity with networking protocols, APIs, and diagnostic tools is highly desirable
  • Proficiency in using diagnostic tools, APIs, and scripting (e.g., Python, Bash) to automate troubleshooting and issue resolution.
  • Advanced certifications (e.g., CCNA, AWS Certified Solutions Architect) are a strong plus.
  • Experience integrating and troubleshooting third-party applications and systems with APIs and webhooks.
  • Familiarity with Slack and Google Workplace applications (Gmail, Google Docs, etc.)
  • Flexibility: Availability to work flexible hours, including nights and weekends, and provide on-call support as needed for high-impact customer cases.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

  • Manage project changes, including cost and schedule impacts.
